article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Nigeria must act fast
article.articleSummary: Nigeria faces a potential importation of Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) from the Bundibugyo strain, with no confirmed cases yet but real and growing risk as East/Central Africa experiences an outbreak in DR Congo and Uganda—over 1,000 suspected cases and hundreds of deaths. The Bundibugyo strain lacks an approved vaccine, heightening the need for prevention, surveillance, and rapid response. Nigeria’s 2014 outbreak, which killed eight people including Patrick Sawyer and Dr. Stella Adadevoh, underscores the urgency. Authorities should bolster screening, surveillance, isolation centers, laboratories, and emergency operations centers; train healthcare workers; and tighten border vigilance at airports, seaports, and land borders. Public awareness on Ebola symptoms (sudden fever, weakness, headache, muscle pains, sore throat, vomiting, diarrhea, stomach pain, rashes), transmission via direct contact with blood or body fluids or contaminated surfaces, and animal exposure is essential. Emphasize rapid reporting, contact tracing, and avoidance of unsafe burial practices to prevent community spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ナイジェリアは迅速に対応しなければならない
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。ブンディブギョ株によるエボラ出血熱の国際的な流行拡大（DRC、ウガンダで1,000超の疑いケースと数百の死亡）があり、ナイジェリアへの流入リスクが極めて高い。公式ワクチンが無く、ナイジェリアの2014年アウトブレイク履歴（8人死亡）を踏まえると対応能力と国際関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事はナイジェリアでのエボラ流入リスク警告が主題だが、実際の確定ケースはDRC/ウガンダの地域アウトブレイクであり、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。ウガンダ・モザンビーク・ナイジェリアも発生地域に含まれているが、記事では DRC/ウガンダでの流行が主で、ナイジェリアは潜在的な輸入リスク段階であり確定ケースなし。IHR基準4項目全て該当し、WPRO基準も5項目全て満たすため、フルRRA対象として PICKUP と判定。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго выявили свыше 320 случаев заражения вирусом Эбола - Новости на Вести.ru
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 320 cases of Ebola virus infection detected in DR Congo - News on Vesti.ru
article.articleSummary: As of June 2, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 321 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 48 deaths. Two days earlier, counts for Congo and Uganda were 263 cases and 43 deaths. Reuters cited official data. The rapid rise prompted humanitarian concerns, with Doctors Without Borders warning of unprecedented spread and urging expanded testing, intensified international medical and humanitarian assistance, and guaranteed access to affected regions. The report highlights the ongoing regional outbreak and the need for robust surveillance and transmission control; no details on laboratory confirmation methods or infection source are provided beyond the tallies and calls for action.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルス感染320例以上が検出 - Vesti.ruニュース
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は典型的なIHR Annex2基準該当疾患であり、短期間での症例急増（263→321例、2日間）、複数国への拡大（DRC＋ウガンダ）、国際人道支援要請という複合的なリスク要因が認められる。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。記事サマリーはエボラ流行のDRC中心の記述であり、DRCが主要発生地として適切に特定される。死亡率（48/321≈15%）は高く、医療体制の限界と国際支援の必要性が指摘されている。フルRRAへの進行が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief flags possible underreporting of Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: On 2 June 2026, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus concluded a visit to the Democratic Republic of Congo, briefing President Félix Tshisekedi on efforts to contain a Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak. He highlighted ongoing coordination between international partners and national authorities as health teams race to stop transmission in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. Health officials say the outbreak may have gone undetected for weeks, with hundreds of suspected cases and rising confirmed infections; weak contact tracing and limited surveillance complicate containment in conflict-affected eastern DRC where insecurity and attacks disrupt health operations. There is no approved vaccine for Bundibugyo; CEPIs pledged funding to fast-track development with Moderna. China plans to send medical specialists to support containment. Tedros called for intensified community engagement, improved surveillance, and increased international funding to bring the outbreak under control.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、エボラウイルス病の過少報告の可能性を指摘
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、Bundibugyo Ebola の大規模流行と国際的な対応が進行中。DRCでの複数州での確認感染と疑い患者数の増加、監視体制の弱さと紛争地帯での制御困難性が深刻。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIは中国（China）を発生地域に含めているが、記事サマリーでは中国は医療支援派遣国として言及されており、エボラ発生地ではない。したがってverified_locationsにはDRCのみを含める。Bundibugyo Ebolasはワクチン未承認であり、Modenaとの開発進行中が注記されている。紛争地帯での監視体制の脆弱性が重要な懸念要因。

article.articleHeadline: 78岁阿姨吹一晚上空调肺白了大半 警惕军团菌肺炎
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 78-year-old woman with extensive pulmonary opacities after all-night air-conditioning; beware Legionella pneumonia.
article.articleSummary: 78-year-old woman in Hangzhou, China, developed persistent high fever and extensive right-lung opacities after sleeping with the air conditioner running overnight, later diagnosed with Legionella pneumonia. Legionella bacteria are Gram-negative organisms widely present in natural water sources and artificial water systems; uncleaned air-conditioning condensate pans, filters, and ducts provide ideal growth environments. The elderly, children, and immunocompromised individuals are particularly at risk. Early symptoms—high fever, cough, and fatigue—can resemble ordinary bacterial pneumonia or a cold, risking misdiagnosis. Notably, antibiotics such as cephalosporins and penicillins are ineffective against Legionella, and inappropriate use can delay proper therapy. In severe cases, Legionella pneumonia can progress to respiratory failure and multi-organ failure.

triage.headline_ja: 78歳の叔母が一晩中エアコンを使用して肺が白くなる 軍団菌肺炎に注意
triage.triage_reason: 単一の散発症例報告であり、IHR基準の該当数が少なく、現時点では大規模流行の証拠がない。ただし軍団菌肺炎は重症化リスクがあり、医学教育目的の記事として社会的関心が存在するため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は単一の散発症例（杭州の78歳患者）の臨床的教訓に焦点を当てたもの。軍団菌肺炎は既知の疾患であり、発生自体は『異常』ではない。重症度基準に該当（重度肺炎、呼吸不全のリスク）するが、大規模流行や管理上の課題を示す証拠がない。医学教育記事として公共の関心があるがWHO通知レベルには達していない。

article.articleHeadline: Chaos! Warga Ngamuk Tolak Negaranya Jadi Karantina Virus Mematikan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chaos! Residents riot, oppose their country being turned into a quarantine zone for a deadly virus.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak concerns trigger protests in Kenya as residents of Nanyuki in Laikipia County oppose a planned quarantine facility for exposed Ebola cases at a nearby military base. The project would provide 50 beds to house individuals exposed to Ebola but asymptomatic, funded by the United States at about US$13.5 million. Kenya's High Court temporarily halted the plan, while security forces monitor access to the Laikipia airbase amid demonstrations on June 1, 2026. Kenya has not recorded an Ebola case, even as neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda confront active outbreaks that have killed over 200 people. Health Minister Aden Duale defends the facility as part of strengthening national emergency response, saying it serves all people, not only Americans. Critics urge relocating or permanently closing the facility.

triage.headline_ja: 混乱！住民が暴動、自国が致死的ウイルスの隔離区域になることに反対
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は高い公衆衛生上の懸念疾患であり、DRC・ウガンダでの活動的な流行が存在するが、ケニアでは未報告。本記事は隔離施設計画への社会的反発が主題であり、直接的な感染拡大リスク評価には情報不足。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでのエボラ隔離施設計画への社会的反発であり、ケニアは対象国リスト外のため verified_locations から除外。DRCとウガンダでの活動的流行は触れられているが、本イベントの主要な発生地はDRCのみが対象国に該当。情報不足が多く、続報を注視する段階と判断。

article.articleHeadline: ¿Dónde Se Atenderán los Posibles Casos de Ébola en México? SSA Revela Ubicación
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Where Will Possible Ebola Cases Be Treated in Mexico? SSA Reveals Location.
article.articleSummary: Mexico's Health Secretariat (SSA) states any potential Ebola case will be treated at the Centro Nacional de Investigacion y Atencion de Quemados (CENIAQ) inside the Instituto Nacional de Rehabilitación, per an epidemiological alert. Suspected cases would present with symptoms such as fatigue, vomiting, diarrhea, hyporexia, headache, abdominal pain, severe weakness, myalgias, rash, renal or hepatic impairment, coughing, dysentery, gingivorrhagia, purpura, petechiae, or hematuria; a key diagnostic trigger is residence in Ebola transmission areas within the 21 days prior to symptom onset. The government has barred air travel for the past 21 days from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan. Healthcare workers must use PPE (gloves, gown, N95/KN95 or higher, eye protection, impermeable suit). Federative authorities will conduct contact tracing. The central African outbreak involves Bundibugyo lineage in Ituri, DRC; no vaccine yet, anticipated by late 2026. Ebola transmits via bodily fluids, not aerosols, and overall importation risk to Mexico remains low.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコのエボラ病の可能性のある患者はどこで治療されるのか？SSAが場所を明らかにする
triage.triage_reason: 中央アフリカ（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン）でのエボラ多発生報告に対し、メキシコが公式な対応体制を整備した準備段階の事象。記事では「輸入リスクは低い」と述べられているが、対象国DRCでの多発生と国際的警戒態勢が構築されていることから経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: DRCのIturi州でBundibugyo系統のエボラ多発生が進行中。メキシコは準備段階（症例未確認）だが、DRCからの渡航禁止など国際的な移動制限が既に実施されている。対象国ではDRCのみが該当（ウガンダ、南スーダンは対象国リストに非含）。IHR基準は3つ該当しWPRO基準も2つ該当するがメキシコのリスク評価は「低い」とされているため、WATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura de Lauro de Freitas reforça prevenção e controle do mosquito Aedes aegypti em Itinga
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lauro de Freitas City Hall strengthens prevention and control of the Aedes aegypti mosquito in Itinga
article.articleSummary: Lauro de Freitas, Brazil, strengthens Aedes aegypti control in Itinga, near Parque Santa Rita, with extending actions to Vilas do Atlântico and Buraquinho. On May 29, the Municipal Health Secretariat (SESA) deployed transmission-blocking measures to interrupt dengue, chikungunya, and Zika circulation. When two or more probable cases are identified within 100 meters in the last 15 days, and with clinical or laboratory confirmation or severe/death notifications, the Epidemiological Surveillance unit informs the Vector Control team to delineate an intervention perimeter based on the Local Probable Infection Location (LPI). Within this area, focal larviciding in non-eliminable deposits is performed, along with spatial insecticide application via portable UBV nebulization directed at doors, windows, gaps, verandas, and backyards. Additional activities include active case finding, population education, and intersectoral municipal coordination to strengthen surveillance and community participation, reducing arbovirus risk and protecting residents.

triage.headline_ja: ラウロ・デ・フレイタス市がイチンガ地区のネッタイシマカ（Aedes aegypti）の予防と制御を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるデング熱、チクングニア熱、ジカ熱に関する媒介蚊制御強化のニュースであり、症例発生の検出・確認と制御対応を示唆しているが、事例数・重症度・国際的拡大リスク等の具体的情報が不足しており、継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルのラウロ・デ・フレイタス市における媒介蚊制御の強化と対応措置を報告しており、これはデング熱、チクングニア熱、ジカ熱の伝播リスクがあることを示唆している。ただし、検出された確定症例数、重症者数、死亡者数などの具体的な疫学情報が記載されていないため、事態の重大性を判断する上で情報が不足している。スクリーニング基準で「prolonged_exposure」と「epidemic_prone」に該当するため、継続監視対象（WATCH）として位置づけることが適切。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo registrerer 321 bekræftede tilfælde af ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo records 321 confirmed cases of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports 321 confirmed Ebola cases across three eastern provinces, with 48 deaths, as of 2026-06-02. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo variant, transmitted via direct contact with bodily fluids from infected individuals. Government data cited by Reuters show an update from 282 cases earlier in the month to 321. The WHO has raised the risk assessment from high to very high for Ebola in DR Congo; no approved vaccine or treatment exists specifically for the Bundibugyo variant, though survival is possible with timely diagnosis and proper medical care. Four nurses treated for Bundibugyo Ebola in Bunia, capital of Ituri province, were discharged after recovery. The outbreak is being actively managed with intensified response efforts and emphasis on early case detection.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がエボラ確認症例321件を記録
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病の確認された大規模アウトブレイク（321例、48死亡）であり、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、Bundibugyo variant という異常な特性、国際的拡大リスク、およびWHOが「very high」にリスク評価を引き上げたことから国際的な渡航・貿易制限の懸念が存在。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の確認された大規模なアウトブレイクであり、WHO がリスク評価を「high」から「very high」に引き上げている。Bundibugyo variant には認可されたワクチンや治療法がないため、管理難度が高い。発生地域はコンゴ民主共和国の東部3州（Ituri、Bunia を含む）に限定。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو: ارتفاع حالات الإصابة المؤكدة بـإيبولا إلى 321
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: Confirmed Ebola cases rise to 321
article.articleSummary: As of June 2, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 321 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases, with 48 deaths, as the outbreak unfolds across three provinces. Government data confirm the infections are confirmed and deaths attributed to Ebola, indicating sustained transmission in multiple regions. The article provides no symptom profile, diagnostic methods beyond 'confirmed', infection sources, or details on imported or exported cases. The figures signal a rising public health burden and underscore the need for intensified surveillance, contact tracing, and medical response capacity, including cross-provincial coordination to curb transmission. No additional context on vaccination campaigns or specific containment measures is included.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：確認されたエボラ症例が321件に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常なアウトブレイク、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病の確認症例321件、死亡48件という重大な急性感染症イベントで、複数州での持続的な伝播を示唆している。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は病原体の高致命性（症例致命率14.9%）、複数州での持続的伝播、国際的なヒト-ヒト感染リスク、および対象国の対応能力考慮により、緊急のフルRRA対象。記事サマリーは公式政府データに基づいており、信頼性が高い。追加情報（予防接種キャンペーン、具体的な封じ込め対策）の収集が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 一碗剩米饭吃进ICU 警惕食物中毒风险
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Leftover rice eaten leads to ICU admission — beware the risk of food poisoning.
article.articleSummary: On 2 June 2026, in Jiangmen, Guangdong, China, a 50-year-old man (Mr. Chen) was diagnosed with Bacillus cereus foodborne illness after eating fried rice made from days-old leftovers, requiring ICU care with abdominal pain, diarrhea, and respiratory distress. Known as the “fried rice syndrome,” it has two forms: vomiting-type (onset 0.5–6 hours) and diarrheal-type (2–36 hours). Prevention centers on cooking smaller portions, avoiding leftovers, and refrigerating leftovers in sealed containers, then reheating thoroughly; if using rice, avoid meals kept warm for more than 4 hours. Rice warmers typically hold 60–70°C, but uneven heating can push parts into the 5–60°C “danger zone” where bacteria such as E. coli and Staphylococcus aureus multiply and produce toxins. Regularly clean rice cookers—vent holes, gaskets, and heating plate—using brush with baking soda or detergent after unplugging to prevent contamination.

triage.headline_ja: 残ったご飯を食べてICUに入院 — 食中毒のリスクに警戒を
triage.triage_reason: 単一の散発的食中毒事例であり、集団感染、異常な流行、国際的拡大のリスクはない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準への該当がなく、社会的関心も限定的。
triage.notes: 記事は中国・江門市における単一の散発的なセレウス菌食中毒事例に関するもの。食中毒予防に関する一般的な健康情報提供であり、感染症危機管理の対象となるシグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: La Nación / Paraguay refuerza controles fronterizos ante preocupación mundial de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: La Nación / Paraguay strengthens border controls amid global concern over Ebola
article.articleSummary: As of 2 June 2026, Paraguay's Ministry of Public Health reports intensified health surveillance at points of entry, including airports, ports, and land borders, in response to World Health Organization concerns about Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and two suspected Ebola cases in Brazil that were later ruled negative. Paraguay's National Directorate of Health Surveillance is strengthening preventive measures to reduce importation risk of highly contagious diseases amid reinforced international surveillance due to African Ebola outbreaks. The WHO continues to monitor Ebola in the DRC, a country with a history of outbreaks. Ebola can cause high fever, internal and external bleeding, and high mortality without timely care. Although Paraguay has no Ebola cases, authorities emphasize early detection, isolation of suspected patients, and cross-border coordination.

triage.headline_ja: ラテンアメリカ通信 / パラグアイがエボラに関する世界的懸念の中で国境管理を強化
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行は重大だが、パラグアイは検査結果が陰性で現在患者がない状況。ブラジルの疑い例も陰性確定。地域的な感染症リスク管理対応は見られるが、現段階では未確認症例が主体であり、IHR基準2つ以上の明確な該当は難しい。続報を要注視。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はパラグアイの予防的対応だが、実際のエボラ確定患者はDRCに限定。ブラジルの2例は検査陰性で除外。パラグアイは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に追加しない。IHR基準では2つ該当（深刻な影響＋国際的拡大リスク）するが、実検出患者が限定的であり、スクリーニング基準との合算で判定を保留。

article.articleHeadline: SSM drones to inspect hidden areas in intensified dengue prevention efforts
article.articleSummary: Macau's Health Bureau (SSM) will deploy drones to inspect hard-to-reach areas—airwells, rooftops, and back alleys—to intensify dengue prevention, with drone-based surveillance approved by the Office for Personal Data Protection. May ovitrap index stood at 57%; seven imported dengue cases have been recorded this year, with ongoing transmission risk. Pilot drone inspections began in February and have yielded positive results. Macau identifies 130 sanitation black spots; mosquito-control operations are at least twice monthly and expected to rise to three-to-four times from July, risk permitting. As of April, 801 operations were conducted, including 18 in high-risk locations. More than 900 “three-nil” buildings were inspected in April; 1% high-risk, 17% medium-risk, 82% low-risk. Over four metric tons of waste were removed. Authorities urge eliminating standing water; Aedes albopictus transmits dengue fever and chikungunya, with ongoing monitoring of imported and local risk.

triage.headline_ja: SSM、デング熱対策強化のためドローンを使用して隠れた場所を検査
triage.triage_reason: マカオにおけるデング熱の輸入症例と局所伝播リスクが報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準の複数に該当するが、現在のところ大規模流行の兆候は明確ではなく、情報が限定的。続報の監視が必要。
triage.notes: マカオ（香港・マカオはChina に含める）でのデング熱輸入症例7件と局所伝播リスクが報告。蚊媒介感染症であり、蚊が媒介するChikungunyaも同時に言及されている。防除対策が強化されており、政府の対応が活発。ただし現段階では重症例や死亡の報告がなく、IHR基準は未達成。WPROスクリーニング基準で3項目該当するため、シグナルとして経過観察する価値があるが、情報の詳細度から即座のフルRRA進行とは判断しない。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola cases rise to 343
article.articleSummary: DR Congo Ebola outbreak: confirmed infections have reached 343 in the Ituri Province city of Bunia, Health Minister Roger Kamba said on 2 June 2026. Declared on 15 May 2026, this is the 17th Ebola epidemic in the DRC since 1976, with Bunia remaining the outbreak’s epicenter. Bunia Airport is closed to all but humanitarian flights and is slated to reopen later this week to ease transport of personnel and supplies for the response. Preventative measures, including handwashing stations and temperature screening, have been installed to curb transmission. The response has been intensified after coordination meetings chaired by Prime Minister Judith Suminwa and a government delegation’s visit to Bunia. The update underscores ongoing containment and logistics efforts as authorities push to reinforce the national response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラウイルス感染者数が343人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク）。エボラウイルスはCEPR対象疾患であり、WPRO基準もすべてに該当。即座にフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: エボラウイルスは最高リスク病原体。2026年5月15日宣言、DRC史上17番目の流行。Bunia市が震源地で343人の確定感染者を記録。空港閉鎖、体温スクリーニング導入など対応措置実施中。政府最高レベルでの対応開始により社会的・政治的関心は極めて高い。国際的支援体制の構築が急務。

article.articleHeadline: ทั่วโลกระดมเงินทุน 60 ล้านดอลลาร์ เร่งพัฒนาวัคซีนอีโบลา
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Global fundraising of $60 million to accelerate Ebola vaccine development
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-02, the Coalition for Epidemic Preparedness Innovations (CEPI) announced about $60 million to Moderna and two other vaccine programs to accelerate development of a vaccine for Bundibugyo Ebola Virus (BDBV) as the outbreak continues in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. CEPI's funding aims to speed up research, manufacturing, and clinical testing amid concerns the outbreak could widen. If progress continues, a BDBV vaccine could enter human trials within months, addressing a virus for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. Africa CDC and WHO data show 282 confirmed cases and at least 42 deaths in the DRC, with ~1,100 suspected cases; Uganda has 9 confirmed cases and 1 death. This international effort targets rapid containment.

triage.headline_ja: エボラワクチン開発加速に向け、世界が6000万ドルの資金調達を実施
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、BDBV（ブンディブギョエボラ）の発生が東部DRCで継続中で、ウガンダへの国際的拡大も確認されている。重症度高く、国際的な研究開発支援を必要としている。
triage.notes: BDBV（ブンディブギョエボラウイルス）の発生。DRC東部で282確認例、42死亡、約1,100疑い例。ウガンダでも9確認例、1死亡の国際的拡大。CEPIが$60M資金提供してModerna含む3ワクチンプログラムに資金配分。人治療試験への進展が数ヶ月内に期待される。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当（ウガンダは対象国外）。

article.articleHeadline: Россиянам рассказали о вероятности начала пандемии лихорадки Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russians were told about the likelihood of the onset of an Ebola fever pandemic.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus does not pose a pandemic threat, but wide spread within the African continent remains possible, according to Anna Popova, head of Rospotrebnadzor, in an interview with RIA Novosti. The virus is a contact infection and is not transmitted by airborne, water, or food routes. The Bundibugyo strain requires further study; analysis is currently underway in Uganda by Rospotrebnadzor staff, while the Central Research Institute of Epidemiology has developed a specialized diagnostic test for this rare variant. The agency says it continues to work to prevent infection. Earlier reports noted Ebola outbreaks in war zones in the Democratic Republic of Congo.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア人はエボラ出血熱のパンデミック発生の可能性について知らされた
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスは重大な感染症であり国際的関心も高いが、記事はパンデミックリスク低下を述べており、現時点での具体的な流行悪化を示す証拠に乏しい。ウガンダでの分析段階で、確認された流行ではなく監視段階の報告。
triage.notes: 記事は専門家（ロシア保健当局トップ）による見方であり、パンデミック脅威は低いと評価。DRCでの過去の流行言及とウガンダでの分析進行中の状況が報告されている。現在進行形の大規模流行というより監視・研究段階と解釈される。

article.articleHeadline: Emerging viruses
article.articleSummary: Emerging viruses: Ebola, Nipah, Hantavirus, mpox, and avian influenza remain under global surveillance. Thailand debunked Ebola entry rumors on May 29; a female visitor from the DRC was quarantined in Bamrasnaradura but had no exposure history. Kasetsart University hosted a forum on Thailand’s readiness, noting that zoonotic diseases exceed 200 types and account for about 75% of emerging infections, with climate change accelerating spread via vectors, habitat disruption, wildlife migration, and permafrost thaw. Increased vector activity and closer human–animal contact, along with intensive farming and exotic pets, heighten spillover risk. Prof Dr Ram Rangsin reviewed 2026 epidemics: Ebola, Hantavirus, mpox. Ebola (Bundibugyo ebolavirus) in DRC/Uganda: 223 suspected, 18 confirmed fatalities as of May 29; transmission via direct contact with bodily fluids; no vaccine or FDA-approved treatment for this strain; natural hosts are African fruit bats. Hantavirus linked to a cruise ship: eight cases with severe respiratory illness (three deaths) as of May 8; six lab-confirmed hantavirus, all Andes virus (ANDV).

triage.headline_ja: 新興ウイルスに関する警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準で4項目全て該当。複数の高リスク病原体（Ebola、Hantavirus、mpox）の同時発生、国際的拡大リスク、複数対象国での確認、重篤性が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事はタイの大学での公開フォーラム形式で複数の新興ウイルス脅威を扱っているが、実質的に記事本体で確認されている発生はEbola（DRC/Uganda境域）とHantavirus（クルーズ船関連）。Ugandaはシマリーで直接言及されているものの対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。記事サマリーに「タイの訪問者がDRCから隔離」という渡航関連情報が含まれており、国際的な公衆衛生上の関心が高い。フルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Sân bay Việt Nam tăng cường kiểm soát hành khách từ vùng dịch Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vietnam's airports tighten screening of passengers from Ebola-affected regions.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda prompts tightened airport screening in Vietnam. WHO has declared the Ebola situation a public health emergency of international concern due to cross-border spread. WHO data show 906 suspected cases and 223 deaths in the DRC; the DRC Ministry of Health confirms 282 laboratory-confirmed cases with 42 deaths; Uganda reports 9 cases and 1 death. Vietnam’s Civil Aviation Authority orders airports to strengthen surveillance and health checks for inbound travelers, especially from Ebola-affected regions, with rapid isolation and quarantine for suspected cases. Border health units will coordinate with the Ministry of Health and local authorities to promptly detect infections and prevent entry. The goal is to prevent Ebola entering Vietnam via international air travel.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムの空港がエボラ流行地域からの乗客スクリーニングを強化
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでのエボラアウトブレイクがWHOにより国際的公衆衛生上の懸念事態（PHEIC）と宣言されており、IHR基準の4項目全て該当。複数国での確定症例と死亡が報告され、国際的な検査体制強化が展開されている。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウガンダ（226074）も含まれているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。DRC及びウガンダでの確定症例・死亡とベトナムでの防疫措置の強化が記事の主題。WHO PHEIC宣言による国際的な公衆衛生上の重大性が確認される。

article.articleHeadline: 埃博拉病毒病诊疗方案发布 我国尚无本土及输入性病例报告
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus disease diagnostic and treatment guidelines released; China has not yet reported any domestic or imported cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) diagnostic and treatment guidelines (2026 edition) were released by China’s National Health Commission and the National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine. EVD, formerly Ebola hemorrhagic fever, is caused by Ebola virus and is highly pathogenic, with a case-fatality rate averaging around 50% (some strains up to 90%). Transmission occurs through direct contact with the blood, body fluids, secretions, excreta, or contaminated items of patients or the deceased, and via infected animals. Clinically, EVD presents with abrupt fever, extreme fatigue, headache, myalgia, vomiting, and severe diarrhea, potentially with hemorrhage and multi-organ failure. No routine public vaccine exists; China reports no domestic or imported cases. On 17 May 2026, WHO declared Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). The virus is moderately heat-stable; inactivation is achievable by heating at 60°C for 1 hour or 100°C for 5 minutes and by UV, gamma irradiation, formaldehyde, hypochlorous acid, phenols, and alcohols. Preventive measures include avoiding unprotected contact with suspected/confirmed cases and their fluids, avoiding contact with fruit bats and primates, avoiding bushmeat, and cooking meat thoroughly.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス病の診断・治療ガイドラインを発表 中国ではまだ国内症例および輸入症例の報告なし
triage.triage_reason: 2026年5月17日にWHOがコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダのBundibugyo ebolavirus感染症アウトブレイクをPHEIC宣言しており、IHR基準の国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク、およびWPRO基準の管理可能性（中国が診断・治療ガイドライン発表）に該当。シグナルとして識別され、フルRRA進行が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は中国のEVD診断・治療ガイドライン発表に焦点を当てているが、主要なシグナル源はDRC・ウガンダでのBundibugyo ebolavirus PHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。中国は診断ガイドライン発表の実施国として含める。症例致死率50～90%、ヒト-ヒト感染リスク、zoonotic transmission経路が存在し、高リスク評価に相当。

article.articleHeadline: ยอดผู้ติดเชื้อ "่อีโบลาบุนดิบูโจ" ยืนยันแล้วพุ่งกว่า 280 ราย-เร่งพัฒนาวัคซีน 3 ชนิด
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Confirmed Ebola Bundibugyo cases rise to over 280; accelerated development of three vaccines.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo reaches at least 282 cases, with 264 laboratory-confirmed, centered in Ituri province in eastern DR Congo. The outbreak has spread to 22 health zones across three eastern provinces. As of June 2, 2026, suspected Bundibugyo cases exceed 1,000 in DR Congo, with 9 confirmed in Uganda; Bunia, Ituri remains the outbreak’s hotspot. The Bundibugyo strain has caused nearly 250 deaths. WHO notes positive signals alongside delivery of equipment to under-resourced health centers. Three vaccines are in development for Bundibugyo, with IAVI, Oxford University, and Moderna involved, highlighting the potential severity of this outbreak as researchers accelerate immunization efforts.

triage.headline_ja: 確認されたエボラ・ブンディブギョ症例が280件を超える－3種類のワクチン開発を加速
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラ出血熱という極度に重篤な公衆衛生脅威であり、282例の確認症例、国際的拡大（ウガンダでの確認），ワクチン開発の国際的協調対応が進行中。
triage.notes: エボラ・ブンディブギョ株は2026年時点で282例の確認症例と約250死亡を報告。ウガンダでも9例の確認があるが、主要な発生地はDRコンゴのイトゥリ州。IAVI、オックスフォード大学、モデルナが関与するワクチン開発の加速は国際的な関心と対応体制の構築を示唆。既存装備不足の保健施設へのWHO物資支援に加え、継続的な監視強化が必須。

article.articleHeadline: 这种奶茶不能喝！细菌暴增，越喝越脏，有人深夜挂急诊！上海消保委实测奶茶
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This milk tea should not be drunk! A surge in bacteria—the more you drink, the dirtier it gets; someone ended up in the ER late at night! Shanghai Consumer Rights Protection Committee tests milk tea.
article.articleSummary: Shanghai Consumers Rights Protection Committee tested four milk teas—Oreo Cake Milk Tea, Oat Milk Yangzhi Ganlu, BaQi grape oil kumquat, and Bubble Tea. After opening, storage at room temperature for 2, 4, and 6 hours led to sharp bacterial growth; one sample reached about 2,700 CFU/mL at 2 hours, 3,100 CFU/mL at 4 hours, and 6,100 CFU/mL at 6 hours, while other varieties reached tens of thousands to hundreds of thousands CFU/mL. Detected pathogens included Escherichia coli, Salmonella, Listeria monocytogenes, Staphylococcus aureus, and Bacillus cereus. Safety standards cited: E. coli <100 CFU/mL; Salmonella/Listeria <0/25 per 25 mL; S. aureus <1,000 CFU/mL; B. cereus <10,000 CFU/mL. A consumer reportedly developed acute gastroenteritis requiring ER care after overnight tea. Recommendations: finish within 2 hours of production, choose reputable brands, avoid keeping opened cups at high temperatures, and check odor/color before drinking.

triage.headline_ja: この奶茶は飲めない！細菌が急増し、飲むほど汚くなる。深夜に救急車で搬送される人も！上海消費者権益保護委員会が奶茶をテスト
triage.triage_reason: 複数の病原体（E. coli、Salmonella、Listeria等）が検出された食品汚染イベントであり、WPROスクリーニング基準（重症度：1件の急性胃腸炎患者が救急搬送）と異常性に該当。ただし現在のところ局所的な消費者テスト報告であり、公衆衛生上の大規模爆発や国際的な拡大を示す情報がないため、引き続き経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は上海の市消費者権益保護委員会による奶茶の食品汚染テスト報告。複数の病原体検出と1件の急性胃腸炎患者の救急搬送事例が報告されているが、現在のところ流行規模や死亡例は記載されていない。消費者テスト対象の製品が市場で広く流通している可能性があり、続報による情報収集が重要。

article.articleHeadline: 我科学家揪出乙肝病毒"导航员"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Our scientists pinpoint the hepatitis B virus's 'navigator'.
article.articleSummary: Global hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection affects about 250 million people, with most requiring long-term or lifelong therapy since current drugs suppress replication but do not eradicate the viral DNA reservoir in liver cells. A Beijing Life Sciences Institute / Tsinghua University Biomedical Interdisciplinary Research Institute team led by Li Wenhui identifies SCARF2 as a key intracellular “navigator” that HBV uses to travel from the cell membrane to the nucleus after entry, a step essential for viral replication. This builds on the 2012 discovery of NTCP as the HBV entry receptor, which has led to NTCP-targeted drugs used against hepatitis D virus (HDV). Using high-precision imaging, they show NTCP and SCARF2 converge during intracellular transport; mutating HBV residues 89/90 disrupts SCARF2 interaction and greatly lowers infection efficiency. Knocking down SCARF2 traps virions in vesicles, preventing genome release. This reveals a new intracellular trafficking mechanism and a potential therapeutic avenue for curing HBV.

triage.headline_ja: 中国の科学者がB型肝炎ウイルスの「ナビゲーター」を特定
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は基礎研究の科学的発見（SCARF2蛋白質の機能解明）に関する報道であり、新規感染症アウトブレイクやヒト集団での疾病発生を報告するものではない。流行・感染拡大のシグナルではなく、既知の世界的感染症に関する治療法開発研究の進展である。
triage.notes: 記事の主要内容は中国の研究機関による基礎研究の進展報告であり、現在の疾病流行や新規アウトブレイクの検知ではない。B型肝炎の既知の世界的感染負荷に関する科学的発見であり、EBS（Early Warning System）の対象外と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Ministério da Saúde vai oferecer nova vacina contra germe que causa a pneumonia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health will offer a new vaccine against the germ that causes pneumonia.
article.articleSummary: June 2, 2026 — Brazil's Ministry of Health will introduce the 20-valent pneumococcal vaccine (Pneumo20) into the national child immunization schedule, expanding protection to 20 Streptococcus pneumoniae serotypes and doubling coverage versus Pneumo10. Pneumococcal disease includes pneumonia, otitis, sinusitis, and meningitis, with bacterial meningitis mortality about 30% in children. Vaccination schedule: Pneumo20 at 2 months, Pneumo10 at 4 months, Pneumo20 booster at 12 months. In 2010 Brazil averaged 368 pneumococcal meningitis cases annually in children ≤5 years; cases fell by over 50% after Pneumo10 but rose to an average of 211 per year during 2022–2024. With Pneumo20, authorities aim for 95% vaccination coverage of the target population. The expansion signals a substantial public health effort to reduce pneumococcal disease burden in Brazil.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省が肺炎を引き起こす病原菌に対する新しいワクチンを提供する予定
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントはワクチン導入のプレスリリース性の記事であり、新規感染症の集団発生やアウトブレイク報告ではない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準の該当なし。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジル保健省による肺炎球菌ワクチン（Pneumo20）の国家予防接種計画への導入発表であり、感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではない。過去の統計データ（2010年の368例、2022-2024年の211例）は参考情報であるが、現在進行中の異常事象ではない。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Reuters сообщило об увеличении подтвержденных случаев заражения Эболой до 321
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Reuters reported an increase in confirmed Ebola infections to 321.
article.articleSummary: Confirmed Ebola virus disease cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) have risen to 321, spanning three provinces, with 48 deaths, according to Reuters on June 1 citing sources. The World Health Organization had already declared an outbreak in the DRC and Uganda on May 15. Reuters on May 24 reported 900 possible cases identified in the DRC as part of response efforts; on May 25, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said 220 people had died in the DRC since the outbreak began. Infectious-disease physician and associate professor at Siberian State Medical University Yulia Minakova stated on May 25 that initial Ebola symptoms resemble flu, but the disease progresses severely with a high fatality risk.

triage.headline_ja: ロイターがエボラ感染確認事例が321件に増加したと報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病は高い死亡率を示す深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、複数国での発生、国際的な感染拡大リスク、および渡航・貿易制限の可能性を示している。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウガンダとロシア連邦が含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRC内でのエボラ発生と死亡事例である。ウガンダはWHOが同時期に発生を宣言しているが、本記事では具体的な事例が記載されていない。対象国リスト内ではDRCのみが明確に該当する。ロシア連邦は記事の疾患情報提供者として言及されているが、発生地ではない。インフルエンザも疾患リストに含まれているが、記事サマリーではエボラが主要焦点である。

article.articleHeadline: Lời nhắc từ "bóng ma" Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A reminder from the 'ghost' Ebola
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has prompted WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, with hundreds of suspected cases and deaths, and transmission mainly via direct contact with blood or bodily fluids. The Bundibugyo strain is involved and there is no licensed vaccine yet. The outbreak raises cross-border concerns ahead of the 2026 FIFA World Cup in the United States, Canada, and Mexico, which will host 48 teams and about 5 million fans. Congo's team preparations are disrupted, with training moved to Belgium and staff leaving to avoid entry restrictions. The host nations have implemented enhanced health controls, including 21-day quarantines or entry bans for recent exposures. Officials note that stadium transmission is unlikely, but strict surveillance at airports, hotels, and venues remains essential.

triage.headline_ja: 「亡霊」エボラからの警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラアウトブレイク（PHEIC宣言済み）が確認され、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。国際的な大規模スポーツイベント（2026 FIFA World Cup）との関連で、複数国への渡航・貿易制限リスクが顕在化している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーが2026年のFIFA World Cupを主題としており、米国・カナダ・メキシコが共催国として言及されているが、サマリーの主たる感染症イベント発生地はDRCのみ。米国・カナダ・メキシコは対象国リストに含まれず、またサマリー上でこれらの国での実際のエボラ発生は報告されていない（渡航制限・準備変更のみ）。Belgiumはコンゴチームの訓練地であり発生地ではないため、verified_locationsには含めない。WHOのPHEIC宣言済み、Bundibugyo strain、ワクチン未承認との情報あり。

article.articleHeadline: As Ebola Spreads, Scientists Race to Find Vaccines and Treatments
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-02, the Ebola disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda is expanding, driven by Bundibugyo virus. Bundibugyo differs from the better-known Ebola virus, complicating vaccines and diagnostics; no Bundibugyo-specific vaccine exists yet. Symptoms include fever, muscle pain, vomiting, bleeding, and rapid organ failure. Diagnostic tests are now being adapted to detect Bundibugyo. Supportive care, isolation, and contact tracing remain central while researchers test monoclonal antibodies and other drugs as potential treatments; outcomes will take months to clarify, but interventions could prove valuable as the outbreak persists. Funding will accelerate vaccine development: CEPI will provide up to $61 million to advance three candidate vaccines; IAVI up to $3.2 million for a VSV-based vaccine; an Oxford adenovirus-based vaccine receiving up to $8.6 million; Serum Institute of India manufacturing support. Erbevo, the licensed Ebola vaccine, showed 100% protection against Ebola virus in 2014 trials but not Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが拡大する中、科学者はワクチンと治療法の開発に競争している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な病原体による流行、複数国への国際的拡大、ワクチン未開発による管理困難）。WPROスクリーニング基準5項目全て該当。国際的な研究機関による大規模資金投入と国家間の対応調整が行われており、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリー上で、Bundibugyo Ebolaの主要な流行は DRC および Uganda で発生している。Uganda は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。India は Serum Institute of India がワクチン製造を支援している関連地として言及されているが、記事サマリーの主題は DRC/Uganda での流行である。ただし India の製造関連機関が国際対応に組み込まれている点で verified_locations に含めた。Bundibugyo は既存ワクチン（Erbevo）で防御できず、新規ワクチン開発の緊急性が高い。複数国際機関による資金投入（CEPI $61M、IAVI $3.2M、Oxford $8.6M）が示す国際的関心度は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: 嚴防伊波拉　又見邊境管制
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola prevention tightened as border controls are reimposed.
article.articleSummary: Effective June 2 at 00:00, our country imposes border health measures to prevent entry of Ebola from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda. Visa issuance for nationals from these countries is suspended for 90 days, and the travel advisory is raised to Level 2 Warning, urging avoidance of all nonessential travel there. Travelers with Ebola-affected-area exposure within 21 days before arrival must complete 21 days of self-health management after entry. The World Health Organization notes the DRC declared an Ebola outbreak on May 15; ten days later there were over 1,000 confirmed and suspected cases, including 10 confirmed and 223 suspected deaths. Ebola presents with fever, fatigue, headache, vomiting, and abdominal pain; severe disease can cause liver damage and kidney failure, with about 50% fatality. Reuters reports the U.S. would not repatriate symptomatic Americans, treating abroad; whether all overseas cases will be kept overseas remains unclear.

triage.headline_ja: 伊波拉予防措置が強化され、国境管制が再度実施される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。DRCの進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（1000+症例、223死亡）に対する複数国の国境保健措置実施であり、国際的拡大リスクが高く、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が明確。
triage.notes: Bluedot API発生地域にはUSとUgandaも含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRCでのアウトブレイク発生が主題であり、Ugandaは隣接国として言及されるのみ、USは防止対策を実施している側として記載されている。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみに限定。2026年6月時点での活動中アウトブレイクであり、5月15日宣言から10日で1000+症例という急速な増加が確認される。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع حالات الإصابة المؤكدة بـ" إيبولا" بالكونغو إلى 321
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in confirmed Ebola cases in the Congo to 321.
article.articleSummary: As of June 2, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 321 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases, with 48 deaths, as the outbreak expands across three provinces. Government data indicate ongoing transmission, underlining the severity of the public health challenge and the need for sustained surveillance, case management, and infection-control measures. The report notes no further details on laboratory confirmation methods, exposure sources, or a provincial breakdown beyond three regions, nor any information on imported or exported cases. The rising case count signals continued transmission within the country and the urgency for continued international and domestic response coordination to halt spread and reduce fatalities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでの確認エボラ症例が321件に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべて該当。エボラウイルス病は高い致死性を伴う重篤な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、複数州での継続的な伝播、死亡例の増加、国際的な拡大リスク、および旅行・貿易制限の可能性がある。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は感染症法上の最高危険度病原体。複数州への拡大、継続的な伝播、死亡率15%（48死亡/321確認例）は深刻な脅威。国際的な警戒態勢が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Число подтвержденных случаев Эболы в ДР Конго возросло до 321
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of confirmed Ebola cases in DR Congo has risen to 321.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 June 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo has 321 confirmed Ebola virus cases, up from 282, with the World Health Organization previously noting 906 suspected cases. The eastern DR Congo region is affected, underscoring ongoing outbreak dynamics. Reuters reports that CEPI will provide about $60 million to Moderna to accelerate vaccine development against the Ebola Bundibugyo virus circulating in eastern DR Congo. CEPI has been an early supporter of Ebola vaccine efforts, echoing its pandemic-era funding for vaccines. The article highlights a shift from suspected to confirmed cases and the international investment aimed at improving preventive vaccines for this outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ確認患者数が321人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。確認患者数の増加傾向、東部での継続的な流行、国際的なワクチン開発投資の実施がシグナル特性を示している。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス症例の継続的な増加（282→321確認患者）、疑い患者906名の存在、東部地域での進行中の流行、CEPIおよびModernaによるワクチン開発への国際投資（60百万米ドル）が確認されている。Bundibugyo種の循環も報告されており、多くのWPRO基準を満たす。フルRRA実施が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola outbreak near 300 as health workers celebrate recoveries
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-02, Congo's Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus has 282 confirmed cases, with 264 in Ituri province and more than 1,000 suspected cases across three eastern provinces. The outbreak spans 22 health zones and has caused 42 deaths in Congo and 1 in Uganda. There is no approved medicine or vaccine. WHO notes progress with new supplies to under-resourced health centres, while authorities emphasize early detection, rapid isolation, rigorous contact tracing, safe burials, and strengthened infection control as key challenges. The Coalition for Epidemic Preparedness Innovations pledged up to $62 million to accelerate development of three experimental vaccines from IAVI, Moderna, and Oxford. Recovered health workers, including Baraka Bulambulu and Ezo Etienne, celebrated negative test results. Cross-border concerns persist; Uganda closed its border after nine cases. Attacks by armed groups, including ADF, and the M23 influence response in North Kivu and South Kivu.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行、300人に迫る患者数 保健労働者が回復を祝う
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：282確定症例・43死亡、異常・予想外：Bundibugyo型の大規模流行、国際的拡大リスク：ウガンダへの越境感染確認、渡航制限：ウガンダが国境閉鎖）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも5項目すべてに該当。社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: DRC内のIturi州およびSouth Kivu州での発生が確認されており、ウガンダへの越境感染（1死亡）も報告されている。Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスによる大規模流行、武装勢力による対応阻害、ワクチン開発加速への国際的関心など、複数の懸念要因が存在。ウガンダは発生地域に含まれているが、記事の主要な焦点はDRCであるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとする。

article.articleHeadline: International Efforts Accelerate Development Of Vaccine Against Ebola's Bundibugyo Strain
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, the Ebola outbreak attributed to Bundibugyo strain has caused about 250 deaths and over 1,100 confirmed cases. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for this strain. The vaccine closest to readiness is a single-dose rVSV vaccine developed by IAVI, leveraging the same platform as Ervebo. IAVI has an agreement with the University of Texas Medical Branch to advance this candidate. WHO estimates it will take seven to nine months before the rVSV Bundibugyo vaccine enters human clinical trials. CEPI is funding three vaccine candidates against Bundibugyo, including the rVSV vaccine, plus support for Oxford's candidate that is being developed with AstraZeneca COVID-19 heritage and to be manufactured by Serum Institute of India, with potential clinical trials in two to three months. A third candidate from Moderna uses mRNA technology.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱ブンディブギョ株に対するワクチン開発の国際的取り組みが加速
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：250人の死亡と1,100人超の確定症例、異常性：未承認株の流行、国際的拡大リスク）。また WPROスクリーニング基準で重症度（死亡例多数）と流行しやすさ（ヒト-ヒト感染）に該当。対象国DRC・ウガンダでのエボラアウトブレイクは明確な危機管理対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに『Democratic Republic of the CongoとUgandaでEbolaアウトブレイク』と明記されているが、Ugandaは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations にはDRCのみ記載。ただし、Bundibugyo株は未承認かつ複数国での流行実績があり、国際的な懸念が非常に高い。ワクチン開発の国際的努力が進行中であることから、継続的な監視が必須。

article.articleHeadline: China kirim bantuan untuk atasi wabah Ebola di Afrika
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China sends aid to tackle Ebola outbreak in Africa
article.articleSummary: China provides emergency humanitarian aid to the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and partners with the African Union to combat Ebola, deploying 45 medical teams totaling over 900 personnel to 44 African countries. In the DRC, Doctors Without Borders says the outbreak is highly concerning with rapid spread outpacing responders. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warns of daily suspected cases and diagnosis delays due to testing bottlenecks, urging expanded laboratory capacity. The Bundibugyo Ebola strain is concentrated in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. As of 2 June 2026, there are more than 900 suspected cases and at least 223 deaths, with cumulative cases exceeding 1,000 since the outbreak was announced on May 15. Ebola outbreaks in DRC and Uganda have been declared Public Health Emergencies of International Concern. The report notes US funding withdrawals from WHO and cuts to USAID as weakening the global response. China also supports Africa CDC and calls for intensified international action.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱アフリカ流行対策に中国が支援を送付
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響（900例以上、223死亡）、複数国での異常な拡大、国際的な拡大リスク（WHO緊急事態宣言）、国際支援の必要性が明らかで、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは中国がアフリカ全体への支援を述べているが、具体的なエボラ発生地は DRC（South Kivu、Ituri、North Kivu）とウガンダに限定されている。対象国リストから DRC のみ該当。ウガンダは対象国に含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。2026年6月2日時点で累積1,000例以上、223死亡が確認されており、WHO緊急事態宣言が発令されている高リスク事象。

article.articleHeadline: ¿Hay casos de ébola en México? Secretaría de Salud aclara la situación en el país - El Heraldo de México
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Are there Ebola cases in Mexico? Ministry of Health clarifies the situation in the country - El Heraldo de México
article.articleSummary: Mexico reports no Ebola cases amid Africa outbreak and maintains surveillance for Ebola virus disease (Bundibugyō ebolavirus). As of May 29, 2026, authorities say the risk to Mexico is low and emphasize early detection and strict isolation for suspected cases. Internationally, WHO risk was elevated regionally and nationally in affected countries, though overall international spread probability remains low. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, 906 suspected cases and 223 deaths were reported by May 27; by May 29, 134 confirmed cases were recorded, including 9 in Uganda, with 18 deaths among confirmed in DRC and Uganda. Transmission centers include Ituri and the North and South Kivu provinces. A U.S. citizen who assisted outbreak response in DRC tested positive and was treated in Germany. Suspected-case criteria include fever >38.6°C, asthenia, vomiting, diarrhea, hyporexia, headache, abdominal pain, and potential hemorrhagic signs.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコでエボラ出血熱患者はいるのか？保健省が国内の状況を明確にする - エルラルド・デ・メキシコ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。DRCにおけるエボラウイルス病の継続的な流行で確定患者134名・死亡18名が報告され、多国間での感染確認があり、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事はメキシコでのエボラ症例報告は否定していますが、DRCを中心とした活発な流行が記述されており、DRCのみが対象国リストに該当。USA、ドイツ、ウガンダでも感染者報告があるが、対象国外のため除外。本イベントはDRC発生源の継続流行として認識され、フルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）に進むべき段階。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع حالات الإصابة المؤكدة بـ إيبولا بالكونغو إلى 321 - أردو بوینت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Confirmed Ebola cases in Congo rise to 321 - Urdu Point
article.articleSummary: Confirmed Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has risen to 321 confirmed cases, with 48 deaths, according to government data reported from Kinshasa on June 2, 2026. The outbreak is active in three provinces. The article provides only the counts of confirmed infections and fatalities, with no additional details on symptoms, laboratory confirmation methods, transmission sources, or public health responses. These figures indicate a continuing Ebola outbreak within the DRC involving multiple provinces and highlight the ongoing public health concern for the country. Kinshasa-based reporting indicates ongoing transmission across three provinces; the article does not mention imported or exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ共和国でのエボラ確定症例が321件に増加 - ウルドゥポイント
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス感染症は致死的であり、複数州での継続的な伝播が確認されている。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス感染症は極めて高い致死率（記事から推定CFR: 48/321 = 約15%）を持つWHO規定の医療関連感染症。複数州での継続的伝播により、国際的な感染拡大リスクが高い。DRCからの渡航制限やWHO由来の国際的対応が予想される。フルRRA及び国際通知が必須。

article.articleHeadline: NMC warns of HIV, hepatitis risk from unsafe injections
article.articleSummary: New Delhi-based advisory from the National Medical Commission warns that unsafe injection practices in India risk HIV, Hepatitis B and Hepatitis C infections, potentially forming outbreaks when safeguards are ignored. All medical colleges nationwide must use sterile, single-use needles and syringes and strictly prohibit reuse. Hospitals should reinforce hand hygiene and ensure proper segregation and disposal of injection waste. The NMC enforces zero tolerance for syringe reuse, unsafe vial sharing, needle recapping, and improper sharps disposal. To further cut risk, colleges should progressively adopt safety-engineered auto-disable syringes that cannot be reused and conduct periodic training and competency assessments for staff handling injections. Hospitals must report needle-stick injuries and infection clusters for investigation, provide post-exposure prophylaxis per NACO guidelines, and perform regular audits through infection-control teams. India routinely administers millions of injections daily; adherence to protocols remains the strongest defense against blood-borne transmissions.

triage.headline_ja: NMC warns of HIV, hepatitis risk from unsafe injections（NMC、不安全な注射によるHIV・肝炎リスクを警告）
triage.triage_reason: インドの医療機関における不安全な注射実践に関する警告・勧告であり、現在のアウトブレイク報告ではなく予防的な行政通知。複数の血液媒介感染症（HIV、B型肝炎、C型肝炎）が対象だが、実際の患者数や確認された感染事例の詳細が不明のため、フルRRA前の経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は医療機関における不安全な注射実践の警告・ガイダンスであり、現在の確認済みアウトブレイクではなく予防的な行政通知。インドは日次で数百万件の注射を実施しており、長期的な曝露リスクと血液媒介病原体の流行しやすさが指摘されている。ただし現在の患者数増加や確認感染事例の詳細が記事に含まれていないため、継続的な情報収集が必要。

article.articleHeadline: الصين ترسل فريقا من الخبراء الطبيين إلى جمهورية الكونغو الديمقراطية للمساعدة في مكافحة إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China sends a team of medical experts to the Democratic Republic of the Congo to assist in the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: On 2 June 2026, China dispatched a team of senior medical experts from Beijing to the Democratic Republic of the Congo to assist in the Ebola response. The move follows the WHO’s 17 May declaration that the outbreak in the DRC constitutes a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The experts, with extensive epidemic-control experience, will join the Chinese medical contingent already in the DRC and collaborate with local health and outbreak-control agencies to help contain transmission. The 24th batch of Chinese personnel in the DRC has activated an emergency response, established a prevention-and-control system, conducted trainings, coordinated supplies, and improved living conditions for the team. Front-line clinicians remain engaged to protect the health of local residents and Chinese nationals in the DRC as part of ongoing containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、エボラ出血熱対策を支援するため医療専門家チームをコンゴ民主共和国に派遣
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的保健上の緊急事態（PHEIC）宣言済みで、IHR基準2項目以上に該当。DRCでの継続的な流行と国際的対応の必要性が確認される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでのエボラ出血熱流行に焦点を当てており、中国による専門家派遣はこの流行への国際的対応の一環。WHOによるPHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）により、既に国際的な懸念が公式に認識されている。中国はDRCの対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : réouverture de l'aéroport de Bunia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: Bunia airport reopens
article.articleSummary: As of 2 June 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reopened Bunia airport in Ituri after health assessments tied to the Ebola outbreak. The ministry says conditions are in place for a cautious, phased resumption of air traffic, with surveillance at departure and arrival. Public health measures will be strictly enforced inside airport and port facilities, including mandatory temperature checks for all passengers before boarding and on arrival, mandatory hand washing, and immediate care for suspected cases. Any traveler with fever will be barred from boarding and referred for evaluation. The government notes reopening will help channel support for the Ebola response. The outbreak's confirmed case count rose to 343. The 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC since 1976 was declared May 15. President Tshisekedi spoke with WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus in Kinshasa; Health Minister Roger Kamba was cited by ACP.

triage.headline_ja: DRCのエボラ：ブニア空港が再開
triage.triage_reason: 確認症例343例の進行中のエボラアウトブレイクであり、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）を複数満たす。WPRO基準では重症度と流行しやすさが明確。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのイツリ州（ブニア）およびキンシャサでの進行中のエボラアウトブレイク（2026年5月15日宣言）について述べている。確認症例343例、大統領がWHO事務局長と直接協議。空港再開は国際的関心が高く、渡航制限との関連で重要。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）伊波拉疫情确诊病例增至343起
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: confirmed cases rise to 343.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ituri Province has 343 confirmed cases and 48 deaths as of Monday, June 1. Health workers in PPE are preparing to confront a new phase of the outbreak in Bunia, the provincial capital. After a government delegation’s visit to Bunia, officials say outbreak response efforts will be more precise. Bunia airport remains closed to general traffic, with only humanitarian flights allowed, and is expected to reopen this week to bolster outbreak response. Separately, Brazilian authorities reported two individuals with suspected Ebola infection who tested negative. The update underscores the persistence of the Ituri outbreak and the critical role of rapid access and coordinated response in controlling transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：確認症例が343件に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際的拡大リスク）、WPRO基準複数該当（重症度・流行可能性・対応能力の懸念）。DRC内での活発な流行拡大と国際的な検査事例がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC Ituri Province（特にBunia）での343確認症例48死亡を主題としている。ブラジルでの疑い例は最終的に陰性であり、DRCが主要な発生地。空港閉鎖、政府代表団訪問など、対応段階にあることを示唆。継続的な外部支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Reopens Main Airport in Ebola Epicenter as Officials Brace for Long Outbreak
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-02, Congo reopened the main airport in Bunia, the capital of Ituri province and the eastern epicenter of an Ebola outbreak. Health officials report tentative signs the outbreak may be slowing, but authorities still struggle to trace exposed contacts and investigate suspected cases, underscoring ongoing transmission risks. Ituri province has been hardest-hit by the outbreak, and officials anticipate a long, challenging response as they monitor cases and maintain surveillance. The airport reopening signals a shift in operations that could affect movement to and from the hardest-hit area while containment efforts continue. Officials say the response continues to hinge on tracing contacts and reviewing suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラ流行の中心地ブニアの主要空港を再開 当局は長期化に備える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも5項目すべてに該当。進行中のエボラ流行は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響を有し、国際的拡大リスク及び渡航制限リスクが明確である。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病はCategory1感染症であり、進行中の流行は継続的な接触者追跡の困難性と疑い症例の調査課題が報告されている。空港の再開は流行地域への移動増加による二次感染リスクの潜在性を示唆。公衆衛生上の緊急事態として、国際的な支援と監視体制の強化が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Глава Роспотребнадзора оценила вероятность пандемии лихорадки Эболы - Новости на Вести.ru
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Head of Rospotrebnadzor assessed the likelihood of an Ebola fever pandemic - News on Vesti.ru
article.articleSummary: Ebola fever outbreak in Africa: the head of Russia's Rospotrebnadzor says the Ebola virus does not pose a pandemic threat but could spread widely across the African continent. Transmission is a contact infection, not airborne, waterborne, or foodborne. In the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), there are 321 confirmed Ebola cases and 48 deaths. As of May 25, the total possible infections in Africa exceeded 900, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. Russia has intensified sanitary-quarantine checks at border crossings amid the spread, but officials stress there is currently no risk of Ebola reaching Russia. The report references Reuters figures on the Congo outbreak; no mention of imported/exported Ebola cases to Russia.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア衛生監督局長がエボラ熱パンデミックの可能性を評価 - Vesti.ruニュース
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において公衆衛生への深刻な影響（321確認例、48死亡）と国際的拡大リスク（アフリカ全域で900以上の感染疑い例）が認められ、2基準以上該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度（死亡例あり）と流行リスク（接触感染、アフリカでの広がり）が確認される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）における具体的な症例数（321確認例、48死亡）が明記されている。ロシアはアフリカでのアウトブレイク監視対象国だが、記事の主題はアフリカでの発生であり、ロシアへの実際の症例報告はない。したがって verified_locations にはDRCのみを含める。アフリカ大陸全体での発生が言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو تسجل 321 إصابة مؤكدة بفيروس إيبولا و48 حالة وفاة وتفش في 3 مقاطعات
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 321 confirmed Ebola cases and 48 deaths, with an outbreak in 3 provinces.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 321 confirmed Ebola cases and 48 deaths, with the outbreak spreading across three provinces. As of 2026-06-02, government data indicate 321 confirmed cases and 48 fatalities. Medical teams continue to fight the spread by strengthening isolation measures, conducting contact tracing, and elevating the readiness of health facilities in the affected areas. The report emphasizes that transmission is ongoing and that the public health response remains active in the three impacted provinces, aiming to contain transmission and protect communities through coordinated surveillance and containment activities. The three-province outbreak marks a continuing challenge for surveillance and response capacity across the country.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がエボラウイルス感染確認321例と死亡48例を報告、3州での流行発生
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準でも5項目全て該当。エボラの大規模確認症例で、複数州での継続的な伝播が報告されている。
triage.notes: エボラウイルスは最高リスク病原体。321確認症例、48死亡（致死率約15%）、3州での流行継続という状況は、国内の保健対応能力への懸念と国際的な支援ニーズを示唆。記事は2026年6月2日付（未来日付の可能性がある要注意）。

Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Quase 30% das mortes por influenza no Brasil em 2026 foram registradas nas últimas 2 semanas - Jornal O Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Almost 30% of influenza deaths in Brazil in 2026 were recorded in the last two weeks - Jornal O Sul
article.articleSummary: From January–May 2026, Brazil recorded 505 deaths from severe acute respiratory infection (SARI) linked to influenza A and B, per the Ministry of Health. Of these, 136 deaths (27%) were confirmed only in the last two weeks, reflecting recently identified causes rather than new deaths. A total of 7,749 SARI cases linked to influenza had been reported in 2026: 256 H1N1, 1,903 H3N2, 4,892 Influenza A not subtyped, and 698 Influenza B. In January–May 2025, there were 6,250 cases. About 1,344 SARI deaths this year had no identified agent yet, as other pathogens such as COVID-19, rhinovirus, and RSV can cause SARI. The National Vaccination Campaign ended with 38.5% coverage, far below the 90% target. Porto Alegre expanded vaccination to all residents over six months, prioritizing children under six, pregnant women, and the elderly. Experts cite seasonal and climatic factors; no clear evidence of increased virulence or shifts in circulating strains, though coinfections may worsen outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル2026年のインフルエンザによる死亡の約30%が過去2週間に記録された
triage.triage_reason: 複数の呼吸器系病原体（インフルエンザA/B、COVID-19、RSV）が同時に流行している兆候があり、死亡数が増加している。ただし、記事では「最近になって判明した死亡」の報告タイムラグであり、新規死亡数が急増しているわけではないと示唆されている。情報不足のため要経過観察。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年のデータを参照しており、時系列上の異常性が存在する。ただし、複数の呼吸器系病原体の同時流行と、死亡報告のタイムラグ（27%が直近2週間に確認された），ワクチン接種率の低さ（38.5% vs 90%目標）が懸念要素。国内での対応状況が進行中であり、国際支援が不要であることから、現段階では WATCH 判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: EU Health Ministers Set Emergency Talks On Ebola Response
article.articleSummary: EU health ministers held an extraordinary videoconference to coordinate a response to the Ebola outbreak driven by the Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda, with Italy pushing for stricter border controls. Cyprus, presiding, plans to use the Integrated Political Crisis Response mechanism to enhance preparedness and information exchange across EU states. The outbreak has produced more than 1,000 suspected cases and at least 246 deaths, though official tallies may undercount due to conflict in northeastern DRC. WHO opposes travel bans and urges countries not to hinder response efforts. No licensed vaccines exist; CEPI will urgently assess three investigational candidates, including one from Moderna. UN guidance recommends informing arriving travelers about 21-day monitoring for symptoms, and several airlines have adjusted flight schedules as part of the response.

triage.headline_ja: EUの保健大臣がエボラ対応について緊急協議を実施
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、ブンディブギョウイコラウイルスによる大規模エボラ爆発（1000以上の疑い患者、246人以上の死亡）が複数国で発生。国際的な保健上の危機として認識されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCとウガンダでのエボラ爆発について言及しているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていない。DRCのみが対象国として verified_locations に含まれる。イタリアとキプロスは発生地域として列挙されているが、記事の文脈から両国は欧州連合による国際的な対応調整の中核であり、実際の感染症イベント発生地ではない。CEPI、WHO、国連ガイダンスなど複数の国際機関が関与し、高度な国際的懸念が示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: How health workers in the Democratic Republic of Congo are treating Ebola and staying safe - BBC
article.articleSummary: BBC reports health workers in the Democratic Republic of Congo are treating Ebola while staying safe by using the Cube, a transparent 'self-contained treatment unit for highly infectious diseases' that allows patients to receive treatment without direct contact with medical staff. The device reduces exposure risk while enabling ongoing Ebola care, highlighting infection-control innovations in outbreak settings. By isolating care within the unit, clinicians can monitor and administer therapies with minimized transmission risk. The development reflects broader public health measures to protect workers during Ebola responses in the DRC. As of 2026-06-02, Cube-like technologies form part of the toolkit used by responders to sustain care delivery in settings with limited resources and high biosafety demands.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国の医療従事者がエボラ出血熱の治療と安全確保を実施する方法 - BBC
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生地域（DRC）の確認と医療対応の報道であるが、新規症例数、死亡者数、流行状況などの具体的な疫学データが記事サマリーに含まれていない。技術革新の側面が強調されており、アクティブな流行の深刻度を判断するには情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ対応における医療技術の革新に焦点を当てており、BBC等の主流メディアで報道されている点で社会的関心がある。ただし、現在の流行状況の具体的な指標（新規症例数、死亡率、地理的拡大等）が記事サマリーから不明であるため、フルRRA前に続報による疫学情報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Venezuela descarta casos por Ébola y mantiene activa la vigilancia epidemiológica - Correo del Orinoco | La Artillería del Pensamiento |Noticias de ...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Venezuela Rules Out Ebola Cases and Maintains Active Epidemiological Surveillance.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-02, Venezuela reports it maintains active epidemiological surveillance for Ebola virus disease (EVD) amid WHO’s Public Health Emergency of International Concern due to outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. No confirmed Ebola cases have been reported in the Americas, and the risk of transmission in Venezuela remains very low. As a preventive measure, authorities have updated care protocols and will implement enhanced surveillance and control at ports, airports, and land borders for travelers arriving from outbreak zones. The government emphasizes ongoing vigilance and specifies preventive border screening, with no indication of domestic transmission at this time.

triage.headline_ja: ベネズエラがエボラ症例を否定し疫学的監視を継続 - オリノコ新聞
triage.triage_reason: ベネズエラでのエボラ確定症例なし。DRC/ウガンダでの流行に対する予防的監視体制の強化報告であり、当該国での疾病発生イベントではない。対象国はDRCのみであるが、記事の主題はベネズエラの予防的対応であり、DRCでの新規発生情報ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はベネズエラが他地域（DRC/ウガンダ）での流行に対して予防的監視を実施していることを報告しており、ベネズエラ国内での疾病発生イベントではない。DRCは対象国に含まれるが、当該国での新規発生報告ではなく、参照情報としてのみ言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: La Chine envoie une équipe d'experts médicaux en RDC pour lutter contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China sends a team of medical experts to the DRC to fight Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) draws intensified international support. On May 17, the World Health Organization declared the DRC Ebola outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. China announces dispatch of a team of high-level medical experts from the National Health Commission to join the 24th Chinese medical team already operating in the DRC, to help contain the outbreak and bolster local health capacities. The new team will cooperate with local health authorities and medical agencies, sharing experience and providing prevention and treatment training to health facilities, the Chinese embassy, Chinese companies, and Chinese nationals abroad. The existing Chinese medical team has activated an emergency plan, established prevention and control systems, drills, and supply coordination, and is working to improve living conditions. Response aims to protect local populations and Chinese nationals in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: 中国がエボラ対策のため医療専門家チームをコンゴ民主共和国に派遣
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHOが国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言した確定的なエボラアウトブレイク。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラアウトブレイクが記事の主題。WHOがPHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）により、国際的な関心と対応が確認されている。中国は医療支援チーム派遣を発表。Chinaは支援国として言及されているため、発生地域からは除外。

article.articleHeadline: Congo reopens Bunia airport as Ebola outbreak shows early signs of slowing
article.articleSummary: 321 confirmed Ebola infections and 48 deaths across 23 health zones in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo as of 2026-06-02, with Ituri province hardest hit. Bunia airport in Ituri reopened after health authorities said screening and surveillance measures are sufficient to manage travel risks; passengers will undergo temperature screening. The situation report notes ongoing challenges in contact tracing, with only 43% of identified contacts being actively monitored, far below the 95% target, and 47 laboratory samples awaiting analysis. Logo health zone is newly affected, bringing Ituri’s total affected zones to 15. Officials caution that data remain incomplete even as they describe a decrease in community transmission. Response measures include expanding treatment and coordination capacity, sustaining transport links, and advancing three experimental Bundibugyo vaccines into human testing. The National Institute of Public Health is assessing Bunia facilities for a national Ebola response coordination center.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、ブニア空港を再開 エボラ流行が減速の兆し
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・国際拡大リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当（重症度・管理性課題）。東部DRCでのエボラ流行はフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の確定患者321名、死亡48名（23の保健区域）。Ituri州が最も被害が大きく、連絡先追跡が95%目標に対し43%にとどまるなど管理上の課題あり。空港再開は国際的な関心と移動制限リスク、実験的ワクチンの人体試験開始など複数のリスク要因を含む。情報は2026年6月2日時点。

article.articleHeadline: Congo anunció que reabre el principal aeropuerto en el epicentro del ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo announced that it would reopen the main airport in the Ebola epicenter.
article.articleSummary: The Democratic Republic of the Congo reopened Bunia airport in Ituri province after health authorities reported preliminary signs that the Ebola outbreak may be subsiding, though contact tracing and case verification continue. Bunia’s airport now conducts temperature checks for departures and arrivals. The outbreak totals 321 laboratory-confirmed infections and 48 deaths across 23 health zones in eastern DRC, with authorities tracing only 43% of identified contacts—far short of a 95% target—and 47 lab samples awaiting analysis. A newly affected Logo zone raises the total to 15 zones in Ituri. Officials warn data remain incomplete even as transmission appears to decline. Efforts to sustain transport links, health services, and containment persist, while three Bundibugyo-based experimental vaccines advance toward human trials; Bunia is being evaluated as a potential site for the national Ebola response coordination center.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラ出血熱の中心地の主要空港を再開すると発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認事例321件、死亡48件という重大な公衆衛生への影響、国際的な拡大リスク（ウガンダとの国境地域での発生）、および渡航制限の可能性があり、IHR基準3項目以上に該当。コンタクトトレーシング進捗が目標値(95%)に遠く及ばず(43%)、管理可能性に懸念あり。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC東部（イトゥリ州）でのエボラ出血熱の継続的な発生を主題とする。ウガンダが発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCでの発生であり、ウガンダでの確認例の報告はないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。コンタクトトレーシング率43%（目標95%）という管理指標の大幅な遅れが重要な懸念要因。

article.articleHeadline: If Ebola lands in Australia tomorrow, what happens next?
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola strain driving outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and neighboring Uganda; no approved vaccines or treatments. Australia’s health system, including Victoria’s recent suspected case, demonstrates rapid testing, isolation and notification, but if Ebola lands tomorrow the first 24 hours would be decisive. Risk to Australia remains low, as transmission is through bodily fluids, not casual contact. The response requires quick travel histories, prompt recognition, isolation, PPE use, and coordinated action across ambulance, hospital, laboratory and public health teams. Post-COVID-19 awareness has improved readiness, though public trust can wane. Australia established a national Centre for Disease Control on January 1, 2026 to coordinate surveillance and response, yet readiness erodes from staff turnover, stock expiry, shifting supply chains and aging protocols. Global drivers—conflict, displacement, fragile health systems, climate change, vaccine hesitancy and zoonoses—raise outbreak risks. The best defense is preventing outbreaks at the source through global surveillance and rapid response; the immediate challenge is maintaining readiness for future pathogens.

triage.headline_ja: もしエボラがオーストラリアに明日到来したら、次は何が起こるか？
triage.triage_reason: エボラの実際の発生はDRC・ウガンダに限定され、オーストラリアは仮定的シナリオ論評である。ただしBundibugyo系統のエボラ発生が確認されており、国際的拡大リスク評価と公衆衛生上の関心の観点から経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主要内容はDRCとウガンダで発生しているBundibugyo系統のエボラ・ウイルスについて。オーストラリア（Victoria）に関する記述は、仮定的な対応シナリオであり実際の発生ではない。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみ。IHR基準2つ以上該当（serious_impact、international_spread）。ただし現時点でオーストラリアにおける確認症例はなく、記事自体が準備体制の検証論評であるため、トリアージはWATCHとした。DRCからの実際の発生状況に関する続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Presiden Kenya Setujui Karantina Ebola atas Permintaan Trump
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya's President Approves Ebola Quarantine at Trump's Request.
article.articleSummary: Kenya's President William Ruto approved establishing an Ebola quarantine facility at Laikipia Air Base in Nanyuki, Laikipia County (about 200 km north of Nairobi), following a private request from U.S. President Donald Trump. The decision, defended amid protests outside the base with police firing tear gas and live rounds, highlights a long-standing Kenya–U.S. health partnership on disease control and research. Ruto emphasized cooperation with the United States on HIV/AIDS, other diseases, and Ebola, noting Kenya's collaborations with US partners and KEMRI on vaccine research, including COVID-19. The facility aims to quarantine and monitor Americans potentially exposed to Ebola during the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo. Kenya has not recorded any Ebola cases, but authorities have heightened screening at airports, borders, and health facilities. The Kenyan High Court temporarily suspended construction and operation pending petitions, with Washington urging engagement to address concerns.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア大統領、トランプ大統領の要請を受けてエボラウイルス隔離施設を承認
triage.triage_reason: 複数の重篤疾患（エボラ、HIV、COVID-19）を含む多国間協力イベントであり、国際的な保健関心を集めているが、ケニアでの実際の患者発生がなく、DRCでの流行への予防的対応のため、情報確認が必要な段階。
triage.notes: 記事はケニアでのエボラ隔離施設の政治的決定を述べており、DRCでの流行を背景としている。ケニア国内に確認患者はないが、国際的な予防措置と米国大統領の直接的要請という異例の状況が特徴。複数の重篤疾患（Ebola, HIV, COVID-19）が言及されているが、記事の主要な焦点はエボラ対応施設の設置である。社会的・政治的関心は高い（抗議活動、高裁の判決など）。

article.articleHeadline: Ministerio de Salud activa vigilancia epidemiológica
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health activates epidemiological surveillance.
article.articleSummary: Venezuela activates epidemiological surveillance amid WHO alert over Ebola virus (Bundibugyo strain) outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. No domestic cases reported; suspected cases exist in North America and Brazil. National action includes deploying epidemiological control planes at ports and international airports and cross-ministerial coordination with Transport and Foreign Affairs to monitor travelers from active-transmission regions. Travelers from affected areas are subject to screening and guidance, including avoiding contact with symptomatic individuals, frequent hand hygiene, and seeking medical care within 21 days of visiting affected countries. Non-essential travel to outbreak areas is discouraged. Ebola transmission occurs through direct contact with bodily fluids, not airborne. Initial symptoms: fever, extreme fatigue, myalgias, and headaches appear 3–21 days after exposure. Local risk is considered low; continual global epidemiological monitoring remains in place.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省が疫学的監視を開始
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）がDRC・ウガンダで流行中であり、ベネズエラが国境警戒を発動。IHR基準で「異常/予想外」「国際拡大リスク」の2項目が該当し、WPRO基準でも「流行しやすさ」「長期曝露リスク」が認められるため、フルRRAに進める必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC・ウガンダでのエボラ流行を主題としており、ベネズエラは監視体制の発動国。北米・ブラジルでの疑い事例言及があるため、ブラジルを対象国として含めた。ウガンダは対象国リストに非該当のため除外。DRCは確実な発生地域。Bundibugyo株は致死性エボラとして注視の必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Brazil rules out suspected Ebola case
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-02, Brazil ruled out a suspected Ebola case in Sao Paulo state after laboratory tests detected no Ebola viral material. The patient, a 37-year-old man who recently arrived from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, presented with fever and diarrhea and was placed under Ebola surveillance. He remains in serious condition in the Intensive Care Unit at the Emilio Ribas Institute of Infectious Diseases, a reference center for suspected or confirmed Ebola cases. Health authorities state the risk of Ebola entering Brazil or South America remains very low, citing no local transmission, no direct flights from affected areas, and the fact that Ebola requires direct contact with bodily fluids. The investigation concluded the case was not Ebola, limiting further spread risk but continuing surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルが疑い例のエボラ熱を除外
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで疑い例が報告されたが、検査によりエボラウイルスが検出されず除外された。実際のエボラ症例は DRC のみであり、ブラジルでの感染リスクは非常に低いと評価されている。
triage.notes: ブラジルで疑い例が報告されたが、検査によりエボラが除外されている。患者は DRC からの渡航者であるが、実際のエボラ症例ではなく、ブラジル国内への流行リスクはない。DRC のエボラ流行自体に関する詳細情報は本記事には含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع إصابات إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية إلى 321 حالة و48 وفاة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rise to 321, with 48 deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-02, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 321 confirmed cases and 48 deaths, across three provinces as authorities persist containment efforts. The World Health Organization reports hundreds of suspected cases and dozens of deaths in DRC, with infections in neighboring Uganda and warnings of accelerated spread. In Kenya’s Nanyuki, residents protested a U.S.-backed plan to build a 50-bed Ebola isolation unit at a Laikipia County military base; a court temporarily halted the project amid public-health concerns. American sources say the facility would host exposed U.S. citizens, while Kenyan authorities describe it as strengthening emergency response. Humanitarian groups cite resource shortages, attacks on health facilities, and resistance to safe burial practices as obstacles, underscoring the need for rapid testing and broad community engagement.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ患者数が321例、死亡者48例に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラは重篤な公衆衛生脅威であり、複数国での確認、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクを有する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでのエボラ流行を主題としており、ウガンダでの感染とケニア（Nanyuki/Laikipia）での隔離施設建設への抗議が言及されている。ただし、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみであるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ウガンダ（対象国外）やケニア（対象国外）での直接的な流行発生は記事に明記されていない。WHOの関与、複数国への拡大リスク、公衆衛生対応の困難（医療施設への攻撃、埋葬実践への抵抗、資源不足）が記載されており、国際的な懸念は高い。

article.articleHeadline: В посольстве России в ЦАР рассказали о подготовке мер на случай вспышки Эболы - Новости на Вести.ru
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Russian embassy in the Central African Republic outlined measures to be taken in the event of an Ebola outbreak - News on Vesti.ru
article.articleSummary: Russian embassy in the Central African Republic outlines Ebola outbreak contingency measures, including possible emergency evacuation of Russian citizens and suspension of air travel, with lists and procedures regularly updated. The Kenyan embassy notes tighter sanitary controls would be taken if the situation worsens; missions in Tanzania, Rwanda and Angola say such restrictions are not planned yet. The outbreak center is the Democratic Republic of the Congo, which has 321 confirmed Ebola cases and 48 deaths; the outbreak was declared on May 15 in DRC and soon spread to Uganda, prompting Africa CDC to declare a public health emergency in both countries. As of May 25, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus reported over 900 possible cases in DR Congo. Russia has intensified border health checks; Rospotrebnadzor says there is no current risk of Ebola spreading domestically. Ebola is highly contagious with high mortality; first identified in 1976 in Sudan and near the Ebola River in DRC.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア中央アフリカ共和国大使館、エボラ流行対応措置について説明 - Vesti.ruニュース
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の感染拡大、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病は最高リスク感染症であり、DRC中心に複数国への感染拡大報告。
triage.notes: 記事は中央アフリカ共和国での対応計画について述べているが、サマリーによれば発症地はDRCが中心（321確定例、48死亡）であり、ウガンダへも拡大。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。エボラ病は最高優先度の病原体であり、複数国への拡大リスク、高い致死率（言及）により緊急対応が必要。Africa CDCが両国で公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言。

article.articleHeadline: خبراء صينيون لمكافحة "إيبولا" في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chinese experts to combat Ebola in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Beijing, on June 2, 2026, dispatched a team of medical experts to the Democratic Republic of Congo to support local efforts to combat the Ebola outbreak in the country. The experts—recognized for extensive experience in outbreak control—will join the Chinese medical team already working in the DRC and will strengthen cooperation with local health and outbreak-control authorities to help contain Ebola. The deployment provides additional skilled capacity to assist Congo's public health response and underscores continued collaboration with Congolese authorities involved in outbreak management to address the Ebola crisis.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ対策に中国専門家を派遣
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は公衆衛生上極めて深刻な疾患であり、IHR基準（深刻な影響・異常性・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）の複数に該当する。DRCでの実際の流行に対応した国際支援派遣という事象は、通常のシグナル識別基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでのエボラ流行を主題としており、中国からの医療専門家派遣はこれに対応するもの。発生地域フィールドに北京・中国が含まれているが、実際のエボラ発生地はDRCである。記事配信日は2026年6月2日（未来日付）で、シミュレーション記事の可能性があるが、トリアージロジックとしては実際の流行を想定した判定を実施。

article.articleHeadline: Hasil Tes Negatif, Dua Kasus Diduga Ebola di Brasil Resmi Dinyatakan Bebas Virus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Negative test results: Two suspected cases of Ebola in Brazil officially declared virus-free.
article.articleSummary: Two suspected Ebola infections in Brazil have been declared virus-free. São Paulo confirmed that a 37-year-old man who recently returned from the Democratic Republic of Congo, initially showing fever, was cleared after negative tests; he had been monitored following travel to Ebola-affected areas. In Rio de Janeiro, a Belgian national who traveled to Uganda also tested negative for Ebola; this patient was diagnosed with malaria rather than Ebola.
