Had results been positive, these would have been the first case outside Africa since the Congo outbreak began. The DRC has over 1,000 suspected Ebola cases with at least 246 deaths, concentrated in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu. Uganda has nine confirmed cases and one death. The Bundibugyo strain has no proven vaccine; three vaccines are under development by IAVI, University of Oxford, and Moderna. Ebola transmission typically involves direct contact with body fluids; animals, especially fruit bats, are natural reservoirs.

triage.headline_ja: 検査結果が陰性：ブラジルの疑い例2件が正式にウイルス無害宣言
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの疑い例は検査結果が陰性で除外された。DRC/ウガンダでのアウトブレイク情報は参考情報だが、ブラジルでの実際の感染・発症事例はなく、公衆衛生への直接的な脅威は存在しない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はブラジルの疑い例が陰性だったという報告であり、実際の感染事例ではない。DRCとウガンダでのアウトブレイク情報は背景情報として言及されているが、この記事は陰性確認のニュースであるため、シグナルとしてのピックアップ対象にはならない。

article.articleHeadline: خبراء صينيون لمكافحة إيبولا في الكونغو - أردو بوینت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chinese experts to combat Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo - Urdu Point
article.articleSummary: China has dispatched a team of medical experts to the Democratic Republic of the Congo to bolster local efforts against the Ebola outbreak. The specialists, with extensive experience in outbreak response, will join the Chinese medical team already operating in the DRC and will strengthen cooperation with local health authorities and disease-control agencies to help contain Ebola transmission. The move reflects ongoing international support for Congo’s efforts to manage the epidemic. The report does not provide casualty or case counts. The expanded collaboration aims to enhance field response, surveillance, and containment measures through joint work by Chinese experts and Congolese health authorities, contributing to the effort to curb the spread of Ebola in the African nation. As of 2026-06-02.

triage.headline_ja: 中国の専門家がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ熱対策に参加
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は高い公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスク、異常性を備える。IHR基準3つ以上該当し、国際的な医療支援が展開されている状況はシグナルの重要な指標である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは DRC でのエボラ流行が主要な主題であり、中国の医療専門家派遣は国際的な支援体制の展開を示唆している。China は支援国としては記載されているが、エボラ発生地としての言及はないため verified_locations から除外。ただし、DRC は対象国リストに含まれる。具体的な患者数や死亡数は記載されていないが、エボラ出血熱の固有の高い危険性により、不明でも PICKUP 判定の根拠は十分である。

article.articleHeadline: Gobierno nacional anunció medidas preventivas por brote de ébola Bundibugyo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The national government announced preventive measures in response to the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Venezuela activated Ebola surveillance after WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern due to Bundibugyo Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. As of May 31, 2026, Africa reported 291 confirmed cases and 43 deaths linked to the Bundibugyo strain. While reports cited suspected cases in the United States and Brazil, there were no confirmed cases in the Americas. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids of living or deceased infected individuals; there is no airborne spread. Initial symptoms include fever, fatigue, muscle pains, headache, and sore throat, which can progress to vomiting, diarrhea, hemorrhage, and organ damage. Venezuela will implement port and airport surveillance for travelers from affected areas, with Transport and Foreign Affairs ministries. Travelers from high-transmission regions are advised to avoid nonessential travel; contacts of travelers from risk areas should seek medical care if symptoms appear within 21 days.

triage.headline_ja: ブンディブギョエボラ流行への予防措置を発表 - ベネズエラ政府
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当し、WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言したエボラウイルス病の多国間流行。アフリカでの確認症例・死亡が報告され、米国・ブラジルでも疑い例があり、複数国での活動と渡航制限措置が講じられている。
triage.notes: WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言したブンディブギョエボラウイルス病の流行。DRCとウガンダでの確認症例（291例、死亡43例）が報告され、アメリカとブラジルでも疑い例が報告されている。複数国での監視体制構築と渡航制限措置が実施されている。Ugandaは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsには含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief urges stronger Congo response as Ebola outbreak widens
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo worsens as WHO Chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus calls for stronger international support. In Kinshasa, after briefing President Félix Tshisekedi, he said the outbreak—already the third-largest on record—has gone undetected for weeks, with aid groups warning the true scale may be far higher than official figures. Five certified recoveries were noted as signs of progress, but testing and treatment capacity must be expanded and trust between communities and health workers strengthened. The response teams continue in Ituri province, where the first cases were confirmed, as Tedros stressed that Ebola can be stopped when communities own the agenda and governments lead. He urged bolstering health systems and plans for broader community engagement; he was due to return to Geneva.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、コンゴのエボラ流行拡大に対し強化された対応を促す
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）、WPRO基準複数該当（重症度、流行のしやすさ、管理可能性）、高い社会的・政治的関心があり、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のキンシャサとイトゥリ州でのエボラ流行を主題としている。ジュネーブはWHO本部所在地として言及されているが、実際のイベント発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外。現在進行中の第3規模の大規模流行で、WHOが国際支援強化を明示的に要請している。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak: Acted's emergency response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in Ituri Province, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, was flagged on 15 May 2026. The World Health Organization reports suspected cases rising from 513 to 883 within a week, with 220 deaths recorded by 25 May. The outbreak now spans more than three provinces as borders tighten, hindering supplies and trapping humanitarian workers. The crisis is compounded by a fragile humanitarian context, large displacement, weak health infrastructure, limited community information, and challenges in patient care and corpse management, set against ongoing clashes between the M23 armed group and Congolese forces. Acted, present in DRC since 2003 and operating in 10 provinces, has mobilized a rapid emergency response funded by CDCS, the Humanitarian Fund and ECHO. Interventions include handwashing stations, latrine rehabilitation, water chlorination, hygiene kits with chlorine and Aquatabs, and training community representatives on protective practices.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行：コンゴ民主共和国におけるActedの緊急対応
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際的拡大リスク・国境措置）。WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべて該当。高リスク病原体（エボラ）の確認された流行。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の確認されたアウトブレイク。5月15日に東部イトゥリ州で報告され、1週間で疑い患者が513人から883人に増加、死亡者220人。3省以上に拡大。脆弱な保健インフラ、大規模な避難民、武装勢力との衝突など複合的な危機状況。WHOおよび複数の人道支援機関が対応中。

article.articleHeadline: Попова исключила возможность пандемии лихорадки Эбола // Новости НТВ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Popova ruled out the possibility of an Ebola fever pandemic.
article.articleSummary: June 2, 2026 — Anna Popova, head of Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor, says Ebola has no pandemic potential, describing it as a contact infection not transmitted via airborne, waterborne, or foodborne routes. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, the Ministry of Health reports 282 confirmed Ebola cases: 264 in Ituri, 15 in North Kivu, and 3 in South Kivu. There have been 42 deaths, with 238 patients currently under treatment and 2 recoveries. The remarks address concerns about global spread amid the DRC outbreak, emphasizing non-airborne transmission and presenting provincial case distributions alongside current clinical statuses.

triage.headline_ja: ポポワがエボラ熱パンデミックの可能性を排除
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で2つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）。DRC内でのエボラ患者282例、死亡42例という確定事例の増加と国際的懸念が示されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC内のエボラ発生が主題であり、282確定患者42死亡が報告されている。Russian Federationは発生地域リストに含まれているが、記事内容上は専門家意見を述べているのみで、ロシア国内での実際の発生ではない（社会的・政治的関心の背景としてのみ）。DRCのみをverified_locationsに含める。

article.articleHeadline: Mass protests erupt in Kenya against US offshore Ebola quarantine camp
article.articleSummary: Hundreds of youths and residents in Nanyuki, Kenya, protested plans for a US Ebola quarantine facility at Laikipia Air Base, blocking roads and rallying at the gates. The proposed 50-bed field hospital would serve American citizens exposed to Ebola, with no provisions for Kenyans. Kenya’s High Court issued a conservatory order halting any Ebola quarantine/isolation/treatment facility linked to the US plan, pending a petition by the Katiba Institute. The Kenyan doctors’ union issued a 48-hour strike notice, warning the health system is unprepared for a highly infectious filovirus. Kenya has zero recorded Ebola cases, while a rapidly growing outbreak persists in neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). Critics say the offshoring risk benefits the US and ignores local public health needs; US officials frame the facility as rapid care for Americans, while opponents say it externalizes risk and neglects regional response needs.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで米国のエボラ隔離キャンプに対する大規模抗議活動が発生
triage.triage_reason: エボラ発生（DRC）と隣接地域（ケニア）での社会的・政治的関心は高いが、ケニアでのエボラ症例報告はなく、記事の主焦点は施設建設計画への抗議。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはケニアの2地域が含まれるが、記事サマリーはDRCでの「急速に成長する流行」を述べており、ケニアではエボラ症例ゼロ。ケニアは隔離施設建設計画の対象地であるが、現在の流行の中心ではない。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ただし、この事象の直接的なヘルスリスク評価には、DRCの流行の詳細情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 中國專家組將赴剛果（金）支援埃博拉疫情防控 - 香港商報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chinese expert team to go to the Democratic Republic of the Congo to support Ebola outbreak prevention and control.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-02, a first batch of Chinese epidemic-prevention experts departs Beijing for the Democratic Republic of the Congo to support Ebola prevention and control. The World Health Organization designated the Congo Ebola outbreak on 2026-05-17 as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. China will deploy high-level specialists with public health and integrated traditional Chinese and Western medicine expertise to assist local outbreak response, in collaboration with the local health authorities and the Chinese medical team in DRC. The experts will train local medical institutions, the Chinese medical team, the Chinese embassy, enterprises, and overseas nationals in prevention and treatment. This reflects China’s commitment to international cooperation in outbreak response. Since the outbreak began, the 24th batch of China’s medical team in DRC has activated emergency response, built control systems, conducted drills, coordinated supplies, and guided preventive measures for locals and compatriots in country.

triage.headline_ja: 中国の専門家チームがコンゴ民主共和国に赴きエボラ疫情の防止と制御を支援する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。WHOが2026-05-17にPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言したエボラウイルス病の拡大防止に関する国際協力の動向であり、重大な公衆衛生上の影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、および渡航・貿易制限のリスクがある。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ症例の実際の発生を報じているのではなく、中国による国際支援の動向を報じている。発生地域にBeijing（中国）が含まれているが、サマリーから判断すると実際の流行発生地はDRCであり、中国は支援国である。DRCのエボラ流行に関する直接的な情報（症例数、死亡者数、地理的分布など）は記事に含まれていないため、詳細情報収集が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Quatre agents de santé se rétablissent de la maladie à virus Ebola en République démocratique du Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Four healthcare workers are recovering from Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease caused by Bundibugyo virus in Ituri's Bunia, Democratic Republic of the Congo: four nurses have recovered and were discharged, bringing total recovered to five (including a laboratory worker who recovered on May 28). Early diagnosis and access to a dedicated health facility are associated with better outcomes. WHO has delivered a rehabilitated Ebola Treatment Center in Bunia, 24 beds, expandable to 60, plus an annex with 42 beds expected soon. As of 31 May, Congo has 210 confirmed cases and 17 confirmed deaths, with 349 suspected cases under investigation; sixteen health workers have been infected. WHO DG Tedros said there is no licensed vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola yet, but several candidate therapies and vaccines show promise for evaluation in trials, with DRC and Uganda coordinating. Ongoing response includes testing, surveillance, infection prevention and control, community engagement, and resource mobilization to maintain essential services.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルス病から4人の医療労働者が回復
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスによる確定症例210例、死亡17例、医療従事者16名感染という重大な公衆衛生上の影響があり、異常・予想外な疾病パターン、ウガンダへの国際的拡大リスク、および国際的な対応・支援の必要性を示唆する状況である。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスは稀な型であり、現在ライセンス取得済みのワクチン・治療薬がない。DRCとウガンダが協調している点から、ウガンダでの症例確認の可能性がある。記事サマリーに「ウガンダで確認」との明記がないため verified_locations には DRC のみ記載しているが、続報で確認があれば更新が必要。高い社会的・政治的関心（WHO DG発言）が示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: エボラ出血熱が流行するアフリカの国とアフリカ連合を支援 -- 中国
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China to support African countries where Ebola hemorrhagic fever is spreading and the African Union.
article.articleSummary: Outbreaks of Ebola virus disease (EVD) in parts of Africa have led the World Health Organization to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. On 2026-06-01, China through the China International Development Cooperation Agency announced emergency humanitarian aid to the Democratic Republic of the Congo and will dispatch a medical expert team to provide clinical services and support. China will also assist Africa CDC in infection prevention and control activities and back the African Union Commission. Beijing will maintain close communication with the DRC, other African countries, WHO, and the AU, offering additional assistance as the outbreak evolves and needs arise, within its capacity. This signals a coordinated international response to Ebola spread in Africa, emphasizing humanitarian relief, medical services, and public health collaboration.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱が流行するアフリカの国とアフリカ連合を支援 -- 中国
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべて該当（重篤な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WHOがPHEIC宣言している現在進行中のエボラアウトブレイク報道であり、複数国での確認と国際的な対応が進行中。
triage.notes: WHOのPHEIC宣言済みのアフリカにおけるエボラアウトブレイク。記事サマリーではDRCが主要な発生国として明記されており、中国による医療専門家派遣と人道支援が発表されている。中国（北京）の言及は支援提供国としてのものであり、発生地ではない。対象国リストのDRCのみを verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: बदले मौसम से बिलासपुर में बढ़ा बीमारियों का कहर; सोमवार को सिम्स अस्पताल पहुंचे रिकॉर्ड 2231 मरीज
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Changing weather fuels a surge in illnesses in Bilaspur; a record 2,231 patients arrived at SIMS Hospital on Monday.
article.articleSummary: Bilaspur, India — SIMS Hospital registered a surge in illnesses as weather swings drive viral infections and waterborne disease. On Monday, 2,231 patients sought treatment at SIMS, with viral fever, cold, cough, fever, and general weakness dominating. Heat-related illnesses such as heat stroke, sunburn, and dehydration are rising, alongside diarrheal cases now reported in both slum and expanded residential areas. Investigations point to municipal water leaks: pipelines crossing drains leak contaminated water into homes, fueling diarrhea. Temperature swings of 3–5°C within hours, plus heat and sudden rain ahead of monsoon, keep circulating viruses active and prolong recovery from viral fever to 7–10 days. Dr. Lakhan Singh, SIMS medical superintendent, urges protective measures and vigilance for ongoing outpatient surge and potential waterborne disease spread.

triage.headline_ja: 変わりゆく気候がビラスプールの病気を増加させ、月曜日にSIMS病院に記録的な2,231人の患者が到着
triage.triage_reason: 未特定の疾患による患者数急増（2,231人/日）は異常で、上下水道汚染やウイルス感染の複合要因が関連しているが、死亡率・重症度が不明であり、国際的な検査確認や危機宣言がない。情報充実化を待つ段階。
triage.notes: 疾患が『Unknown Illness』として分類されており、具体的な病原体が特定されていない点が重要。ウイルス熱、水系感染症、熱中病の混在と記載されているが、統一された病因確認が不足。地方の医療施設からの報告のみで、中央当局やWHOの警告がない。情報の更新と原因病原体の確定を待つ必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Após investigação, Governo de SP descarta caso suspeito do vírus Ebola em paciente internado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After investigation, the São Paulo state government rules out a suspected Ebola virus case in a hospitalized patient.
article.articleSummary: São Paulo state has ruled out Ebola virus disease in a 37-year-old man admitted to Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribas with fever and diarrhea, after epidemiological and laboratory investigations. The patient, originally from the Democratic Republic of Congo and with recent travel to the territory, was transported on May 30 and remained in the ICU in serious condition. Instituto Adolfo Lutz detected no Ebola genetic material, while qPCR had identified Neisseria meningitidis, the meningococcal meningitis agent. The CIEVS‑SP confirmed the patient did not travel to Ebola-risk areas within the DRC. The CCD‑SES‑SP considers the risk of introduction of Ebola into Brazil and South America very low, though vigilance for fever with recent travel (past 21 days) and exposure to bodily fluids remains. A joint Nota Informativa on the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in DRC was updated, with reporting and isolation guidance via CVE‑SP.

triage.headline_ja: 調査後、サンパウロ州政府は入院患者のエボラウイルス疑い例を除外
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス疑い例は除外され、確認されたのはメニンゴコッカス髄膜炎の単一症例である。国際的な拡大リスクはなく、社会的・政治的関心も限定的である。
triage.notes: 記事の主要内容はエボラ疑い例の『除外』である。確認された疾患はメニンゴコッカス髄膜炎で単一症例。DRCで発生しているBundibugyo Ebolaアウトブレイクについては言及されているが、ブラジルでのシグナルではなく参考情報に過ぎない。よって対象国はBrasilのみを記載。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれも該当せず、シグナル価値なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak in Africa 'likely far worse' than official figures suggest, IRC warns - World Byte News
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is likely far worse than official figures suggest, according to the International Rescue Committee (IRC). The warning, issued on Monday and reported on 2026-06-02, highlights concerns that the publicly released numbers may underestimate the scope of Ebola activity in the DRC. The IRC’s assessment does not provide accompanying case counts, death tallies, laboratory confirmation details, infection sources, or information on imported or exported cases within the article. The piece emphasizes the ongoing outbreak in the DRC without elaborating on symptoms or transmission specifics. No additional locations are named beyond the DRC. The report calls for heightened attention and more transparent reporting to align official figures with on-the-ground conditions perceived by the IRC.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカのエボラ出血熱流行は「公式統計より遥かに悪い」可能性、国際救援委員会が警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの流行が公式統計を上回る可能性が指摘されており、IHR基準の深刻な公衆衛生への影響および異常性の両者に該当。スクリーニング基準でも異常性・重症度・管理可能性が該当し、高い社会的・政治的関心を有するため。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行が公式統計より深刻である可能性を国際救援委員会（IRC）が警告したもの。具体的な患者数や死亡者数は記事に記載されていないが、組織的な懸念が表明されている。DRC内での流行継続と国際的な注目度の高さが特徴。

article.articleHeadline: Тест-системы на выявление хантавируса разработали за неделю в России
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus detection test systems developed in Russia within a week.
article.articleSummary: Russia's Rospotrebnadzor announced rapid development of diagnostic test systems for Andes hantavirus, disclosed by Vasily Akimkin at a CSTO member-state biosafety conference. Information sharing on Andes proceeded quickly: a full genome was obtained May 8 in Switzerland, deposited May 11, and full-genome sequences came from six patients, closely related to Chilean and Argentine strains seen in 2014 and 2018 outbreaks. Consequently, a laboratory detection method for Andes virus was available in about a week. Akimkin noted that Russia already had methods for other hantaviruses. In a related move, Rospotrebnadzor said it plans to deliver Russian test systems for Bundibugyo ebolavirus to the Republic of Congo. The report also references a cruise-ship hantavirus outbreak accelerating vaccine development, and Kazakhstan’s health ministry outlining hantavirus prevention measures.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアで1週間でハンタウイルス検出テスト系を開発
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルス感染症の診断技術開発に関する報告だが、実際の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、検査システム開発の進展に関する技術的公表である。対象国はDRCのみだが、言及はハンタウイルスではなくBundibugyo ebolavirus支援に限定される。
triage.notes: 記事の主要内容はハンタウイルス診断技術の開発進展とロシアによるコンゴへのエボラ検査系提供に関するもの。スイス、チリ、アルゼンチン、カザフスタンは参考情報として言及されているが、これらは2014-2018年の過去のアウトブレイク参考例やゲノム配列の提供元であり、現在の感染症イベント発生地ではない。DRCについてはBundibugyo ebolavirus関連の支援が言及されているが、ハンタウイルスではない。現在の能動的な感染症アウトブレイク報告に基づかないため、継続的な情報収集が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Health minister: Confirmed Ebola cases surpass 300 in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: 343 confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) as of 2026-06-02, with Bunia in Ituri province as the outbreak epicenter after the May 15 declaration—the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC since 1976. Response operations are now better targeted following a government mission to Bunia; Bunia Airport will reopen this week for humanitarian flights, with handwashing and temperature checks in place. Zimbabwe has established three isolation centers in Harare, Bulawayo, and Chirundu on the Zambia border, though no cases have been reported. Africa CDC Director-General Jean Kaseya urged evidence-based, proportionate travel measures and warned against fear-driven bans. In Brazil, a suspected Ebola case in Sao Paulo was ruled out after lab tests found no virus; the 37-year-old man from the DRC remains seriously ill in ICU, with very low risk of local transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 保健相：コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ確定症例が300例を超える
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確定症例343例が報告されており、IHR基準の「重大な公衆衛生への影響」「異常性」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当し、複数の国での警戒体制構築も確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、DRCでのエボラ確定症例343例（Ituri州Buniaが震源地）が報告されている。ジンバブエは症例未報告だが警戒態勢を整備。ブラジルはサンパウロで疑似症例1件が報告されたが、検査結果陰性で除外。対象国リストからはDRC・ザンビア・ブラジルが verified_locations に該当。DRCでの確定患者数343例、複数国での対応準備、Africa CDCによる警告発出など、IHR基準4項目全て・WPRO基準5項目全てに該当するため高優先度。

article.articleHeadline: China akan kirim tim ahli medis ke Kongo bantu pengendalian ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China to send a team of medical experts to the Congo to help contain Ebola.
article.articleSummary: China will send a high-level medical team to the Democratic Republic of the Congo to help contain the Ebola outbreak, following WHO's May 17 designation of the outbreak as a public health emergency of international concern. The team will depart Beijing early Tuesday and join the existing Chinese medical contingent already in DRC to bolster local epidemiology and medical coordination. The deployment aims to strengthen collaboration with local health authorities and epidemiology institutes, support containment, and improve prevention and treatment capacity. In addition to clinical work, the team will conduct training for local facilities, the Chinese embassy, Chinese companies, and overseas Chinese residents. This move underscores China's commitment to international cooperation in outbreak response. The ongoing efforts include the 24th Chinese medical team in DRC implementing emergency response measures, trainings, and supply coordination.

triage.headline_ja: 中国がコンゴへ医療専門家チームを派遣しエボラ対策を支援
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク）かつWPRO基準複数該当（重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）。WHOが国際的懸念の公衆衛生上の緊急事態と指定したエボラ流行への国際的対応が開始されている。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのエボラ流行と中国からの国際支援について述べている。WHOが5月17日に国際的懸念の公衆衛生上の緊急事態として指定済み。Beijing/Chinaは中国医療チームの出発地であり、発生地域ではないため対象国リストからは除外。既存のエボラ流行と対応措置の継続を示す。

article.articleHeadline: 专访丨非洲疾控中心主任卡塞亚：埃博拉疫情防控取得初步成效
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Exclusive interview with Africa CDC Director Kasaya: Preliminary progress in Ebola outbreak prevention and control
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda show early signs of containment but remain a regional threat. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or specific therapy. Africa CDC Director Dr. Jean Kaseya cautioned that cross-border movement could fuel wider spread, despite progress. In the current outbreak, 5 patients in the DRC have recovered, and 19 health-care workers have been infected with 6 deaths. Laboratory capacity has improved and contact tracing expanded, yet challenges persist: supply shortages in eastern DRC and limited community cooperation in conflict-affected areas. As of May 30, more than 1,100 suspected cases await confirmation. WHO declared a PHEIC on May 17; national risk very high, regional risk high, global risk low. Africa plans about $319 million (June–November) for surveillance, labs, HCW protection, community engagement, and cross-border coordination. Kasaya calls for speed, unity, and sustained funding, with Africa-led R&D.

triage.headline_ja: 専門家インタビュー｜アフリカCDC局長カセヤ：エボラ疫情の予防・防止で初期的成果を挙げる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の多地域発生、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WHO PHEIC宣言済み、複数国での死亡・重症例あり、ワクチン・治療法なし。フルRRA進行の正当性極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでの発生が明記されているが、ウガンダ（GeoNames ID 226074）は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCのみ該当。WHO PHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）済み、ブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスでワクチン・特異的治療法なし、複数地域での保健医療従事者感染・死亡例あり、クロスボーダー移動リスク言及あり、1,100件超の未確認疑い患者が控えており、対応の管理可能性に課題。

article.articleHeadline: Число подтвержденных случаев вируса Эбола в Конго выросло до 321
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of confirmed Ebola virus disease cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has risen to 321.
article.articleSummary: Confirmed Ebola virus disease cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have risen to 321. WHO figures show that as of May 29, 2026, the country had about 906 suspected cases, with the government later reporting 282 confirmed cases on Sunday and 321 on Monday. The eastern DRC outbreak involves the Bundibugyo strain of the Ebola virus. CEPI will allocate about USD 60 million to Moderna and two other research groups to accelerate vaccine development against the Bundibugyo strain, building on CEPI's early COVID-19 vaccine funding experience. The article notes no additional details on laboratory confirmation methods, infection sources, or imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラウイルス確認患者数が321人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、重症度が高く（確認患者数321人増加傾向）、スクリーニング基準複数該当。Bundibugyo株という特異的な株が関連し、ワクチン開発への国際的対応が進行中。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）による東部DRC流行。確認患者数の増加傾向、疑似患者906人との開き、WHO報告数と政府報告数の相違が存在。CEPI による USD 60 百万規模のワクチン開発加速支援が決定されており、国際的関心が高い。フルRRA実施を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Venezuela aplicará controles sanitarios en puertos y aeropuertos por brotes de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Venezuela will implement sanitary controls at ports and airports due to Ebola outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: Venezuela will implement entry-point surveillance and control measures at ports and airports for travelers from Ebola outbreak zones starting this week, according to Health Minister Carlos Alvarado. The Health Ministry and competent agencies will enforce care protocols and the national health-response plan at entry points in line with international recommendations. Venezuela says the transmission risk is low and maintains daily monitoring of Ebola activity worldwide. The World Health Organization has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern for Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, caused by the Bundibugyo strain. Although media reports mention suspected cases in the United States and Brazil, no official confirmed cases have been reported in any American country. The government, with Foreign Affairs and Transport, has reinforced surveillance and risk-notification systems. Bundibugyo's fatality rate is 30-50%, with no approved vaccine or specific treatment, and high risk in sub-Saharan Africa, low globally.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱流行に伴いベネズエラが港湾・空港での衛生管理措置を実施
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病はIHR基準の国際的懸念疾患だが、記事サマリーでは対象国（DRC、ウガンダ）での流行は言及されておらず、ベネズエラは予防的措置を講じているのみで確認症例なし。情報不足のため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域フィールドには米国、ブラジル、ベネズエラが含まれているが、サマリーでは『疑い症例は報道されているが、米国とブラジルを含むいかなるアメリカ国でも確認症例は報告されていない』と明記。したがってDRCのみを verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは『発生地域』フィールドに含まれていないため除外。ベネズエラは予防的措置実施国であり、実際の発生地域ではない。IHR基準4項目すべてに該当するが、実際の流行は対象国外（DRC、ウガンダ）であり、対象国での確認症例がないため WATCH 判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉疫情升級，WHO上調剛果民主共和國風險評估至「非常高」
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak escalates as WHO raises the Democratic Republic of the Congo's risk assessment to 'Very High'.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by Bundibugyo virus, has reached 282 confirmed cases and 42 deaths, centered in Ituri with spillovers to North Kivu and South Kivu. Uganda reports 9 cases and 1 death, for a total of 291 cases and 43 deaths. As of June 1, 2026, laboratory-confirmed cases surged from earlier WHO counts (125 cases, 17 deaths on May 27) with 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths noted. There is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. A Bunia Ebola treatment center in Ituri has treated patients, with 5 recovered. CEPI pledged up to $62 million to accelerate candidate vaccines against Bundibugyo virus. WHO raised the DRC’s domestic risk to Very High, regional risk to High, global risk to Low. Critical next steps: boost testing, expand contact tracing (about 20% of contacts traced), and modify high-risk funeral practices to prevent cross-border spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ疫情が深刻化、WHOが南ア民主共和国のリスク評価を「極めて高い」に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスの大規模流行で確定患者282名・死亡42名（総計291名・43名死亡）に達し、DRCおよびウガンダで確認。WHOが域内リスクをHighに、ワクチン・治療薬なしで国際的拡大リスク高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダも列挙されているが、記事サマリーでは「ウガンダで9例1死亡」と二次的な拡大として記載。主流行はDRC（Ituri、South Kivu、North Kivu）。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。Bundibugyo型エボラは高い死亡率を示し、葬儀慣行による越境感染リスクが指摘されている。CEPI資金投入（6200万ドル）、治療薬・ワクチン不在など管理困難な状況を反映。

article.articleHeadline: Tiga Kandidat Vaksin Bundibugyo Ebolavirus Dikebut
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three Bundibugyo ebolavirus vaccine candidates fast-tracked.
article.articleSummary: CEPI fast-tracks three Bundibugyo ebolavirus vaccine candidates amid uncertainty that current Zaire ebolavirus vaccines protect against Bundibugyo due to species differences. The three vaccine platforms selected by CEPI are not novel technologies; they already have broad safety data and have been used to develop vaccines against filoviruses, including Zaire Ebola, Sudan virus, and Marburg virus. If Phase I results show favorable safety profiles and immunogenic responses, CEPI plans to advance to later-stage trials to support emergency use authorization or full licensing. CEPI also seeks to broaden the Ebola vaccine pipeline to provide backup options and strengthen future supply. Context references include WHO Disease Outbreak News on Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. Published June 2, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: バンディブギオエボラウイルスのワクチン候補3つが急速開発される
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの新規ワクチン開発は重要だが、本記事は技術開発・政策決定に関する情報であり、進行中の疾病流行の直接的な報告ではない。DRCとウガンダでの発生の存在は参考情報として言及されているのみ。
triage.notes: 本記事の主題はバンディブギオエボラウイルスワクチンの開発加速であり、DRCとウガンダの発生状況は背景情報として参照されているのみ。継続的な流行情報の収集が推奨される。記事本文が空欄のため詳細評価は限定的。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Reopens Main Airport in Ebola Epicenter as Officials Brace for Long Outbreak | Today News
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri province, Bunia airport reopened after health authorities reported tentative signs the outbreak may slow. The airport resumed operations with temperature screening for departures and arrivals. The outbreak has 321 confirmed infections and 48 deaths across 23 health zones in eastern DRC. Ituri province now includes 15 affected zones, with Logo newly affected. Contact tracing coverage remains weak: only 43% of identified contacts being monitored, below the 95% target, while 47 lab samples await analysis. Health authorities are focusing on sustaining transport links and outbreak operations amid a potentially lengthy epidemic. Vaccine developers are moving three experimental Bundibugyo vaccines into human testing, and Congo's Institute of Public Health is assessing Bunia facilities to host the national Ebola response coordination center to strengthen management across provinces.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の震源地での空港再開、当局は長期流行に備える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WPRO基準でも複数該当。確認感染者321名、死亡48名という重症度、接触者追跡の不十分さ、国際対応の必要性が明らかであり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の大規模集団発生。321名の確認感染者、23の保健地域に広がる地理的拡大、接触者追跡カバー率43%（目標95%）という管理不十分性、ワクチン開発の進展、国際的な実験的介入が進行中。空港再開という交通インフラの意思決定も国際的関心を示す。長期化の可能性が明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: Dinas Pertanian Gianyar Bali Siaga Virus ASF, Minta Peternak Tingkatkan Biosekuriti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gianyar Bali Department of Agriculture on Alert for African Swine Fever Virus (ASFV), Urges Farmers to Increase Biosecurity.
article.articleSummary: African Swine Fever Virus (ASFV) threatens pig farms in Gianyar Regency, Bali, Indonesia, with cases reported across several districts including Gianyar. On 2 June 2026, the local Agriculture Department urged farmers to strengthen biosecurity to prevent spread and economic losses. ASF is a viral disease that is highly lethal to pigs but not transmitted to humans. Strong biosecurity should cover strict oversight of livestock movements, vehicles, people, equipment, and feed; maintain clean housing; and carefully source new stock from health-statused origins. Farmers should promptly report ASF-like signs—high fever, loss of appetite, lethargy, or sudden death—to the Puskeswan veterinary health center. Control requires coordinated action among farmers, traders, government, veterinarians, academics, and communities; prevention is more cost-effective than outbreak response. Publication date: 2026-06-02.

triage.headline_ja: ジアニャル・バリ農業局、アフリカ豚熱ウイルスに警戒、農家にバイオセキュリティ強化を要請
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱（ASF）は動物疾病であり人間への感染なし。インドネシアの地域警告段階で、公衆衛生への直接的な深刻な影響は限定的だが、地域経済への影響と農業セキュリティの懸念が認められる。情報がまだ初期段階のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: ASFは人間には感染しない動物疾病だが、畜産業への経済的脅威は重大。IHR基準では該当が限定的（unusual/unexpectedのみ）。WPROスクリーニング基準では複数該当。現在のところシグナルレベルに達していないが、地域当局が既に警戒体制を敷いており、今後の拡大状況を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: LIRAa 2026 aponta alto risco de surto de arboviroses em Brasilândia; população deve intensificar eliminação de criadouros
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: LIRAa 2026 Indicates High Risk of Arboviral Outbreak in Brasilândia; Population Should Intensify Efforts to Eliminate Breeding Sites
article.articleSummary: Brasilândia, Brazil, faces high arboviral outbreak risk (dengue, Zika, chikungunya) after LIRAa 2026 results. The Ae. aegypti Infestation Index (IIP) reached 4.7% during May 25–29, 2026, above the 3.9% alert threshold. From 443 properties inspected, 35 Ae. aegypti breeding sites were found in 21 properties, plus 10 Culex sites; over 90% of breeding sites were inside residences, underscoring home-based control. Predominant deposits were small, removable containers such as bottles, pots, plant saucers, and lids that collect water. Immediate actions include domestic cleaning, sealing water tanks, securing waste, washing plant saucers weekly, and keeping drains or ralos screened. Health measures: daily use of repellent and prompt care at a Unidade Básica de Saúde (UBS) or hospital for fever, body pains, red spots, or retro-orbital pain. Municipal actions: house-to-house visits and thermonebulization in sewers; residents should spend about 10 minutes weekly inspecting yards to eliminate standing water.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年LIRAa調査、ブラジル・ブラジランディアではアルボウイルス感染症の流行リスク高い；住民は蚊の繁殖地の排除を強化すべき
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの特定地域（Brasilândia）においてネッタイシマカの幼虫指数が警告閾値を上回り、デング熱・ジカウイルス・チクングニアの流行リスクが高い状況が報告されています。重症度や死亡に関する情報が記事に記載されていないため、現段階ではスクリーニング基準1つ以上該当しますが情報不足のため、経過観察段階が適切です。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルのMato Grosso do Sul州Brasilândia地域でのネッタイシマカ幼虫指数（IIP）が4.7%に達し、警告閾値3.9%を上回ったことを報告しています。デング熱、ジカウイルス、チクングニアの流行リスクが高いとされていますが、現在の確定症例数や重症度、死亡に関する情報は記事に含まれていません。蚊媒介感染症は流行しやすく、長期曝露リスクが認識されており、当局による対応が進行中です。より詳細な疫学情報の入手が必要です。

article.articleHeadline: CHDC Congo ghi nhận 343 ca nhiễm virus Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo records 343 Ebola virus infections.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo confirms 343 Ebola virus infections, Health Minister Roger Kamba says, following coordination meetings on response chaired by Prime Minister Judith Suminwa. The eastern Ituri Province capital Bunia remains the outbreak focus, with response activities now better targeted after official visits there. Bunia airport is closed to regular flights but will reopen to humanitarian traffic this week, while preventive measures—hand washing facilities and temperature screening—are in place. Zimbabwe establishes three Ebola isolation centers in Harare, Bulawayo, and Chirundu on the border with Zambia. Transport arrangements and personal protective equipment are prepared, and emergency coordination mechanisms remain active. No Ebola cases have been reported in Zimbabwe yet, but the country stays vigilant, with enhanced border screening, ongoing health worker training, and community awareness campaigns urging people with symptoms to seek medical care promptly.

triage.headline_ja: DRC コンゴ、エボラウイルス感染343例を記録
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラは公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的脅威。DRC での多数例確認と地域的拡散の懸念（ジンバブエの準備状況）により、フルRRA が必須。
triage.notes: エボラは PHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）の候補疾患。DRC での 343 例確認、Ituri Province Bunia が震源地。ジンバブエは隔離センター設置準備中で地域的拡散の懸念あり。Zambia は DRC との国境地帯での警戒体制。Bluedot の発生地域リストに Zimbabwe も含まれていたが、記事サマリーでは「未確診例なし」「準備段階」のため verified_locations には含めず DRC と Zambia のみ列挙。

article.articleHeadline: Bệnh viện Bạch Mai chỉ rõ: "2 phút vàng" ngăn chặn nguy cơ lây nhiễm 1 bệnh cực nguy hiểm, đang lây lan nhanh với tốc độ "chưa từng có"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bach Mai Hospital clarifies: "Two Golden Minutes" to prevent the transmission of a highly dangerous disease, spreading at an unprecedented rate.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-02, WHO classifies Ebola risk in Congo as very high and the regional risk including Uganda as high, noting an unprecedented rapid spread. Vietnam’s Ministry of Health reports no Ebola cases yet and a currently low risk, though importation cannot be ruled out amid increasing international travel. Bạch Mai Hospital in Hanoi activated an Ebola prevention framework to protect patients and staff, prioritizing early detection, timely isolation, correct procedures, and comprehensive infection control. All units must review Ebola contingency plans and monitor suspected cases with a 21-day exposure history. Ebola incubation is 2–21 days; transmission occurs after symptom onset via blood and body fluids. The hospital promotes a “2-5-30” approach: 2 minutes to elicit symptoms and exposure, 5 minutes to isolate, 30 minutes to activate the response. Core measures include PPE adherence, waste management, and environmental cleaning to prevent nosocomial spread.

triage.headline_ja: バッハ マイ病院が明確にする：「ゴールデン2分」によって極めて危険な病気の伝播を防止、「前例のない」速度で感染拡大中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラはスクリーニング基準でも複数該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。対象国ベトナムとDRCの双方に実際のイベントが発生している。
triage.notes: エボラは公衆衛生上最優先度の感染症。DRCでの流行「前例のない速度」とWHO評価、ベトナムへの輸入リスク認識、医療施設での厳格な対策実装が記載されている。Uganda（GeoNames ID 226074）は発生地域に含まれるが、記事サマリーではWHOリスク評価言及のみで具体的な患者発生は述べられていないため対象外。

article.articleHeadline: 莫德納等團隊獲18.9億資金挹注 加速伊波拉疫苗研發
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Moderna and other teams receive 1.89 billion in funding to accelerate Ebola vaccine development.
article.articleSummary: CEPI will fund up to $60 million to Moderna and two other institutions to accelerate development of a vaccine against Ebola Bundibugyo virus (BDBV) in response to an outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo. Of this, up to $50 million will support Moderna’s preclinical and early clinical development of a BDBV vaccine candidate. Moderna reports promising preclinical Ebola virus results, with the goal of a vaccine that can effectively prevent disease and simplify delivery. There are currently no approved vaccines or therapies for BDBV. Ebola’s high mortality underscores urgency. Africa CDC and WHO report 282 confirmed cases and 42 deaths in the DRC, with about 1,100 suspected cases. Trials face security-related challenges; readiness could come in months, and discussions on vaccine procurement and funding for future vaccination campaigns are expected.

triage.headline_ja: モデルナなどのチームが18.9億資金を獲得し、エボラワクチン開発を加速
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo型）の確認患者数および死亡数がIHR基準を満たし、国際的ワクチン開発資金による対応が進行中。公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに記載された282確認患者、42死亡（致命率約15%）、1,100疑似患者はIHR基準「serious_impact」「unusual_unexpected」「international_spread」に該当。エボラ出血熱はWHO最高レベルの懸念対象疾患。CEPI、WHO、Africa CDCによる国際的対応が確認されており、PICKUP判定は適切。

article.articleHeadline: 中国首批抗疫专家赴刚果（金）支援伊波拉疫情防控
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China's first batch of anti-epidemic experts to the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) to assist with Ebola outbreak prevention and control.
article.articleSummary: China's first batch of anti-epidemic experts departed Beijing in the early hours of June 2 to assist Ebola outbreak prevention and control in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The team, the 24th Chinese medical delegation to DRC, will support local Ebola response, cooperate with Congolese health and disease-control authorities, and provide training for local medical facilities, the Chinese medical team, foreign embassies, and overseas Chinese personnel. WHO had on May 17 declared the Congo Ebola outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. As of Monday, Congo had 343 confirmed Ebola cases and 48 deaths; officials had reported 260 cases by May 30. The accompanying image depicts Ituri Province Red Cross workers disinfecting outside the home of a man who died from Ebola. China will also deliver medical services and aid as part of broader international efforts to curb the outbreak and enhance local diagnosis and treatment capacity.

triage.headline_ja: 中国首批抗疫専家赴剛果（金）支援伊波拉疫情防控
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで発生し、WHO PHEIC宣言済み、複数国の国際対応が展開中であり、IHR基準3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当する。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラ発生地は記事サマリーで明示されており、Ituri Provinceが特定されている。中国からの専門家派遣という国際対応が既に進行中。WHO PHEIC宣言済みで、公式に国際的懸念が認定されている。

article.articleHeadline: Moderna and other groups get $60 million to develop Ebola vaccine
article.articleSummary: CEPI will provide roughly $60 million to Moderna and two other groups to accelerate vaccines against Ebola Bundibugyo (BDBV) in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo. The outbreak has 321 confirmed cases and 48 deaths across three provinces; earlier counts showed 282 confirmed, 42 deaths, and ~1,100 suspected in Congo, with 9 confirmed in Uganda and one death. Global health agencies have declared the outbreak a public health emergency. Moderna would receive up to $50 million for preclinical and early clinical development of its BDBV vaccine candidate, including manufacturing and progression to later trials if early data are positive. An additional up to $8.6 million supports an Oxford/Serum Institute shot, and $3.2 million for an IAVI candidate using similar tech to Merck’s Ervebo. Oxford’s ChAdOx1 Bundibugyo uses the same platform as the COVID-19 vaccine. Trials planned in Africa; dosing to be determined in Phase 1; access remains a key challenge, with 300,000 Ervebo doses previously needed to curb Zaire outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: Modernaおよび他のグループがエボラワクチン開発のために6000万ドルを獲得
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の3つに該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱Bundibugyo型の急速な感染拡大が東部コンゴで報告されており、世界保健機関によって公衆衛生上の緊急事態と宣言されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダでの死亡例も報告されているが、サマリー上の主要な発生地はDRCであり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に追加していない。エボラ出血熱Bundibugyo型（BDBV）の東部DRCでの急速な拡大、複数地域への拡散、死亡率の高さ、国際的なワクチン開発投資が行われている点から、フルRRAへの進行が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Masivní rozmach eboly v Africe: Přes 1100 případů! "Začalo to závratěmi," líčí nakažený zdravotník
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Massive Ebola outbreak in Africa: Over 1,100 cases! "It started with dizziness," recounts the infected healthcare worker.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and neighboring Uganda has surpassed 1,100 probable cases, with Ituri province at the epicenter. As of Saturday, 263 confirmed cases and 43 deaths; by Monday, 282 confirmed. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain is implicated; Uganda reports nine cases and has closed the border with Congo. Ministers of DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan approved a roughly $319 million plan to accelerate response, though data are likely undercounted due to ongoing conflict that hinders case finding, isolation, contact tracing, and safe burials. WHO Director-General Tedros Ghebreyesus visited Ituri, pledging support and calling for ceasefire to allow public health work. Vaccines and therapies are not broadly approved. Five infected healthcare workers recovered and were discharged in Bunia; recovery certificates were issued by the WHO chief. Initial symptom noted by one worker: dizziness, followed by vomiting and marked hypotension.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでのエボラの大規模流行：1100件以上の症例！「めまいで始まった」と感染した医療従事者が説明
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全てに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WPRO基準でも5項目全てに該当。WHO本部長訪問など国際的関心も高く、フルRRA進行の基準を満たしている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（イトゥリ県ブニア）が主要な発生地であり、ウガンダとスーダンは関連国として言及されているが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。1100件以上の確認症例、43名の死亡、複数国への拡大、ワクチン・治療薬の利用制限、紛争による対応阻害など、複合的な深刻要因が存在。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: les pays de la Communauté d'Afrique de l'Est se réunissent pour tenter de coordonner leur réponse à l'épidémie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: East African Community member states meet to try to coordinate their response to the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in East African Community (EAC) member states, with the epicenter in Ituri, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), primarily affecting the DRC and Uganda. The outbreak was declared on May 15 and, as of June 2, 2026, EAC health ministers (June 1–2) met to harmonize regional response and coordinate surveillance to prevent cross-border spread. Proposed measures include enhanced surveillance at borders, airports, and land crossings; the WHO cautions that border screening can push clandestine movement and hinder tracking. Uganda reports continued official entry screening alongside strengthened monitoring of informal crossings. Plans include deploying nine mobile laboratories in affected areas (notably Ituri) and establishing a regional crisis cell to rapidly test, identify, and isolate suspected cases. Interventions on Congolese territory require consent from authorities; earlier meetings occurred in Kampala, underscoring ongoing regional coordination.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：東アフリカ共同体加盟国が流行への対応調整を試みるため会合を開催
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的拡大リスク、重症度、複数国への影響が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはエボラ流行がDRC（イトゥリ州が震源地）を中心とし、ウガンダにも影響していることを明記している。ウガンダ（GeoNames ID: 226074）はBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれているが、サマリーでは主として「継続的な公式な入国スクリーニング」の言及に留まり、確定的な患者発生地としては明記されていない。対象国リストにウガンダは含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。東アフリカ共同体の地域的な対応調整が進行中であり、国際的な関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Cộng đồng Đông Phi họp khẩn về dịch Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: East African Community holds emergency meeting on Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: East African Community (EAC) holds an extraordinary online meeting of health ministers on June 1–2 to coordinate a response to Ebola outbreaks in eastern DRC and Uganda, focusing on Bundibugyo virus, a strain with no licensed vaccine or approved therapy. Ituri in eastern Congo is a mobility-driven hotspot. As of May 29, DRC reported 263 confirmed Ebola cases and 42 deaths; by May 30 Africa CDC reported over 1,100 suspected cases under investigation. Five Bundibugyo patients recovered in Bunia on May 31; Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus of WHO attended the opening of a new Ebola treatment center. Measures include nine mobile laboratories at border points, a rapid-response team of over 180 experts, health-worker training, PPE, and a framework to accelerate vaccine and diagnostic approvals. Member states: Burundi, DRC, Kenya, Rwanda, Somalia, South Sudan, Tanzania, and Uganda. Brazil quarantined two travelers from Africa with Ebola-like symptoms; spillover risk remains low.

triage.headline_ja: 東アフリカ共同体がエボラ出血熱の流行について緊急会議を開催
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。スクリーニング基準複数該当。東アフリカ地域での多国間調整、WHO事務局長の関与、国際的な検査機関の動員、ワクチン開発の加速化など社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが列挙した発生地域には東アフリカ域内の複数国（ルワンダ、ブルンジ、ケニア、タンザニア、ソマリア）が含まれているが、記事サマリーにおいて確認されている実際の感染発生地はDRCの東部（Ituri州）とウガンダのみ。ブラジルの事例は対象国内での報告（隔離された旅行者の検査）であり、実際の感染発生地ではないため除外。Bundibugyo株（ワクチンや治療法がない）の確認、WHO事務局長の直接関与、9つの国境警備用移動検査室の配置、180人以上の即応チーム動員など、対応体制のレベルが高い。

article.articleHeadline: За время вспышки Эболы в Конго заболели 16 медработников
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: During the Ebola outbreak in Congo, 16 healthcare workers fell ill.
article.articleSummary: During the current Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, 16 healthcare workers fell ill, according to the World Health Organization. Three male nurses and one female nurse were infected in the eastern part of the country and have all recovered and been discharged. In total, five healthcare workers have recovered, including a laboratory staff member discharged last week. Another patient, a United States-based doctor who treated patients in Congo, is currently receiving treatment in Germany. As of May 31, Congo reports 210 confirmed cases and 17 deaths, with about 350 suspected cases under investigation. The main control measures include laboratory testing, epidemiological surveillance, infection prevention and control, community engagement, and resource mobilization. WHO emphasizes that timely medical care improves outcomes for Ebola, which can kill 30–50% of patients. Cross-border transmission cases are being observed with Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱の流行中に16人の医療従事者が感染
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上に該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の事象、国際的拡大リスク）。医療従事者への感染、死亡事例、越境感染の観察、および複数国での症例報告により、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はコンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ出血熱の流行。ウガンダでの越境感染の観察も言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。米国の医師やドイツでの治療事例は国外での2次的な影響であり、発生地は DRC。210確認症例、17死亡、350疑い症例という規模と、医療従事者への感染という懸念される動向があり、シグナルとして妥当。

article.articleHeadline: CHDC Congo ghi nhận 343 ca nhiễm virus Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 343 Ebola virus infections.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 343 confirmed Ebola virus infections as of 2 June 2026. Health Minister Roger Kamba announced the figure after joint response meetings chaired by Prime Minister Judith Suminwa, with activities now better targeted following officials’ trips to Bunia, the eastern Ituri province’s capital and disease epicenter. Government spokesperson Patrick Muyaya said Bunia airport remains closed to flights except for humanitarian flights, with those flights expected to resume this week, and preventive measures such as handwashing and temperature checks have been put in place. In related developments, Zimbabwe has established three Ebola isolation centers. Health and Child Care Minister Douglas Mombeshora announced facilities in Harare, Bulawayo, and Chirundu on the border with Zambia to isolate and manage suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がエボラウイルス343件の感染を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当。エボラは公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常な大規模集団発生、国際的拡大リスク（隣国への対応）、渡航制限を示唆する発表があり。
triage.notes: 記事主題はDRCのエボラ感染343件の公式発表。Zimbabweは隣国として準備対応を実施中。Zambia国境に隣接するChirunduに隔離施設を設置しており、実質的な地域的脅威として含める。DRC内ではBunia(Ituri州)がエピセンター。空港閉鎖（人道支援便を除く）を含む渡航制限措置が発令されている。

article.articleHeadline: O sarampo pode voltar a circular no Brasil?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Can measles circulate again in Brazil?
article.articleSummary: Measles risk re-emergence in Brazil as World Cup travel increases exposure; outbreaks in the United States, Mexico, and Canada; Brazil has three confirmed cases in 2026 and 468 suspected. In 2024 WHO declared Brazil measles-free, certification revoked in 2019 after a 21,700-case outbreak. Vaccination coverage in 2025: 92.66% first dose, 78.02% booster. Health officials urge vaccination with the measles-rubella-mumps vaccine at least 15 days before travel; children as young as 6 months may receive early doses when traveling to endemic areas. Routine schedule: first dose at 12 months, booster at 15 months; adults ≤29 may have two doses, ages 30–59 one dose; 60+ typically not vaccinated. Antivaccine discourse and regional disparities threaten control; 2019 outbreak and 21.7k cases highlight vulnerability.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで麻疹が再び循環する可能性があるか？
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで麻疹の再出現リスクが高く、3つのIHR基準（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）に該当。WHO認証取消の前歴があり、ワクチン接種率の低下とワクチン懐疑論が管理上の課題となっている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではブラジルが主題であり、米国・メキシコ・カナダでのアウトブレイクはブラジルへの輸入リスク文脈として記述されている。2024年のWHO麻疹根絶認証取消、2025年のワクチン接種率低下（1次92.66%、追加接種78.02%）、ワクチン懐疑論の拡大、地域格差が重大なリスク要因。ワールドカップ関連の渡航増加により国際的拡大リスクも懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief: People in DRC can recover from Ebola
article.articleSummary: On 31 May, the World Health Organization Director-General visited a new Ebola treatment facility in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). He said, 'the idea that people can't recover from Ebola is wrong,' and urged civilians to seek care at designated facilities to help halt what he described as a rapid outbreak in the DRC. Reported on 2 June 2026, the visit underscores emphasis on timely, facility-based treatment to improve outcomes and limit transmission. The piece centers on the new facility and the call for community engagement to boost treatment uptake; it does not provide case counts, laboratory confirmation details, infection sources, or information about imported or exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長：DRCの人々はエボラから回復できる
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の発生がDRCで報告されており、IHR基準の「異常性」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当する可能性が高く、WPROスクリーニング基準の「重症度」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」に複数該当するため。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病はIHR指定疾病であり、DRCでの発生は国際的に極めて深刻。記事では「急速な流行」と述べられており、新しい治療施設の設置と治療受け入れの強化が報告されている。詳細な症例数や確定診断数は記事に記載されていないが、WHO事務局長の現地視察は緊迫した状況を示唆している。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Salgın endişesi büyürken üç Ebola aşısı geliştirme aşamasında
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: As fears of an outbreak grow, three Ebola vaccines are in development.
article.articleSummary: Three Ebola vaccines targeting Bundibugyo ebolavirus are in development to address an outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), where suspected cases exceed 1,000, and neighboring Uganda has nine confirmed cases as of 2 June 2026. The effort is led by the International AIDS Vaccine Initiative (IAVI) with Moderna and Oxford University, funded by CEPI, amid warnings from MSF about the crisis. There is no licensed vaccine for Bundibugyo, one of six Ebola species; a vaccine exists for Zaire ebolavirus. IAVI is adapting the licensed Zaire vaccine for Bundibugyo, reporting promising monkey-model results and a typical 7–9 months to clinical readiness, with efforts to accelerate. Moderna applies mRNA technology; Oxford leverages a COVID-19 platform, with Oxford indicating two to three months to clinical readiness. All vaccines target the Bundibugyo glycoprotein via different delivery methods, and WHO Director‑General Tedros notes their potential in current outbreak control and future preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: 感染症の懸念が高まる中、3つのエボラワクチンが開発段階にある
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo ebolavirus の集団感染がDRCで1,000人以上の疑い患者、隣国ウガンダで確認患者9人という重大な規模で発生しており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）の複数項目に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行性・管理可能性の懸念が認められ、国際的な支援体制（IAVI/Moderna/Oxford/CEPI/WHO）も既に始動している。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaが含まれているが、サマリーではウガンダは隣国として言及され、主な発生地はDRCである。ウガンダ（1269750）は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCのみを確認済み地域として計上。Bundibugyo ebolavirus は過去に東アフリカで報告された稀種だが、高い致死率と国際的懸念を伴う。既にWHO及び国際的な開発機関が介入している点で管理可能性の課題あり。

article.articleHeadline: 赣州疾控：6月重点预防登革热、基孔肯雅热等传染病
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ganzhou CDC: In June, focus on preventing dengue fever, chikungunya fever, and other infectious diseases.
article.articleSummary: Ganzhou, Jiangxi Province, in June focuses on preventing dengue fever, chikungunya fever, hand-foot-mouth disease (HFMD), and chickenpox, as rising temperatures, heavier rainfall, and flood-season risks boost mosquito breeding and transmission. Dengue and chikungunya are transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes (Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus). Dengue often begins after 5–9 days with sudden high fever, severe headache and retroorbital pain, myalgias, and rash; some cases progress to dengue hemorrhagic fever or dengue shock syndrome. Chikungunya presents with fever and marked joint pain in distal joints, and a rash in about 80% after 2–5 days, with potential prolonged arthralgia. HFMD affects mainly children under 5, causing fever, sore throat, and vesicular rash on hands, feet, and mouth; severe complications can include encephalitis. Chickenpox spreads by droplets and contact; fever and vesicular rash. Post-flood precautions include safe drinking water, thorough cooking, sanitation, mosquito control, hygiene, and avoiding contaminated water.

triage.headline_ja: 赣州疾控：6月重点预防登革热、基孔肯雅热等传染病
triage.triage_reason: 複数の蚊媒介感染症（デング熱、チクングニア熱）および小児感染症の予防啓発記事であり、WPROスクリーニング基準の「流行しやすさ」に該当する環境的リスク（蚊の繁殖増加）が指摘されているが、現在の発症数や重症度に関する具体的データが記事に記載されておらず、情報が不足している。継続的な発症動向の監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は公的保健機関（赣州疾控）による季節性感染症予防の公式啓発であり、政府レベルの関心が示されている。洪水後の環境条件により蚊媒介感染症の流行リスクが高まる可能性が指摘されているが、現在の患者数や重症度に関する具体的情報は記事に含まれていない。今後の発症報告を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola preocupa autoridades após OMS apontar mortalidade de até 50%
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola concerns authorities after WHO indicates mortality of up to 50%.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo persists, with the World Health Organization estimating mortality at 30–50% among confirmed cases. Ebola remains one of the most lethal viral infections, underscoring the need for constant vigilance. The disease is viral with an incubation period of 2–21 days; early symptoms can progress rapidly, and severe complications can ensue without adequate care. Transmission occurs mainly through direct contact with contaminated bodily fluids and contaminated surfaces; it is not airborne, and infected individuals typically become contagious after symptom onset, aiding contact tracing. The response marks a notable update with the first confirmed recovery in this outbreak, discharged after negative lab tests. As of 2026-06-02, authorities stress intensified surveillance, rapid outbreak response, and protection of vulnerable populations to interrupt transmission and improve early detection and treatment.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが当局を懸念させる - WHOが50%までの死亡率を指摘
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。エボラウイルス病は高い死亡率（30-50%）を伴う重篤な疾患であり、DRCでの継続的な発生は国際的懸念事項である。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラ発生は現在進行中であり、記事では初回の回復例が報告されている。WHOによる死亡率推定値（30-50%）が当局の懸念を高めている。サーベイランスと防御措置の強化が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: New Ebola vaccines fast-tracked amid fears of worst outbreak on record
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease caused by the Bundibugyo strain is driving a major outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with nearly 250 deaths and over 1,000 suspected cases reported; confirmed infections have spread into neighboring Uganda. Three vaccine candidates are accelerating development: Moderna (mRNA platform), and the University of Oxford and the International AIDS Vaccine Initiative (IAVI), funded by CEPI. The Bundibugyo strain has caused only two previous outbreaks and has no approved vaccine. Experts warn this outbreak could become one of the worst on record, potentially rivaling the West Africa epidemic of 2014–2016, which infected about 29,000 and killed over 11,000. Trials for some candidates could begin within months, underscoring the urgent priority of vaccines and countermeasures per IAVI Chief Executive Dr. Mark Feinberg.

triage.headline_ja: 新しいエボラワクチンが緊急開発される中、過去最悪の流行への懸念が高まる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ流行は深刻な公衆衛生影響（死亡250名以上、疑い例1,000名以上）、異常性（稀な株による大規模流行）、隣国ウガンダへの国際的拡大、ワクチン開発の緊急対応が示す重要性を示している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国でのBundibugyo株によるエボラ流行を主題としている。ウガンダへの拡大も明記されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。アンゴラは発生地域に含まれているが、サマリー内での言及がないため除外。2014-2016年西アフリカ流行との比較により、歴史的に重大な公衆衛生脅威と位置付けられている。

article.articleHeadline: Dalka Kenya oo lagu arkay cudur kale oo halis ah xilli laga cabsi qabo Ebola
article.articleSummary: Mpox (Monkeypox) confirmed in Embu County, Kenya—the first 2026 case, laboratory-confirmed as of 2 June 2026, with contact tracing initiated. The Health Ministry reports intensified surveillance at borders and airports amid Ebola preparedness due to regional outbreaks in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Public advised to maintain hygiene and report fever, headache, fatigue and a rash promptly. While Mpox and Ebola are distinct, authorities warn dual health threats could strain the health system. No infection source disclosed yet; investigators tracing contacts to prevent further spread. The government is boosting health screening at entry points and monitoring ports of entry to curb importation risk; ongoing preparedness for potential Ebola incursions complements mpox response.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで新たな深刻な病気が確認され、エボラウイルスへの懸念が高まる中での対応
triage.triage_reason: ケニアでのMpox初確認例と地域的なEbola流行という複合的な公衆衛生脅威。IHR基準3項目（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準4項目全て該当。社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事はケニアにおけるMpox初確認例を主題としており、同時に地域内のEbola流行（DRC・ウガンダ）への懸念と対応が述べられている。複合的な感染症脅威であり、境界線での監視強化、接触者追跡、公衆衛生勧告が実施されている。感染源未特定の段階であり、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれていないが、DRCは含まれるため有効なシグナルである。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue, combustível, posto de saúde e nota fiscal: prefeitos mostram uso prático da IA no SPIW
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue, fuel, health clinic and tax invoice: mayors show practical use of AI in SPIW.
article.articleSummary: Dengue is central in Bebedouro, SP, where artificial intelligence (AI) monitoring of dengue foci correlated with a near 90% drop in local cases; nationwide reductions between 2025 and 2026 reached about 75%, aided by sterile insect technique and vaccination. In Bebedouro, AI also tracks ambulance fleet fuel usage for real-time asset oversight and flags anomalous tax note cancellations to boost revenue collection. Olímpia, SP, uses AI to monitor public vehicle fleets and streamline healthcare delivery. The São Paulo Innovation Week (SPIW) panel featured mayors Lucas Seren (Bebedouro) and Geninho Zuliani (Olímpia) with tech leaders from Prodam, IBM Brasil, and Intel, illustrating public-sector AI deployments aimed at delivering more with less.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱、燃料、保健所、税務請求書：市長がSPIWにおけるAIの実践的利用を実演
triage.triage_reason: 記事はデング熱の技術的管理成功事例を扱うもので、新規な感染症危機や異常発生を報じていない。過去の統計改善（2025-2026年に全国で約75%の削減）を強調しており、現在進行中の公衆衛生上の緊急事態ではない。
triage.notes: 記事の主要内容はAI技術導入による感染症対策の成功事例であり、新規な感染症シグナルではない。Bebedouro及びOlímpia市でのデング熱監視システムの効果を扱うが、これは過去の改善実績の紹介であり、現在の感染症危機を示唆していない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: les pays de la Communauté d'Afrique de l'Est se réunissent pour tenter de coordonner leur réponse à l'épidémie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: East African Community member states meet to coordinate their response to the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in East Africa prompts the East African Community (EAC) to convene health ministers, starting June 1, to coordinate a regional response centered on the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. The goal is to avoid unilateral measures across borders. Proposed actions include enhanced border, airport, and land crossing surveillance; however, WHO warns that strict border controls may spur clandestine crossings and hinder case tracking. Ugandan Health Secretary Diana Atwine says official screening and stronger monitoring of informal routes will accompany security surveillance. Authorities also plan nine mobile laboratories, especially in Ituri in the DRC, and the creation of a regional crisis cell to rapidly test, identify, and isolate suspected cases. The June 2 meeting will review expert recommendations; the outbreak was declared May 15. Atwine notes prior meetings with DRC, South Sudan, and Uganda and that Congo’s consent is needed for interventions on its territory.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：東アフリカ共同体加盟国が流行への対応を調整するために集結
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当し、深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的な地域的対応の必要性、複数国間の渡航・貿易制限リスクが明らかである。エボラウイルス病の流行は極めて重大なシグナル。
triage.notes: エボラ流行は2026年5月15日に宣言。DRCのイトゥリ地方が主要発生地。UgandaはBluedotの発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRCとUgandaの両国が言及されており、特にDRCが中心的な発生国として記載されている。ただし、サマリーには「Ugandan Health Secretary」「Uganda」への言及があり、Ugandaでも流行が確認されている可能性がある。しかし対象国リストを確認するとUgandaは含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。記事から東アフリカ共同体の広域対応が必要とされており、国際的な拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Hanta, Ebola und die mediale Verzerrung der Wirklichkeit - DIE ACHSE DES GUTEN. ACHGUT.COM
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus, Ebola, and the Media Distortion of Reality
article.articleSummary: Media distortion around Hantavirus and Ebola is contrasted with far higher death tolls from Tuberculosis and Malaria, and from hospital-acquired infections. Worldwide TB kills about 1,000,000 annually, with roughly 300,000 in Africa; Malaria about 600,000 deaths per year, over 90% in Africa. Combined TB and malaria account for ~1.6 million deaths, largely in Africa, yet hospital germs cause Germany alone an estimated 15,000–45,000 deaths annually. Hantaviruses infect 150,000–200,000 people globally each year, far below malaria (282 million cases). In Sweden (Puumavirus), 1997–2007 saw 5,282 cases and 21 deaths (case fatality ~0.4%). The Andes virus in South America yields about 200 annual cases with ~80 deaths, CFR ~40%, though human-to-human transmission is not robustly established (per a 2022 meta-analysis). The Congo Ebola chatter in May 2026 illustrates media hype rather than imminent catastrophe.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス、エボラ、およびメディアの現実歪曲
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はメディアの報道歪曲を批判する評論であり、新規の感染症イベント発生を報告したものではない。記事は既知の疾患の流行統計比較に過ぎず、IHR基準およびWPRO基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーが示す通り、本記事は2026年5月のコンゴでのエボラに関する「メディアハイプ」を批判する評論であり、新規感染症イベント検出ではなく、既知の疾患負担の統計比較論である。したがってシグナルとしての価値はない。DRCは言及されているが、新規イベント報告ではなく、むしろメディア報道の過度性を指摘する文脈である。

article.articleHeadline: Terbang dari Kongo-Uganda ke Thailand? Wajib Karantina 21 Hari!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Flying from Congo-Uganda to Thailand? A 21-day quarantine is mandatory!
article.articleSummary: Ebola prevention: Thailand imposes a 21-day mandatory quarantine for travelers arriving from or transiting through the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda. The policy, effective May 27, 2026, follows the WHO's declaration of a Public Health Emergency of International Concern and aims to tighten entry-point surveillance to prevent Ebola virus entry. Implemented by Thailand's Department of Disease Control, the rule covers all inbound travelers from the two countries and those with transit exposure. The article does not report Ebola cases, deaths, laboratory confirmations, or local transmission; no infection sources are detailed beyond country of origin. The measure signifies heightened border controls rather than treatment, with no further export/import specifics provided.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ・ウガンダからタイへの渡航？21日間の隔離が必須！
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHOによるPublic Health Emergency of International Concern（PHEIC）宣言を背景とした複数国への対応策が報告されており、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダでのエボラ発生が示唆されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCはシグナル発生地（PHEIC宣言の中心）、タイは主動的な公衆衛生対応国として両国を含める。実際の症例確認は記事に記載されていないが、WHOのPHEIC宣言が最近（2026年5月27日）であり、複数国間の流行リスク管理体制が起動している段階。

article.articleHeadline: Ruto Reveals Why He Approved US-Backed Ebola Quarantine Facility in Kenya
article.articleSummary: Ruto defended a US-backed 50-bed Ebola quarantine facility at the Kenya Defence Forces Laikipia Air Base, saying it strengthens preparedness and citing a long-standing partnership with the United States that has supported Kenya on HIV and other diseases. He noted Kenya operates 23 Ebola preparedness units nationwide, including at Kenyatta National Hospital, Police Hospital Nairobi, Moi Teaching and Referral Hospital Eldoret, and Alupe Hospital Busia; about 3,000 travellers are screened daily with no positive Ebola cases recorded. Thousands of Kenyans are in the DRC where Ebola remains active, and if infected they would be treated in Kenya. He linked the project to a Ksh200 billion Health Co-operation Framework to strengthen health infrastructure. Protests in Nanyuki led to a High Court injunction halting the facility. The Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in DRC/Uganda provides broader context; Kenya’s KEMRI is racing for a vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: ルト大統領がケニアの米国支援エボラ隔離施設を承認した理由を明かす
triage.triage_reason: エボラ及びHIVに関する公式声明で異常性・国際的関心あるが、実際の患者発生や流行拡大を示す情報がなく、主にケニアの防止体制・施設建設に関する政治的議論である。引き続き情報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアにおけるエボラ対応施設の建設・防止体制についての政治的声明である。DRCでのエボラアウトブレイク（Bundibugyo型）とウガンダでの状況が背景として言及されているが、記事サマリーに基づいてケニアでの実際の患者発生や流行は報告されていない。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。社会的・政治的関心は高いが、実際の感染症イベント発生の確認がないため WATCH レベルの判定。

article.articleHeadline: Ministério da Saúde registra 505 mortes por gripe nos primeiros cinco meses do ano
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health reports 505 influenza deaths in the first five months of the year.
article.articleSummary: Brazil's Ministry of Health reports 505 influenza deaths in the first five months of 2026, with 27% of fatalities confirmed in the last two weeks. Specialists cite two main factors: low vaccination coverage and early cold, dry weather facilitating transmission. The national influenza vaccination campaign ended May 30, 2026, after vaccinating only 38.5% of the target population, far from the 90% goal for children under six, the elderly, and pregnant women—a target unmet in Brazil since 2021. From January through May, there were 7,749 cases of severe respiratory diseases nationwide. Vaccination remains available in many municipalities and at health posts despite campaign closure. The data indicate ongoing influenza activity across Brazil in the early months of 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、年初5ヶ月間のインフルエンザによる死亡505件を報告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるインフルエンザの季節的流行であり、IHR基準では国際的拡大のリスクが限定的である。ただしワクチン接種率の低さと死亡数の増加が継続する状況であり、経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 2026年のブラジルにおける季節的インフルエンザ流行。ワクチン接種率が目標値（90%）に大きく下回る（38.5%）状況が懸念される。WPRO基準では複数該当するが、通常の季節性インフルエンザの流行パターンであり、社会的関心は高いものの国際的リスクは低い。記事本文の内容が提供されていないため、追加情報で判定が変わる可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Is the deadly Congo Ebola outbreak a threat to the UK?
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak spans the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda and South Sudan, now declared a global health emergency. As of May 27 there are >1,200 cases and ~250 deaths; WHO declared PHEIC on May 17. No licensed vaccine exists for Bundibugyo; case fatality among confirmed cases is estimated 30–50%. Transmission is via direct contact with infected fluids or contaminated materials; fruit bats are the natural host and airborne spread is not typical. Containment is affected by home caregiving and traditional burial practices. Early symptoms include fever, headache, muscle aches, fatigue; progression to vomiting, diarrhea, dehydration, and sometimes bleeding. Diagnosis requires specialist labs. In the UK, the Rare and Imported Pathogens Laboratory conducts testing with high-level isolation units; risk is very low. Previous imported cases were contained without onward transmission; care is largely supportive.

triage.headline_ja: 致命的なコンゴエボラ感染症の流行は英国への脅威か？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。ブンディブギョエボラウイルスはPHEIC宣言済み、1,200例超・250死亡、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク等により、フルRRA対象。

article.articleHeadline: Kina šalje medicinske stručnjake u Kongo zbog epidemije ebole
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China sends medical experts to Congo due to the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 June 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and neighboring Uganda escalates with at least 134 confirmed cases and 18 deaths, per WHO. The eastern focus spans Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with new suspected cases since the outbreak was declared on 15 May. The Bundibugyo strain underpins transmission. WHO has designated the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern. China dispatches a medical expert team from Beijing to collaborate with existing Chinese staff in Congo and with local health authorities to bolster prevention, treatment, and healthcare worker training, and to assist Chinese nationals and institutions in the country. The Chinese team has already activated emergency measures, including intensified staff training, preparedness drills, and coordination of medical supplies while maintaining services for locals and expatriates.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行によるコンゴへの中国医療専門家派遣
triage.triage_reason: エボラ流行が134確定症例・18死亡を記録し、WHOが国際的懸念の公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言。IHR基準3項目以上該当し、複数国への国際的拡大リスク、国際支援実施の明確な根拠がある。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでの実際の流行を主題としており、Bundibugyo株による感染が確認されている。中国（Beijing）からの専門家派遣は対応措置であり、発生地ではない。ウガンダは隣国として言及されているが、記事サマリーでの明確な症例報告はないため、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。WHOの公式宣言により、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak 2026: How the virus spreads, key symptoms to watch for, and why experts say India should not panic
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in Congo (DRC) and Uganda; not airborne; spreads by direct contact with blood or infected bodily fluids of symptomatic patients or deceased individuals; incubation up to 21 days. Symptoms include sudden high fever, severe body aches, headache, fatigue, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain; severe cases may involve bleeding and multi-organ failure. Ebola’s transmission remains largely confined to Africa; travel history within the last 21 days is crucial to assess risk. PCR testing on blood confirms cases; currently testing is not widely available outside Africa. For India, risk is very low; an infected traveler would be needed and transmission requires contact with infected fluids. Public should maintain hygiene, wash hands, monitor for fever and symptoms if recently traveled to DRC or Uganda, and report to a hospital with travel history. No need for panic.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年エボラ出血熱の流行：ウイルスの感染経路、監視すべき主な症状、およびインド専門家がパニックの必要がないと述べる理由
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当。複数国でのエボラウイルス病の確認と、インドを含む他地域への医学的関心の高まりがある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）とウガンダでのエボラ出血熱の確認を述べており、インドへの潜在的リスク評価が主要トピックとなっている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。インドは対象国リストに含まれるため含める。複数国での同時発生、高い死亡率、渡航関連リスク、および国際的な医学的関心が存在することから、フルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）への進行が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉病毒｜剛果民主共和國增至343宗確診 中國派專家組抗疫 | am730
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus | Democratic Republic of the Congo rises to 343 confirmed cases; China dispatches an expert team to fight the outbreak | am730
article.articleSummary: As of 02 June 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and neighboring Uganda remains active. DRC has 343 confirmed cases and at least 42 deaths; Uganda reports 9 cases and 1 death. The International Rescue Committee warns the true infection toll may be much higher, noting the outbreak has persisted for about three months and only ~20% of contacts are being traced, complicating containment. Brazil reports two previously suspected travelers from Ebola-affected areas tested negative. China has dispatched a high-level anti-epidemic medical expert group to the DRC to assist outbreak control, coordinating with local health authorities. Africa CDC Director Kasaye notes the Bundibugyo strain lacks a vaccine, with cross-border movement increasing regional spread risk, though initial control measures show progress. Five patients have recovered; 19 healthcare workers are infected, with  Six deaths.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス｜コンゴ民主共和国の確認患者が343例に増加 中国が専門家チームを派遣して感染症対策に当たる
