article.articleHeadline: China sends medical experts to DR Congo to help combat Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: DRC and Uganda report 134 confirmed Ebola cases with 18 deaths as the Bundibugyo strain concentrates in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu, with total outbreak figures exceeding 1,000 since the May 15 declaration. The World Health Organization has classified the event as a public health emergency of international concern. In response, China dispatched a team of experienced epidemic-response experts to the Democratic Republic of Congo to bolster prevention, treatment, training for health workers, and support for Chinese nationals and institutions in the country; the delegation departed Beijing early on 2 June 2026 and will operate alongside Chinese personnel already in Congo and local authorities. The existing Chinese response has activated emergency measures, including drills and supply coordination, to sustain frontline medical services.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、エボラ出血熱との闘いを支援するため医療専門家をコンゴ民主共和国に派遣
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHOが国際的懸念事項の公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）と分類したエボラ出血熱の多国間アウトブレイク。確認症例134件、死亡18件、総患者数1,000人超えで深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、国際的拡大とそれに伴う社会政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドにはBeijingとChinaも含まれるが、サマリーから明確に主要な発生地はDRCおよびウガンダであり、中国は支援国として登場。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。WHOによるPHEIC認定により国際的懸念が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Faces Ebola Spread Across Three Provinces While Coalition Funds Experimental Vaccines
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Congo, involving Bundibugyo virus, totals 282 confirmed cases across three eastern provinces, centered in Ituri (264 cases). More than 1,000 suspected infections reported; 42 deaths in Congo and one in Uganda. Spread spans 22 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. No approved medicine or vaccine for Bundibugyo virus. Early detection, rapid isolation, contact tracing, safe burials, and strengthened infection control are priorities. Coalition for Epidemic Preparedness Innovations pledges up to $62 million to accelerate development of three experimental vaccines from IAVI, Moderna, and the University of Oxford. WHO Honored five survivor health workers during a Bunia visit and the opening of a new Ebola treatment center. Uganda reports nine cases and closed its border; cross-border transmission and ADF attacks in Beni complicate response. Transmission occurs via close contact with sick or dead patients’ bodily fluids.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴがエボラの3県への拡大に直面、連合が試験的ワクチンに資金提供
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、ブンディブギョウイボラウイルスによる大規模多国間アウトブレイク（確定症例282例、死亡43例、ウガンダへの越境拡大）はフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: ウガンダも記事内で9例確認・国境閉鎖が述べられているが、GeoNames ID 226074（ウガンダ）は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCのみ対象国リストの対象。22の保健地域にまたがる3県での拡大、承認医薬品/ワクチン未有、国際的な資金動員（CEPI $62M）がされており、極めて高優先度のシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: इबोला'च्या धोक्यासाठी पुणे सज्ज; नायडू रुग्णालयात विशेष विलगीकरण कक्ष
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pune ready for the Ebola threat; special isolation room at Naidu Hospital.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 June 2026, Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan have prompted global alert. In India, the central government directed preventive measures and advised states; Pune, Mumbai, and Nagpur airports with international traffic are implementing special guidelines. Pune has no Ebola cases, but a dedicated isolation room has been established at Naidu Hospital (Pune Municipal Corporation) with medicines, supplies, and trained personnel. Since 18 May, health screening at Pune Airport for travelers from Ebola-affected regions includes travel history, health status, and potential symptoms; one traveler with symptoms was placed in isolation as a precaution, but Ebola testing was negative. Blood samples from suspected cases are sent to the National Institute of Virology, Pune, for laboratory confirmation. The state health department has instructed district, municipal, and primary health centers to stay vigilant, isolate suspected cases, and monitor contacts. No current suspected cases in Pune.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの脅威に向けてプネ準備完了；ナイドゥ病院に特別隔離室を設置
triage.triage_reason: インドでエボラ対策の準備・体制強化が報告されているが、実際の患者発生はなく、アフリカの流行に対する予防的措置段階。情報が限定的であり、実際の患者発生の確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンでのエボラ流行が言及されているが、インドでの実際の患者発生は報告されておらず、プネ空港での検査で1例が疑い例として隔離されたが検査陰性。インドは対象国のため verified_locations に含める。社会的・政治的関心は高いが、患者発生がなく準備段階であることから WATCH 判定。

article.articleHeadline: Aeroméxico prohíbe el embarque a pasajeros que hayan viajado a países afectados por el ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Aeroméxico prohibits boarding for passengers who have traveled to countries affected by Ebola.
article.articleSummary: To curb Ebola spread ahead of the June 11 start of the 2026 FIFA World Cup in Mexico, Aeroméxico will prohibit boarding for passengers who have been in Uganda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, or South Sudan within the 21 days before travel, a measure in place for 60 days. Mexican passport holders are exempt. The policy aligns with a tri-national health-strategy with the United States and Canada to strengthen border controls as visitors arrive for the tournament. Other carriers, Viva Aerobus and Volaris, will apply similar restrictions; health filters will be deployed at major international airports. Health Secretary David Kershenobich said documentary checks and itinerary reviews will identify travelers from affected areas even if they stopover in third countries. Mexico reports no Ebola cases yet, while the WHO continues outbreak surveillance, with over 220 deaths reported.

triage.headline_ja: アエロメヒコ、エボラ流行国への渡航歴のある乗客の搭乗を禁止
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は致死的感染症であり、国際的なイベント（FIFA W杯）を前にした複数国による国境管理強化、航空会社の搭乗制限という異常で予想外の公衆衛生対応が実施されている。IHR基準3項目以上該当し、国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限の実施が明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにはウガンダ、南スーダン、メキシコ、カナダ、米国が言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダは対象国外。南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれていない（スーダン共和国のみ）。実際の流行地はDRC・ウガンダ・南スーダン（アフリカ東部）だが、記事の主眼はメキシコでのFIFA W杯に向けた国際的な航空渡航制限。エボラは極めて重篤で致死率が高く、複数国による協調的な国境管理強化は異常かつ重大な対応。

article.articleHeadline: Cứu sống bệnh nhân suy đa tạng nguy kịch do nhiễm liên cầu lợn
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Saving a Patient with Life-Threatening Multi-Organ Failure Due to Streptococcus suis Infection.
article.articleSummary: Streptococcus suis infection caused septic shock and multi-organ failure in a 58-year-old man from Nghe An, Vietnam, admitted to Vinh City General Hospital. He developed severe hypotension, metabolic acidosis, and DIC within hours; light purple patches appeared on extremities. Three days earlier, he had eaten pig entrails. Suspected infection led to intubation, antibiotics, blood products, and continuous renal replacement therapy with an M100 filter. After 72 hours, hemodynamics improved; by day 10 he was awake, with no evidence of infection or coagulopathy. S. suis is a zoonotic bacterium transmitted from pigs; no human-to-human transmission is documented. Prevention stresses avoiding raw pork products and consuming meat from regulated sources; proper handling and cooking of pork.

triage.headline_ja: ブタ連鎖球菌感染による生命危機的な多臓器不全患者の救命
triage.triage_reason: ブタ連鎖球菌（S. suis）による重篤な感染症の個別症例報告。ヒト-ヒト感染なし、国内管理可能と判断されるが、人畜共通感染症であり経過観察を要する。
triage.notes: 個別症例報告。患者は豚の内臓摂取から3日後に発症。S. suisはヒト-ヒト感染が記録されていないため、流行の可能性は低い。記事は医療対応の成功例として報告されており、クラスター発生やアウトブレイク情報なし。越南における既知の人畜共通感染症として認識されている。

article.articleHeadline: "Ebola se răspândește necontrolat de luni de zile": pacientul zero, identificat încă din ianuarie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Ebola has been spreading uncontrollably for months": patient zero, identified as early as January.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo began with patient zero in Rwampara village; hospitalized late January and died in February, infecting eight health workers. The Telegraph reports at least 1,077 suspected cases and 223 deaths in subsequent months, linked to Bundibugyo strain that has spread in DRC. Nine Uganda cases reported, heightening cross-border concerns. If local clinicians’ account is confirmed, the virus circulated uncontrollably for months before official confirmation on May 15 by the DRC Ministry of Health. The WHO had previously suspected the first case was a Bunia health worker with symptoms on April 25 and death thereafter. Neighboring Burundi and South Sudan are considered vulnerable. If January onset is accurate, several thousand people could have been exposed. Bundibugyo Ebola is difficult to control and lacks licensed vaccines or known treatments; only about 20% of identified close contacts have been traced, with thousands missing.

triage.headline_ja: 「エボラが数ヶ月間制御不能に広がっている」：患者ゼロは1月にまで遡る
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）の多国間にわたる大規模アウトブレイク。IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の広がり、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも5項目全てに該当。重篤な感染症で国際的対応が急務。
triage.notes: 記事は主にDRCでのエボラ・ブンディブギョ株アウトブレイクに焦点。ウガンダで9症例報告され、ブルンジ・南スーダンも脆弱性を指摘されているが、サマリーでは実症例のある地域として確認されているのはDRCのみ。公式確認は5月15日だが、実際の発生は1月まで遡る可能性がある。数千人の曝露リスク、ワクチン・治療法なし、接触者追跡も20%の低率。極めて高リスクなシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: خبراء صينيون لمكافحة "إيبولا" في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chinese experts to combat Ebola in the Congo
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-02, China dispatched a team of medical experts to the Democratic Republic of the Congo to bolster local efforts against the Ebola outbreak. The specialists, with extensive experience in epidemic control, will join the Chinese medical team already operating in the DRC. They will strengthen cooperation with local health authorities and agencies involved in outbreak response to help contain Ebola transmission. The move signals ongoing international support for the Congo’s Ebola containment efforts and highlights China's continued role in global health security by providing technical expertise and collaborative capacity at the outbreak site.

triage.headline_ja: 中国の専門家がコンゴでエボラ対策を支援
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの発生（DRC）は IHR Annex2 基準で重篤な公衆衛生上の影響と国際的拡大リスクに該当。中国からの医療専門家派遣による国際対応の実施が記載されており、WPRO スクリーニング基準の重症度・管理可能性基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでのエボラ発生と中国からの医療専門家派遣について述べており、DRCが主要な発生地。発生地域フィールドに中国も記載されているが、サマリー上では中国は支援側の役割であり、エボラ患者の発生地ではないため verified_locations には DRC のみを列挙。この情報は国際的な感染症対応を示す重要なシグナルである。

article.articleHeadline: South Africa: Government Ramps Up Fmd Response While Safeguarding Export Markets
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-M Mouth Disease (FMD) outbreak in South Africa persists, but key livestock exports are safeguarded as government expands response. Since February SA has procured 13.5 million FMD vaccine doses and vaccinated about 4.4 million animals; 3.5 million doses arrived last week, with regulatory approval for 14 million more for boosters. Total vaccine spend stands at R494 million. Agriculture Minister John Steenhuisen says measures protect the national cattle population, preserve jobs and food security, while maintaining trade access. Open markets include Jordan, UAE, Hong Kong and Kuwait; talks with Qatar continue, with expected expansion to Tunisia, Lebanon, Egypt, Bahrain, Oman and Saudi Arabia. SADC regional framework for FMD aims to enhance cross-border zoning, vaccination, surveillance, biosecurity corridors and compartmentalisation. Domestic capacity grows via more labs and veterinary personnel and a public-private biosecurity framework to be launched. 2025 exports rose about 7% to US$7.3 billion; citrus exports strong.

triage.headline_ja: 南アフリカ：政府が口蹄疫対応を強化しながら輸出市場を保護
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常/予想外、国際拡大リスク、貿易制限リスク）。動物衛生上の深刻な影響と多国間の輸出市場への影響を伴う進行中の大規模アウトブレイク。
triage.notes: 記事はギニア南アフリカでのFMD発生を主題としており、農業大臣の声明を引用。複数の中東・北アフリカ国が市場アクセスに関連して言及されているが、記事サマリーはこれら地域への輸出市場確保について述べており、発生地そのものではない。対象国リスト内で実際の発生地として確認できるのはChina（香港が開放市場として言及）のみ。南アフリカは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。4月以来の継続的なアウトブレイク、13.5百万頭のワクチン接種、地域間の協調枠組み（SADC）構築が進行中で、国家レベルの対応強化が明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: 中國尚無埃博拉病毒病本土及輸入性病例報告 | 電訊
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China has not yet reported any domestically transmitted or imported Ebola virus disease cases | Telecom
article.articleSummary: China reports no domestic or imported Ebola virus disease (EVD) cases as of June 1, 2026, per the National Health Commission and the National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine, which issued the 2026 EVD diagnosis and treatment guidelines. EVD, formerly Ebola hemorrhagic fever, is a highly pathogenic acute infection transmitted via direct contact with blood, body fluids, secretions, excreta, or contaminated materials from patients, cadavers, or infected animals. Symptoms include fever, extreme fatigue, headache, myalgia, vomiting, and severe diarrhea; bleeding and multi-organ failure may occur. The global case fatality averages about 50%, up to 90% for some strains, with major outbreaks in sub-Saharan Africa. On May 17, the WHO declared Bundibugyo virus outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda as a PHEIC—the third such global alert for Bundibugyo virus. No routine public vaccine exists; prevention emphasizes avoiding unprotected contact with cases and fluids, wildlife exposure avoidance, and thorough cooking of food.

triage.headline_ja: 中国はエボラウイルス病の国内および輸入事例報告がないと報告
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題はBundibugyo virus（PHEIC宣言）がDRCとウガンダで発生していることだが、中国自体にはEVD症例がないと明記されている。DRCは対象国に含まれるため、Bundibugyo outbreakの情報収集価値はあるが、中国の情報のみに限定されるため判定は控えめとなる。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo virus outbreakはWHOにより2026年5月17日にPHEIC宣言されており、高い優先度を持つ。ただし記事の主体はBundibugyo (DRC・Uganda) でありEbolaではない。中国の記事であるため対象国からは中国を追加すべきだが、サマリーでは中国にEVD症例がないことを報告しているのみで、実イベント発生地ではない。DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: President Ruto defends planned Ebola quarantine centre
article.articleSummary: Kenya defends a planned Ebola quarantine centre at Laikipia Air Base with U.S. support, aiming to safeguard public health and bolster outbreak response; President William Ruto compares it to the Nairobi Hospital isolation facility used during COVID-19. Médecins Sans Frontières warns that rapid Ebola spread in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is deeply alarming. The High Court has suspended the facility and barred arrivals of foreign patients pending a case brought by the Law Society of Kenya and Katiba Institute. Nanyuki residents protested, citing lack of public participation and fearing local exposure to Ebola amid reports the centre could host Americans exposed to the virus. Kenya has not recorded Ebola cases, while neighboring Uganda reports nine cases and has closed its border with the DRC. Date reference: 2026-06-02.

triage.headline_ja: ルト大統領がエボラ隔離センター計画を擁護
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。DRCでのエボラ急速拡大、複数国への波及リスク、米国との関連、高裁による施設停止など多角的な懸念がある。
triage.notes: 記事はケニアのエボラ隔離センター計画が主題だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。DRCでのエボラ急速拡大が報告されており、これが対象国に該当するため DRC のみを列挙。ウガンダも言及されているが対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。米国との連携、国際的な波及リスク、高裁による法的介入など複合的な懸念が存在。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Drugmaker Moderna, other groups get $60 mln to develop Ebola vaccine
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, with 280 confirmed cases and more than 40 deaths; authorities report over 1,000 suspected cases. CEPI will provide about $60 million to Moderna and two other groups to develop a vaccine targeting Bundibugyo, the first approved candidates for this strain. CEPI chief executive Richard Hatchett cautioned that while rapid progress is possible—as seen in COVID-19 trials—field trials will be complicated by the region’s security situation. In addition to Moderna, funding supports a vaccine developed by Britain's University of Oxford and manufactured by Serum Institute of India, using the same COVID-19 technology and targeting trial readiness in around six weeks. The International AIDS Vaccine Initiative is backing a treatment based on a different Ebola strain. Other funders, including the World Bank Pandemic Fund, are backing vaccine development.

triage.headline_ja: 医薬品企業モデルナなど、エボラワクチン開発に6000万ドルの資金を獲得
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラアウトブレイク（確定280例、死亡40例以上）は公衆衛生への深刻な影響を示し、IHR基準の「深刻な影響」「異常・予想外」に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準では重症度、流行可能性、管理可能性の複数基準に該当し、国際的なワクチン開発資金配分という高い社会政治的関心も併わせ持つ。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラアウトブレイク（Bundibugyo株）を主題としており、イギリスの大学がインドのSerum Institute of Indiaと協力してワクチン開発を行う点から、DRCとIndiaが該当対象国として検証される。UKは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。セキュリティ状況が臨床試験実施の課題として言及されており、地域の管理可能性に懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: CEPI sets aside about US$60 million for Bundibugyo Ebola vaccines
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus (BDBV) outbreak spreading in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo prompts CEPI to pledge about US$60 million to accelerate vaccine development. The funding supports Moderna and two other vaccine programs to speed research, production, and clinical testing, with the goal of entering human trials within the next few months. There is currently no approved vaccine or treatment for this Ebola strain. The outbreak in Congo has grown to 282 confirmed cases and at least 42 deaths, with roughly 1,100 additional suspected cases, according to Africa CDC and WHO data. The initiative signals intensified international response as authorities monitor potential spillover. If trials proceed successfully, a BDBV vaccine could reach human testing in the near term, marking a major advance in addressing this strain.

triage.headline_ja: CEPIがブンディブギョエボラワクチン開発に約6000万米ドルを拠出
triage.triage_reason: ブンディブギョエボラウイルスのDRC東部でのアウトブレイク（282確認症例、42死亡、1100疑い例）は公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的対応を示唆し、IHR基準3項目該当、WPROスクリーニング基準4項目該当。国際的なワクチン開発支援の決定は高い社会・政治的関心を示す。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョエボラ（BDBV）は5つのエボラウイルス種の中でも比較的稀だが、高い致死率と国際的な懸念を引き起こしている。記事はワクチン開発の加速化と臨床試験への進展を強調しており、国際的な公衆衛生対応の深刻さを反映している。DRC内での地理的位置（東部）と疑い例の多さから持続的な伝播リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Китай направит группу медицинских экспертов в Демократическую Республику Конго для оказания помощи в борьбе с лихорадкой Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China will send a group of medical experts to the Democratic Republic of the Congo to assist in the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: On June 2, 2026, early Tuesday, China dispatched a group of high-level medical experts from Beijing to the Democratic Republic of the Congo to assist local authorities in fighting Ebola. Prompted by WHO’s May 17 designation of the outbreak as a public health emergency of international concern, the new team will join the already deployed Chinese medical contingent to bolster collaboration with local health and outbreak-control agencies and help contain Ebola. They will train local health facilities, the Chinese embassy, enterprises, and Chinese citizens on prevention and treatment. The move underscores China’s commitment to international cooperation in outbreak response. The 24th Chinese medical team in the DRC has begun emergency response measures, established prevention and control systems, coordinated supplies, and improved conditions for frontline health workers and residents, serving at the front line of the response.

triage.headline_ja: 中国がエボラ出血熱との闘いを支援するため医学専門家チームをコンゴ民主共和国に派遣
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてが該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、国際的拡大リスク、WHOによる国際的懸念事項の公衆衛生上の緊急事態認定、国際協力が発動されている）。エボラ出血熱は高致死率の感染症であり、DRCでの流行はすでにWHO緊急事態と認定されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）でのエボラ出血熱流行が主題であり、中国がDRCに医療専門家を派遣する内容となっている。Bluedot APIが付与した北京の情報は中国派遣チームの出発地であり、実際の感染症イベント発生地ではないため、verified_locationsに中国を含めない。DRCはWHO緊急事態として認定されており、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Regeneron's Inmazeb Ebola Antibody Recommended by World Health Organization for Investigational Use in Response to Current Bundibugyo Ebolavirus Outbreak
article.articleSummary: WHO Therapeutics Advisory Group has prioritized maftivimab—the most potent neutralizing antibody in Regeneron's Inmazeb—for evaluation as a monotherapy against Bundibugyo ebolavirus amid the DRC and Uganda outbreak declared a public health emergency of international concern. WHO coordinates with the DRC and Uganda governments to facilitate research evaluations of prioritized products. Regeneron is preparing existing maftivimab supply for potential trials; Inmazeb stock is on the ground in the DRC for immediate use or study components. Maftivimab shows broad in vitro activity against multiple Ebola species, including Bundibugyo, but has not yet been tested in vivo as a monotherapy. Inmazeb—a three-antibody cocktail approved by FDA for Orthoebolavirus zairense (Zaire ebolavirus)—has been administered to hundreds with an acceptable safety profile. Regeneron donated 500 doses to WHO in Sept 2025 for low- and lower-middle income countries; U.S. stockpiles and HHS coordination continue; Afya Foundation supports frontline response.

triage.headline_ja: ジェネラリティーズのInmazeb エボラ抗体が、現在のブンディブギョエボラウイルスアウトブレイクへの対応として世界保健機関によって治験使用を推奨される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。DRCとウガンダで発生中のエボラアウトブレイク（PHEIC宣言）に対する公式な医療介入の推奨であり、シグナルとしてピックアップ。
triage.notes: ウガンダはサマリー内で言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。記事はBundibugyo ebolavirus（ブンディブギョエボラウイルス）のアウトブレイクに関するもので、DRCとウガンダでのPHEIC宣言済み。WHOによる治験推奨は重要な公衆衛生反応であり、緊急の経過観察が必要。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية تسابق الزمن لتطوير لقاحات مواجهة لسلالة فيروس "إيبولا بونديبوجيو" - ستاد الأهلي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization races against time to develop vaccines to combat the Bundibugyo strain of the Ebola virus — Al Ahly Stadium
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease caused by Bundibugyo (BDBV) strain in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo is facing a race against time to develop effective countermeasures. There are no licensed vaccines or therapies specifically approved for this strain. The outbreak carries a high fatality rate, about 40% of cases, and infections are rising according to WHO risk assessments. Experimental vaccines and therapies are under evaluation, with limited data and some approaches previously used against the Zaire strain being tested for partial protection; current evidence derives only from animal studies. Priority is on advancing several candidates, including monoclonal antibodies, antivirals, and vaccines. The leading rVSV-based vaccine candidate, rVSVΔG/BDBV-GP, developed by IAVI, builds on the platform used for Merck’s Ervebo. Widespread human trials are pending, contingent on emergency use or compassionate-use approvals for deployment in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関が「エボラ出血熱ブンディブギョ株」に対抗するワクチン開発に時間との競争を行う
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響・異常性・国際的拡大リスク）、かつWPRO基準でも複数該当。DRC内での新規ウイルス株による高い致死率のアウトブレイクであり、ワクチン未承認のため管理可能性に懸念がある。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ(BDBV)株は既知のエボラウイルス株の一つだが、本記事は東部DRCでの現在進行中のアウトブレイクを扱っており、40%の高い致死率、ライセンス取得済みワクチン/治療法の欠如、実験的対策の評価段階という点で深刻。国際的な支援とワクチン開発の緊急性が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola may have spread beyond Africa. How are health authorities responding?
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is the third-largest on record. First suspected case detected April 24; WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. As of 27 May, 906 suspected cases and 223 deaths reported in the DRC. Exported/imported cases include a suspected case in Italy; two suspected cases in Brazil (São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro) later ruled out for Ebola (malarial and meningitis diagnoses); an American patient treated in Germany; Uganda reporting nine cases and one death. Global response includes travel restrictions by the United States and Canada on travelers from DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan, with Brazil activating safety protocols and Australia monitoring risk as very low. Funding surpasses A$86 million to develop vaccines targeting Bundibugyo. Transmission via direct contact with infected bodily fluids; early symptoms include fever, sore throat, fatigue, with severe illness causing vomiting, diarrhea, and seizures; urban and healthcare settings drive spread, alongside burial practices and instability.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがアフリカ以外に拡大した可能性。保健当局はどう対応しているのか？
triage.triage_reason: ブンディブギョ型エボラの国際的拡大が確認または疑いの段階であり、IHR基準の「国際的拡大リスク」「渡航制限リスク」に該当。複数国での輸出入症例と各国の対応措置がWHO緊急事態宣言と並行して実施されており、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはブラジル、イタリア、米国、ドイツ、ウガンダ、カナダなど多数国が列挙されているが、記事サマリーの精読に基づき、実際に症例が報告または確認された対象国はDRCとブラジルのみ。ブラジルの2疑い例は後に陰性と判明しているが、記事の主要な国際的拡大シナリオの対象として言及されているため含める。ウガンダはAFROスクリーニング対象外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Three Ebola vaccines in development amid growing outbreak fears
article.articleSummary: Three vaccines are being developed to tackle the Bundibugyo Ebola species, which has killed nearly 250 people, amid mounting outbreak fears in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and neighboring Uganda. The International AIDS Vaccine Initiative (IAVI) is developing one vaccine; the University of Oxford and Moderna are researching others, with funding from Cepi. More than 1,000 suspected cases are reported in the DRC, and nine cases have been confirmed in Uganda. The outbreak, detected after spreading in a conflict zone with limited healthcare resources, raises concerns it could reach the size of West Africa’s 2014–16 epidemic, which infected about 29,000 and killed over 11,000. Dr. Mark Feinberg, head of IAVI, warned the outbreak could be as severe or worse, stressing that vaccine development and countermeasures are a priority.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスの成長する流行の懸念の中、3つのワクチンが開発中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準で複数項目該当、社会的・政治的関心も高い。フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（対象国リストに含まれる）での1,000件以上の疑いケースと250人の死亡、ウガンダでの9件の確認ケースが報告されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。ブンディブギョ・エボラ種による大規模流行の懸念、2014-16年西アフリカエボラ流行との比較言及、ワクチン開発の国際的取り組みなどから、複数のIHR基準およびWPRO基準に該当する重要なシグナルと判定。

article.articleHeadline: कांगो में इबोला से 321 बीमार, 48 की मौत, भारतीय कंपनी सहित 3 समूहों को वैक्सीन के लिए फंड जारी
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 321 sick with Ebola in Congo, 48 dead, funds released for the vaccine to three groups, including an Indian company
article.articleSummary: As of June 2, 2026, Ebola infections caused by the Bundibugyo strain in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda total 321 cases with 48 deaths, and about 1,100 suspected cases across three eastern provinces. There is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo. Global health authorities have declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. CEPI is funding a $60 million vaccine push: Moderna receives about $50 million for early clinical testing and manufacturing; Oxford University and Serum Institute of India receive $8.6 million to develop the ChAdOx1 Bundibugyo vaccine using the same platform as the COVID-19 vaccine. IAVI gets $3.2 million initially for a single-dose vaccine based on a proven platform related to Merck’s Ervebo; animal studies show promise. Gavi commits $50 million; World Bank Pandemic Fund allocates $220.6 million. Distribution in conflict zones and access for poor communities remain major challenges.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ感染者321人、死亡48人、インド企業を含む3つの団体にワクチン資金を配分
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の確認症例321人・死亡48人で深刻な公衆衛生影響、Bundibugyo株は予想外、WHOが国際的懸念事項宣言、国際的ワクチン開発・資金配分が進行中で国際支援機構が関与。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、エボラ感染事例の主体はDRC・ウガンダで発生しており、インドはSerum Institute of Indiaがワクチン開発資金を受給する支援側として登場。サマリーの主題はDRCでのエボラ拡大事例であるため、verified_locationsはDRCとインドのみに限定。ウガンダ（対象国外）は除外。

article.articleHeadline: Serum Institute of India to manufacture Oxford Ebola vaccine backed by $8.6 million CEPI funding
article.articleSummary: CEPI commits up to $8.6 million to accelerate preclinical testing and early-stage development of an Oxford University Ebola vaccine targeting Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with SII manufacturing doses for Phase 1 trials. The Oxford candidate uses the ChAdOx1 platform, the same technology as the Oxford-AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine. No licensed vaccines exist for Bundibugyo, and CEPI has selected three investigational vaccines to maximize success. The funding supports creation of a Master Virus Seed stock and preparation for early-phase trials. The outbreak is spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and neighboring Uganda and has been declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern by WHO and a Public Health Emergency of Continental Security by the Africa CDC; hundreds of suspected deaths and cases have occurred, making it one of the largest filovirus outbreaks on record. SII’s involvement builds on the COVID-19 partnership to enable access for affected nations if successful.

triage.headline_ja: インド血清研究所がオックスフォード大学エボラワクチンを製造へ、CEPI資金860万ドルを確保
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO/Africa CDCによるPHEIC・PHEOCS宣言された大規模エボラ流行であり、ワクチン開発による重要な対応が進行中。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでの流行が言及されているが、対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。ウガンダは対象国に含まれていないため除外した。インドはワクチン製造国として記載されているが、イベント発生国ではないため verified_locations に含めていない。PHEIC宣言済みの大規模流行でありワクチン開発の国際的な動きが活発化している重要なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو تسجل 321 إصابة مؤكدة بفيروس إيبولا و48 حالة وفاة وتفش في 3 مقاطعات
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo records 321 confirmed Ebola virus infections and 48 deaths, with an outbreak in three provinces.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reaches 321 confirmed infections and 48 deaths, with transmission across three provinces. Medical teams pursue containment through isolation, contact tracing, and strengthened health facility readiness in affected areas. The World Health Organization is partnering with the Congo’s medical research organization to boost diagnostic capacity, aiming for real-time data and rapid case confirmation to save lives. Uganda reports the outbreak rising to 8 Ebola cases. Kenya has approved opening a quarantine facility at the Laikipia Air Base in central Kenya for people exposed to the virus, with U.S. access rights to land at the base; Kenyan authorities say the measure was sought for all nationalities, though it remains unclear if that will be implemented. The United States is funding 50 clinics in the Congo for Ebola response as part of a $50 million support package.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がエボラウイルスの感染者321人と死亡者48人を記録、3つの州でのアウトブレイク
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準でも全5項目該当。エボラ出血熱の多国間確認例と大規模死亡者数から、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、実際のエボラアウトブレイク発生地はDRコンゴのみ確認。ウガンダ（8例）、ケニア（検疫施設整備）、アメリカ（支援提供）の記述は存在するが、これらの国での実際の発生事例は記載されていないため、verified_locationsに含めない。DRコンゴは対象国リストに含まれる（ID: 203312）ため追加。国際的な懸念の高さと公衆衛生上の重大性から即座のフルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: 치사율 최대 90%인데 백신도 없다...에볼라 재확산에 전 세계 비상사태
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Up to 90% fatality rate, and there is no vaccine... Global emergency as Ebola resurges.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV) is resurging in Africa, prompting WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) and Africa CDC's PHECS. Current counts: 918 suspected cases and 224 deaths, with Congo Democratic Republic reporting 906/223 and Uganda 12/1. Ebola symptoms include fever, headache, myalgias, vomiting, and diarrhea, potentially progressing to organ failure, bleeding, and shock; mortality can reach 90%. No licensed vaccine exists for BDBV; existing Ebola vaccines target Zaire ebolavirus, limiting applicability. CEPI has initiated emergency vaccine development, backing three candidates from Moderna, Oxford University, and IAVI; Oxford’s candidate is produced in India by Serum Institute. Moderna expands CEPI collaboration, with up to $50 million to support nonclinical and Phase 1 trials and scale-up manufacturing. Korea’s KCDC raised the alert level to watch and designated DR Congo, Uganda, South Sudan, Ethiopia, and Rwanda as high-risk quarantine regions.

triage.headline_ja: 致死率最大90%なのにワクチンもない…エボラ再拡散で全世界非常事態
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV)の再拡散に対しWHOがPHEIC宣言、IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、公衆衛生上の重大な懸念が確認されたため。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーによると、DRCおよびウガンダでBDBV再拡散が発生。ワクチン開発におけるセラム・インスティテュート（インド）の役割が記載されているため、Indiaを verified_locations に含める。ウガンダ、南スーダン、エチオピア、ルワンダは記事で言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。韓国CDCの対応が記載されているが、感染症イベント自体は対象地域外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: コンゴでエボラ大流行、死者220人、感染者900人...問われる「流行後」の医療体制 | ニューズウィーク日本版 オフィシャルサイト
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo, 220 deaths, 900 infections... the post-outbreak healthcare system is being tested
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached about 900 infections and at least 220 deaths as of the end of May 2026, with transmission extending into neighboring Uganda. Long-term sequelae among survivors include neurological and musculoskeletal disorders and vision impairment, imposing a continued burden on an already strained health system. A second blow accompanies the outbreak: in January 2026, the United States withdrew from the World Health Organization and cut global health funding, weakening frontline response and post-epidemic care. Diagnostic capacity is severely limited, with current testing limited to a few cases per hour, hindering epidemiological containment. Public health experts warn this is not merely a regional crisis but the world’s first stress test as wealthier nations retreat from systems they previously supported.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ大流行、死者220人、感染者900人...問われる「流行後」の医療体制
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大、ウガンダへの越境感染確認）。WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。エボラウイルス疾患の大規模流行は最高優先度のシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴでの大規模エボラ流行を主題とし、ウガンダへの越境を言及しているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。米国のWHO脱退による国際的支援削減も状況の深刻性を増している。診断能力の深刻な制限と長期後遺症による医療システムへの持続的負荷は、単なる流行対応の問題を超えた世界的規模での関心事項となっている。

article.articleHeadline: WHOテドロス事務局長がエボラ感染拡大地域を訪問　「エボラは食い止められる」 | ニューズウィーク日本版 オフィシャルサイト
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General Tedros visits Ebola outbreak areas; "Ebola can be stopped" | Newsweek Japan Official Site
article.articleSummary: In Kinshasa, World Health Organization Director-General Tedros met Congo President Tshisekedi to review the Ebola response after his visit to eastern Ituri. He urged community-led action and strong government leadership to stop the outbreak and called for strengthening health systems in affected areas. As of May 29, Congo reported 906 suspected Ebola cases with 223 deaths under investigation; by May 31, authorities said 19 new positives, bringing confirmed cases to 282 and deaths to 42. The International Rescue Committee warned the outbreak may be larger and more advanced than official counts, noting only about 20% of contacts are being traced and transmission routes remain challenging. The Coalition for Epidemic Preparedness Innovations pledged about $60 million to accelerate vaccine development for the Bundibugyo Ebola strain, including Moderna, while China announced it would send medical experts to support Congo’s response.

triage.headline_ja: WHOテドロス事務局長がエボラ感染拡大地域を訪問　「エボラは食い止められる」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス疾患は重篤で高い致命率、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクがあり、既に282確認症例と42死亡が報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはキナシャ（DRC首都）とイトゥリ（DRC東部）でのエボラ発生を主題としている。Bluedot APIが中国（1814991）を発生地域に含めているが、サマリーで中国が医療専門家の派遣を「支援」する側として記述されているのみであり、実際の感染発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外した。ICRCの警告および国際的支援の必要性から、フルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）への進行を推奨。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Încă o persoană depistată cu COVID-19 la Satu Mare
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another person tested positive for COVID-19 in Satu Mare.
article.articleSummary: Romania reports another COVID-19 case in Satu Mare County. As of Tuesday, May 19, 2020, the country total stood at 17,191 confirmed cases, with 10,166 recovered and discharged. Satu Mare has 58 cases, up from May 18. Nationwide deaths total 1,126; 195 patients are in intensive care. There are 11,808 people in institutional quarantine and 24,415 in home isolation under medical monitoring. A total of 322,074 tests have been processed. In the last 24 hours, 155 new cases were recorded. Romanian citizens abroad number 2,923 infected (Italy 1,698; Spain 561; France 30; Germany 487; UK 87; others). Of Romanians abroad, 22 have recovered (Germany 9; France 9; Indonesia 2; Luxembourg 1; Tunisia 1). Europe/global snapshot: UK 243,695; Spain 231,350; Italy 225,435; France 142,411; Germany 174,697; worldwide 4,679,511 cases, 315,005 deaths, 1,787,539 recovered.

triage.headline_ja: サトゥ・マレでもう1人がCOVID-19陽性と判定
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19は既知の流行疾患であり、2020年5月の記事として時系列が大きく古い。ルーチン的な患者報告であり、異常性、重症度の急増、新規の感染動向などを示す証拠がない。対象国（インドネシア）は患者国ではなく、回復者の国籍記載に過ぎない。
triage.notes: 記事は2020年5月19日付けで、現在は2026年6月。配信日時は2026年6月2日とあるが、記事内容の時系列に大きな矛盾がある。サマリーでインドネシアが言及されているのはルーマニア国外感染者の回復者統計に限定される。ルーチン的なCOVID-19ケースレポートであり、シグナル価値なし。

article.articleHeadline: Không phải Ebola hay virus Hanta, đây mới là dịch bệnh nào đáng lo ngại nhất hiện nay
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: It's not Ebola or the Hantavirus; which disease is the most worrying right now?
article.articleSummary: Measles in Bangladesh has caused one of the worst outbreaks in decades, with more than 78,000 suspected or confirmed cases and over 500 child deaths in the past two months, most deaths among children under five who were not vaccinated. Separately, rare Hantavirus infections are drawing attention: 13 cases and 3 deaths linked to an Andes-variant outbreak on the MV Hondius, a ship that traveled from Argentina to Europe, suggesting possible human-to-human transmission. There is no vaccine or specific treatment for Hantavirus; prevention is key. The Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda has surpassed 1,000 cases and about 220 deaths as of May 29, with WHO declaring a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17; no approved vaccines or treatments exist for Bundibugyo. Indonesian experts warn on exposure risks, highlighting the need for rodent control and public health vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスやハンタウイルスではない。現在最も懸念されている病気は何か？
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹（バングラデシュ）、ハンタウイルス感染症（アルゼンチン発生、船舶での集団発生）、エボラ・ブンディブギョ（DRC・ウガンダ）の3つの重大な感染症イベントが同時に報告されており、IHR基準複数該当、WPRO基準複数該当。エボラについてはWHOがPHEIC宣言済み。
