triage.notes: 記事はアルゼンチンと船舶（MV Hondius）でのハンタウイルス集団発生も報告しているが、アルゼンチンは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めていない。エボラはウガンダでも確認されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため含めていない。3つの異なる病原体による複数の重大なアウトブレイク（麻疹、ハンタウイルス、エボラ）が同時報告されており、国際的な関心と対応が必要。

article.articleHeadline: NCDC DG Says Nigeria Only 59% Prepared For Ebola Threat
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-02, Nigeria’s preparedness for an Ebola outbreak is about 59%, per NCDC Director‑General Dr. Jide Idris. Despite intensified surveillance and updated entry protocols amid renewed Ebola activity in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of the Congo and rising international travel, a nationwide risk assessment found critical gaps, especially at points of entry. Assessments covered isolation centres, public health emergency operations centres, healthcare infrastructure, and emergency stockpiles for suspected cases, with advisers deployed to states. High‑risk locations include states hosting international airports; porous land borders and informal routes complicate monitoring. The Federal Ministry of Health issued protocols to bolster border and airport screening. Nigeria’s 2014 Ebola containment experience underpins current laboratory expansion and surveillance improvements. Concurrently, the country is managing seven to eight outbreaks, including Cholera and Lassa Fever, which strain public health resources.

triage.headline_ja: NCDC局長がナイジェリアはエボラ脅威に対する準備が59%だけと述べる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外な状況、国際的拡大リスク）。ウガンダ・DRCでのエボラ活動増加、ナイジェリアの複数感染症同時流行（エボラ・コレラ・ラッサ熱）、国の準備状況が59%と不十分な点が重大なシグナル。
triage.notes: DRCとウガンダでのエボラ活動増加がナイジェリアの脅威を引き起こしている。記事はナイジェリアの準備状況評価が主題であり、DRCは流行地として言及されている。Uganda（対象国外）は流行地として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないが、記事の主題がナイジェリアであり重大な懸念事項であるため、実質的な脅威として verified_locations に含める必要があると判断。ただし厳密には対象国外であることを注記。複数の同時流行（コレラ・ラッサ熱）も資源を圧迫している点が追加の懸念。

article.articleHeadline: Menkes Tegaskan Risiko Penyebaran Ebola ke Indonesia Rendah : Okezone Women
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Minister Reiterates Low Risk of Ebola Transmission to Indonesia: Okezone Women.
article.articleSummary: On 2 June 2026, Indonesian Health Minister Budi Gunadi Sadikin said the risk of Ebola entering Indonesia remains low, despite WHO warnings. Speaking in Jakarta after attending the World Heart Day 2026 Health Talk Show, he emphasized that Ebola is not airborne and spreads via bodily fluids, making transmission less easy than COVID-19. He noted WHO has issued vigilance guidelines, but the overall risk is higher in countries or regions directly affected by outbreaks. The statements aim to reassure the public that Indonesia faces a low transmission risk for Ebola and reflect a cautious, non-alarmist stance toward international health advisories.

triage.headline_ja: 保健大臣がインドネシアへのエボラ感染拡大リスクが低いことを改めて確認：Okezone Women
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスとCOVID-19に関連した記事であるが、記事サマリーはインドネシアの保健大臣による「リスク低い」という公式声明であり、実際のエボラ感染事例や異常な疾患発生を報告していない。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシア保健大臣による公式声明であり、実際のエボラ症例報告や感染イベント検出ではなく、リスク評価・安心供与に焦点を当てている。疾患名にエボラが含まれているが、記事サマリーはインドネシアでのエボラ感染リスクについての予防的コメントであり、実際の感染事例は報告されていない。WHO警告への対応姿勢を示すニュースだが、シグナルの条件を満たさない。

article.articleHeadline: Avoid travel to Ebola-hit countries, experts tell Nigerians
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak, confirmed by the World Health Organization in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, has yielded more than 1,100 suspected cases and over 246 suspected deaths. The WHO warns the spread into densely populated and conflict-affected areas is hampering surveillance, contact tracing and treatment. In Nigeria, the National Ebola Emergency Watch has been activated in Lagos, the Federal Capital Territory, and eight other states. The Nigeria Centre for Disease Control, the Federal Airports Authority of Nigeria and partners have intensified airport surveillance, focusing on travelers from high-risk regions to prevent disease influx. Officials say preparedness remains around 59%, acknowledging it cannot be 100%, while stressing personal and environmental hygiene as the strongest defense. Public health experts urge Nigerians to avoid unnecessary travel to Ebola-hit countries to reduce transmission risk.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱患者が発生している国への渡航を避けるよう専門家がナイジェリア人に呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、複数国での確認例、渡航制限勧告）。WHOが確認したブンディブギョ型エボラ出血熱の急速な拡大と、複数国での準備態勢強化が進行中。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCとウガンダでのWHO確認事例、ナイジェリアでの準備態勢強化を述べているが、ウガンダ(GeoNames ID 226074)および対象国外のナイジェリアは verified_locations から除外。対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。エボラ出血熱は極めて高いリスク疾患であり、複数国での確認、死亡事例、そして国際渡航制限勧告の発出がある点で、フルRRA進行の優先度は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Épidémie d'Ebola : le diocèse de Bunia renforce les mesures de
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: the Diocese of Bunia strengthens measures.
article.articleSummary: Diocese of Bunia tightens Ebola response in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo. In a statement signed by Bishop Dieudonné Uringi, the Catholic Church calls all faithful, priests, religious to actively participate in prevention as the virus remains highly contagious and its transmission chain is not yet controlled. Key measures include mandatory handwashing facilities at the entrance of parishes, chapels, and gathering sites; strict physical distancing during liturgies; bans on embraces, handshakes, and other physical contact. Baptisms, first Communions, and priestly ordinations planned for June 11 are postponed. Visits to patients in health facilities are suspended until further notice. Retreats, prayer vigils, and other gatherings are discouraged. The Diocese urges members to combat misinformation, follow hygiene guidelines, and promptly direct anyone with suspicious symptoms to health centers, contributing to the broader public health response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染症の流行：ブニア教区が予防措置を強化
triage.triage_reason: DRC（対象国）におけるエボラウイルス疾患の確認イベント。IHR基準4項目中3項目に該当し、重篤な公衆衛生上の影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスクがある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで述べられているイベント発生地はDRC（ブニア地域）である。エボラウイルス疾患は死亡率が高く、ヒト-ヒト感染が可能であり、制御されていない伝播チェーンが存在すると明示されている。宗教行事の中止措置など社会的影響も大きい。対象国リストにはDRC（GeoNames ID: 203312）が含まれるため verified_locations に追加した。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Menkes: Pasien Hantavirus di RSPI Sudah Pulang : Okezone Women
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Minister: Hantavirus patient at RSPI has already gone home: Okezone Women.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia’s Health Minister Budi Gunadi Sadikin announced that the hantavirus patient treated at RSPI Sulianti Saroso in Jakarta has recovered and has been discharged. After contact tracing, no transmission to others was detected. The update followed the World Heart Health Day Talk Show 2026 at the Health Ministry in Jakarta on 2 June 2026. Earlier, authorities in the United Kingdom notified Indonesia about a British worker linked to hantavirus; in response, the government isolated the patient and provided care at RSPI Sulianti Saroso. Officials stressed the investigation found no human-to-human transmission stemming from the case.

triage.headline_ja: 保健大臣：RSPIのハンタウイルス患者は既に退院した：Okezone Women
triage.triage_reason: 患者は既に回復・退院し、接触者追跡で他への感染は検出されず、ヒト-ヒト感染の報告なし。確認された症例数が限定的で、公衆衛生への深刻な影響や国際的拡大のリスクは現在認められない。
triage.notes: 記事では英国の労働者が関与していると述べられているが、サマリーの主題はインドネシアでの症例の回復・退院である。英国はWPRO対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ハンタウイルスは通常ヒト-ヒト感染しないゾーノーティック疾患であり、本事例で接触者への感染が検出されなかったことが記事で明確に述べられている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Alert In Brazil: 2nd Suspected Case Tests Negative
article.articleSummary: On 2 June 2026, Brazil reported a second suspected Ebola case tested negative, as two men arriving from Africa with viral symptoms were isolated amid concerns over outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. In Sao Paulo, authorities ruled out Ebola for a 37-year-old traveler who had been to the DRC; lab results indicated meningitis instead. In Rio de Janeiro, another man who had traveled to Uganda was diagnosed with malaria and tested negative for Ebola. Brazil’s health ministry said the risk of Ebola entering Brazil or South America remains very low. Globally, the DRC outbreak has produced more than 1,000 suspected Ebola cases since it was declared on May 15, with nearly 250 deaths; Uganda reports confirmed infections and one death. Ebola transmission requires contact with infected bodily fluids, contributing to slower spread.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルにおけるエボラ警戒：2番目の疑い患者が陰性判定
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。DRCおよびウガンダでの大規模エボラ流行（1,000件以上の疑い患者、250件近い死亡）がブラジルに波及した可能性があり、国際的な対応が必要な段階。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（1,000件以上の疑い患者、250件近い死亡）とウガンダでの確認感染があり、ブラジルではこれまで疑い患者が検査で陰性となっているが、アフリカからの渡航者による持ち込みリスクが現在化している。ウガンダは対象国リストにないため verified_locations に含めない。Bluedot APIの「発生地域」にはブラジル国内の都市（São Paulo、Rio de Janeiro）が含まれているが、記事の主題はDRCおよびウガンダでの流行と、それがブラジルに波及する可能性であり、ブラジル国内での流行発生ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Après le Covid, sommes-nous vraiment prêts pour Ebola ?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After COVID, are we really ready for Ebola?
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu, has triggered hundreds of suspected cases and more than 200 deaths, with the WHO declaring a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The circulating variant is Bundibugyo with no approved vaccine, and the Sudan Ebola virus is noted for a fatality around 50%. Weakening international support, including reduced USAID funding, challenges surveillance, testing, and logistics amid ongoing conflict and population displacement. The protracted mobility linked to mining, refugees, and armed groups risks turning a local outbreak into a regional threat. Maurice’s risk is currently low but not negligible; the country has reactivated its Ebola plan, enhancing at the SSR airport: health questionnaires, traveler tracing, specialized teams, rapid isolation, airline coordination, and hospital drills, plus lab and PPE stock assessments. Incubation up to 21 days means silent travel is possible; proactive, transparent action is essential.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19の後、本当にエボラに対する準備はできているのか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目以上該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（200人以上の死亡、WHO国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言）で、国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にモーリシャスが含まれていますが、サマリーではDRCのイトゥリ、北キブ、南キブが主な発生地です。モーリシャスはリスク監視国として位置付けられており、実際の発生地はDRCのみです。WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言している重篤な出血熱で、ワクチン未承認のブンディブギョ亜種とスーダンエボラウイルス（致死率約50%）の流行。鉱業移民、難民、武装勢力による持続的な人口移動が地域的脅威への拡大リスクを高める。国際支援の減少（USAID資金削減）が監視・検査・ロジスティクスを困難にしている。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Menkes: Pasien Hantavirus di RSPI Sulianti Saroso sudah pulang
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Minister: A hantavirus patient at RSPI Sulianti Saroso has been discharged.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 June 2026, Indonesia’s Health Minister Budi Gunadi Sadikin confirms a hantavirus patient treated at RSPI Sulianti Saroso in Jakarta has been discharged. Contact tracing showed no onward transmission among exposed individuals. The patient reportedly previously worked on a ship; authorities were alerted by the United Kingdom about a British national traveling to Indonesia for work. Hantavirus has circulated in Indonesia since the early 2000s; seroprevalence surveys have found antibodies in Bali (around 16 percent) and in Surabaya and Jakarta (about 13 percent), indicating the virus is not new and that the fatality rate remains very low. Separately, WHO reported a cruise-ship outbreak rising to 12 hantavirus cases with three deaths; a Dutch crew member who disembarked in Tenerife and was repatriated to the Netherlands is among the cases. More than 600 contacts across 30 countries are being monitored, with some high-risk contacts still under follow-up.

triage.headline_ja: 保健大臣：RSPI スリアンティ・サロソ病院のハンタウイルス患者は退院済み
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで確認されたハンタウイルス症例に加え、国際的な船舶関連アウトブレイク（クルーズ船で12例、死亡3例）が報告されており、国際的拡大リスク、複数国の接触者監視、および予想外の集団発生の兆候があるため、シグナルとして識別。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはスペイン（テネリフェ島）、オランダ、英国も含まれているが、記事の主題はインドネシアでの症例確認と追跡調査であり、該当対象国はインドネシアのみ。ただしテネリフェ島でのクルーズ船アウトブレイク（オランダ乗客を含む）は国際的スプレッドの重要な背景情報であり、30カ国の接触者監視が進行中である点は重大。

article.articleHeadline: "Des facteurs sociaux et culturels": pourquoi les femmes paient un plus lourd tribut face au virus Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Social and Cultural Factors": Why do women bear a heavier toll in the face of the Ebola virus?
article.articleSummary: Female-dominated caregiving and funeral rites drive higher Ebola exposure in past outbreaks and risk in the 2026 outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. Historical data show: 2018–2019 in the DRC, about two-thirds of cases were women; 2014 West Africa, up to 75% of deaths in some Liberian communities; 2000–2001 in Uganda, infections among women exceeded men; 1979 Sudan, 69% female. In 2026, the pattern may recur as DRC faces a humanitarian crisis and strained health services. Women are disproportionately exposed—caring for the sick, aiding at home, cooking, washing, and preparing bodies—while also serving as essential responders in outreach and case finding. Pregnant women face particular risk due to contact with health facilities; two of the three largest outbreaks involved maternity transmission per WHO. ONU Femmes calls for sustained funding for women-led organizations, stronger primary care, and greater women’s participation in decision-making; quarantines may heighten gender-based violence risk.

triage.headline_ja: 「社会的・文化的要因」：エボラウイルスに直面する中で女性がより重い負担を負う理由
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの現在の進行中の流行（2026年DRC・ウガンダ）であり、IHR基準の「公衆衛生への深刻な影響」「異常性」「国際的拡大リスク」が該当。WPRO基準でも「重症度」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」が認められ、複数基準を満たすシグナル。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが列挙した5カ国のうち、記事サマリーで実際に2026年の進行中の流行として言及されているのはDRC(民主コンゴ)とウガンダのみ。スーダン、アンゴラ、リベリアは過去の歴史的データとして参照されているが、現在の流行としては記述されていないため、verified_locationsから除外。エボラウイルスは高い死亡率と人-人感染の可能性を持つため、管理可能性の課題も判定。

article.articleHeadline: Nő a halálos áldozatok száma, három vakcinával próbálják megfékezni a súlyosbodó Ebola-járványt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll is rising; three vaccines are being used to curb the worsening Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo-type Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered around Bunia, has claimed nearly 250 lives, with concerns it could rival the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak of over 11,000 deaths. No approved vaccine exists for Bundibugyo strain. Three vaccines are in development: IAVI, Moderna, and the University of Oxford, supported by CEPI. IAVI's modified vaccine shows near-complete protection in animal studies; clinical trials likely to start in seven to nine months. Moderna applies mRNA technology to accelerate development, with researchers aiming to reach at-risk communities as quickly as possible. Oxford is leveraging its platform to develop a vaccine; first human trials could begin in two to three months. All candidates target the Bundibugyo virus glycoprotein to elicit neutralizing immunity. WHO Director-General Tedros emphasizes vaccines as key to current outbreak control and future preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: 死亡者数が増加中、3つのワクチンで悪化するエボラ出血熱の流行を抑制しようと試みている
triage.triage_reason: ブンディブギョ型エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で発生し、既に約250人の死亡者を出しており、IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響（死亡者数増加）、予想外性（既知のワクチンがない株）、国際拡大リスク（地域的脅威）が認められる。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度（多数死亡）、管理可能性（国際的ワクチン開発支援の必要性）が該当する。
triage.notes: 記事にはウガンダとアンゴラも地域として記載されているが、サマリーの主題はコンゴ民主共和国（Bunia周辺）のブンディブギョ型エボラ出血熱の発生である。ウガンダとアンゴラは地域的な参照として含まれているが、記事の主な発生地点はDRCであるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ただし、ウガンダとアンゴラでの確認の可能性がある場合は、続報により更新が必要。WHO事務局長による強調など、国際的な注目度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Govt urges calm as dominant NB.1.8.1 Covid strain shows no sign of greater severity
article.articleSummary: Dominant NB.1.8.1 Covid-19 strain shows no sign of greater severity. Singapore reported a mid-May surge of 12,700 cases in the week May 10–16, with hospitalisations rising to 73 and ICU cases around one per day. Thailand’s surveillance shows seasonal increases with mostly mild symptoms and a capable health system; 3,642 cumulative cases and one death from Jan 1 to May 23, 2026, below the five-year median. Public guidance emphasizes basic precautions during the rainy season: frequent handwashing, masking in crowded or poorly ventilated places, and avoiding close contact with those with respiratory symptoms. Fever, cough, sore throat or fatigue warrant ATK testing and home rest; high-risk groups—older people, those with chronic diseases, and pregnant women—should limit exposure and seek medical advice if symptoms develop.

triage.headline_ja: 政府が冷静を呼びかけ、優勢なNB.1.8.1 Covid株はより高い重症度の兆候を示していない
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の既知株（NB.1.8.1）の報告であり、重症度の増加は見られず、両国の保健システムが対応可能な状況。IHR基準・スクリーニング基準いずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではシンガポールの5月中旬の症例増加が言及されているが、シンガポールは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。タイについては対象国に含まれ、記事の主題となっているため採用。全体として、既知のCOVID-19株の季節的な増加報告であり、重症度増加なし、両国の保健システムが対応可能との記述であるため、シグナルの条件を満たさない。

article.articleHeadline: China To Send Medical Expert Team To DR Congo For Ebola Control
article.articleSummary: China's National Health Commission (NHC) announced that a team of Chinese medical experts will depart Beijing in the early hours of Tuesday, June 2, 2026, for the Democratic Republic of the Congo to support local Ebola control efforts. The experts, noted for their rich experience in epidemic control, will join the Chinese medical team currently in the DRC and will work to strengthen cooperation with local medical and epidemic-control agencies to help contain the Ebola outbreak. The report does not provide case counts, laboratory confirmations, infection sources, or details on imported or exported cases. Published June 2, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、コンゴ民主共和国へのエボラ制御支援のため医療専門家チームを派遣
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の発生地（DRC）における国際的な支援活動であり、IHR基準の「異常・予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。対象国DRCでのシグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCでのエボラ発生に対する中国の国際支援活動である。中国がチームを派遣するニュースであり、Chinaが発生地域フィールドに含まれているが、エボラの実際の発生はDRCであるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。具体的な感染者数や検査確認情報が記事に記載されていないが、既知のエボラ流行に対する国際対応という文脈から、シグナルとしてピックアップすべき。

article.articleHeadline: Menkes Pastikan Risiko Ebola di Indonesia Rendah, Penularannya Tak Semudah Covid-19
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Minister Confirms Ebola Risk in Indonesia Is Low, Ebola's Transmission Is Not as Easy as COVID-19.
article.articleSummary: Ebola risk in Indonesia remains low despite WHO designating the Africa outbreak as a public health emergency of international concern. Indonesian Health Minister Budi Gunadi Sadikin says Ebola transmission is via bodily fluids, not airborne, explaining Indonesia's global risk is low and largely limited to populations in affected areas. The WHO flags imported risk mainly for travelers from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda, with higher transmission in the outbreak zones and moderate regional risk, while overall global risk remains low. Indonesia is not a major international air hub, making entry risk lower than hubs like Dubai or Singapore. Authorities will monitor travelers from Congo, emphasizing caution rather than panic. The current outbreak centers on the Bundibugyo strain in DRC and Uganda, with increased cases and deaths reported in East Africa.

triage.headline_ja: 保健大臣がインドネシアのエボラ・リスクは低いと確認、伝播はCOVID-19ほど容易ではない
triage.triage_reason: WHOが公式にアフリカのエボラアウトブレイクを国際的関心のある公衆衛生上の緊急事態として指定しており、IHR基準（重大な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）に該当。対象国のインドネシアで政府レベルの公式声明があり、国際的な政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: WHOがアフリカのエボラアウトブレイク（Bundibugyo株、DRCとウガンダで流行）を公式に国際的関心のある公衆衛生上の緊急事態として指定している。インドネシア保健大臣の公式声明によりシグナルとして識別。DRCとウガンダからの旅行者の監視が強化されている。

article.articleHeadline: Menkes Pastikan Pasien Hantavirus di RSPI Sulianti Saroso Sudah Kembali Pulang
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Minister Confirms Hantavirus Patient at RSPI Sulianti Saroso Has Returned Home.
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus case confirmed in Indonesia: Health Minister Budi Gunadi Sadikin reports the patient treated at RSPI Sulianti Saroso in Jakarta has returned home. The individual, linked to work on a ship, was isolated on arrival; contact tracing found no onward transmission. Indonesia has long-standing hantavirus presence with seroprevalence surveys showing antibodies in Bali (about 16%) and in Surabaya and Jakarta (about 13%), indicating this is not a new virus and with a very low fatality rate. Separately, WHO updates on a cruise-ship hantavirus outbreak: by May 22, 2026, 12 cases and 3 deaths reported; one additional case involved a crew member who disembarked in Tenerife, Spain, then returned to the Netherlands. Over 600 contacts in 30 countries remain under monitoring; authorities urge vigilant surveillance of passengers and crew through the remainder of the quarantine period.

triage.headline_ja: 保健大臣がRSPI スリアンティ・サローソのハンタウイルス患者が帰宅したことを確認
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで確認されたハンタウイルス患者に加え、国際的なクルーズ船アウトブレイク（12症例、3死亡、30カ国で600以上の接触者監視中）が報告されており、IHR基準の「異常性」「国際的拡大リスク」「渡航制限リスク」に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度（死亡事例）、流行しやすさ（ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性）、管理可能性（多国間の接触者監視必要）が明らかであり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域フィールドにはスペイン・オランダ・カナリア諸島も含まれているが、記事サマリー上で主題の感染症イベント発生地はインドネシア（ジャカルタのRSPI Sulianti Saroso）である。クルーズ船アウトブレイクはスペイン・オランダも関連するが、対象国リストに該当せず。インドネシアは対象国（ID: 1643084）であるため verified_locations に含める。複数国での複合的な公衆衛生イベント（国内症例＋国際的クルーズ船アウトブレイク）であり、IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準いずれも複数該当し、高優先度シグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Kina poslala tim medicinskih stručnjaka u Kongo kako bi pomogli u liječenju ebole
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China sent a team of medical experts to the Congo to help treat Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 June 2026, China has dispatched a team of medical experts to the Democratic Republic of the Congo to assist in the Ebola response amid an outbreak monitored by the World Health Organization, which has declared an international public health emergency. The specialists, departing Beijing, will collaborate with existing Chinese personnel in the Congo and with local health and epidemiological services to aid in prevention and treatment, train health workers, and support Chinese nationals and institutions in the Central African country. The mission seeks to share expertise and strengthen capacity for Ebola prevention, control, and treatment. The Chinese team already in Congo has activated emergency measures, including extra staff training, drills, and coordination of medical supplies, while continuing services for locals and Chinese nationals. WHO data indicate at least 134 confirmed cases across the Congo and Uganda, with 18 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、コンゴのエボラ治療を支援するために医療専門家チームを派遣
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、WHO公式宣言による国際的関心）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: WHOが国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言しているエボラ流行。コンゴとウガンダで134確認症例、18死亡が報告されている。中国による国際的な医療支援派遣は、この事象の国際的・政治的重要性を示している。Bluedotの発生地域にはBeijingも含まれているが、記事サマリーではBeijingは医療チームの出発地にすぎず、実際のエボラ発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: l'aéroport de Bunia de nouveau opérationnel après le renforcement des mesures sanitaires
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Bunia Airport Back in Operation After Strengthening Health Measures
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) prompts Bunia Airport reopening in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, after strengthening health measures. The airport, previously closed due to the outbreak, resumed operations on June 1 following assessments by health authorities and the Ministry of Transport, with a plan for a progressive, safe resumption of air traffic. Implemented safeguards include systematic temperature checks for all passengers at departure and arrival, strict hand hygiene with soap, water, or sanitizers, and immediate evaluation and management of fever cases by the National Border Hygiene Program. Bunia remains a key logistics hub in eastern DRC; however, Goma and surrounding areas face near isolation due to the AFC/M23 rebellion, and the region is under siege, complicating humanitarian access, supplies, and mining activity.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：保健措置の強化後、ブニア空港が再開
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱の継続的な発生であり、IHR基準4つすべてに該当する可能性が高く、WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当。国際的関心も高い公衆衛生上の重大事象。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのイトゥリ州ブニアにおけるエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク対応として、空港再開時の感染対策強化について報じている。東部DRCにおける人道的アクセス制限、M23反乱勢力による包囲状況は、対応能力に影響を与える重要な背景。エボラ出血熱は非常に高い致死率と感染性を持つため、継続的な監視が必須。

article.articleHeadline: エボラ感染疑いの男性2人、検査で陰性 ブラジル
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two men suspected of Ebola infection test negative in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: Two men in Brazil suspected of Ebola infection tested negative, announced by São Paulo health authorities on June 1, 2026. Both had recent Africa travel histories and were quarantined after Ebola-like symptoms. The 37-year-old man who had traveled to the Democratic Republic of Congo previously had a positive meningitis result, but Ebola testing was negative. The second man, with a Uganda travel history and quarantined in Rio de Janeiro, was diagnosed with malaria; Ebola tests were negative. Despite heightened regional vigilance, Brazil’s health ministry said the risk of introducing Ebola into Brazil or South America remains very low. No further cases were reported, and authorities continue routine surveillance. Location mentions include Brazil (São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro) and Africa (DRC, Uganda). Symptoms noted include meningitis-like signs and malaria confirmation in the second case."

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染疑いの男性2人、検査で陰性 ブラジル
triage.triage_reason: 疑い患者が検査で陰性となり、実際のエボラ感染症例ではない。ブラジルでのマラリア診断は予想内であり、国際的拡大リスク・公衆衛生への深刻な影響は低い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はエボラ疑い患者の検査陰性確認であり、実際の感染症事例ではない。DRCおよびウガンダはエボラ流行地域としての背景情報であるが、本記事では当該国での感染症発生イベントが主題ではないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Fact Check: Did X-Files Predict the Hantavirus Outbreak?
article.articleSummary: Tempo's fact-check debunks a viral claim that hantavirus is featured in The X-Files: Fight the Future as a US-made virus; the film is science fiction, with deaths caused by an alien virus. Separately, the World Health Organization reported a severe respiratory infection outbreak on cruise ship MV Hondius, with South African authorities confirming the Andean hantavirus variant in two onboard passengers. Hantaviruses are rodent-borne viruses (family Hantaviridae) causing two syndromes: HFRS, historically in East Asia (China, Russia, South Korea) with mortality typically <1–15%; and HCPS, more severe with up to 50% mortality, common in the Western Hemisphere (US, Canada, Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Paraguay, Panama, Uruguay). The article reiterates hantaviruses are not man-made. Laboratory confirmation of the Andean variant on MV Hondius marks the latest finding on board.

triage.headline_ja: ファクトチェック：X-FILESはハンタウイルスの流行を予測したのか？
triage.triage_reason: クルーズ船MV Hondiusでのハンタウイルス（Andean variant）検査確認による新規シグナル。HCPS（最大50%の致命率）の報告、複数国への地理的広がり、国際旅行関連による国際伝播リスク、公衆衛生上の重大性が認められ、IHR基準3項目以上該当。
triage.notes: 記事はクルーズ船MV Hondiusでの南米由来Andean hantavirusの検査確認を報告。ハンタウイルスはげっ歯類媒介で東アジア（HFRS、China/Russia/South Korea）および西半球（HCPS、高い致命率）に分布。クルーズ船という国際的移動手段での感染確認は国際伝播リスクを示唆。検証対象国ではChina（歴史的HFRS地域）とBrazil（HCPS地域）のみ該当。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）埃博拉疫情防控仍充满挑战_京报网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak prevention and control in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Kinshasa) still faces challenges.
article.articleSummary: 343 confirmed Ebola cases have been reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Kinshasa) amid an outbreak concentrated in Ituri Province, with Bunia as a focal point. The World Health Organization and the Congolese government say the epidemic response remains challenging, emphasizing early case detection and isolation, contact tracing, safe and dignified burial, strengthened infection prevention in health facilities, and community engagement. Bunia airport has reopened with public health measures such as handwashing and temperature checks after a suspension due to outbreak risk. Five patients have recovered, and a treatment center in Bunia is now operational. There is no licensed Ebola vaccine or specific therapy yet; vaccine and therapeutic trials are being pursued alongside timely supportive care. Brazil and Italy reported suspected imported cases ruled out for Ebola. China dispatched its 24th medical team to support Congo’s Ebola response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国（キンシャサ）のエボラ疫病予防・管理依然として課題が多い
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病の確認症例343件、複数国への拡大懸念、国際支援展開中。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にBrazil、Italy、Chinaが含まれているが、記事サマリーではこれらの国での確認症例は「疑い症例」として除外されている（Brazil and Italy reported suspected imported cases ruled out for Ebola）。実際の感染症イベントはDRC（Ituri Province/Bunia）に限定される。中国の医療支援派遣はDRCの対応支援であり、中国での発生ではない。したがって verified_locations にはDRCのみを記載。

article.articleHeadline: 民主剛果伊波拉疫情燒　肯亞抗議美當地設隔離處 - 國際 - 華視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo flares up; Kenya protests U.S. quarantine facility there - International - CTS News Network
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have intensified, with 282 confirmed cases and 42 deaths reported. The surge remains focused in the DRC, with concerns extending to neighboring Uganda and across the border into Kenya, where protests erupted over a U.S. plan to establish an Ebola isolation facility near Laikipia Air Base in Nakuru. Kenyan authorities had halted the plan, but demonstrations and road blockages continued. In frontline districts, health workers in full protective gear carry coffins and care for suspected and confirmed cases in the ‘red zone,’ while a 10-year-old patient shows perioral vesicular lesions and is described as slowly improving. No Ebola vaccine or definitive treatment exists at present, though the Coalition for Epidemic Preparedness Innovations plans to provide about $60 million to Moderna and two other groups to accelerate vaccine development. The article highlights ongoing transmission and public-health tensions over imported/exported cases of U.S. citizens abroad.

triage.headline_ja: 民主共和国のエボラ疫情が激化　ケニアが米国の隔離施設設置に抗議
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外な事態、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも全5項目該当。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC内での282確認例・42死亡の報告が主要な内容。ウガンダとケニアへの懸念が記述されているが、記事の主題はDRCのエボラ発生。対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみが該当国。ケニアとウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsから除外。社会政治的関心も高い（米国隔離施設設置への抗議など）。

article.articleHeadline: कांगो में इबोला का कहर, 48 की मौत, भारतीय कंपनी सहित 3 समूहों को वैक्सीन के लिए फंड जारी
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak ravages Congo, 48 dead, funds for vaccines released to three groups including an Indian company.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak driven by the Bundibugyo strain hits eastern Africa, centered in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) with spillover into Uganda. By 2 June 2026, 321 cases and 48 deaths, about 1,100 suspected across three provinces. WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. CEPI seed-funds $60 million to accelerate vaccines: $50 million to Moderna for early trials and manufacturing, and about $8.6 million to Oxford University and Serum Institute of India to develop a ChAdOx1 Bundibugyo vaccine using the AstraZeneca platform. IAVI gets $3.2 million. Ervebo remains the licensed vaccine for Zaire strain; animal studies for the Bundibugyo vaccine are promising. Trials will face security barriers in eastern DRC, complicating access. Gavi commits $50 million; World Bank Pandemic Fund allocates $220.6 million to bolster outbreak response and health systems.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラが猛威、48人死亡、インド企業を含む3つのグループにワクチン資金が配分される
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）による国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態。IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHOによるPHEIC宣言、多数の死者（48人）、複数国への波及（DRC、ウガンダ）、国際的な資金動員が確認される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは主要な発生地はDRC（東部）とウガンダとされているが、ウガンダ（ID226074）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。インドはセラムインスティチュート・オブ・インディアがワクチン開発に参加する組織所在国として記載されている。Bundibugyo株によるエボラは新しい脅威（Zaire株の既知ワクチンが効果的でない可能性）であり、セキュリティ上の課題から対応の難度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Darurat Ebola, Negara Afrika Ini Dilanda Demo hingga Chaos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Emergency: This African Country Hit by Protests and Chaos
article.articleSummary: Protests erupt in Kenya over plans to build a 50-bed Ebola quarantine facility at Laikipia Air Base in Nanyuki, Laikipia County. Demonstrators argue the project endangers public health and that Kenya's health system is unprepared; the High Court halted construction on May 29. The US would fund about $13.5 million for Ebola preparedness in Kenya, though few details of the quarantine center were released. Health Minister Aden Duale says the arrangement is part of a broader emergency-response effort and that the facility would serve all people, not only Americans. Kenya has yet to detect an Ebola case, while neighboring Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda have ongoing outbreaks. Protest organizers, including Patrick Wahome, have called for the facility's removal by June 9. Security forces were deployed to reinforce the base.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ緊急事態：このアフリカ国が抗議デモと混乱に見舞われている
triage.triage_reason: ケニアでのエボラ対応施設建設計画をめぐる大規模な公開抗議と政治的混乱が発生。隣接するDRC・ウガンダで進行中のアウトブレイクが存在し、国際的な公衆衛生対応の文脈にある。
triage.notes: ケニアでのエボラ症例報告はまだないが、隣接するDRCとウガンダで進行中のアウトブレイクがある。米国による1,350万ドルの支援予定があり、国際的関心が高い。高等裁判所が施設建設を5月29日に停止しており、6月9日までの撤去を求める抗議活動が継続中。地域検証：記事の主題はケニアでの公開抗議と施設計画だが、DRCとウガンダのアウトブレイク状況も文脈として言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: la Russie et l'Ouganda vont déployer un laboratoire à la frontière avec la RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Russia and Uganda will deploy a laboratory at the border with the DRC.
article.articleSummary: An inflatable laboratory will be deployed at the border with the Democratic Republic of the Congo by Russia and Uganda to establish sanitary and quarantine controls that previously did not exist, according to Anna Popova, head of Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor. The objective is to bolster border surveillance amid an Ebola outbreak declared on May 15 in the DRC and Uganda. Russia’s health agency has sent 4,000 tests to Uganda to detect the Bundibugyo strain. The Ituri province in the DRC remains the epicenter, with over 1,000 suspected cases and 240 deaths. Uganda reports 9 infections and 1 death. This cross-border initiative underscores intensified measures as the two countries contend with the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：ロシアとウガンダがコンゴ民主共和国との国境に検査室を配備
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4つすべてに該当。エボラアウトブレイク（異常・予想外）、高い死亡率、国際的拡大リスク、複数国による国境対応が進行中。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが発生地域にロシア（対象国外）とウガンダ（対象国外）を含めているが、記事サマリーの主要な流行地はコンゴ民主共和国（Ituri州）であり、実際の感染症イベント発生地は対象国リスト内ではDRCのみ。ロシアとウガンダは対応国として言及されているが感染発生地ではない。DRCはWHO EMRO地域に属するがトリアージシステムが適用される重要イベント。

article.articleHeadline: RDC e Uganda: Ébola mata mais de 40 pessoas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC and Uganda: Ebola kills more than 40 people.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda has reached 263 confirmed cases and 43 deaths, as of 2026-06-02, two weeks after the first cases were reported. The epicenter is Ituri province in eastern DRC, where 16 healthcare workers were infected during patient care; five have recovered. The World Health Organization warns that containment hinges on community engagement, early symptom recognition, and adherence to infection prevention measures, noting that there is no specific treatment and that fatality rates can reach about 50%. Authorities in the DRC, in coordination with WHO and Uganda, are scaling up responses to the Bundibugyo Ebola virus variant. Measures include rapid diagnostic testing, contact tracing, patient isolation, and preparations for clinical trials of vaccines and experimental therapies.

triage.headline_ja: RDC とウガンダ：エボラで 40 人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認された多数の死亡（43人以上）を伴う国際的な流行拡大イベントであり、IHR基準4つすべてに該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度と流行性が顕著。即座にフルRRA評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダは記事サマリーに言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCのイツリ州が流行の震源地として特定されている。264例の確認例と43人の死亡が報告され、致死率約50%のBundibugyo型エボラウイルス。WHOおよび当局による対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Health officials oppose US plan to treat Ebola-exposed Americans overseas By Reuters
article.articleSummary: Ebola-exposed Americans overseas face policy opposition from U.S. health officials. An open letter by infectious disease expert Krutika Kuppalli, emergency physician Debra Houry, Craig Spencer, and epidemiologist Anne Schuchat argues that treating or quarantining exposed citizens in Kenya or the EU—rather than repatriation—raises clinical, ethical, operational, and legal risks, could deter frontline responders, and diverts resources to overseas quarantine infrastructure rather than outbreak control at the source. Washington has proposed quarantining exposed Americans in Kenya and, if symptoms develop, sending them to a third country instead of bringing them home, a plan tied to Ebola outbreaks in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. Kenya’s opposition includes a court-ordered suspension of a proposed quarantine facility over public health concerns. As of 2026-06-02, the policy debate continues about exporting versus treating cases abroad.

triage.headline_ja: 米国保健当局がエボラウイルスに曝露したアメリカ人を海外で治療する計画に反対
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱は致死率の高い第1類感染症であり、東部DRC及びウガンダでのアウトブレイク関連で国際的な政策論争が生じており、WPRO基準の異常性・流行しやすさ・管理可能性でも該当。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは米国とケニアの政策論争を主題としており、実際のエボラアウトブレイクの発生地は東部DRCとウガンダと明記されている。対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみが該当。ケニアは対象国外のため除外。米国も対象国外のため除外。ウガンダも対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。本イベントは政策論争であり、現在の進行中のアウトブレイク（DRC東部、ウガンダ）との関連で国際的な渡航・隔離政策のリスク及び資源配分に関する懸念が表明されており、WPRO基準及びIHR基準を複数満たす。

article.articleHeadline: Кина испраќа медицински експерти во Конго поради епидемијата на ебола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China sends medical experts to Congo due to the Ebola epidemic.
article.articleSummary: China dispatched a team of medical experts to the Democratic Republic of Congo to assist in managing the ongoing Ebola outbreak, which the World Health Organization has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Departing Beijing, the experts will coordinate with Chinese personnel already in Congo and with local health and epidemiological services to support prevention, treatment, and training of health workers, while backing Chinese nationals and institutions operating in the region. The mission aims to share expertise and strengthen Congo’s capacity to prevent, control, and treat Ebola. The team in Congo has activated emergency measures, including additional staff training, drills, and coordination of medical supplies, while continuing to deliver health services to locals and Chinese citizens. As of the latest WHO data released on Friday, at least 134 confirmed cases have been recorded in Congo and Uganda, with 18 deaths among confirmed cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱流行のためコンゴに医療専門家を派遣する中国
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の confirmed outbreak（WHO PHEIC宣言済み）であり、IHR基準で少なくとも3項目に該当。DRCで134例以上の確定患者および18名の死亡が報告されており、国際的な公式宣言と深刻な公衆衛生影響が確認される。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが Beijing と China を発生地域に含めているが、これは中国からの派遣チームの出発地であり、実際のエボラ発生地はDRCと Uganda。記事サマリーの主題は DRC での outbreak であるため、verified_locations は DRC のみ。Uganda は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。WHO による PHEIC 宣言済み、及び複数国への国際的拡大（DRC+Uganda）が確認されているため、PICKUP判定は妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Ruto defiende el centro de cuarentena de ébola como parte de la...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ruto defends the Ebola quarantine center as part of the...
article.articleSummary: Kenya's President William Ruto defends a quarantine and treatment center for Ebola planned at a Laikipia Air Base, part of a long-standing US-Kenya health-security partnership. The center's establishment has been temporarily suspended by Kenya's Supreme Court. It is described as one element within a national system of about 23 such centers, alongside facilities in Nairobi, Eldoret, and Busia — including Kenyatta National Hospital, National Police Service Hospital, Moi University Teaching, Referral and Research Hospital (Eldoret), Kenyatta University Teaching, Referral and Research Hospital (Nairobi/Kiambu), and Alupe Hospital. The plan to relocate Americans exposed to Ebola to this facility follows outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and cases in Uganda; protests occurred in Nanyuki, Laikipia. In talks with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio, Washington pledged about $13.5 million to Kenya and $112 million in bilateral regional assistance, underscoring ongoing health-security coordination between the two nations.

triage.headline_ja: ルト大統領、エボラ隔離センターをケニア・米国保健安全保障パートナーシップの一部として擁護
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの国際的な流行兆候（DRC・ウガンダでの発生）があり、ケニアが予防的な隔離施設整備を進めているものの、記事時点ではケニア国内での確認患者がなく、施設建設が司法判断で一時停止中。情報不足のため段階的監視が適切。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアの隔離施設整備であるが、ケニア国内での患者発生は報告されていない。国際的な拡大リスク（DRC・ウガンダでの発生）と予防的な公衆衛生措置が講じられている点は注視すべき。ただし確認患者や深刻な公衆衛生影響が具体的に述べられていないため、現段階ではWATCH判定とする。続報でケニアでの患者発生が確認される場合はPICKUPに昇格。

article.articleHeadline: 综述丨刚果（金）埃博拉疫情防控仍充满挑战
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Review: Ebola outbreak prevention and control in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains challenging.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri Province, Bunia) remains challenging, with 343 confirmed cases reported. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus drives the outbreak. The WHO and DRC government warn that prevention and control remain difficult, highlighting gaps in early detection and isolation, contact tracing, safe and dignified burials, infection prevention in health facilities, and strengthened community awareness. Bunia airport has reopened with health screening measures (handwashing and temperature checks) after a period of suspension to curb transmission. Five patients have recovered, and a dedicated Ebola treatment center in Bunia is operational. No approved vaccine or specific therapy exists; clinical trials of vaccines and treatments are under way. Imported-case risk is being monitored; two suspected cases were ruled out in Brazil and Italy. China dispatched its first batch of anti-epidemic experts to support DR Congo, with the 24th team mobilized to bolster the response.

triage.headline_ja: 評論：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ疫情対策は依然として課題が多い
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目該当。進行中の大規模エボラアウトブレイク（343確認患者）で、国際的な懸念と支援が必要な状況。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにおいて、エボラアウトブレイクはコンゴ民主共和国（イトゥリ州、ブニア）で発生していることが明記されている。ブラジルとイタリアに言及されているのは疑い症例が除外された国として記載されており、アウトブレイク発生地ではないため、verified_locationsから除外。中国の専門家派遣はDRCへの支援活動を示しており、DRCが発生地。Bundibugyo ebolavirus は比較的致死率が低いebolavirus種だが、343確認患者という規模、ワクチン・治療法の不在、国際的な輸入感染リスク監視、複数国への影響が確認されており、高いシグナル判定が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: لمكافحة "الإيبولا".. الصين ترسل فريقا من الخبراء الطبيين إلى الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: To combat Ebola, China sends a team of medical experts to the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-02, the National Health Commission of China announced that a team of senior medical experts would depart for the Democratic Republic of the Congo to bolster Ebola response efforts. The deployment follows WHO's 17 May declaration of the DRC Ebola outbreak as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The visiting team will join the existing Chinese medical contingent in the DRC and coordinate with local medical and health agencies to contain Ebola. It will also provide training in prevention and treatment for local facilities, the Chinese medical team, the Chinese embassy, companies, and Chinese nationals abroad. China’s commitment to international cooperation is underscored by this move, as the 24th batch of Chinese health professionals in the DRC continues emergency response work—establishing prevention/control systems, conducting drills, coordinating supplies, and improving living conditions for the team.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対策のため、中国が医療専門家チームをコンゴ民主共和国に派遣
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準で4項目すべてに該当。WHOが2026年5月17日にDRCエボラアウトブレイクをPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）と宣言しており、国際的拡大リスクおよび渡航・貿易制限のリスクがある。
triage.notes: WHO PHEC宣言済みのエボラアウトブレイクであり、既に国際的な公衆衛生上の重大事象として認識されている。中国の国際協力による専門家派遣は対応強化の証左。記事サマリーに基づき、DRCとChina（派遣元）の両国でイベントが関連している。

article.articleHeadline: O alerta do Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola Alert
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo involving the Bundibugyo strain poses a wake-up call beyond Africa. The strain is not airborne, spreads slower than COVID-19, and has high lethality; there was no vaccine for this strain and rapid tests were lacking. Hospitals faced attacks; distrust hindered response; Uganda has confirmed cases and WHO raised international alert. Despite scientific gains since COVID—rapid viral sequencing, vaccines, genomic surveillance—the world remains politically fragmented; international health aid fell per OECD; pandemic treaty stalled over patents, data sharing, vaccine access; US retreat from multilateralism. The Congo outbreak exposes fragilities: conflict zones, weak state presence, social distrust; about one-third of residents in affected areas doubt the disease exists (ActionAid). On-ground capacity—treatment centers, public trust, funeral protocols—remains critical. The article warns: pandemics are possible; the bigger danger is complacency and political neglect. First weeks drive outcomes; memory fades after crises.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）、WPRO基準複数該当（重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）、社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラアウトブレイク（東部コンゴ）。ウガンダでも症例確認、WHOが国際アラート発令。高致死率、ワクチン欠落、急速検査不足。紛争地域での弱い国家体制と社会的不信により対応困難。記事は政治的分裂と国際保健支援の縮小を警告。Bluedot発生地域にUSAが含まれるが、記事サマリーでUSAでの発生報告なし。ウガンダは記事で言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemija ebole u Kongu: Kina poslala tim kako bi pomogli u suzbijanju
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo: China has sent a team to help contain it.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-02, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and neighboring Uganda continues, with WHO declaring an international public health emergency. Latest data released on Friday report at least 134 confirmed cases and 18 deaths among confirmed cases across Congo and Uganda. China has dispatched a team of medical experts from Beijing to assist, joining Chinese staff already in the DRC and coordinating with local health authorities. The mission will aid in prevention and treatment, train health workers, and support Chinese nationals and institutions operating in the region. The Chinese team on the ground has activated emergency measures, including expanded training, readiness drills, and coordinated medical-supply logistics, while maintaining health services for locals and Chinese citizens. The goal is to share expertise and strengthen capacity for prevention, control, and treatment of Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行：中国が支援チームを派遣
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべて該当、WHO国際保健上の緊急事態宣言、対象国DRCで確認されたエボラ流行。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCとウガンダでのエボラ流行を述べているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないためDRCのみ verified_locations に含める。中国からの医療支援派遣は対象国外での活動であり、主なイベントはDRCでの流行である。WHO国際保健上の緊急事態宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: Ученые рассказали, как сохранить деликатесную рыбу от смертоносных бактерий
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scientists explained how to protect delicacy fish from deadly bacteria.
article.articleSummary: On 2 June 2026, DTU scientists report that bacteriocins from certain lactic acid bacteria can suppress Listeria monocytogenes in cold-smoked salmon, extending shelf life and reducing listeriosis risk. Listeria cannot be salted, dried, or fully neutralized by alcohols or acids and can multiply in the refrigerator, causing severe diarrhea and up to 20% mortality without treatment. The international team, including partners from Algeria, Brazil, and Bulgaria, shows bacteriocins can selectively kill Listeria in smoked salmon without altering taste, aroma, appearance, or texture. Russia’s strict quality controls have yielded only isolated listeriosis cases, yet producers seek decontamination technologies to cut costs after contamination. The researchers suggest the approach could apply to trout, halibut, or mackerel, and plan biocontainment of smoked fish to guard against Listeria and other pathogens; results published in Fishes.

triage.headline_ja: 科学者たちが致命的な細菌からデリケートな魚を保護する方法を説明
triage.triage_reason: リスティリア菌の基礎研究・予防技術開発に関する学術報告であり、疾病の異常な発生流行ではない。対象国の実質的なアウトブレイク情報を含まない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は冷燻製サーモンにおけるリスティリア菌の制御に関する学術研究であり、感染症の流行・アウトブレイクではない。Bluedot APIが記事から複数国を抽出しているが、これらは研究パートナー国の言及に過ぎず、実際のイベント発生地ではない。対象国はBrazilのみが該当するが、疾病流行のシグナルとしての要件を満たさない。

article.articleHeadline: कांगो में इबोला के पुष्ट मामले 282 पहुंचे, स्वस्थ हुए स्वास्थ्यकर्मियों की कहानियों से बढ़ी उम्मीद
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Confirmed Ebola cases in the Congo reach 282; hope grows from stories of recovered healthcare workers.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-02, Congo reports 282 confirmed Ebola cases, centered in eastern Ituri with 264 confirmations, and more than 1,000 suspected Bundibugyo virus infections nationwide. There is no approved treatment or vaccine yet. The outbreak spans three provinces and 22 health zones, with 42 deaths in Congo and one in neighboring Uganda; Uganda has 9 cases and has closed its border with Congo. WHO notes progress in delivering scarce supplies to strained health facilities, but key challenges include rapid case identification, immediate isolation, effective contact tracing, safe and dignified burials, and strengthening infection prevention in clinics. CEPI announced up to $6.2 million to accelerate three experimental vaccines for Bundibugyo virus, developed by IAVI, Moderna, and Oxford University. Healthcare workers are at highest risk; five recovered workers were honored at Bunia’s new treatment center, including nurses Baraka Bullambulu and Ajo Etiyen, who described recovery and symptoms they've observed.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴにおけるエボラ確認症例が282件に達し、回復した医療従事者の物語から希望が生まれている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当。エボラアウトブレイク、複数国への拡大、高い致命率、国際支援が必要。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス（確認症例282件、うちIturi地域264件）およびBundibugyo virus疑い症例1000件超を報告。ウガンダへの国際拡大（9症例、1死亡）が確認されており、ウガンダは国境を閉鎖。医療従事者が最高リスク群。ワクチン開発（CEPI 6.2百万ドル支援）が進行中。国境閉鎖による渡航制限あり。

article.articleHeadline: エボラウイルスの株 | 髪人ブログ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus strain | Hair Person Blog
article.articleSummary: A blog post about the Ebola virus strain, specifically the Zaire strain, asserts that the United States created an Ebola biological weapon via patent ownership. It alleges the perpetrator of a recent terrorist act is a rogue state and claims that in Japan, functions of gain-of-function experiments are being performed on the Zaire strain domestically. The piece contends that an outbreak in Japan would not arise from a Congo origin but would result from a laboratory release (lab leak), with the broader aim of portraying Japan as a rogue nation. It frames the Congo outbreak as a potential cover for a deliberate release, and directs readers to a linked appeal. The content combines pathogen-focused claims with geopolitical accusations and provides no verifiable outbreak data or laboratory confirmations within the article itself.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスの株 | 髪人ブログ
triage.triage_reason: 記事は陰謀論・デマ内容であり、検証可能な感染症アウトブレイク情報を含まない。実際の感染事例、確認された患者数、公衆衛生上の実害の記述がなく、IHR基準およびWPRO基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はブログの陰謀論であり、米国によるバイオウェポン開発、日本での違法な機能獲得実験の実施、ラボリークなどの根拠のない主張を含む。DRC、米国、日本が発生地域として記載されているが、サマリーに検証可能な実際のアウトブレイク発生は記述されていない。信頼できる疫学的データ、確認患者、公開されたラボ情報がなく、シグナル検出の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: 快訊／麻疹爆群聚！泰國移入「感染北部20多歲男」3症狀曝光
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Breaking News: Measles Outbreak Clusters — Imported into Thailand: a man in his twenties from the North who is infected; three symptoms revealed
article.articleSummary: Measles in Taiwan: as of 2026-06-02, Taiwan CDC reports 11 measles cases this year, including 3 domestic and 8 imported from Vietnam, Malaysia, the United States, India, Indonesia, Kyrgyzstan, Japan, and Thailand. A new domestic case involves a man in his 20s from Northern Taiwan, onset May 26, linked to a cluster that began with a Thai imported case reported last week; the cluster has 2 confirmed domestic cases and 491 contacts under monitoring through June 16. Case 1 is a foreign woman in her 30s who traveled to Taiwan in mid-May and developed fever, cough, nasal symptoms, and rash; Case 2 is the Northern Taiwan man who became ill during contact tracing. Globally, Japan reports 511 cases this year; Bangladesh (Dhaka region) reports 70,936 cases, 9,049 confirmed, 585 deaths. Public health measures urge vaccination, with ample MMR stock; travelers should consider MMR vaccination 2–4 weeks before travel and practice hygiene; non-compliance penalties apply.

triage.headline_ja: 速報：麻疹アウトブレイク多発！タイから台湾へ輸入：北部20代男性が感染、3つの症状が判明
triage.triage_reason: 複数国での麻疹集団発生であり、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。対象国内（インド、インドネシア、タイ、ベトナム）での感染確認と国際的拡大を示唆する情報あり。
triage.notes: 記事は台湾での麻疹アウトブレイク（11例）を報告しており、台湾は対象国リストに含まれないが、サマリーは複数の対象国（インド、インドネシア、タイ、ベトナム）からの輸入症例を明示。バングラデシュのダッカ地域での大規模流行（70,936例、585死亡）も同時報告。複数WPRO国での麻疹流行クラスターの確認。ワクチン接種の強化と渡航前予防接種の推奨がなされている。

article.articleHeadline: 快訊／麻疹爆群聚！泰國移入「感染北部20多歲男」3症狀曝光 | 祝你健康 | 三立新聞網 HEALTH.SETN.COM
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Breaking News: Measles Outbreak Clusters! Thailand-Imported Case: "Infected Man in His 20s from the North" — 3 Symptoms Revealed
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports a new measles outbreak cluster linked to an imported case from Thailand. A 30-something foreign woman who arrived in mid-May developed fever, cough, runny nose, and rash and was laboratory-confirmed. Her northern Taiwan roommate, a man in his 20s, subsequently developed cough, fever and rash and was also confirmed. The cluster comprises 2 domestic cases, with 491 contacts identified and monitored through June 16. Taiwan's 2026 measles total reaches 11 cases (ages from under 1 to 50s): 3 domestic, 8 imported from Vietnam, Malaysia, United States, India, Indonesia, Kyrgyzstan, Japan, and Thailand. Global context: Japan has 511 cases this year; Bangladesh's Dhaka region reports about 70,936 cases (9,049 confirmed) and 585 deaths. The health authority emphasizes vaccination, health monitoring for contacts, and pre-travel MMR vaccination for those born after 1966; vaccines stockpile is sufficient; call 1922/0800-001922 for information.

triage.headline_ja: 速報：麻疹が大規模クラスター化！タイから輸入された「北部の20代男性感染」3つの症状が明らかに
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の多地域クラスター発生（台湾で2国内症例、8輸入症例、491接触者監視中）。IHR基準において異常性・予想外性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク等が認められ、スクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行しやすさ・管理性が該当する。公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念あり。
triage.notes: 台湾はWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。ただし、記事で複数のWPRO対象国（タイ、ベトナム、マレーシア、インド、インドネシア、バングラデシュ）における麻疹クラスターまたは流行の言及があるため、これらを検証対象地域として列挙。バングラデシュでは約70,936症例（確定9,049例）585死亡が報告されており、極めて深刻な状況。日本でも511症例の報告がある（日本はWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations 外）。IHR/WPRO両基準で満点の評価。

article.articleHeadline: India dispatches second tranche of medical assistance to strengthen Ebola response capacities across Africa
article.articleSummary: India dispatched the second tranche of 43 tonnes of medical aid to Africa's Centre for Disease Control and Prevention to bolster Ebola response capacities across Africa, focusing on the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar announced the shipment, which includes protective gear, diagnostic and monitoring equipment, medicines, and supplements, to strengthen public health preparedness and containment efforts. Supplies were routed through Africa CDC's Eastern Regional Coordinating Centre in Uganda and mobilized to eastern DRC. Africa CDC welcomed the assistance, noting it supports ongoing response measures and affected communities. India had previously confirmed the first tranche on May 29. New Delhi says it remains in close contact with African health authorities and stands ready to deploy additional tranches as the situation evolves.

triage.headline_ja: インドがエボラ対応能力を強化するため、アフリカへの医療援助の第2陣を派遣
triage.triage_reason: エボラ発生はDRCで確認されている重篤な疾患（IHR基準該当可能性あり）だが、記事は医療援助の派遣（インド→アフリカ）が主題であり、新規発生のシグナル評価ではない。DRC における発生状況の重症度・伝播リスク・国際的懸念の詳細が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事はインドによる医療援助派遣を主題としており、DRCのBundibugyo Ebola アウトブレイク対応を支援する背景にある。DRC での現在の流行規模、症例数、致死率などの詳細情報が記事に記載されていないため、IHR基準の full assessment には追加情報が必要。WPRO基準では重症度・流行性・管理可能性の観点から懸念あり。社会的・政治的関心（政府閣僚の公式発表）は高い。

article.articleHeadline: India dispatches second tranche of medical assistance to strengthen Ebola response capacities across Africa - The Tribune

India reiterated close cooperation with African health authorities and its readiness to deploy further tranches as the situation evolves, underscoring solidarity with Africa.

triage.headline_ja: インドがアフリカ全域のエボラ対応能力強化のため第2陣の医療支援物資を派遣
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生国（DRC）は対象国リストに含まれ、記事で具体的に言及されているが、インドからの支援派遣に関する報道であり、実際の発生イベント情報ではない。ただしDRCでのBundibugyo Ebolaアウトブレイク情報が含まれているため経過観察が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Africa: Statement from the Voting Members of the Governing Board on the Pandemic Fund's Accelerated Support for the Ebola Emergency
article.articleSummary: Emergency Financing Procedures activated with up to US$220.6 million in Pandemic Fund grant financing to rapidly bolster the Ebola outbreak response in Central and Eastern Africa, following WHO’s May 17, 2026 PHEIC declaration and Africa CDC alignment. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus, which has no vaccine, no treatment, and no rapid diagnostic test, with confirmed cross-border transmission underscoring regional vulnerability. Funding will support urgent outbreak response, preparedness, and cross-border coordination, prioritizing enhanced disease surveillance, laboratory systems, and health workforce capacity, in line with the WHO-Africa CDC Strategic Preparedness and Response Plan. Up to US$175.7 million will be reprogrammed from active Pandemic Fund projects to assist immediate efforts in Democratic Republic of Congo, South Sudan, Rwanda, Burundi, Tanzania, Zambia, Angola, Kenya, and Ethiopia, while up to US$44.9 million will be provided via expedited financing for Uganda, the Central African Republic, and the Republic of Congo. The Board advocates early, coordinated action—one plan, one budget, one team—to contain transmission and strengthen longer-term pandemic preparedness, in partnership with governments, implementing entities, regional and international partners, and civil society.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ：パンデミック基金のエボラ緊急事態への加速支援に関するパンデミック基金運営委員会投票メンバーからの声明
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において4つすべてに該当。Bundibugyo ebola virusの新規アウトブレイク、ワクチン・治療法なし、国境を越えた感染確認、複数国への拡大、WHO PHEIC宣言済み。
triage.notes: WHO PHEIC宣言済み（2026年5月17日）。Bundibugyo virus（ワクチン・治療法・迅速診断検査なし）による中央・東アフリカでのエボラアウトブレイク。パンデミック基金から220.6百万米ドルの緊急資金が承認された。記事では9か国への支援言及があるが、対象国リストにはDRC、Zambiaのみ該当。

article.articleHeadline: India Sends 43 Tonnes Medical Aid for Ebola in Africa
article.articleSummary: As of June 2, 2026, India dispatched a second 43-tonne tranche of medical aid to the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention to bolster Ebola response capacities. The consignment, announced by External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar, includes protective gear, diagnostic and monitoring equipment, medicines, and supplements. Delivered through Africa CDC's Eastern Regional Coordinating Centre in Uganda, the supplies are mobilised to support response efforts in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) amid the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak. A first tranche was sent on May 29 to assist the ongoing outbreak in the DRC. Africa CDC welcomed the emergency diagnostics and therapeutics, emphasising that the assistance strengthens containment and supports affected communities. India says it remains in close contact with African health authorities and stands ready to deploy further tranches as the situation evolves.

triage.headline_ja: インド、アフリカのエボラ対策に43トンの医療援助を派遣
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中のブンディブギョエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクであり、IHR基準で「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」「渡航・貿易制限リスク」に該当。WPRO基準でも「重症度」「長期曝露」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」が全て該当し、国際的支援が既に展開中。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはインドによるコンゴ民主共和国のエボラアウトブレイク対応への医療援助について述べており、実際の疾患発生地はDRCである。発生地域にインド（1269750）と記載されているが、これは援助国であり発生地ではないため、verified_locationsから除外した。ウガンダはアフリカCDCの東部地域調整センターの所在地として言及されているが、記事上で実際のエボラ発生地としては東部DRCのみが明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: México refuerza vigilancia por la amenaza del ébola | Diario de Centro América
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico strengthens surveillance due to the Ebola threat | Diario de Centro América
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-02, Mexico imposed a 60-day temporary entry restriction for international travelers who in the previous 21 days visited Uganda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, or South Sudan, amid an ongoing Ebola outbreak in the region near the Congo. The measure targets travelers without a Mexican passport or valid residence permit and was announced by VivaAerobus on X, with Mexican health and immigration authorities enforcing it for arrivals from African countries near the Congo region. Officials say the overall risk is low, and travelers should verify entry requirements before heading to the airport. The Secretaría de Salud has not publicly commented, though Health Secretary David Kershenobich said preventive measures have been strengthened to anticipate any crisis.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコがエボラの脅威に対する監視を強化 | ディアリオ・デ・セントロ・アメリカ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）、かつWPRO基準も複数該当。アフリカでのエボラ発生とメキシコの対応から国際的な公衆衛生の懸念が明確。
triage.notes: 記事はメキシコの対応を扱っているが、実際の感染症イベント発生地はアフリカ（DRC、ウガンダ、スーダン）である。メキシコは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。DRCのみが対象国リストに該当。エボラの重症性、ヒト-ヒト感染性、および国境を越えた制限措置の実施により、複数のIHR基準が明確に該当する。

article.articleHeadline: கொசுக்களை வைத்தே டெங்கு, ஜிகா நோய்களை ஒழிக்கப் போகும் கூகுள்! 3.2 கோடி கொசுக்கள் வெளியிடுவதன் பின்னணி என்ன?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Google, which aims to eradicate dengue and Zika diseases by releasing mosquitoes! What is the background behind releasing 32 million mosquitoes?
article.articleSummary: India, where dengue spikes during the monsoon, is the focus of Google's plan to release 32 million Wolbachia-infected male Aedes mosquitoes to curb dengue and Zika transmission. Traditional measures—fogging insecticides and eliminating breeding sites—remain essential, but Wolbachia is seen as a potential future tool for vector control. While studies show promising results, researchers caution about long-term environmental effects and public acceptance, and about deployment across regions with different climates. Releasing non-biting male mosquitoes aims to reduce disease-carrying mosquitoes without increasing biting risk. The initiative signals a science-based, environmentally friendly approach to counter major vector-borne diseases and highlights Google's efforts to tackle dengue and Zika in India and beyond as of 2026-06-02.

triage.headline_ja: Google、蚊を使ってデング熱とジカウイルスを撲滅へ！3200万匹の蚊放出の背景は？
triage.triage_reason: Wolbachia蚊放出は予防的介入であり、現在の流行対応ではない。インドにおけるデング・ジカの潜在的リスクは存在するが、このニュース自体は管理戦略の発表であり、公衆衛生緊急事態ではない。情報不足な点が多いため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 本記事はGoogle主導のWolbachia蚊放出計画についてのニュースであり、進行中の流行発生ではなく、ベクトル制御の予防的施策である。記事サマリーでは『デング熱は雨季に急増』と述べられているが、現在の活動中の流行に関する具体的情報（症例数、死亡数、地理的拡大）は記載されていない。科学的な新規施策としての社会的関心は高いと推察されるが、IHR通知基準には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Scatta l'allarme Ebola al "Civico" di Palermo: gli accertamenti escludono il virus, "è malaria"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola alert triggered at Palermo's Civico Hospital: tests rule out the virus, it's malaria.
article.articleSummary: On 2 June 2026, Palermo's Civico Hospital activated Ebola-safety protocols for a man coming from Africa (Rwanda, described as near the Congo border) who presented at the emergency department with fever and symptoms compatible with a contagious infectious disease. The patient had traveled through several international airports before seeking care, triggering rigorous clinical investigations. Subsequent diagnostic workup ruled out Ebola, with malaria ultimately diagnosed as the cause. The case was treated as an imported malaria infection, enabling rapid de-escalation of Ebola precautions and reassurance for staff and the public. The patient, involved in humanitarian work in African territories, highlights ongoing vigilance due to travel from regions affected by international health emergencies, but confirms that malaria, not Ebola, accounted for the presentation.

triage.headline_ja: パレルモの「チビコ」病院でエボラアラート発動：検査でウイルスが除外され、「マラリアだった」
triage.triage_reason: エボラは検査で除外され、実際の診断はマラリアであり、対象国での確認事例ではない。イタリアでの一過性の疑い事例に過ぎず、IHR基準やWPRO基準の該当がない。
triage.notes: 記事はイタリア（パレルモ）でのエボラ疑い患者ケースを報じているが、患者はルワンダから到着した輸入症例であり、実際の診断はマラリアである。エボラは検査で除外されている。対象国（DRC、ルワンダなど）での流行を示唆する内容ではなく、むしろイタリアでの疑い事例の解決を示すものである。したがって対象国での実際の発生イベントを示さないため、verified_locationsは空である。

article.articleHeadline: PS Oluga: Kenya has trained 2,200 health workers to handle Ebola
article.articleSummary: Kenya has trained 2,200 health workers to strengthen Ebola preparedness as of 2026-06-02, said Principal Secretary for Medical Services Ouma Oluga. About 800 were trained in the most recent incident, with Kenya building capacity for years through recurrent training during neighboring-country outbreaks. The government maintains a high index of suspicion for travelers from the DRC or Uganda within the last 21 days. Preparedness includes surveillance at 26 entry points, contact tracing, screening, and isolation facilities. Ebola-designated hospitals must have dedicated isolation areas, adequate PPE, and infectious-disease units with controlled airflow; suspected patients should be separated from others immediately, with isolation ambulances available for transfers. Common symptoms: headaches, fever, body weakness, diarrhoea, and bleeding in severe cases. A Turkish tourist scare tested negative; hotline 719. Vaccines and treatments exist for some strains, but the current strain has no vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: PS Oluga: ケニアはエボラ対策のため2,200人の保健労働者を訓練した
triage.triage_reason: エボラ対策の準備体制強化の記事であり、現在のアクティブなアウトブレイク報告ではない。ただし隣国DRC・ウガンダでのエボラ流行を背景とした地域的警戒が継続中であり、国境での高い感染リスク認識があるため経過観察対象とする。

article.articleHeadline: China está pronta para ajudar ativamente a RDC e outros países africanos atingidos pelo Ebola, diz porta-voz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China is ready to actively assist the DRC and other African countries affected by Ebola, a spokesperson said.
article.articleSummary: On June 1, 2026, China announced it is ready to actively assist Ebola-affected African countries, including the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), with emergency humanitarian aid and the deployment of medical expert teams. During a daily Foreign Ministry briefing, spokesperson Lin Jian said Beijing would support the DRC and other nations amid a new Ebola outbreak by providing medical services, assistance, and cooperation on epidemic prevention and control. China also aims to bolster African countries' capacity to fight the outbreak and will maintain close contact with the DRC and others. Lin noted China’s 2015 aid to three West African nations during the Ebola epidemic and called on the international community to take concrete action to defeat the outbreak as quickly as possible, including support to the African Union.

triage.headline_ja: 中国がエボラ出血熱の影響を受けたアフリカ諸国への支援準備が整っていると発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生事実は記事サマリーから確認できるが、本記事は中国の支援声明に焦点を当てた二次的な報道であり、疫学的な詳細情報（患者数、死亡数、感染の広がり）が不足している。実際の発生状況の進展を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本記事は中国の支援表明に関する外交的声明であり、疾病の流行状況に関する疫学的情報（症例数、死亡数、地理的拡大）が記載されていない。発生地域にアンゴラが含まれているが、サマリーではDRCが主な言及対象であるため、アンゴラでの実際の発生の有無は不明。中国は対象国リストに含まれるため言及されているが、本来の疫学的イベントはアフリカで発生している。更なる疫学情報を待つ。

article.articleHeadline: Число подтвержденных случаев заболевания лихорадкой Эбола в ДР Конго возросло до 282 -- НИАТ "Ховар"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of confirmed cases of Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has risen to 282 — NIAT 'Khovar'.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo reports 282 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases, with 264 in Ituri, 15 in North Kivu, and 3 in South Kivu, and 42 confirmed deaths. Overall in-country totals exceed 1,000 suspected cases and about 240 deaths. Uganda reports one death and seven suspected cases, with two recoveries. On May 27, Uganda closed its border with DRC to curb spread; Rwanda had previously closed its border and Zambia has implemented strict medical checks. The WHO on May 17 declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern for the Ebola outbreak in DRC and Uganda, following the May 15 official outbreak declaration by DRC authorities. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, first identified in Uganda in 2007.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラウイルス病確認症例数が282例に増加

article.articleHeadline: 北部爆麻疹群聚！泰國移入病例傳同住友人 匡列491接觸者
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles cluster outbreak in the north! An imported case from Thailand transmitted to a housemate; 491 contacts traced.
article.articleSummary: Measles cluster in northern Taiwan linked to an imported case from Thailand, with 2 domestic infections confirmed as of June 2, 2026. Case 1—a woman in her 30s who travelled to Taiwan in mid-May—developed fever, cough, runny nose, and rash within 3 days of arrival; laboratory confirmation followed. Case 2, a man in his 20s living in the same household, subsequently fell ill and was also confirmed. Both cases are mild and managed with home isolation; no hospitalization. A total of 491 contacts have been traced and are under health monitoring through June 16. Year-to-date Taiwan records 11 measles cases: 3 domestically acquired and 8 imported from Vietnam, Malaysia, the United States, India, Indonesia, Kyrgyzstan, Japan, and Thailand. Global context shows continued measles activity in nearby regions, underscoring airborne transmission risk and the need for strict contact tracing, monitoring, and protection measures.

triage.headline_ja: 北部で麻疹クラスター発生！タイからの輸入症例が同居友人に伝播 491人の接触者を特定
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の二次感染による国内クラスター発生、大規模な接触者追跡（491人）、複数国からの輸入症例と地域的な流行リスク上昇を示す。スクリーニング基準の複数項目に該当し、公衆衛生への関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はタイワンの麻疹クラスター発生ですが、タイワンは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めていません。タイからの輸入症例と複数国からの輸入症例パターンが確認されており、スクリーニング基準では異常性・流行しやすさ・管理可能性に該当。IHR基準も2つ以上該当しRRAの条件を満たします。

article.articleHeadline: Health: Three experimental Ebola Bundibugyo vaccines being f
article.articleSummary: Three experimental vaccines targeting the Ebola Bundibugyo virus strain are being fast-tracked as an eastern Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak raises regional alarm, including in Uganda. The Coalition for Epidemic Preparedness Innovations (CEPI) will support up to $8.6 million to advance development of the Oxford Vaccine Group candidate and two other vaccine approaches, with preclinical work and manufacturing for first-in-human testing at the Serum Institute of India. All candidates use different technologies; one leverages the same platform as the Oxford-AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine. There is currently no approved vaccine for Ebola Bundibugy o, and none has entered human trials. The Bundibugyo strain was first identified in Uganda’s Bundibugyo District in 2007. In Uganda, two additional cases in Kampala have been confirmed, bringing total confirmed infections to nine, including one death; six are Congolese nationals and three are Ugandans, including two health workers. The outbreak in DRC has prompted heightened border surveillance and preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: Health: Three experimental Ebola Bundibugyo vaccines being fast-tracked
triage.triage_reason: Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in DRC with cross-border spread to Uganda (9 confirmed cases including 1 death). Meets IHR criteria for serious public health impact, unusual/unexpected event, and international spread risk. Active vaccine development response indicates manageability concerns.
triage.notes: Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in eastern DRC with confirmed cross-border transmission to Uganda (9 cases, 1 death). Serum Institute of India involved in vaccine manufacturing for first-in-human trials. Uganda detected in article but not in target country list. India included as vaccine development/manufacturing hub.

article.articleHeadline: 國內爆麻疹群聚！友人來台旅遊「20歲男被感染」　匡列491人│TVBS新聞網

A total of 491 contacts have been traced and are being monitored through June 16. Taiwan's cumulative measles cases this year reach 11 (3 domestic infections, 8 imported originating from Vietnam, Malaysia, United States, India, Indonesia, Kyrgyzstan, Japan and Thailand). Globally, Japan reports 511 cases (Tokyo, Kanagawa, Saitama); Bangladesh reports 70,936 cases and 585 deaths. Public health actions highlight airborne transmission, health monitoring for contacts, vaccinations; penalties for non-compliance (NT$60,000–NT$300,000). Adults born after 1966 are advised to consider MMR vaccination before travel.

triage.headline_ja: 国内で麻疹クラスター勃発！友人が台湾旅行で訪問「20歳男性が感染」 491人が接触者として追跡

article.articleHeadline: 國內爆麻疹群聚！20多歲男遭外籍友人感染 491人遭匡列
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Domestic measles outbreak! Man in his twenties infected by a foreign friend; 491 people quarantined.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 June 2026, Taiwan’s CDC reports a domestic measles cluster linked to a foreign traveler: a woman in her 30s who visited in mid‑May developed fever, cough, rhinitis and rash three days after entry and was diagnosed with measles. Her housemate, a man in his early 20s in northern Taiwan, also became ill and was confirmed as the second case; 491 contacts were quarantined and monitored through 16 June. This year Taiwan has 11 measles cases, ages from under 1 to 50s; 3 domestic, 8 imported, with infections from Vietnam, Malaysia, United States, India, Indonesia, Kyrgyzstan, Japan and Thailand. Globally, outbreaks rise: Japan reports 511 cases this year, Bangladesh reports 70,936 total with 9,049 confirmed and 585 deaths, Dhaka region worst; other Southeast Asian countries continue reporting and exporting cases. Measles is highly airborne; noncompliance may incur fines. Publicly funded MMR vaccination is sufficient; adults born since 1966 planning travel should get MMR 2–4 weeks before departure and practice TOCC reporting with clinicians.

article.articleHeadline: Jest gorzej niż myślano. Groźny wirus szaleje na kontynencie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: It's worse than people thought. A dangerous virus is ravaging the continent.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-02, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo risks being undercounted. Only about 20% of contacts are being traced, impeding isolation of new transmission sources. The DRC Ministry of Health reports over 1,000 suspected infections and more than 200 suspected deaths, with 282 laboratory-confirmed cases and 42 deaths. In Uganda, at least nine travel-associated cases and one death have been reported, raising concerns about spread to Burundi and South Sudan. The International Rescue Committee warns of diagnostic shortages, testing backlogs, and health worker losses (at least six staff, including two doctors). Community avoidance of facilities could fuel transmission. The outbreak resembles North Kivu’s 2018–2020 trajectory, but there is no vaccine yet for Bundibugyo; three candidate vaccines are being developed. IRC calls for immediate international funding to scale up contact tracing, surveillance, testing, and community engagement, including involving recovered patients in outreach.

triage.headline_ja: 予想以上に深刻。危険なウイルスが大陸で猛威を振るっている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模流行で、死亡者200名以上、1,000件以上の疑い患者、確認患者282名。ウガンダへの越境感染確認、ブルンジ・スーダンへの拡大懸念。国際支援要請あり。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、DRC での主要な流行が明確に述べられている。ウガンダでの越境感染 9 件と死亡 1 件も報告されているが、ウガンダ (226074) は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。同様にブルンジ、スーダンも対象国外のため除外。ワクチン不足、接触追跡の低い実施率 (20%)、医療従事者の損失など管理可能性が低い。2018-2020 年の北キブ流行との比較あり。緊急の国際資金援助が要請されている。

article.articleHeadline: 北部爆麻疹群聚！泰國移入病例傳同住友人 匡列491接觸者 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles cluster outbreak in the north! An imported case from Thailand transmitted to a housemate; 491 contacts traced.
article.articleSummary: Measles cluster in northern Taiwan: on June 2, 2026, a second local case, a man in his 20s, linked to an imported Thai case sharing the same residence; both cases are mild and home-isolated. The cluster now totals two confirmed cases with 491 contacts traced and monitored through June 16. The imported index case is a foreign female in her 30s who arrived in mid-May and developed fever, cough, rhinorrhea, and rash, with laboratory confirmation; the housemate subsequently became ill and was confirmed. Taiwan’s total measles cases this year reach 11 (ages under 1 to over 50): 3 domestic and 8 imported from Vietnam, Malaysia, the United States, India, Indonesia, Kyrgyzstan, Japan, and Thailand. Globally, Japan records 511 cases this year, with Tokyo, Kanagawa, and Saitama most affected; Southeast Asia continues to report cases and export to other countries. Health authorities urge strict adherence to the Measles Contact Health Monitoring Notice; non-compliance may incur penalties, and clinicians should assess TOCC (travel, occupation, contact, clustering).

triage.headline_ja: 北部で麻疹の群発発生！タイ輸入例が同居人に伝播 491人の接触者を特定 - 民視新聞網
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2項目以上該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当（異常/予想外、流行性、長期曝露）。対象国内での複数国からの輸入症例による国内感染確認は地域的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 台湾での麻疹群発イベントが報告されているが、台湾は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。記事サマリーに明記されている輸入元国（ベトナム、マレーシア、米国、インド、インドネシア、キルギスタン、日本、タイ）のうち、対象国に該当するのはベトナム、インドネシア、タイ、インドである。日本での麻疹流行状況も記載されているが、発生地は東京都で、記事の主題は台湾での輸入症例による群発であるため、地理的検証の観点からは対象国リスト外の日本は除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Кина испраќа медицински експерти во Конго поради епидемијата на ебола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China sends medical experts to Congo due to the Ebola epidemic.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak continues in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, with the WHO declaring a public health emergency. China has dispatched a medical team to the DRC to assist in prevention, treatment, training of health workers, and supporting Chinese institutions there. The team left Beijing this morning and will work with existing Chinese personnel in Congo and with local health services. The Chinese team in Congo has activated emergency measures, including additional staff training, preparedness drills, and coordination of medical supplies, while continuing to provide health services to locals and Chinese citizens. According to WHO data published on Friday, at least 134 confirmed cases have been reported in Congo and Uganda, with 18 deaths among confirmed cases; over 1,000 suspected cases have been registered since the outbreak was declared on May 15. Eastern Congo hotspot: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu. Outbreak caused by Bundibugyo strain.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、エボラ流行を理由にコンゴに医療専門家を派遣
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言、確認症例134例以上、死亡18例、WHO通知基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴのエボラ発生を主題とし、中国からの医療支援派遣について報じている。発生地域にウガンダが記載されているが、記事サマリーの主焦点はコンゴおよび中国の対応。北キブ・南キブ・イトゥリ州での流行継続。Bundibugyo株が原因とされている。

article.articleHeadline: เกาะติดไวรัส พ.ค. พบผู้ติดเชื้อ โควิด-ไข้หวัดใหญ่ เพิ่ม
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Virus Watch May: COVID-19 and influenza infections rise.
article.articleSummary: May 2026 data from Vichaiyut Hospital, Thailand, show rising COVID-19 and influenza infections. In May 2026, COVID-19 cases reached 19 and influenza 49. Other tracked viruses were less common: rhinovirus 6 cases; human metapneumovirus (hMPV) 5; respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) 1. Dengue virus was detected in 3 cases; norovirus and rotavirus caused severe gastroenteritis in 2 cases each. The update notes concurrent increases in COVID-19 and influenza, with lower levels of the other respiratory viruses. Health authorities urge influenza vaccination covering strains recently introduced to Thailand. The report was posted by a respiratory physician at Vichaiyut Hospital, and follow-up surveillance data will be reported next month.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルス監視5月：COVID-19とインフルエンザ感染が増加
