triage.triage_reason: タイの単一病院からの月間監視データであり、複数の呼吸器ウイルスの同時検出が報告されているが、公衆衛生的な深刻性や国際的拡大リスクを示唆する情報が限定的。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 単一病院（Vichaiyut Hospital）の月間ウイルス検査結果に基づく報告。COVID-19（19例）とインフルエンザ（49例）の同時増加が注目されているが、地域全体または国全体の流行状況を示すものではない。複数のウイルスが同時に検出されているため、監視継続が必要だが、現段階ではシグナルピックアップの基準には達していない。

article.articleHeadline: Mientras el ébola se expande por África, Brasil descarta casos y Paraguay se pone en alerta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: As Ebola spreads across Africa, Brazil rules out cases and Paraguay is on alert.
article.articleSummary: Two suspected Ebola cases in Brazil were ruled out. In São Paulo, a 37-year-old man with meningitis had fever and hemorrhagic symptoms; he had been in the Democratic Republic of the Congo but did not travel to high-risk areas and tested negative for Ebola after evaluation in São Paulo. In Rio de Janeiro, a man arriving from Uganda on May 22 presented with fever, cough and diarrhea; he was diagnosed with malaria and Ebola testing was negative. Brazilian health authorities say the risk of transmission in Brazil and South America remains low. The WHO declared a PHEIC on May 17 due to Bundibugyo Ebola in the DRC and Uganda, with more than 1,100 suspected cases and about 250 deaths; no vaccine or specific treatment exists for this variant. Paraguay tightened border surveillance, requiring advance notification for travelers from risk zones (DRC, Uganda) and a 21-day monitoring period; no cases detected in Paraguay.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がアフリカで拡大する一方、ブラジルは患者を否定し、パラグアイは警戒態勢に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。WHOがPHEIC宣言済みのBundibugyo型エボラ出血熱であり、DRC・ウガンダでの感染確認と1,100件以上の疑似患者、250人近い死亡が報告されている。南米での侵入リスク評価と国境管理強化が進行中。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、DRC・ウガンダでのエボラ出血熱流行（WHOがPHEIC宣言、Bundibugyo型、1,100件以上の疑似患者、250人近い死亡）が主題。ブラジルでの疑似患者は検査で陰定であり、パラグアイは警戒強化段階。対象国リストではDRC（203312）とBrazil（3469034）のみが該当するため verified_locations に含めた。ウガンダは対象国リストに未含。記事配信日時は2026年6月であり、現在時点より約18ヶ月先の仮想シナリオと考えられるが、評価対象として処理した。

article.articleHeadline: 时隔12年，我国更新埃博拉病毒诊疗方案：存在气溶胶传播风险 -- 新京报
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After 12 years, China updates its Ebola virus diagnostic and treatment protocol: risk of aerosol transmission.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo Ebola outbreak persists with over 260 confirmed cases across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu; about 900 samples tested and 142 patients in treatment centers; lab result turnaround now 48 hours. Outside Africa, suspected cases in Italy's Lombardy, Province of Como: two Ugandan returnees, a ~30-year-old man and a 33-year-old woman, presenting fever and GI symptoms shortly after return. In Austria's Upper Austria, a 5/25 returnee from Uganda with suspected infection. In Brazil's Sao Paulo, a 37-year-old man who arrived from Congo is under investigation; if confirmed, Brazil's first case. WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. China dispatched its first batch of Ebola-expert teams to DRC on 2026-06-02 and updated its Ebola diagnostic and treatment protocol (2026 edition), noting potential aerosol transmission risk but no confirmed airborne spread; no domestic or imported cases in China.

triage.headline_ja: 12年を経て、中国がエボラウイルス診断・治療方案を更新：エアロゾル伝播のリスク存在
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、複数国での異常なシグナル、国際的拡大リスク、WHOによるPHEIC宣言済み）。DRCでの継続的なエボラ流行、アフリカ外での複数の疑似症例確認により、国際的影響が顕著。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが報告した地域にはイタリア、オーストリア、ウガンダが含まれているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。DRCでの継続的流行（260+ 確認症例）、アフリカ外での複数の疑似症例（イタリア、オーストリア、ブラジル）、WHO PHEIC宣言済み（2026-05-17）。中国も診断・治療方案を更新するなど、国際的対応の強化が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: 國內爆麻疹群聚！30多歲女泰國入境確診 北部20多歲男同住被傳染
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nationwide measles cluster outbreak! A woman in her 30s who arrived from Thailand was diagnosed with measles; in the north, a man in his 20s who lived with her was infected.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan's CDC reports 1 imported measles case sparking a cluster. The index case is a foreign woman in her 30s who visited Taiwan in mid-May; three days after arrival she developed fever, cough, and rash, self-medicated, then sought emergency care on day four, where measles was diagnosed and she was isolated. A second case, a man in his 20s, developed cough, rash, and fever and was confirmed; he is a household contact. A total of 491 contacts have been traced by June 16. Taiwan has 11 measles cases (ages under 1 to over 50): 3 domestic, 8 imported, from Vietnam, Malaysia, United States, India, Indonesia, Kyrgyzstan, Japan, and Thailand. Japan reports 511 cases; Bangladesh reports 79,936 cases with 9,049 confirmed and 585 deaths in Dhaka. Vaccination is urged; MMR stock is ample; adults born since 1966 should consider pre-travel vaccination; suspected cases should wear masks and contact health authorities.

triage.headline_ja: 国内で麻疹クラスター発生！30代女性がタイから入国し確診、北部20代男性が同居者として感染
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の多国間での複数事例（台湾・日本・バングラデシュで計数千例以上）、国際的に拡大するリスク高く、IHR基準3つ以上に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも異常/予想外、重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性が該当。
triage.notes: 記事は台湾のCDCレポートが中心であるが、台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。バングラデシュ（記事で79,936例、585死亡と記載）も対象国リストにないため除外。対象国内での発生が確認される：ベトナム、タイ、インドネシア、インド（輸入例としてリスト記載）。日本も発生地域に含まれるが対象国リストにないため除外。麻疹の高感染性、複数国での確認、死亡事例の報告から公衆衛生影響は深刻。

article.articleHeadline: 중국 전문가팀, 콩고민주공화국 파견...에볼라 방역 지원 나서
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chinese expert team dispatched to the Democratic Republic of the Congo to assist Ebola prevention and control.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo prompts China’s National Health Commission to dispatch its first expert team for prevention and control. On June 1, the NHC announced that the first batch of high-level infectious disease prevention and control specialists will depart Beijing for the DRC in the early hours of June 2. The WHO declared the Congo Ebola outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, underscoring international urgency. The Chinese team blends public health, traditional Chinese medicine, and Western medical expertise and will work with an existing Chinese medical support team in the DRC to bolster outbreak response. Initiatives include cooperation with local medical and disease control agencies, training for local staff, Chinese enterprises, and Chinese nationals residing in the DRC, and enhanced vaccination logistics, education, and surveillance. This builds on the 24th Chinese medical support team’s rapid emergency activation aimed at strengthening local capacity.

triage.headline_ja: 中国の専門家チーム、コンゴ民主共和国へ派遣...エボラ防疫支援に乗り出す
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WHO PHEIC宣言済みのエボラ本流発生であり、即座にフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ感染症事象であり、中国からの派遣は対応に関する報道である。Bluedot APIが付与したBeijing/Chinaロケーションは記事の出典地であり、感染症イベント発生地ではないため除外。DRC（id:203312）のみがverified_locationsに該当する。WHO PHeIC宣言（2026年5月17日）も記事内で言及されており、国際的な公衆衛生上の重大事象。

article.articleHeadline: Top 5 Stories Of The Day | NCDC says Nigeria Is Not Fully Ready For An Ebola Outbreak | YNaija
article.articleSummary: Nigeria's Ebola preparedness stands at about 59% readiness, per Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention Director-General Jide Idris. Speaking on Arise TV, Idris warned that the country remains vulnerable to an Ebola outbreak as Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo report new cases, raising cross-border transmission risk into Nigeria. Despite improvements, significant gaps persist in Nigeria's health emergency response system, with factors such as international travel, population movement, and weaknesses at entry borders contributing to importation risk. Authorities are actively strengthening surveillance and response capabilities across the country while continuously assessing and closing readiness gaps. The warning underscores the need for sustained investments in border screening, case detection, and rapid containment to prevent importation and spread of Ebola as of 2026-06-02.

triage.headline_ja: 本日のトップ5ニュース | ナイジェリア疾病管理予防センターがエボラウイルス感染症の流行に完全には対応できていないと発表 | YNaija
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。ウガンダとDRCからのエボラ新規症例報告と、ナイジェリアへの越境感染リスクが明記されており、複数国への拡大傾向を示す。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、ウガンダとDRCで新規エボラ症例が報告されており、ナイジェリアへの越境感染リスクが具体的に言及されている。ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。対象国リストから該当するのはDRC（203312）のみ。ただしサマリーではナイジェリアが主要な懸念国として扱われており、西アフリカ地域全体のエボラリスク評価として注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Китай направит группу медицинских экспертов в Демократическую Республику Конго для оказания помощи в борьбе с лихорадкой Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China will send a group of medical experts to the Democratic Republic of the Congo to assist in the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: On 2 June 2026, China announced the departure of a group of highly skilled medical experts from Beijing to the Democratic Republic of Congo to assist local authorities in fighting Ebola, following the World Health Organization’s 17 May declaration of the outbreak as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The specialists will join the 24th Chinese medical team already in the DRC, enhancing collaboration with local medical and anti-epidemic institutions to contain Ebola. They will conduct training in prevention and treatment for local health facilities, the Chinese embassy, Chinese enterprises, and Chinese citizens. The move underscores China’s commitment to international cooperation in outbreak response. Since the outbreak began, the 24th Chinese medical team in the DRC has implemented emergency measures, created a prevention and control system, conducted training and drills, coordinated supplies, and improved living conditions for team members to protect locals and Chinese nationals alike.

triage.headline_ja: 中国がエボラ出血熱対策支援のため医療専門家グループをコンゴ民主共和国に派遣
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。既にWHOがPHEIC宣言しており、複数国にまたがるエボラ流行事象として高リスク。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱はハイコンセクエンス感染症。WHO PHEIC宣言済み（2026年5月17日）。記事はDRCでの流行と中国の国際支援協力を主題としており、両国共にシグナル対象。北京への言及は医療専門家の派遣地点であり、新規発生地ではないため当該国家レベルのみカウント。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief ends DR Congo visit as group warns Ebola likely spread undetected
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-02, Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo persists, with WHO Chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus ending a visit after briefing President Félix Tshisekedi in Kinshasa. An aid group warned the outbreak is likely larger than official counts, with about four-fifths of virus contacts untraced. The outbreak is the third-largest on record and has persisted for weeks largely undetected, leaving health officials behind in control efforts. In Ituri province, where the first cases were confirmed, Tedros urged greater international support to stop spread and to ramp up testing and treatment capacity while building trust in health workers. Five recoveries were noted during the visit. He emphasized strengthening health-system capacity and noted community ownership and strong government leadership as crucial to stopping Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴ民主共和国訪問を終了、支援団体がエボラ感染がより広く蔓延している可能性を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響（過去3番目の規模の流行）、異常性（接触者の約80%が追跡不能）、国際的拡大リスク、国際支援の緊急性が全て確認される。
triage.notes: 現在進行中の大規模エボラ流行。公式統計を大きく上回る感染が警告されており、数週間検出されないままの状態が続いている。WHO事務局長の現地訪問と大統領への直接的な関与は、状況の深刻性と国際的な関心の高さを示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: India issues fresh advisory amid Ebola scare: 'Isolate if travelled through affected country'
article.articleSummary: India issues a fresh Ebola advisory: no confirmed cases in the country. Anyone who has travelled from or transited through an Ebola-affected country in the last 21 days and develops fever, headache, muscle pain, vomiting, diarrhoea, or unexplained bleeding should isolate and inform local health authorities. Helpline 1075 is available. The alert follows travel advisories listing the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan. The government urges citizens not to panic and to rely on official Health Department information; a suspected Ebola case from Congo tested negative. The WHO notes Ebola has not reached pandemic emergency criteria, though border regions with DR Congo face higher risk. Congo reopened the main airport in the eastern province hardest hit after tentative signs the outbreak may be slowing; contact tracing and investigation of exposed individuals continue.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ恐怖の中、インドが新たな勧告を発出：「影響を受けた国を経由して渡航した場合は隔離を」
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は極めて高い死亡率を持つ指定感染症であり、DRC・ウガンダ・南スーダンでの発生は国際的な懸念事項。インドを含む複数国が勧告を発出している点で異常・予想外性が高く、IHR基準2項目以上、WPROスクリーニング基準複数項目に該当。フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウガンダと南スーダンも含まれているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。サマリーによればインドでは確認症例なく勧告は予防的性質だが、DRCでのエボラ発生が主題。WHOでのパンデミック緊急基準未達成との記述はあるが、国境地域での高リスク評価がされている。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع إصابات إيبولا بالكونغو لـ321 .. وسباق مع الزمن لإنتاج لقاح ضد السلالة القاتلة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rise to 321, as a race against time to develop a vaccine against the deadly strain
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 321 confirmed cases with 48 deaths, spanning three provinces, with the outbreak also affecting Uganda. There is currently no licensed vaccine or treatment for the Bundibugyo strain driving this outbreak. The World Health Organization notes the closest vaccine is a single-dose rVSV-based candidate, developed under the International AIDS Vaccine Initiative framework and leveraging the Ervebo platform. A collaboration between IAVI and the University of Texas Medical Branch is advancing this vaccine. Primarily animal studies in 2013 showed protection against Bundibugyο, but progress stalled due to limited pharmaceutical interest. WHO estimates it may take seven to nine months before a human-trial-ready rVSV vaccine for Bundibugyo, with Serum Institute of India potentially initiating trials within two to three months. A Moderna mRNA vaccine candidate, funded by CEPI, is also in development.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ患者数が321人に増加、致命的な変異株に対するワクチン開発が急務
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、国境を越えた拡大リスク（ウガンダへの波及確認）、ワクチン不在による管理困難性を示す。
triage.notes: サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国が主要な発生地で321確定例・48死亡を報告。ウガンダへの波及も明記されているが、対象国リストに該当しないため除外。インドはSerum Institute of Indiaがワクチル臨床試験を進める開発パートナーとして関与。Bundibugyo株による未制御の流行であり、ワクチン不在が重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Ударно се разработват 3 ваксини за ебола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three Ebola vaccines are being developed rapidly.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-02, CEPI will accelerate development of three experimental vaccines against Bundibugyo virus to counter the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. The three candidates, labeled by WHO as the most promising, are Moderna’s mRNA vaccine, an Oxford University–Serum Institute of India collaboration, and IAIVI’s rVSV-based vaccine (the latter building on the platform used for a Zaire ebolavirus vaccine). Serum Institute of India will manufacture the vaccines. CEPI has allocated up to $50 million for preclinical and Phase 1 work on Moderna’s vaccine; up to $8.6 million for the Oxford/SII program; and up to $3.2 million for IAIVI’s candidate. Leaders including CEPI CEO Dr. Richard Hatchett, WHO Director-General Dr. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, and Africa CDC Director Dr. Jean Kasaya describe the investment as critical for outbreak control and future readiness.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスに対する3つのワクチンが急速に開発されている
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクの全4基準に該当する極めて重大な感染症であり、DRCおよびウガンダでの現在の流行に対するワクチン開発の国際的な対応が報告されている。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIで列挙されたRepublic of Uganda (226074) はIHR対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。記事サマリーではDRC、ウガンダでの流行、インドのSerum Institute of Indiaによるワクチン製造が言及されており、DRCとIndiaのみが対象国として該当。エボラウイルスの重大性とCEPI、WHO、Africa CDCによる国際的対応の報告により、ピックアップの判定は確定的。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola patient zero identified as outbreak thought to have been 'spreading unchecked' for months
article.articleSummary: DRC's Bundibugyo virus Ebola outbreak in Ituri Province (Bunia) has 282 laboratory-confirmed cases and more than 1,000 suspected cases, with the death toll nearing 250. It is the third-largest Ebola outbreak on record. A patient zero may date to January in Rwampara, eastern DRC, infecting eight health workers before dying in February. The WHO had earlier cited a Bunia health worker as index case with symptoms on 25 April; the Congolese health ministry confirmed the index on 15 May. Bundibugyo virus has no approved treatment or vaccine. Symptoms include fever, fatigue and headache. Containment challenges include early detection, rapid isolation, contact tracing, safe burials, and stronger infection prevention in facilities. By 31 May, five had recovered; four were to be discharged on 31 May and one had been discharged the day before yesterday, with a new treatment centre opened in Bunia. A traveler from Uganda to Austria was isolated for possible export risk.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者第1号が特定、数ヶ月間『チェックされずに広がっている』と考えられている感染症
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。第3規模のエボラ最大級アウトブレイクで、死亡者250近く、確定例282件、疑い例1000件超。ウガンダからオーストリアへの旅行者による国際的な拡散リスクが確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国のイトゥリ州(ブニア)でのブンディブギョウイルスエボラアウトブレイクが主題。ルワンダのキガリに言及があるが、実際の流行発生地はDRCのみ。オーストリアへの旅行者の隔離は輸出リスク管理であり、発生地ではない。ウガンダからの報告もDRC内での広がりの文脈。検証対象国はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: 快新聞／麻疹爆群聚感染！外國友人來台旅遊「傳染20歲男子」　疾管署匡列491人 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Breaking News / Measles outbreak with clustered infections! Foreign visitors to Taiwan on a trip “infected a 20-year-old man” — Taiwan CDC traces 491 people.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in Taiwan involves a cluster traced to a foreign traveler. The index case is a foreign woman in her 30s who arrived in mid-May 2026 and developed fever, cough, rhinitis, and a rash within 3 days; laboratory-confirmed measles. A Northern Taiwan resident in his 20s, who shared accommodation with her, later developed cough, fever, and rash and was also diagnosed with measles. Taiwan CDC has traced 491 contacts under health monitoring, with monitoring extending to June 16, 2026. Year-to-date, Taiwan reports 11 measles cases (ages from under 1 to 50s): 3 domestic, 8 imported, with infection sources in Vietnam, Malaysia, United States, India, Indonesia, Kyrgyzstan, Japan, and Thailand (one each). Public health guidance emphasizes airborne transmission prevention; noncompliance can incur fines of 60,000–300,000 TWD. Vaccination remains the best defense; free national MMR stock is available, and those born 1966 or later traveling to measles-endemic regions should consider pre-travel MMR boosters 2–4 weeks before departure. For information, contact 1922 or 0800-001922.

triage.headline_ja: 速報：麻疹の集団発生！外国人旅行者が台湾来訪で「20歳男性に感染」　疾病管制局が491人を追跡調査
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹は国際的に懸念される感染症であり、複数国からの輸入症例と現地での二次感染が確認されている。台湾での集団発生は異常かつ予想外であり、491人の接触者追跡が行われており、対象国（ベトナム、インドネシア、タイ、インド）での流行源がある。
triage.notes: 台湾での麻疹集団発生であるが、台湾は対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsには記事で明示された感染源国のみを列挙した（ベトナム、インドネシア、タイ、インド）。麻疹は高度に伝播しやすく、ワクチン接種率が低い集団での流行リスク有り。WPRO基準5項目すべてに該当し、IHR基準3項目に該当するためPICKUP判定。

article.articleHeadline: 5 patients recover from Ebola in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola caused by the Bundibugyo strain is circulating in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with 282 confirmed cases and 42 deaths as of 2026-06-02. In Bunia, capital of Ituri province, four nurses treated for Bundibugyo Ebola have been discharged after recovery, and a laboratory worker had recovered earlier this week, bringing total recoveries to five. The outbreak response is intensifying, and early diagnosis with access to care is driving ongoing recoveries. Suspected cases tied to travel to affected nations are under investigation in Brazil and Italy. The World Health Organization had earlier this month declared this Bundibugyo outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, though it does not meet the criteria of a pandemic emergency. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus stressed that, while there is no licensed vaccine or treatment, survival is possible with good medical care during a visit to Bunia.

triage.headline_ja: DR コンゴでエボラから 5 人の患者が回復
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当し、WHOが公衆衛生上の国際的懸念事項（PHEIC）宣言済みの現行エボラ流行。複数国での疑い事例と国際的な拡大リスクが確認されている。
triage.notes: Bluedot API がブラジルとイタリアを発生地域に含めているが、記事サマリーでは両国は疑い事例の調査地点のみ。実際の流行はDRC（Ituri州 Bunia）に限定される。WHOが PHEIC 宣言済みで、ブンディブギョ株による282確定例、42死亡。対象国リストに DRC が含まれるため PICKUP。

article.articleHeadline: 腸病毒今年已釀1死　疾管署示警：疫情持續升溫
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Enteroviruses have caused one death this year; Taiwan CDC warns that the outbreak is continuing to rise.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan’s CDC reports rising enterovirus activity. In Week 21 (May 24–30, 2026), outpatient and emergency visits reached 5,573, up 8.2% from 5,153. Community enteroviruses are dominated by Coxsackievirus A6, followed by A4 and D68. Year-to-date there have been four severe enterovirus infections, including one death: D68 (2 cases) and Coxsackie A4 and A16 (1 each). Nearby countries show increasing outbreaks: Vietnam has over 34,400 EV71 cases by April; China tops 200,000 by mid-May (mainly A16); Thailand 12,542; and Japan, Korea, Hong Kong also rising. Public health measures emphasize hygiene and disinfection in crowded settings such as schools, daycare centers, and indoor play areas; stay-at-home if sick. The under-5 age group is highest risk; look for lethargy, altered consciousness, weakness, tremors, persistent vomiting, rapid breathing or tachycardia, and seek hospital care. For guidance, contact 1922.

triage.headline_ja: 腸病毒今年已釀1死　疾管署示警：疫情持續升溫
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）、WPRO基準複数該当（異常性、重症度、流行性、長期曝露）。複数対象国での多発情報と死亡報告があり、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはTaiwan（対象国外）での発生を主題としているが、サマリー内でVietnam、China、Thairandの複数地域での大規模発生が明記されており、これらは対象国である。Vietnam 34,400+、China 200,000+、Thailand 12,542の症例報告がある。5歳以下の高リスク層への影響も指摘されている。Hong Kong は China に含める。

article.articleHeadline: 國內爆麻疹群聚！匡列接觸者491人
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nationwide measles cluster outbreak! 491 contacts traced.
article.articleSummary: Measles cluster outbreak in Taiwan is ongoing. On June 2, 2026, Taiwan CDC reported one new imported case triggering domestic transmission, with 491 contacts traced by June 16. The index case is a foreign national woman in her 30s who arrived in mid-May; she developed fever, rash, and cough three days after arrival, self-medicated, then sought emergency care and was diagnosed with measles. Case 2, a male in his 20s living with the index case in northern Taiwan, was later confirmed as a domestic transmission. Taiwan has 11 measles cases this year: 3 domestic, 8 imported from Vietnam, Malaysia, the United States, India, Indonesia, Kyrgyzstan, Japan, and Thailand. Globally, Japan reports 511 cases this year; Bangladesh has an escalating outbreak since March with about 79,936 cases and 9,049 confirmed (585 deaths), and Southeast Asia continues to report cases and exports. Public health measures emphasize vaccination (MMR stock is sufficient), health monitoring for contacts, masking for suspected cases, and pre-travel vaccination advice for adults born after 1966 (2–4 weeks before travel).

triage.headline_ja: 国内で麻疹群発感染！濃厚接触者491人
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の国際的な多地域発生に伴い、対象国（台湾=中国、ベトナム、インドネシア、タイ、インド）での群発感染が確認されており、IHR基準（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）の複数該当とWPRO基準（異常性、流行性、管理性）の複数該当が認められる。公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 台湾の麻疹群発感染が主題。バングラデシュは記事で言及される地域であるが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。マレーシア、日本、キルギス、米国も発生地域として記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。複数の対象国（ベトナム、マレーシア、米国、インド、インドネシア、キルギス、日本、タイ）からの輸入症例が確認されており、WPRO地域での広域的な麻疹流行の懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: El objetivo prioritario es detener el ébola y evitar que los sistemas de salud colapsen a su alrededor
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The top priority is to stop Ebola and prevent health systems in the surrounding area from collapsing.
article.articleSummary: Ebola remains the top priority in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where 1,077 suspected cases and 246 associated deaths mark one of the largest outbreaks on record. The immediate goal is to prevent a regional health-system collapse that would devastate care for malaria, HIV, tuberculosis and other diseases. The 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak showed that malaria deaths can rise when services are disrupted; CDC estimated a 50% drop in access worsened malaria, HIV and TB mortality. DR Congo bears the world’s second-largest malaria burden: 35.1 million cases and 24,880 deaths in 2024. If health systems collapse, maternal health services, immunizations and routine care would falter, risking measles and other preventable diseases. Ebola’s epicenters are Ituri and North Kivu, with cross-border movement to Rwanda, Burundi, Tanzania, South Sudan and Uganda (which has closed its border). Cholera and mpox are also surging: 2026 cholera 25,418 suspected cases/726 deaths (12/26 provinces); 2025 cholera 71,646 cases/2,028 deaths; mpox 2026 1,036 cases/1 death (2025: >21,000 cases/~100 deaths); measles 2026 71,023 cases/683 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 最優先課題はエボラを阻止し、周囲の保健システムが崩壊するのを防ぐこと
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な影響、予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。複数の高危険疾患（エボラ、コレラ、mpox）が同時発生し、地域的な保健システム崩壊のリスクが高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はDRC（Ituri州およびNorth Kivu州）でのエボラ流行であり、これが地域的な保健システム崩壊をもたらすリスクを論じている。隣接国（Rwanda、Burundi、Tanzania、South Sudan、Uganda）への越境感染リスクが言及されているが、これらの国での実際の流行状況の詳細は不明なため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含める。複数の疾患（エボラ、コレラ、mpox、麻疹、マラリア、HIV、TB）が記載されているが、これらはすべてDRCおよび周辺地域における同時危機の文脈である。

article.articleHeadline: 國內爆麻疹群聚！匡列接觸者491人 - 生活新聞 - PChome Online 新聞
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Domestic measles cluster outbreak! 491 contacts traced.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports a domestic measles cluster linked to an imported case. In mid-May, a foreign woman in her 30s visiting Taiwan developed fever, cough, and rash three days after arrival; she sought emergency care, was diagnosed with measles, and isolated at home. Lab confirmation classified it as imported. A cohabiting northern Taiwan male in his 20s was later diagnosed; by June 16, 491 contacts have been traced. Taiwan records 11 measles cases this year: 3 domestically acquired and 8 imported, with import origins from Vietnam, Malaysia, the United States, India, Indonesia, Kyrgyzstan, Japan, and Thailand. Measles is highly contagious via airborne transmission. Authorities urge strict health monitoring for contacts, mask use for suspected cases, and prompt medical evaluation; noncompliance may incur fines (NT$60,000–NT$300,000). Vaccination remains the best prevention; public stocks of MMR are sufficient. Adults born since 1966 planning travel should consult pre-travel MMR vaccination 2–4 weeks prior."

triage.headline_ja: 国内麻疹クラスター発生！接触者491人を追跡
triage.triage_reason: 台湾での麻疹クラスター（国内感染3例を含む11例）はIHR基準2つ以上に該当し、国内での持続的な感染リスクと国際的な輸入ケース複数が確認されている。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは台湾での麻疹クラスターを主題としているが、台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsには記事で言及されている対象国（ベトナム、インドネシア、タイ、インド）のみを列挙した。麻疹の輸入元として複数国が関連している点、国内での持続的な感染、高い感染力、および491人の接触者追跡がスクリーニング基準全5項目に該当する。

article.articleHeadline: 國內爆麻疹群聚！ 北部20多歲男遭同住者傳染 緊急匡列491人
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Domestic measles cluster outbreak! A man in his twenties in the north infected by a housemate; 491 people quarantined.
article.articleSummary: Measles cluster outbreak in Taiwan: a man in his 20s in northern Taiwan developed illness on May 26, linked to a previously reported 30-something imported case from Thailand, forming a domestic cluster. The outbreak prompted 491 contacts to be traced and monitored through June 16. Totals this year in Taiwan reach 11 measles cases, with 3 domestic infections (all cluster-related) and 8 imported from Vietnam, Malaysia, the United States, India, Indonesia, Kyrgyzstan, Japan, and Thailand. Globally, measles activity remains high; Japan reports 498 cases this year, concentrated in Tokyo, Kanagawa, and Saitama, while Bangladesh's Dhaka region reports about 79,936 cases and 585 deaths since March. The CDC warns airborne transmission and urges contacts to follow monitoring notices, seek care for symptoms, and comply with public health measures; vaccination with the MMR vaccine remains the most effective prevention, and domestic stock is adequate.

triage.headline_ja: 国内麻疹集団発生！北部20代男性が同居者から感染、緊急対応で491人濃厚接触者隔離
triage.triage_reason: 台湾での麻疹集団発生であり、国際的リンク（タイからの輸入症例）、急速な感染拡大（491人の接触者追跡）、および空気感染の警告により、IHR基準2つ以上に該当。
triage.notes: 台湾での麻疹集団発生が主題。記事では台湾の状況が中心だが、台湾は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には台湾を含めない。ただし、タイからの輸入症例がトリガーとなり、ベトナム、マレーシア、米国、インド、インドネシア、キルギスタン、日本、タイからの輸入症例が報告されている。対象国リスト内では、タイ、ベトナム、インドネシア、インドが該当する。なお、バングラデシュのダッカでの大規模麻疹流行（79,936症例、585死亡）についても言及されているが、バングラデシュは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 腸病毒今年已釀1死 疾管署示警：疫情持續升溫
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Enteroviruses have caused one death this year; Taiwan CDC warns: the outbreak continues to rise.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan’s CDC reports the domestic enterovirus outbreak is rising. In week 21 (May 24–30) 5,573 clinic/ED visits were recorded, up 8.2% from the prior week. Community activity is dominated by Coxsackievirus A6, with Coxsackie A4 and D68 also common. This year four laboratory-confirmed severe enterovirus cases occurred, including one death: two D68, one Coxsackie A4, and one Coxsackie A16. Nearby regions report rising activity: Vietnam has over 34,400 EV71 cases by April with severe disease and deaths; China exceeds 200,000 cases by mid-May, mainly A16; Thailand has 12,542 cases; Japan, Korea, and Hong Kong are also increasing. Public health advice stresses handwashing, environmental disinfection, and avoiding crowded places; keep sick children home. High-risk group: children under 5. Seek hospital care for warning signs such as drowsiness, limb weakness, or persistent vomiting. For guidance, call 1922 or 0800-001922; bleach disinfection guidelines are provided.

triage.headline_ja: 腸病毒今年已釀1死 疾管署示警：疫情持續升溫
triage.triage_reason: Enterovirus 71を含む腸病毒の地域的な流行拡大が複数国で確認されており、IHR基準（異常性、国際拡大リスク）2つ以上に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度（死亡例あり）、流行しやすさ、管理可能性で複数項目該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはタイワン、日本、韓国、香港も含まれるが、対象国リストに該当しないため verified_locations には含めていない。ベトナム・中国・タイは対象国であり、記事サマリーでも「nearby regions」として明示的に流行が報告されているため対象に含めた。Enterovirus 71は手足口病（HFMD）と関連し、小児における重症疾患の可能性があり、WPROでの流行は公衆衛生上の重要な関心事である。

article.articleHeadline: 國內爆麻疹群聚！外籍女來台旅遊確診、同住友人也中鏢 匡列接觸491人
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Domestic measles cluster outbreak! Foreign woman visiting Taiwan diagnosed; a housemate also infected; 491 contacts traced.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports a domestic measles cluster linked to an imported case from Thailand. A Thai woman in her 30s who visited Taiwan in mid-May developed fever, cough, runny nose, and rash after three days and was confirmed; her northern Taiwan housemate (20s) later contracted measles. Together, two domestic cases and 491 contacts are under health monitoring through June 16. Taiwan has 11 measles cases this year (3 domestic, 8 imported from Vietnam, Malaysia, the United States, India, Indonesia, Kyrgyzstan, Japan, and Thailand). Globally, Japan has 511 cases this year, Bangladesh’s Dhaka region reports 70,936 cases and 585 deaths. Public health measures emphasize airborne transmission, mandatory contact monitoring, fines up to NT$300,000 for noncompliance, and vaccination: free MMR stock and advising travelers born since 1966 to consider MMR 2–4 weeks before travel.

triage.headline_ja: 台湾で麻疹クラスター発生！タイから来台した外国人女性が確診、同居友人も感染 接触者491人に対応
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で異常性（予想外のクラスター発生）と国際的拡大リスク（輸入症例からの国内波及）が明確に認められ、WPROスクリーニング基準では重症度と流行可能性（ヒト-ヒト感染）が確認され、さらに社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: Taiwan（台湾）は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。ただし記事の主要な発生地はTaiwanであり、輸入元がThailand、Vietnam、Malaysiaなど複数国に及ぶ。Bangladesh Dhaka regionの70,936例は参考値だが、対象国リストにはBangladeshが含まれていないため除外。Japan、Kyrgyzstan、United States、Malaysiaも発生地域に含まれるが対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。このイベントはPICKUPレベルの国際的な懸念を示しており、フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Youths protest outside Kenya's Ebola quarantine centre for US citizens
article.articleSummary: On 1 June 2026, hundreds of youths in Nanyuki, Kenya, protested outside the Laikipia Air Base Ebola quarantine centre planned for American citizens exposed to the virus, after the High Court suspended the facility and any arrival of foreign patients pending a hearing by the Law Society of Kenya and a constitutional watchdog. U.S. officials said exposed Americans would be sent to the Kenyan facility rather than flown home, with a 50-bed site slated to be operational by Friday and backed by about $13.5 million for preparedness. Kenya has not recorded Ebola cases; Uganda reports nine and has closed its border with Congo. The Bundibugyo Ebola strain has about 282 confirmed cases and over 1,000 suspected, with no approved treatment or vaccine. Health Minister Aden Duale said the centre would serve everyone; local leaders, including Laikipia Governor Joshua Irungu, opposed, fearing exposure. Protests included anti-Ebola chants.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアのエボラ隔離センター外でアメリカ国民のために抗議活動
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認例は記事対象国（ケニア、ウガンダ）では限定的（ウガンダ9例）であり、ケニアでは発症例なし。ただしBundibugyo株の地域的拡大（282確認例、1,000以上の疑い例）と隔離施設に対する社会的関心が存在するため、経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にNanyuki（ケニア）とLaikipia（ケニア）が含まれているが、これらは隔離施設の計画地であり、実際のエボラ発症地ではない。実際の患者発生はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）とウガンダのみ。ケニアは隔離施設設置による社会的・政治的関心が高い。記事本文情報がないため重症度やヒト-ヒト感染拡大リスクの詳細は不明。

article.articleHeadline: 开封2小时，细菌数量暴涨！很多人天天在喝，有人甚至进急诊...... - 21经济网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Kaifeng, bacterial counts surged within two hours! Many people drink it every day, and some even end up in the emergency department.
article.articleSummary: Rapid bacterial growth in freshly prepared milk tea was reported in Kaifeng, Henan, with some drinkers ending up in emergency departments. Shanghai Consumer Rights Protection Committee tested four milk teas and found significant growth after 2, 4, and 6 hours: one milder variety reached 2.7k, 3.1k, and 6.1k CFU/mL, while others climbed to tens of thousands CFU/mL by 4–6 hours. Unopened samples also exceeded 10k CFU/mL after 2 hours. Detected pathogens included E. coli, Salmonella, Listeria monocytogenes, Staphylococcus aureus, and Bacillus cereus. GB 7101-2022 limits are total plate count ≤10,000 CFU/mL and E. coli ≤10 CFU/mL. Recommendations: finish within 2 hours; if not, refrigerate and cover, or reheat to 70°C for 1–3 minutes; discard after 4 hours or if sensory changes occur. A blogger testing 36 beverages showed E. coli rises and unopened cups harbor high counts, highlighting contamination from air, ingredients, ice, equipment, and mouth contact.

triage.headline_ja: 開封2時間で細菌数が急増！多くの人が毎日飲んでいて、中には救急車で搬送される人も
triage.triage_reason: 食品関連の細菌汚染イベント（複数病原体検出）であり、WPROスクリーニング基準に複数該当するが、公開された情報が限定的で、具体的な患者数・重症度・広がりが明確でない。継続的な情報収集が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は中国の複数地域（開封、上海）での飲料（ミルクティー）に関連した細菌汚染を報道している。複数の食中毒病原体（大腸菌、リステリア菌など）が検出され、一部患者が救急車で搬送されたとされているが、具体的な患者数、確認症例数、感染経路の確度が明記されていない。食品安全上の懸念として関心は高いが、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響の程度や管理可能性についての情報が不足しており、WATCH判定とした。続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: How health workers in DR Congo are treating Ebola and staying safe
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ituri province, centered on Bunia, faces an Ebola outbreak from Bundibugyo virus. There are no approved Bundibugyo-targeted drugs; care is supportive (oxygen, IV fluids, symptom relief). Early symptoms include headache, fever, and malaise; vomiting, abdominal pain, diarrhoea, and bleeding can follow. Isolation of suspected and confirmed cases and PPE for contacts are in place. The Cube, a treatment unit, enables staff to treat remotely and allows family visits. Two Cubes arrived in Bunia over the weekend, with two more en route; PPE supplies are limited amid shortages feared by nurses. Sixteen health workers have contracted Ebola. Authorities report more than 282 confirmed cases and 42 deaths, and over 1,000 suspected cases, with over 220 deaths among the suspected group. The outbreak has spread from Ituri to North and South Kivu and to Uganda. Testing delays complicate mapping; discharge requires two negative results. No approved vaccine; experimental candidates exist.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国の保健労働者がエボラに対応し、安全を確保する方法
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo型）の大規模流行で282確定例、42死亡、1,000以上の疑似症例と高い死亡率、複数州への拡大とウガンダへの越境確認、国際的懸念が明確。
triage.notes: エボラ(Bundibugyo型)の確定例282名、死亡42名、疑似症例1,000名以上、死亡220名以上。Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu各州で拡大確認。ウガンダへの越境感染も報告。保健労働者16名が感染。ワクチン未承認、治療薬なし(supportive care)。検査遅延により正確な把握困難。国際的支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: World News | India Dispatches Second Tranche of Medical Assistance to Strengthen Ebola Response Capacities Across Africa
article.articleSummary: India dispatched the second tranche of 43 tonnes of medical assistance to Africa CDC to bolster Ebola response capacities across Africa amid the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The consignment, delivered through Africa CDC's Eastern Regional Coordinating Centre in Uganda, includes protective gear, diagnostic and monitoring equipment, medicines, and supplements. External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar highlighted that the shipment will strengthen public health preparedness and Ebola response across the African Union. Africa CDC welcomed the aid, noting it supports containment efforts in eastern DRC and commends India’s solidarity. India had previously confirmed the first tranche on May 29 and said it remains in close contact with African health authorities, prepared to deploy additional tranches as the situation evolves.

triage.headline_ja: 世界ニュース | インドがアフリカ全域のエボラ対応能力強化のため医療支援の第2弾を派遣
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当（2基準以上）。DRCでのBundibugyo Ebola outbreak進行中であり、地域的重症度と国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのBundibugyo Ebola outbreakを主題としており、インドが医療支援を派遣している。DRCが実際の発生地域、インドが支援国として確認される。UgandaはAfrica CDCの東部地域調整センター所在地として言及されているが、感染症イベント発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: India Sends 43-ton Ebola Aid Package To Africa CDC - BW Businessworld
article.articleSummary: India dispatched a 43-ton consignment of medical aid to the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention to strengthen Ebola preparedness and response across Africa. The shipment includes protective gear, diagnostic and monitoring equipment, medicines, and nutritional supplements to support healthcare systems responding to the Ebola outbreak and enhance public health readiness. External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar described it as the 'second tranche' of India's medical assistance to the Africa CDC. The aid aims to bolster Ebola response mechanisms across the African Union's member states. The move reflects India's ongoing health and humanitarian engagement with Africa, especially in epidemic response and medical capacity building. In New Delhi, Jaishankar also met South Africa's Deputy President Shipokosa Paulus Mashatile to discuss expanding bilateral cooperation in trade, MSMEs, digital technologies, and infrastructure, underscoring closer coordination between India and South Africa in international forums and broader partnership frameworks like BRICS and the India–Africa partnership.

triage.headline_ja: インド、アフリカにエボラ対策支援物資43トンを送付 CDC
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題はインドからアフリカへの人道支援物資の送付であり、実際のエボラ発生イベントではない。感染症危機管理において、支援物資の配送は動員後の対応段階であり、初期シグナル探知の対象外。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域（New Delhi, India, South Africa）は記事サマリーを注意深く読むと、実際のエボラ発生地ではなく、支援物資の送付元（インド）と外交会談の場所（南アフリカ）を示している。記事サマリーには『アフリカでのエボラ流行』への言及がなく、流行地の具体的な国名も記載されていない。したがって、対象国リストに基づく verified_locations は空配列とする。本記事は感染症イベント報告ではなく、国家間の人道支援・外交ニュースであり、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya's president defends planned U.S.-backed Ebola quarantine facility
article.articleSummary: Kenya’s President William Ruto defended a U.S.-backed Ebola quarantine facility at Laikipia Air Base in Nanyuki, central Kenya, as part of a national preparedness plan and longstanding health partnership with Washington. The facility, approved after a U.S. request, would house Americans who may have been exposed to Ebola and would also serve Kenyans and other foreign partners if needed. A court temporarily suspended the plan amid a lawsuit claiming public-health risks, drawing protests from local residents. Ruto said the site is not unusual and comparable to other Kenyan facilities, noting 23 counties have isolation, surveillance, and treatment capabilities and that border screening ~3,000 people daily has found no Ebola cases in Kenya. Separately, the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda has caused 48 deaths and drawn a WHO public health emergency of international concern.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア大統領、米国支援のエボラ隔離施設計画を擁護
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（高影響度疾患）に関する地域的準備体制の記事だが、ケニアでの実際のエボラ発生報告はなく、DRC・ウガンダのブンディブギョエボラアウトブレイク（WHO国際的懸念の公衆衛生上の緊急事態）については記事の副次的言及のため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアの隔離施設計画（実際の発生ではなく準備体制）であるが、副次的にDRC・ウガンダのブンディブギョエボラアウトブレイク（48死亡、WHO PHEIC認定）が言及されている。ケニアでの実際のエボラ発生は報告されていない（国境スクリーニング3,000人/日でケニアでのエボラ症例なし）。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。IHR基準は2以上で技術的にはPICKUP相当だが、主題がケニアの準備計画で実際の発生イベントではないため、WATCHに判定。DRC/ウガンダのアウトブレイク詳細情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: How Contagious Is Ebola?
article.articleSummary: More than 200 people are suspected to have died in Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda as of May 29, per CDC; the majority of deaths are in the DRC. The World Health Organization declared a public health emergency of international concern on May 17. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain is driving outbreaks in DRC and Uganda; four of six Ebola strains cause disease in humans, with Zaire ebolavirus historically most lethal (up to 90% case fatality without treatment). Transmission occurs via direct contact with blood, secretions, or other bodily fluids, or contaminated surfaces. There is no vaccine for this Bundibugyo strain. Ebola’s basic reproduction number (R0) is about 1.5–2.5, lower than Omicron COVID-19 (8–10) and measles (12–18).

triage.headline_ja: エボラはどのくらい感染力があるのか？
triage.triage_reason: DRCとウガンダで200人以上の死亡が報告され、WHOが国際的懸念事項の公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言しており、IHR基準を複数満たす。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株による新規アウトブレイクであり、シグナル対象として適格。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにはウガンダの言及があるが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを列挙。WHO による国際的懸念事項の公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言済み。Bundibugyo ebolavirus 株はワクチンが存在しないため管理難度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases surpass 300 in Congo as more health zones affected
article.articleSummary: As of 2 June 2026, Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo have surpassed 300, with 48 deaths, according to the Health Ministry. The outbreak now spans 23 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with Ituri alone reporting more than 260 confirmed cases. Community resistance in Bunia and the northeastern town of Nizi, along with rumors and disinformation, is hindering response efforts. Four patients recovered and were discharged from the Evangelical Medical Center in Bunia. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus concluded a visit to discuss the Bundibugyo-strain Ebola outbreak, amid vaccination trials and the opening of a new 60-bed treatment center in Bunia. Authorities installed monitoring devices at Bunia Airport, which reopened to humanitarian flights to support the response. The latest outbreak was declared on 15 May.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱患者がコンゴで300人を超え、さらに多くの保健地区が影響を受ける
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱の急速な拡大（300超の患者、23保健地区に拡大、死亡48人）は重大な公衆衛生影響、異常事態、国際的拡大リスク、および渡航・貿易制限のリスクを呈している。フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスのアウトブレイク。2026年6月2日時点で300超の確定患者と48人の死亡。複数州（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）で23保健地区に拡大。コミュニティ抵抗と誤報が対応を阻害。WHO事務局長が現地訪問。新設された60床の治療センターと空港監視体制の強化によるWHOと当局の対応の実施が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: 防堵伊波拉病毒！4國人自「剛、烏2國」返台　1人發燒檢驗結果曝
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prevent Ebola virus! Four people return to Taiwan from Congo and Uganda; one person with fever—test results revealed.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan's CDC on June 2 announced a 90-day entry suspension for residents from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda to prevent Ebola virus importation. This follows May 27 guidance requiring travelers from these countries to report at quarantine stations and undergo 21 days of self-health management. Four Taiwanese nationals who returned from the two countries—two from Uganda and two from DRC—are under self-health management, with daily health reporting including twice-daily temperatures and symptom checks. One returnee, who arrived May 27, developed a mild fever the next day but tested Ebola virus negative. Authorities note the rainy seasons in Uganda and DRC with malaria and respiratory infections common, and that this case appears linked to local endemic diseases rather than Ebola. No imported Ebola cases have been reported.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対策で台湾が4か国から帰国者を検査！コンゴ・ウガンダからの帰国者に発熱者、検査結果判明
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの国際的な輸入リスク対策が主題だが、検査結果は陰性で実際の感染確認なし。台湾はスクリーニング対象国に含まれないため verified_locations は DRC のみ。情報不足のため WATCH 段階で継続監視が適切。
triage.notes: Bluedot API の発生地域には Taiwan も含まれているが、記事サマリーでは Taiwan は対象国リスト外であり、実際のエボラ発生地は DRC と Uganda である。DRC は対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。一度の陰性検査結果のため深刻性は低いが、DRC/Uganda の継続的エボラリスク監視の重要性、および輸入ケース防止対応の取り組みから WATCH 判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Готовится срочная эвакуация из-за смертельной болезни: причиной стал новый штамм вируса
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An emergency evacuation is being prepared due to a deadly disease: the cause was a new strain of the virus.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 June 2026, Ebola hemorrhagic fever caused by Ebolavirus triggers an emergency evacuation plan for Russians in the Central African Republic (CAR) due to a poorly studied Bundibugyo variant. The CAR Russian community is up to 200 people; in Kenya, about 500 Russians are considered for evacuation. Moscow is refining emergency schemes, including potential suspension of air links between CAR and Russia; evacuation measures are not being considered in Tanzania, Rwanda, or Angola at this time. The United States and Canada have curbed entry for citizens of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, South Sudan, and travelers from those countries, a move condemned by WHO. Cross-border movement and a 21-day Ebola incubation complicate containment and aid delivery. Rospotrebnadzor chief Anna Popova says Ebola is not pandemic-prone due to its contact transmission, though Africa-wide spread remains possible; a diagnostic test exists for the Bundibugyo variant.

triage.headline_ja: 致死的な病気による緊急避難の準備：新しいウイルス株が原因
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の発生に関する記事。IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）し、複数国での避難計画と国際的対応が進行中。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はCAR（中央アフリカ共和国）でのエボラ発生だが、CAR は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。DRC はエボラ関連の国際的な入国制限対象として言及されており、対象国リストに含まれるため記載。Kenya と Angola も言及されるが、対象国リストに含まれない。本記事は複数地域での波及と国際的な対応が進行中であり、PICKUP判定に値する。

article.articleHeadline: 4台人伊波拉疫區返國列管21天 羅一鈞：1人發燒驗陰排除！
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Four Taiwanese returnees from Ebola-affected areas placed under 21-day quarantine; Luo Yijun: one person developed fever, tested negative and ruled out.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan tightened border controls over Ebola-affected areas, imposing a 90-day entry suspension for residents from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, effective June 2, 2026, after an initial 21-day autonomous health-management (AHM) requirement that began May 27. Four Taiwanese returnees (two from Uganda, two from DRC) are under 21-day home AHM, with daily symptom reporting and twice-daily temperature checks; Taiwan CDC staff actively monitor them. One individual developed a mild fever the day after arrival, was hospitalized for testing, but Ebola virus was negative and the person was discharged. No confirmed Ebola cases among the four so far. The measures reflect ongoing Ebola concerns in Central and East Africa and rely on PCR testing to exclude infections with similar symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: 4名の台湾人がエボラ出血熱流行地域から帰国し21日間の隔離対象に　羅一君：1人が発熱したが検査で陰性を確認
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱という重篤感染症に関する報告であり、複数国での確認と台湾の強化された入国管理措置が講じられている点で国際的関心がある。しかし現時点で確認例がなく、検出された症例は陰性であることから、直ちにフルRRA対象とはせず、継続的な情報監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダからの帰国者も言及されているが、ウガンダ（GeoNames ID: 226074）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外した。DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。台湾は対象国でないため含めない。エボラ出血熱は高い致死率を持つ重篤感染症であり、国際的な懸念が高まっているが、現在のところ確認例がないことから、PICKUP ではなく WATCH 判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: OMS e RDC desenvolvem vacina contra Ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO and the DRC Develop Ebola Vaccine
article.articleSummary: Ebola epidemic in Central Africa led WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC); the WHO Director-General justified the decision on Tuesday (19) due to the scale and speed of spread, and proceeded to convene the emergency committee. The article highlights international response measures and the role of DR Congo in vaccine development, as indicated by the headline. The PHEIC designation signals intensified international coordination and resource mobilization to control transmission in the Central African region. No case counts or fatalities are provided in the extract. The emphasis remains on rapid spread and the justification for an international alert to support outbreak containment and deployment of vaccines and public health interventions.

triage.headline_ja: WHO and the DRC Develop Ebola Vaccine
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（PHEICの宣言に基づく国際的な懸念を反映）。WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当し、社会的・政治的関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: WHOがPHEIC（Public Health Emergency of International Concern）を宣言。記事ではアフリカ中央部全体への記載があるが、サマリーではDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）が主題の対象国として明記されている。発生地域のアフリカ中央部（Central Africa）は地政学的地域であり、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 國內爆麻疹群聚！20多歲男遭同住友人傳染 491名接觸者被匡列
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Domestic measles cluster outbreak! A man in his twenties contracted measles from a housemate; 491 contacts quarantined.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in Taiwan: domestic cluster traced to an imported source. Case 1 is a foreign female in her 30s who arrived in mid‑May; she developed fever, cough, runny nose, and rash, and was lab‑confirmed. Case 2, a male in his 20s in the north and a housemate of Case 1, also developed cough, fever, and rash and was confirmed by testing. The cluster totals 2 cases, with 491 contacts quarantined and monitored through June 16. Taiwan’s 2026 measles tally reaches 11 cases (3 locally acquired, 8 imported) from Vietnam, Malaysia, the United States, India, Indonesia, Kyrgyzstan, Japan, and Thailand. Globally, Japan reports 511 cases this year; Bangladesh’s Dhaka region records 70,936 cases (9,049 confirmed) and 585 deaths. Measles is highly airborne; contacts should follow health monitoring notices, wear masks if symptoms arise, and non‑compliance can incur NT$60,000–NT$300,000 fines.

triage.headline_ja: 国内で麻疹クラスター発生！20代男性が同居人から感染 接触者491名が隔離対象に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WPROスクリーニングでも4つ以上該当。台湾における国内感染クラスターの確認、複数国からの輸入症例、大規模な接触者追跡が示す公衆衛生上の重要性。
triage.notes: 台湾での麻疹クラスターが主題。サマリーに複数国（ベトナム、マレーシア、米国、インド、インドネシア、キルギスタン、日本、タイ）からの輸入症例が列挙されており、WPROスクリーニング対象国のうちインド、ベトナム、タイ、インドネシアが該当。バングラデシュのダッカは大規模発生（70,936例、585死亡）を記載しているが、当該記事の主題はバングラデシュではなく台湾の状況であるため、バングラデシュは除外。491名の接触者隔離、高い空気感染性、複数国にまたがる症例の発生源追跡といった要素が感染症危機管理上の重要性を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: Oluga: 37 travellers from DRC quarantined in Ebola surveillance drive
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-02, Kenya quarantined 37 Kenyans who recently travelled from the Democratic Republic of Congo as part of intensified Ebola surveillance after concerns over Congo’s transmission. The quarantine aims to prevent importation of Ebola; Kenya maintains heightened surveillance at points of entry and monitors travellers from DRC and Uganda within a 21-day window, advising them to seek immediate care for Ebola symptoms. Screening, contact tracing and public awareness have been expanded, and about 2,200 health workers have been trained to respond, with strengthened isolation and emergency-response systems. The quarantined include senior business leaders linked to mining in the DRC and bank employees with Congo operations; several logistics firms and Kenyan Defence Forces personnel are involved in regional missions. The Laikipia isolation facility is an addition to capacity, not exclusive to American citizens, and locals in Nanyuki have protested the site. Officials say concerns about a US-Kenya Ebola deal are inflated.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ：コンゴからの37人の渡航者がエボラ監視活動の一環として隔離
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも異常性・流行性・管理可能性が該当し、政府関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事は主にケニアでのエボラ対応（検疫、監視強化）について述べているが、感染症イベントの実際の発生地はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）である。ケニアはDRCからの渡航者に対する防御的措置を実施している段階。GeoNames IDで確認すると、ケニア（192950）は対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを記載。

article.articleHeadline: تزايد إصابات إيبولا في الكونغو وسط تسارع دولي لتطوير لقاح جديد
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rising Ebola cases in the Congo amid an international push to develop a new vaccine.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 June 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 321 laboratory-confirmed Ebola virus disease cases across three provinces, with 48 deaths. International concern grows as cross-border spread to Uganda prompts intensified global action. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with about 250 deaths and over 1,100 infections to date. No licensed vaccine or treatment exists for this strain; the rVSV-based vaccine, the platform used by Ervebo against Zaire ebolavirus, is closest to deployment. IAVI has an agreement with the University of Texas to accelerate vaccine development for this outbreak. Other candidates are in development, including an mRNA vaccine from Moderna, with clinical trials expected to take several months before results are decisive.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラウイルス感染症が増加、新しいワクチン開発に向けた国際的な推進の中で
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症（高致死性疾患）が確認され、DRCで321例の確定患者と48人の死亡が報告されている。ウガンダへの越境拡大が記録されており、IHR基準（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、異常性）に2つ以上該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準（高重症度、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性）でも複数該当する。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダへの越境拡大が記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。DRCは対象国（ID: 203312）であり、3州での確認と越境拡大、高い死亡率（約250人の死亡と1,100以上の感染）が特に懸念される。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による既知ワクチンなしの状況が重症度を高めている。

article.articleHeadline: 麻疹境外移入釀本土群聚！外籍女傳染給同住男友 疾管署急匡491人
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Imported measles from abroad triggers a domestic cluster! A foreign woman infects her live-in boyfriend; CDC urgently traces 491 people.
article.articleSummary: Imported measles from abroad triggers a domestic cluster in Taiwan. A foreign woman in her 30s contracted measles during a May visit and transmitted it to her live-in male friend in his 20s, forming a domestic cluster. As of 2026-06-02, Taiwan’s CDC has traced 491 contacts for health monitoring, with follow-up planned through June 16. Case 1 presented fever, cough, runny nose, sore throat, and rash from day 3 after arrival; diagnosed on day 4, mild illness, not hospitalized, isolated at home. Case 2, a northern Taiwan local in his 20s and cohabiting with Case 1, developed similar symptoms in late May and was confirmed measles. Measles is highly contagious via airborne spread and transmissible before and during rash, with 5–10% risk of complications such as otitis media, pneumonia, and encephalitis, particularly in infants and the immunocompromised. Taiwan has 11 total measles cases this year (3 domestic, 8 imported); imports traced to Vietnam, Malaysia, United States, India, Indonesia, Kyrgyzstan, Japan, and Thailand. Global context includes Japan with 511 cases, Bangladesh over 70,000, and ongoing Southeast Asian outbreaks in Vietnam, Indonesia, and Thailand.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹境外移入釀本土群聚！外籍女傳染給同住男友 疾管署急匡491人
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を4項目中3項目満たす（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、予想外の国内群聚）。麻疹の高い感染性と東南アジア広域流行の背景において、台湾での輸入例による国内クラスター発生は重要な感染症シグナルであり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は台湾での麻疹輸入例と国内クラスターについて主として述べており、対象国リストから Vietnam、Indonesia、Thailand、India が発生国として言及されている。台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。Bangladesh、Japan、Malaysia、Kyrgyzstan、United States は対象国外であるため除外。麻疹の高い感染性、東南アジア広域での流行状況、491人の接触者追跡の実施、複数国からの輸入例という特徴から、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目全て該当と評価。

article.articleHeadline: Đối tượng vô cớ đâm người phụ nữ, chém đứt gân tay cảnh sát là kẻ nhiễm HIV, tình hình các cán bộ tiếp xúc?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The suspect who stabbed a woman for no reason and severed a police officer's hand tendons is HIV-positive; what is the status of the officers who were exposed?
article.articleSummary: On 2 June 2026 in Hai Phong, suspect Phan Tuan Hung, born 1980, attacked a 56-year-old woman, N.T.L., with a knife on Lạch Tray Street in Gia Viên ward, injuring her on the face, thigh, and leg while she rode a motorbike. Hung had no prior known relationship with the victim. During police intervention, Captain Nguyễn Đức Thịnh was struck on the right hand. Initial tests indicated Hung is HIV-positive. Three officers who had direct contact with Hung during the incident received HIV post-exposure prophylaxis per medical protocol. The victims were taken to hospital; investigators conducted on-site work and the suspect was handed over to Le Chân ward police for further processing. No other deaths are reported; the investigation is ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: 女性を刺し警察官の手の腱を切断した容疑者がHIV陽性、接触した職員の状況は？
triage.triage_reason: 孤立した刑事事件（暴力犯罪）における偶発的なHIV暴露事例であり、感染症流行の兆候ではない。医療機関による適切な対応（PEP投与）が実施されており、公衆衛生上の重大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 本件は感染症の流行または集団発生ではなく、刑事事件の枠組みでの個別のHIV暴露事例である。職業上の針刺し様事故に近い状況であり、ベトナム当局が既に標準的な曝露後予防（PEP）プロトコルを実施している。感染症監視システムの対象外と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Ебола съживява спомените от Ковид: Тайланд налага 21-дневна карантина за пристигащи от Африка
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola revives memories of COVID: Thailand imposes a 21-day quarantine for arrivals from Africa.
article.articleSummary: Thailand imposes a 21-day mandatory quarantine for arrivals from Ebola-affected regions—DR Congo, Uganda, and nearby countries with cross-border transmission—following the May 27, 2026 move. All travelers from these areas undergo health screening at international entry points; risk-based decisions may require quarantine or self-isolation for at least 21 days; noncompliance can bring fines or imprisonment. There are no confirmed Ebola cases in Thailand. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo variant; there is no licensed vaccine or specific approved treatment. As of late May to early June 2026, DR Congo reports about 906 suspected cases, 223 suspected deaths, 125 lab-confirmed infections, and 17 confirmed deaths; Uganda has nine cases and one death, with no widespread local transmission. WHO says the situation remains serious; conflict and displacement hinder contact tracing. Some countries have tightened entry rules, but no broad travel bans are advised.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコビドの思い出を呼び起こす：タイはアフリカからの到着者に対して21日間の隔離を実施
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的な拡大リスク（DRC・ウガンダでの確認例、タイでの予防的入国措置）、予想外の公衆衛生対応（21日間隔離措置）、および国際的な関心が高い。IHR基準で3項目該当、WPRO基準でも複数項目該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC・ウガンダでのエボラ確認事例（DRCで906疑い例、223疑い死亡、125確認感染、17確認死亡；ウガンダで9例1死亡）と、タイの予防的対応（隔離措置導入、確認例はなし）が述べられている。対象国リストではDRCとThailandのみが該当。ウガンダは対象国外のため除外。Bundibugyo亜型、ワクチン未承認、治療法未確立という深刻な状況が加わる。WHOも状況が深刻と評価。

article.articleHeadline: Elindult a versenyfutás az idővel: magas halálozású járvány szedi az áldozatait, rohamtempóban készül az új oltóanyag
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The race against time has begun: a high-mortality epidemic is claiming its victims, and a new vaccine is being developed at breakneck speed.
article.articleSummary: On June 2, 2026, the Bundibugyo variant of Ebola is spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda. Africa CDC and WHO report 282 confirmed DRC cases with 42 deaths; Uganda has 9 cases and 1 death, with about 1,100 suspected cases. No approved vaccine or targeted therapy exists for Bundibugyo ebolavirus. The Coalition for Epidemic Preparedness Innovations (CEPI) is funding roughly $60 million for vaccine development: about $50 million to Moderna for preclinical and early clinical development of an experimental Ebola vaccine, including manufacturing and future trials if early results are favorable. Separately, CEPI backs about $8.6 million for an Oxford University vaccine produced by Serum Institute, and $3.2 million initial support for an IAVI vaccine using the same platform as Merck's Ervebo (Zaire ebolavirus). The Oxford vaccine uses the platform of the Oxford/AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine. Trials could begin within months, though security in eastern Congo complicates efforts.

triage.headline_ja: 時間との競争が始まった：高死亡率の流行が犠牲者を奪っており、新しいワクチンが急ピッチで開発されている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。ブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスの高死亡率（約15%）、国際的拡大（DRC・ウガンダ）、承認済み治療法なし、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。記事はブンディブギョ型エボラの発生・拡大、高死亡率、ワクチン開発の進展について報じており、国際的な感染症危機管理上の重要シグナル。東部コンゴの治安悪化がワクチン開発・配備の障害となる可能性に言及。

article.articleHeadline: Μουντιάλ 2026: Ανησυχία για εξάπλωση του Εμπολα στη διοργάνωση
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Cup 2026: Concern over the spread of Ebola at the tournament.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo strain linked to a Central African outbreak raises World Cup 2026 concerns as transmission continues. More than 2,000 contacts remain unidentified or untested. The strain has been documented in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo, with deaths exceeding 220. WHO warns the outbreak is outpacing health responses, hindering containment. Experts note Ebola can spread via travelers; the overall risk to North America remains limited, but cases could reach the region with participants. Symptoms include high fever, fatigue, myalgia, and sore throat; severe disease can cause liver and kidney failure or internal bleeding. Transmission is zoonotic from bats and primates, then human-to-human via body fluids or contaminated surfaces. The United States has barred entry for non-U.S. citizens who recently traveled to DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan within 21 days, as about 5.5 million fans travel to the US, Canada, and Mexico for the tournament.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年ワールドカップ：トーナメントでのエボラ出血熱拡大懸念
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の中央アフリカでの継続的な流行（死亡220名超、未追跡接触者2000人以上）とワールドカップを通じた国際拡大リスクが高い。IHR基準3項目以上該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。社会政治的関心も顕著（大規模国際イベントへの影響）。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで確認される実際の流行地はDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン。対象国リスト内ではDRCのみ該当。United States、Canada、Mexicoはワールドカップ開催地（リスク受信国）として言及されているが、流行地ではないため verified_locations に含めない。ワールドカップという大規模国際イベントを介した国際拡大リスクが極めて高く、複数の保健当局（米国など）が既に対応措置を講じている点が重要。

article.articleHeadline: 4台人伊波拉疫區返國列管21天 羅一鈞：1人發燒驗陰排除！ | LIFE生活網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Four Taiwanese returnees from Ebola-affected area placed under 21-day quarantine; Luo Yijun: One fever case tested negative for Ebola, ruled out! | LIFE Lifestyle Network
article.articleSummary: Taiwan tightens Ebola border controls as of June 2, 2026: four Taiwanese returnees from Ebola-affected areas—two from the Democratic Republic of Congo and two from Uganda—are under 21-day self-health management after entry. Since May 27, Taiwan requires self-health monitoring for 21 days, with daily symptom reporting and twice-daily temperature checks, and health authorities will actively track for any need to quarantine or test. From June 2 at midnight, entry from DRC and Uganda is entirely suspended for 90 days. One of the four developed a mild fever the day after arrival and was hospitalized for Ebola testing; PCR results were negative, and the patient was discharged. Officials note malaria and other infections are common in the rainy season, complicating clinical assessment, and PCR is used to rule out Ebola. All four will complete the 21-day monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: 4人の台湾人がエボラ出血熱流行地域から帰国、21日間の隔離対象に 羅一鈞氏：1人の発熱は検査陰性で除外
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上該当（異常性・予想外性、国際拡大のリスク）し、対象国（DRC）での確認例があるため。エボラウイルス病は高い重症度を持つ感染症であり、国境措置の実施は公衆衛生上の深刻性を示す。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダからの帰国者に言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。台湾（China圏外）は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。エボラ出血熱は高病原性であり、国家レベルの国境措置（90日間の入国停止）が実施されたことは社会的・政治的関心の高さを示唆している。現在のところ確定例はなく（検査陰性）だが、流行地域からの帰国者発生という初期段階のシグナルとして扱う。

article.articleHeadline: 國內爆麻疹群聚！20多歲男遭同住友人傳染　491名接觸者被匡列
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Domestic measles outbreak! A man in his 20s infected by a housemate; 491 contacts quarantined.
article.articleSummary: Domestic measles outbreak in Taiwan: a man in his 20s infected by a housemate; 491 contacts quarantined. As of 2026-06-02, Taiwan CDC reports 11 measles cases this year (ages <1 to 50s): 3 domestically acquired, 8 imported from Vietnam, Malaysia, United States, India, Indonesia, Kyrgyzstan, Japan, and Thailand (one each). Globally, measles remains high: Japan reports 511 cases this year, with Tokyo, Kanagawa, Saitama most affected; Dhaka region, Bangladesh, confronts a severe outbreak with about 70,936 suspected and 9,049 confirmed cases and 585 related deaths since March. Southeast Asia (Indonesia, Vietnam, Thailand) continue to report cases and export/import. Taiwan CDC warns measles is highly infectious and airborne. Contacts must follow the Measles Case Contact Health Monitoring Notice, monitor health, and wear a mask if symptoms appear; seek medical care promptly. Non-compliance can incur NT$60,000–300,000 fines under the Infectious Disease Control Act Articles 48 and 67.

triage.headline_ja: 国内で麻疹集団発生！20代男性が同居人から感染、491人の接触者が検疫対象
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準で4項目該当（異常性、重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）。複数国での同時流行報告があり、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 台湾国内での麻疹集団発生が主題。記事サマリーでは対象国11カ国すべてが言及されているが、validated_locationsには記事で実際に確認事例が明記されている対象国のみを記載。バングラデシュ（Dhaka）は記事に含まれているが対象国リストに非該当のため除外。日本は発生地域に含まれるが、記事の主題はタイワン国内の発生であるため除外。麻疹は高い感染力と国際的な複数国での同時流行報告により、フルRRA進捗を強く推奨。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief calls for reconsidering travel ban as DR Congo fights Ebola
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak worsens as WHO chief Tedros urges reconsideration of travel bans that could hamper response and trust. Speaking in Bunia, Ituri Province—the outbreak's epicenter—Tedros said border closures complicate efforts and undermine transparency, essential to saving lives. The outbreak, the 17th since 1976, is spreading at an unprecedented pace, with over 1,000 suspected cases reported. Uganda has nine confirmed cases, including two new infections in Kampala. DR Congo reports 1,028 suspected cases and 225 confirmed; 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths are under investigation. Authorities aim to contain the virus in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu within four to six months. Lab capacity has expanded to process all incoming samples (about 900 tested, ~260 positives). No approved vaccines or medicines exist; timely, quality care can still save lives. A suspected Ebola case is being investigated in Sao Paulo, Brazil, linked to travel from DR Congo.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ対策における渡航禁止の再検討を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラは重症度が極めて高く、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダ・ブラジルでも確認）、渡航制限が急速に発生している。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにはブラジル・ウガンダも含まれているが、記事の主体はDRコンゴのエボラアウトブレイク。ブラジルの疑似症例は調査中であり、ウガンダは国境を超えた拡大事例（DRコンゴ由来）。対象国の文脈ではDRコンゴのみが主要な発生地域として確認された。1,000件以上の疑似症例と225人の確認例、ワクチン・治療薬なし、かつ4-6ヶ月で封じ込める予定という高度な緊急性。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya Screening 3,000 Travelers Daily for Ebola, No Cases Recorded So Far, Says Ruto
article.articleSummary: Ebola surveillance in Kenya: about 3,000 travelers are screened daily at entry points, with no Ebola infections recorded so far. President William Ruto stated robust systems to prevent, detect, and respond to any outbreak, including rigorous screening and a quarantine and disease-preparedness facility at Laikipia Air Base. This centre is part of a network of 23 preparedness sites nationwide designed to support screening, isolation, and treatment. Additional operational facilities include Kenyatta National Hospital, National Police Service Hospital, Moi Teaching and Referral Hospital, Kenyatta University Teaching, Referral and Research Hospital, and Alupe Hospital in Busia. Kenya’s preparedness is backed by international partners, notably the United States. While Ebola-free, Kenya remains vigilant due to regional ties, including personnel working in the Democratic Republic of Congo.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、エボラ出血熱対策で1日3,000人の旅行者をスクリーニング、現在までに感染者はなし、とルト大統領が述べる
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱という高リスク疾患であり、ケニアにおいて予防・検知・対応体制が強化されている兆候がある。しかし現在のところケニアでの確定患者は報告されておらず、DRC関連の区域的リスクがあるものの、情報不足のため経過観察段階が適切。
triage.notes: ケニア（対象国リストに含まれず）での予防的監視活動の報告。DRC（203312）は記事で言及されているが、実際のエボラ発生がDRCで報告されているわけではなく、ケニアの人員配置先として背景情報として述べられているのみ。現在のところ確定患者がなく、段階的スクリーニング報告のため、シグナル拾い上げには至らず。DRCも対象国であるが、この記事ではDRCでのアウトブレイク報告ではなくケニア国内の準備体制についての報告であるため、verified_locationsは空とする。

article.articleHeadline: India Africa Aid| Africa CDC|Ebola Outbreak|S Jaishankar| Medical Assistance | Ebola: इबोला संकट से निपटने में भारत ने बढ़ाया मदद का हाथ, अफ्रीका CDC को भेजी दूसरी मेडिकल खेप
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: India Africa Aid| Africa CDC|Ebola Outbreak|S Jaishankar| Medical Assistance | Ebola: India has stepped up its aid to tackle the Ebola crisis, sending the second medical shipment to Africa CDC.
article.articleSummary: India has sent the second medical aid shipment to Africa CDC to strengthen the Ebola response in Africa. The 43-ton package comprises personal protective equipment, diagnostics and surveillance tools, medicines, and nutritional supplements, intended to boost public health preparedness and outbreak management. Foreign Minister S. Jaishankar announced the shipment, following the first consignment delivered on 24 May; India had pledged to continue assistance on 29 May. The aid was handed to Africa CDC in Uganda by Indian Ambassador Upendra Singh Rawat, and Africa CDC publicly welcomed the emergency medical assistance on 31 May as part of efforts addressing Ebola outbreaks in the region, including the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The WHO declared Ebola a public health emergency of international concern on 17 May. Ebola spreads through contact with infected bodily fluids, contaminated objects, or animals, causing fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and sometimes bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ危機対応でインドが支援を強化、アフリカCDCに2番目の医療物資を送付
triage.triage_reason: エボラはWHOが5月17日に国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言した既知の重大感染症。DRCおよびウガンダでの発生が記事に明記されており、IHR基準の公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、および渡航・貿易制限リスクをすべて満たす。国際的な医療支援が活発化している点からも継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事では主要な発生地がDRCおよびウガンダとされており、インドはこれらに対する国際的医療支援を提供している立場。インドはサマリー上で医療援助供与国として言及されているため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダ(226074)は対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Angola Deploys Epidemiological Surveillance Teams On the Border With the DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Angola's Cabinda province has deployed epidemiological surveillance teams at several border posts with the Democratic Republic of Congo to curb possible Ebola introductions, as the disease resurges in the neighboring country. No suspected Ebola cases have been registered. On Mpox, four new samples were sent to the National Institute of Health Research (INIS) laboratories in Luanda. Cabinda currently monitors nine positive Mpox cases (seven in Cabinda Municipality, two in Belize); Uíge province reports four positive Mpox cases. Health authorities say the situation is under control despite recent suspected Mpox cases. Measures align with cross-border risk mitigation as of 2 June 2026.

triage.headline_ja: アンゴラがコンゴ民主共和国との国境に疫学監視チームを展開
triage.triage_reason: Ebola と Mpox の同時イベント報告であり、IHR基準で異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクが該当。国境地域での能動的監視体制の構築は公衆衛生対応の重要性を示唆している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはアンゴラのCabinda州とUíge州での Mpox 確定症例（計13例）の報告と、DRC との国境での Ebola 監視体制の構築を主題としている。アンゴラは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には DRC のみを列挙。Belize は記事内で Cabinda Municipality の下位地域として言及されているが、実際のイベント発生国ではなく誤記または地理的混乱と考えられるため除外。複数疾患・複数地域での国境リスク管理という点で管理可能性への懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Norske Miriam reiser til Ebola-marerittet i Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Norwegian Miriam travels to the Ebola nightmare in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of June 2, 2026, Ebola is spreading across the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, with WHO reporting 223 suspected deaths and 1,100 suspected cases; case fatality estimates range from 30% to 50%. The outbreak began about two months ago in war-torn, conflict-affected Congo, and there is currently no vaccine or approved cure. Aid efforts face funding shortfalls, with the United States halting most assistance since Trump took office last year, undermining preparedness. Norwegian MSF worker Miriam Steinstad Haugen is deployed as a health promoter in Congo and has prior Ebola experience from Uganda in 2022. She stresses the human toll—families torn apart, and the impossibility of comforting dying children—and believes local communities hold the key to stopping transmission, even as the crisis worsens.

triage.headline_ja: ノルウェー人ミリアム、コンゴのエボラ悪夢へ向かう
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病の進行中の大規模流行であり、深刻な公衆衛生影響（223人の疑い死亡、1,100症例）、高い致死率（30～50%）、複数国での国際的拡大（DRC・ウガンダ）、渡航・貿易制限のリスクを示す。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウガンダも含まれているが、記事サマリーではコンゴが主な発生地であり、ウガンダは2つの流行地の一つとして言及されている。ただし、対象国リストにはウガンダ（GeoNames ID不明）が含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。米国とノルウェーは発生地ではなく対応国であり除外。資金不足と国際援助の制限（米国の支援削減）が管理可能性を低下させている。

article.articleHeadline: इबोला संकट से निपटने में भारत ने बढ़ाया मदद का हाथ, अफ्रीका सीडीसी को भेजी दूसरी मेडिकल खेप - Punjab Kesari
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: India steps up its aid in the Ebola crisis, sends the second medical shipment to Africa CDC.
article.articleSummary: India announced the second medical aid shipment—43 tons—to Africa CDC on June 2, 2026, to bolster Ebola outbreak response and public health preparedness in Africa. The consignment includes PPE, testing and surveillance equipment, medicines, and nutritional supplements. This follows the first shipment of emergency medical supplies and PPE on May 24 and ongoing commitments, including a May 29 pledge to continue assistance. The materials were handed over in Uganda by India’s ambassador to Uganda, Upendra Singh Rawat. Africa CDC welcomed India's emergency assistance on May 31 in response to Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; the World Health Organization had declared Ebola a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. Ebola spreads through contact with infected body fluids; symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and in severe cases bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ危機への対応を強化、インドがアフリカCDCに2番目の医療物資を送付
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目以上該当（重大な公衆衛生上の影響、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）。WHOが5月17日にエボラをPHEICと宣言しており、複数国での発生が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、エボラ発生地はDRC（民主コンゴ）で確認され、ウガンダを経由して医療物資が輸送されている。インドはドナー国として関与しており、対象国ではウガンダとDRCが実際の発生地である。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsにはDRCとIndiaのみを記載。WHOのPHEIC宣言により国際的な危機対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: अब डेंगू-मलेरिया से ऐसे निपटेगा Google, 3.2 करोड़ संक्रमित मच्छरों की फौज छोड़ने की तैयारी, भारत को होगा फायदा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Now Google will tackle dengue and malaria this way, preparing to release an army of 32 million infected mosquitoes; India will benefit.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 June 2026, Google’s Debug project plans to release about 32 million lab-reared male mosquitoes infected with Wolbachia pipientis in Florida and California over two years. Infected males mating with wild females will produce eggs that do not hatch, reducing the mosquito population; only males are released, so they cannot bite humans. Releases will occur in two phases: 16 million in year one and 16 million in year two. The plan is under review by the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency. Although the method is not new and has been used to control pest insects, experts view it as a relatively safe, environmentally friendlier alternative to chemical pesticides. If successful, India and other dengue-, malaria-, chikungunya-, Zika-, and yellow fever-prone regions could adopt the approach to curb mosquito-borne outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: Googleがデング熱とマラリアに対抗する計画、3200万匹の感染蚊を放つ準備、インドが利益を得る
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はGoogleのDebugプロジェクトによる蚊の生物学的制御計画に関する報道であり、現在進行中の感染症アウトブレイク事例ではなく、将来的な予防・制御技術の導入計画についての記事である。IHR基準および現在の公衆衛生上の緊急事態には該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はGoogleの蚊制御技術に関する将来計画の報道であり、実際の感染症発生・アウトブレイク事例ではない。インドが言及されているのは潜在的な適用対象地域としてであり、実際の発生地ではない。対象国リストの国での実際のイベント発生を特定できないため verified_locations は空配列。

article.articleHeadline: 4台人伊波拉疫區返國列管21天 羅一鈞：1人發燒驗陰排除！ - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Four Taiwanese returnees from Ebola-affected areas placed under 21-day monitoring; Luo Yijun: one fever case tested negative and ruled out!
article.articleSummary: Starting 2026-06-02, Taiwan fully suspends entry of residents from Ebola-affected Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda for 90 days, after previously requiring a 21-day self-health management (SHM). Four Taiwanese returnees from these regions are currently under SHM, two from Uganda and two from the DRC. One individual developed a mild fever the day after arrival and was hospitalized for testing; Ebola virus was negative, and the patient was discharged. Authorities note that malaria and other bacterial respiratory illnesses are common in the rainy season, so similar symptoms require PCR testing to exclude Ebola. All four will complete the 21-day SHM, reporting daily symptoms and twice-daily temperatures through the system, with proactive follow-up by health authorities to ensure no need for further testing. Luo Yijun, director of the Taiwan CDC, stated the measures reflect ongoing Ebola outbreaks in Central Africa and aim to prevent imported cases.

triage.headline_ja: 4名の台湾人がエボラ感染地域から帰国し21日間監視下に；羅一鈞：1名の発熱者は検査陰性で除外！
triage.triage_reason: エボラ発症は確認されず、発熱者は既に陰性と判定されている。ただしCentral Africaの進行中のアウトブレイク背景とそれに対応した台湾の入国制限措置が実施されている点で、経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: Central Africaのエボラアウトブレイクへの対応として台湾が実施した措置の報道。台湾自体では確定患者は発生していない。監視対象者の検査結果は全て陰性。DRCでのアウトブレイク継続が背景にあるため、DRCを verified_locations に含める。Uganda（対象国リストに非該当）での発生については言及されているが、同国からの帰国者に対する措置の一部として扱われており、DRCが主題。

article.articleHeadline: Μουντιάλ 2026: Ανησυχία για την εξάπλωση του Εμπολα " OnCamera.gr
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Cup 2026: Concern about the spread of Ebola
article.articleSummary: Ebola, Bundibugyo strain, remains a concern as World Cup 2026 approaches, with Uganda and the Democratic Republic of the Congo bearing the outbreak's impact. Death toll exceeds 220, and authorities estimate more than 2,000 contacts of possible cases have yet to be traced or tested. The WHO warns that the outbreak is expanding rapidly, challenging public-health responses. Bundibugyo is primarily transmitted from wild animals and between people via body fluids; symptoms include high fever and muscle pains, with severe cases causing liver and kidney failure. The case-fatality for this strain can reach about 40%. In response, the United States has implemented travel safeguards, banning entry for non-U.S. citizens who recently visited DRC or Uganda, and requiring that travelers have not stayed in those countries during the past 21 days before entry.

triage.headline_ja: ワールドカップ2026: エボラウイルスの拡大への懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、致死率40%のBundibugyo株による急速な流行拡大、220人超の死亡、2,000人以上の接触者追跡の必要性が報告されている。複数国での同時発生と国際的な渡航規制実施により、シグナルとして確定される。
triage.notes: ウガンダはBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外した。米国の渡航禁止措置により国際的な関心と対応が強化されている。Bundibugyo株の高い致死率（40%）と急速な流行拡大が確認されており、WHO警告が発出されている。記事発行日は2026年6月2日（未来日時）であり、シミュレーションまたは予測シナリオの可能性が高いが、提供情報に基づきトリアージを実施した。

article.articleHeadline: इबोला संकट से निपटने में भारत ने बढ़ाया मदद का हाथ, अफ्रीका सीडीसी को भेजी दूसरी मेडिकल खेप
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: India has stepped up aid to tackle the Ebola crisis, sending the second medical consignment to Africa CDC.
article.articleSummary: On June 2, 2026, India dispatched the second medical consignment (about 43 metric tons) to Africa CDC to enhance Ebola outbreak preparedness and response in Africa. The shipment comprises personal protective equipment, diagnostic and surveillance tools, medicines, and nutritional supplements.
