This follows the first consignment of emergency medical supplies and safety kits sent on May 24, with India pledging continued assistance on May 29. The handover to Africa CDC's Uganda office was conducted by India’s ambassador to Uganda, Upendra Singh Rawat. Africa CDC welcomed the emergency aid on May 31 as part of ongoing support to the Democratic Republic of the Congo and other affected countries amid the Ebola crisis. The World Health Organization had declared Ebola a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. Ebola spreads via infected bodily fluids; symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and, in severe cases, bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: インドがエボラ危機への支援を強化、アフリカCDCに第2次医療物資を送付
triage.triage_reason: エボラはIHR基準2つ以上該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク）し、WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態として宣言済み。DRCとウガンダでの進行中の流行に対応した国際支援が展開中。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIで示された発生地域にはウガンダとインドが含まれるが、記事サマリーではウガンダはインド大使による物資引き渡し地点であり、エボラ発生地はDRCと明記されている。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみに限定。WHOによるPHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）により国際的対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Ученые рассказали, как не стать жертвой опасных микробов, живущих в рыбе
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scientists Explain How Not to Fall Prey to Dangerous Microbes Living in Fish.
article.articleSummary: Listeria monocytogenes in cold-smoked salmon is being targeted by scientists from Don State Technical University (DSTU) and international partners (Algeria, Brazil, Bulgaria). They report that lactic acid bacteria-derived bacteriocins can selectively kill Listeria without altering taste, smell, appearance, or texture, potentially extending shelf life and reducing foodborne illness risk. Findings, published in Fishes, emphasize Listeria’s ability to multiply at refrigeration temperatures and resist salting, drying, or acids, with listeriosis causing severe diarrhea and mortality up to 20% without medical care. Russia has seen only sporadic listeriosis due to strict quality control. The biocontainment approach targets L. monocytogenes in delicatessen smoked salmon under low-oxygen, chilled storage, where the pathogen proliferates slowly, and could be applicable to other fish such as rainbow trout, halibut, or mackerel. Researchers aim to develop biopreservation technology to guard smoked fish against Listeria and other pathogens.

triage.headline_ja: 科学者が説明：魚に生息する危険な微生物の被害を避ける方法
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は学術的な研究報告であり、特定の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、科学技術の開発に関するもの。リステリア症の散発的な事例報告がなく、公衆衛生上の急迫した脅威を示唆する情報がない。
triage.notes: 本記事は学術研究の進展に関する記事であり、現在のアウトブレイクや感染症の急速な拡大を報告するものではない。ロシアではリステリア症の厳格な品質管理により散発的事例のみとのこと。記事は食品微生物学的な予防技術開発の話題であり、シグナル認識の対象外と判定した。verified_locationsはBrazilのみとした（アルジェリア・ブルガリア・ロシアは対象国ではないため）。

article.articleHeadline: Mokslininkai perspėja dėl plintančio pavojingo viruso: kai kurie atvejai baigiasi net mirtimi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scientists warn of a spreading dangerous virus: some cases end in death.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization declared an international health emergency over an Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda as of 2026-06-02. There is no vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola. The Bundibugyo virus is one of six Ebola species, with transmission currently centered in the Uganda–DRC border region; past small outbreaks occurred in 2007 and 2012. Case fatality for Bundibugyo Ebola is estimated at 30–50%, and outcomes vary by context, with historically higher mortality for other Ebola strains. Contributing factors include urbanization and civil conflict; surveillance gaps have been linked to a pause in USAID funding. European risk to Lithuania is described as minimal, though travel restrictions and testing could arise. The article suggests it is unlikely that an Ebola patient will arrive in Lithuania.

triage.headline_ja: 科学者らが急速に広がる危険なウイルスについて警告：一部の症例は死亡に至る
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）し、WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言した公式なシグナル。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCおよびウガンダでのBundibugyo Ebolaの発生を記述しており、WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言している。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外した。リトアニアへの言及は地域的リスク評価であり、実際の発生地ではないため除外。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に追加。ウガンダはリストに含まれないが、ウガンダ・DRC国境地域での感染が記述されている。対象国リスト内の最も近い地域がウガンダであり、リスト外のため、対象国内での実際の発生はDRCのみとなる。ただし、記事がウガンダでの発生を明示している場合、原文サマリーを厳密に読めば「Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda」と明記されているが、ウガンダは対象国でないため除外。最終的にverified_locationsはDRCのみが該当する。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo Demokratik Cumhuriyeti'nde Ebola Vakalarının Sayısı 300'ü Aştı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 300.
article.articleSummary: As of June 2, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 343 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases, with the outbreak concentrated in the eastern Ituri province, particularly Bunia. Health Minister Roger Kamba announced the figure after a coordination meeting led by Prime Minister Judith Suminwa. Following a visit to Bunia, response efforts were refocused on targeted interventions. Government spokesperson Patrick Muyaya said Bunia Airport, currently open only to humanitarian flights, is expected to resume full operations this week after implementing preventive infrastructure such as handwashing stations and temperature screening to aid supply and personnel deployment. The current outbreak was declared on May 15 and marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC since the disease was first identified in 1976.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラウイルス病の症例数が300を超えました
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、急速に増加する確認症例数（343例）、東部での地理的集中、継続的な伝播リスク、国際的な拡散の可能性が認められる。エボラ出血熱は最高レベルのリスク疾患であり、フルRRAが必須。
triage.notes: 2026年6月2日時点で343例の確認患者が報告されている。第17次エボラ流行。発生地はイトゥリ州ブニアに集中しているが、国境を接する近隣国への拡散リスクも考慮すべき。ブニア空港の運営再開予定は人員・物資流通により感染拡散を助長する可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: इबोला संकट से निपटने में भारत ने बढ़ाया मदद का हाथ, अफ्रीका सीडीसी को भेजी दूसरी मेडिकल खेप | India dispatches second tranche of medical aid to Africa CDC to strengthen Ebola response
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: India steps up aid to tackle the Ebola crisis, dispatches the second medical shipment to Africa CDC.
article.articleSummary: India dispatched a second 43-ton aid consignment to Africa CDC to bolster Ebola outbreak response in Africa. The shipment, sent from New Delhi on June 2, includes personal protective equipment, diagnostic and surveillance tools, medicines, and nutritional supplements, aiming to strengthen public health preparedness and Ebola-control capacity. A first emergency delivery of materials and PPE had been sent on May 24, with a pledge on May 29 to continue support. Africa CDC received the latest consignment via Uganda, where India’s envoy handed it to the office. On May 31, the Africa CDC welcomed India’s emergency aid to combat Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The WHO had declared Ebola a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. Ebola spreads through contact with infected bodily fluids, contaminated objects or animals, and symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and bleeding in severe cases.

triage.headline_ja: インドがエボラ危機への支援を強化、アフリカCDCへ第2次医療援助物資を派遣
triage.triage_reason: 記事はインドからアフリカへの医療援助の派遣についてであり、インドでのエボラ発生イベントではない。実際の感染症発生地は対象国リストに含まれないコンゴ民主共和国およびウガンダであるため、対象国での発生確認がない。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはインド（1269750）が含まれているが、記事サマリーを精読すると、本イベントはアフリカ（DRCおよびウガンダ）でのエボラ流行に対するインドからの医療援助派遣について述べたものであり、インドでのエボラ発生イベントではない。対象国リスト内で実際にエボラが発生している地域はDRC（203312、対象国リストに含まれる）であるが、記事の主題はあくまで援助活動であり、新規感染症イベントの報告ではない。したがってverified_locationsは空配列とする。

article.articleHeadline: Vdekjet nga virusi - Rastet me Ebola kalojnë 300 në Kongo, preken më shumë zona shëndetësore
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deaths from the virus - Ebola cases exceed 300 in Congo, with more health zones affected.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 June 2026, Ebola confirmed cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo surpassed 300, with 48 deaths, as the outbreak continues to spread to 23 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. In Ituri, confirmed cases exceed 260. Community resistance in Bunia, the provincial capital, and in Nizi, along with rumors and misinformation, are hindering response efforts. Four patients recovered and were discharged from the Evangelical Medical Center in Bunia. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus concluded a visit to discuss the Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak; authorities and partners opened a 60-bed treatment center in Bunia and are conducting vaccine trials. Government spokesman Patrick Muyaya said monitoring equipment at entry and exit has been installed, and Bunia Airport, previously limited to humanitarian flights, reopened to support the response. The latest outbreak was declared on 15 May.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルスによる死亡 - コンゴでのエボラ症例が300例を超え、より多くの保健地域が影響を受ける
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確定例300例超、48人の死亡、23の保健地域への拡大という深刻な流行。IHR基準4項目全て該当、WPRO基準も全て該当。国際的な感染症危機として即座のフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 2026年6月2日時点でDRCのエボラ確定例300例超、死亡48例。Ituri州では260例以上、計23の保健地域に拡大。Buniaの民間医療センターでの患者4名が回復退院、ワクチン試験実施中。社会的課題として住民のバンディブギオ・エボラウイルス(BDBV)アウトブレイク情報への抵抗感やデマが対応を妨げている。国際的対応（WHO局長訪問、60床治療センター開設）が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Versenyfutás az idővel: kísérleti vakcinákkal próbálják megállítani az ebola terjedését
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Race Against Time: Experimental Vaccines Try to Stop the Spread of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus Bundibugyo strain in the Democratic Republic of the Congo accelerates, with over 1,000 suspected cases and a death toll exceeding 200 as of June 2, 2026, and cross-border spread to Uganda raising regional risk two weeks after the initial outbreak. WHO has fast-tracked clinical trials for several experimental therapies and vaccines, as no approved, proven treatment exists for Bundibugyo lineage. Investigational options include MBP134 antibody therapy (Mapp Biopharmaceutical), Regeneron’s maftivimab, and Gilead’s remdesivir. The leading vaccine candidate is an rVSV-based, single-dose Bundibugyo vaccine developed by the International AIDS Vaccine Initiative, though broad clinical testing may take up to nine months. The possibility of using the licensed Ervebo vaccine is deemed unsupported by current evidence for Bundibugyo. Virologist Dr. Miklós Rusvai notes vaccines may not be the sole tool, highlighting ongoing subunit and mRNA strategies.

triage.headline_ja: 時間との競争：実験的ワクチンでエボラの拡大を阻止しようとする試み
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大、渡航制限リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも5項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス感染症は最高リスク病原体であり、1,000例以上の疑い患者と200人以上の死亡、国家間の越境伝播が確認されている。
triage.notes: Uganda（226074）はBluedot発生地域に含まれるが、記事サマリーでは「cross-border spread to Uganda」と述べられており、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。DRCのみ verified_locations に含める。エボラウイルス Bundibugyo strain の発生であり、承認済み治療法がない。WHO による実験的治療法・ワクチンの緊急臨床試験進行中。

article.articleHeadline: 防堵伊波拉病毒！4國人自「剛、烏2國」返台　1人發燒檢驗結果曝 | 祝你健康 | 三立新聞網 HEALTH.SETN.COM
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Stopping Ebola virus! Four people from Congo and Uganda return to Taiwan; test results for one fever patient revealed.
article.articleSummary: On 2 June 2026, Taiwan's CDC announced a 90-day suspension of entry for residents from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda to prevent Ebola virus disease importation. Four Taiwanese nationals have returned from these two countries and are under 21-day self-health management, considered imported cases to Taiwan; two from Uganda and two from DRC. Daily health reporting, including twice-daily temperature checks, is required. One traveler who returned on 27 May developed a mild fever the day after arrival; Ebola virus test results were negative. The policy followed a 27 May requirement for entry travelers from these countries to report at quarantine stations for health assessments. DRC and Uganda are in the rainy season, with malaria and other respiratory infections common; preliminary assessment links the fever to endemic diseases rather than Ebola. No confirmed Ebola cases in Taiwan.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスの流入防止！コンゴとウガンダから台湾に帰国した4人のうち1人が発熱、検査結果が判明
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの国際的拡大リスク、予期しない輸入症例の可能性が存在するが、現時点では台湾での確定患者がなく、検査結果は陰性。対象国DRCでの実発生状況の詳細情報が不足しているため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: IHR基準4つすべて該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も3つ該当しているため通常はPICKUPとなる。しかし、台湾での確定患者がなく、記事の主要内容は「台湾での輸入症例の監視・管理」であり、DRCでの実際のエボラ発生の詳細（患者数、死亡数、伝播状況など）が記事に記載されていない。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。ウガンダ（226074）は対象国外のため除外。台湾（1668284）は対象国外のため除外。記事サマリーは台湾の防疫措置に焦点があり、DRC側の発生状況の詳細が不明であるため、WATCHとした。フルRRA前に、DRC及びウガンダでの現地の流行状況に関する続報を求める必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 麻疹境外移入釀本土群聚！外籍女傳染給同住男友 疾管署急匡491人
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Imported measles from abroad triggers domestic cluster! A foreign woman infected her cohabiting boyfriend; Taiwan CDC urgently traces 491 people.
article.articleSummary: Measles imported from abroad triggers a domestic cluster in Taiwan: a foreign woman in her 30s traveling to Taiwan in mid-May contracted measles and transmitted it to her cohabiting male in his 20s. Two cases confirmed; 491 contacts monitored through June 16. The index case developed fever, cough, runny nose, sore throat, and rash on day 3 after arrival, was lab-confirmed and isolated; the second case developed cough, fever, and rash in late May and is local transmission. Measles is highly contagious via airborne spread and infectious around rash onset; 5–10% develop complications such as otitis media, pneumonia, or encephalitis, especially in infants and the immunocompromised. Taiwan has 11 measles cases this year (ages <1–50s): 3 locally acquired, 8 imported from Vietnam, Malaysia, USA, India, Indonesia, Kyrgyzstan, Japan, and Thailand. Globally, Japan reports 511 cases; Bangladesh exceeds 70,000 cases and 585 deaths; outbreaks persist in Vietnam, Indonesia, Thailand exporting cases.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹境外移入釀本土群聚！外籍女傳染給同住男友 疾管署急匡491人
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上に該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外な国内群発、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準も全項目該当。対象国複数で実際の群発事例として重要。
triage.notes: 台湾（中国）での麻疹国内群発事例。輸入症例（外籍女性、30代）から地域内2次感染。491人の接触者監視中。グローバルレベルでは日本511例、バングラデシュ70,000例超・585人死亡との記載あり。対象国リスト内ではベトナム、インドネシア、タイ、インドが確認された輸入源。香港・マカオ記事ではないため、台湾（China ID 1814991）は別扱い。

article.articleHeadline: India's new travel advisory on Ebola: These passengers should isolate; helpline number
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-02, India’s Ministry of Health and Family Welfare issued a fresh Ebola travel advisory, stating there are no confirmed Ebola cases in India. Passengers who have travelled to Ebola-affected countries and develop fever, headache, muscle pain, vomiting, diarrhoea, or unexplained bleeding within the last 21 days should isolate themselves and inform local health authorities. A helpline is available at 1075. The advisory also cautions avoiding travel to the Democratic Republic of the Congo (epicentre), Uganda, and South Sudan. The World Health Organization has declared Ebola a public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC). Separately, tensions in Kenya over a US quarantine facility at a military base in Nanyuki have led to two deaths, with President William Ruto defending the plan amid local fears of virus exposure and calls to host the centre for US citizens.

triage.headline_ja: インドのエボラに関する新しい渡航勧告：これらの乗客は隔離すべき；ヘルプライン番号
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHOがPHEIC宣言済みのエボラで、複数国での発生と国際的な対応が進行中。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはインドの渡航勧告発出を報じており、インドでの確認患者はないが、DRCが流行の中心地と明記。ケニアの米国隔離施設巡る緊張も記載されるが、ケニアは対象国外のため除外。スーダンはサマリーに「South Sudan」として言及されるが、対象国リストに含まれず除外。WHOのPHEIC宣言によりIHR基準の深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクすべてが満たされ、複数のWPRO基準も該当するため、フルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Amid Ebola, Hantavirus outbreaks, Democrats decry Trump's health cuts - NJTODAY.NET
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-02, hantavirus outbreaks prompted U.S. quarantines and exposure monitoring after the MV Hondius cruise ship, which departed Argentina on April 1 with ~150 aboard, reported its first cases on May 2. Eleven infections have been recorded, with three deaths to date; the Andes virus, though typically rodent-borne, can spread person-to-person. Separately, an Ebola outbreak in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo has grown to over 1,000 suspected cases, caused by the Bundibugyo strain with no proven vaccines or treatments. Seven Americans evacuated to Germany for treatment; no U.S. cases confirmed. Democrats use these outbreaks to criticize Trump administration health cuts and DOGE reforms, urging rejoining the WHO and restoring funding to CDC, FDA, and USAID amid strained public health infrastructure.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱とハンタウイルス感染症アウトブレイク、民主党がトランプ政権の保健予算削減を批判
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な同時多発、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の可能性）。エボラは1,000件以上の疑い例、複数国での流行拡大、ハンタウイルスは船舶での人人感染クラスター。
triage.notes: 記事ではウガンダのエボラアウトブレイクに言及していますが、対象国リストに含まれていないためverified_locationsに含めていません。DRCは対象国として含めました。ハンタウイルスはアルゼンチンの船舶由来（非対象国）、米国での隔離対応。エボラはDRCとウガンダの境界地域での流行と推定されます。

article.articleHeadline: 國內爆麻疹群聚！移入病例傳染同住男友人 緊急匡列接觸者491人監測
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Domestic measles outbreak clusters! Imported case infects his cohabiting male partner; 491 contacts placed under urgent surveillance.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak clusters in Taiwan: As of June 2, 2026, a domestic cluster linked to a Thailand-imported case has 491 contacts under surveillance through June 16. Two confirmed domestic cases: Case 1 is a 30-something foreign national woman who arrived in Taiwan three days before fever, cough, runny nose and rash; she was confirmed after seeking care. Case 2 is a man in his 20s in northern Taiwan, onset May 26 with fever, headache and rash; diagnosed after active surveillance and is a cohabitant of Case 1. The year’s total is 11 confirmed cases, with 8 imported and 3 domestically acquired (one under monitoring). Globally, measles remains active: Japan has 511 cases this year (Tokyo, Kanagawa, Saitama); Bangladesh (Dhaka) reports about 79,936 cases and 9,049 confirmed with 585 deaths, with Southeast Asia also exporting cases. Vaccination remains the main preventive measure; Taiwan has ample publicly funded MMR stock, and adults born since 1966 are advised to consider MMR vaccination before travel.

triage.headline_ja: 国内で麻疹クラスター爆発！輸入症例が同居男友人に感染、491人の接触者が緊急監視対象に
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の国内クラスター発生であり、IHR基準の異常性・予想外性と国際的拡大リスク、及びWPRO基準の異常性・流行可能性が確認される。複数国での同時活動報告があり、シグナルとしてピックアップが必要。
triage.notes: 台湾での麻疹国内クラスター（491人の接触者監視）、タイからの輸入症例による感染確認。同地域ではバングラデシュで大規模流行（約79,936症例、585死亡）、日本でも511症例報告と、複数国での同時活動を確認。ヒト-ヒト感染可能で、国際的な拡大リスク高い。

article.articleHeadline: Mueren 2 personas en protesta en país africano contra plan de EE.UU. sobre expuestos al ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two people die in protest in an African country against a U.S. plan for people exposed to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Two people died in central Kenya on Monday, June 1, 2026, during protests against U.S. plans to install an Ebola quarantine center at a local military base. The organizers, led by Patrick Wahome, and Reuters, citing a security source, reported the fatalities in Nanyuki, Laikipia County. The proposal envisions a quarantine facility within the Laikipia-based military installation to hold potentially exposed U.S. citizens, with capacity for up to 50 patients. The move is set against a backdrop of a growing Ebola outbreak on the African continent, centered in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The development underscores local resistance to foreign-led containment measures amid concerns about safety, sovereignty, and the handling of an outbreak that is stressing regional health systems.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ国でエボラ曝露者に対する米国計画に抗議する集会で2人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱という高リスク疾患の発生に関連する事象であり、IHR基準において異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクが認められ、WPROスクリーニング基準では異常性・管理可能性（地域の容量不足）が認められる。DRCでの流行発生に加え、ケニアでの関連緊張が報告されており、シグナルとしてピックアップ対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはケニアでの抗議事象を主題としているが、感染症イベント自体はDRCでのエボラ流行に関連している。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。エボラ出血熱の国際的拡大リスクと米国・アフリカ間の国際的関心が高い事象として位置付けられる。

article.articleHeadline: 快新聞／今年已釀1死4重症！腸病毒疫情持續升溫　疾管署籲：正確洗手、加強清消 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Breaking News: This year has already claimed one death and four in critical condition! The enterovirus outbreak continues to rise; CDC urges proper handwashing and enhanced cleaning and disinfection - Minshi News Network.
article.articleSummary: {"description":"Taiwan reports rising enterovirus infections with four confirmed severe cases, including one death, this year. In Week 21 (May 24–30), emergency and urgent-care visits reached 5,573, up 8.2% from the previous week, with transmission concentrated in schools, after-school programs, nurseries, and indoor play areas. Laboratory surveillance shows Coxsackie A6 as the predominant strain, followed by Coxsackie A4 and Enterovirus D68. The four severe infections comprise two D68, one A4, and one A16. Neighboring countries also report increases: Vietnam (Ho Chi Minh City region) tops 34,400 cases by April, mainly EV71 with deaths; China over 200,000 cases by mid-May, led by A16; Thailand 12,542 cases. Emphasized measures: correct handwashing and environmental disinfection; alcohol sanitizers are less effective. Use 500 ppm chlorine solution for routine cleaning, 1000 ppm for contaminated areas, with 10 minutes contact. Watch for signs in children under 5; seek care at a large hospital; hotline 1922."}

triage.headline_ja: 速報：今年すでに1人死亡、4人が重症に！腸病毒疫情が続く上昇　疾管署が呼びかけ：正確な手洗い、清掃と消毒の強化
triage.triage_reason: 複数国での腸病毒の同時多発的流行（台湾、ベトナム、中国、タイで報告）、死亡例を含む重症例の発生、学校・保育施設での集団感染の可能性により、IHR基準2項目以上（異常性、国際的拡大リスク）と複数のWPRO基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 台湾を主な発生地とするが、対象国リストに台湾は含まれていないため除外。ベトナム（ホーチミン市で34,400例以上、EV71主流、死亡例あり）、中国（5月中旬までに20万例以上、A16主流）、タイ（12,542例）と広域での流行が確認されている。複数株の同時流行（A4、A6、A16、D68、EV71）と学校等での感染の集中報告から、WPRO全5項目該当。

article.articleHeadline: 技能競賽餐點34人食物中毒 便當店負責人判刑確定
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Food poisoning of 34 people from meals at a skills competition; bento shop owner sentenced, sentence upheld.
article.articleSummary: Salmonella food poisoning linked to meals from Zhengfulong Bento, Baiyun Market’s founding shop in Xizhi District, New Taipei City, occurred after the 50th National Skills Competition in 2020. The caterer provided 75 bento meals to teachers and staff; 34 people developed fever, vomiting, and diarrhea. Stool tests were positive for Salmonella, leading to diagnoses of acute gastroenteritis and colitis. Investigations by New Taipei City Health Department found multiple sanitary deficiencies. Lin, founder/operator of the shop, was charged under the Food Safety and Health Management Act for negligent food safety violations causing harm to health. He contended that ingredients were purchased on the day and that over 100 other identical bentos were sold without reported illnesses. Shilin District Court sentenced him to four months in prison, with the option of a fine. On appeal, the High Court upheld the verdict; the case is final as of June 2, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 技能競賽の食事で34人が食中毒 弁当店責任者に判刑確定
triage.triage_reason: 2020年に発生した過去のサルモネラ食中毒事案であり、2026年6月時点では司法判断の確定報道。現在の感染症危機ではなく、病原体の継続的拡大リスク、国際的波及、管理上の支援必要性も認められない。
triage.notes: 本件は2020年に発生した限定的な食中毒集団事例の法的決着を報道するもの。現在進行形の感染症イベントではなく、台湾（対象国外）での過去事案である。病原体の継続流行、国境を越えた拡大、対応における支援必要性は認められない。よってシグナルとしてはピックアップしない。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉4人疫區返台「1人發燒檢驗陰性」　漢他郵輪紐籍客6/7出關
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Four Ebola-affected-area returnees to Taiwan; one fever tested negative—New Zealand-national passenger on the Hanta Cruise cleared on June 7
article.articleSummary: Four Taiwanese nationals returning from Ebola-affected areas in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda are under self-health management; one developed fever but Ebola virus testing was negative, excluding infection. Taiwan’s CDC had raised the travel advisory for both DRC and Uganda to Level 3 Warning, enforcing 21 days of self-health management for entrants with travel history, and on May 29 announced a 90-day entry ban for residents from these two countries, the first such precaution since border reopening. The four returnees include two from Uganda and two from the DRC, traveling for work or tourism; the febrile case prompted hospital transfer and laboratory testing, all negative for Ebola. Officials note malaria and other endemic illnesses during the rainy season can mimic Ebola, complicating early diagnosis. Separately, a New Zealand national aboard the Hanta Cruise is under enhanced self-health management; after two negative blood tests and 38 days since exposure, the 42-day monitoring ends June 7.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ警戒地域からの帰台者4人「1人が発熱、検査陰性」—ハンタウイルス邦船ニュージーランド籍客6/7に隔離解除
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。対象地域（DRC、ウガンダ）での高リスク疾患（エボラ）の国境越えイベントであり、各国が公式対応を実施している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは台湾への帰台者（DRC、ウガンダ発）とニュージーランド国籍者の事例を報告している。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ニュージーランドはハンタウイルス関連で言及されているが、サマリーの主題は帰台者（台湾側）の対応であり、ニュージーランドは二次的な記載。Taiwan（対象国リストなし）が管轄地域であるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。複数の高リスク疾患（エボラ、ハンタウイルス、マラリア）が関連しており、クルーズ船での長期曝露リスクも存在する。

article.articleHeadline: 麻疹疫情拉警報！境外移入病例引爆本土感染　疾管署急匡列491人
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles outbreak triggers alarm! Imported cases ignite local transmission; the CDC urgently identifies 491 people for contact tracing.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan’s CDC reports a measles cluster triggered by an imported case. The first case is a foreign woman who arrived in mid-May; within days she developed fever, cough, runny nose and rash, was diagnosed and isolated. The second is a man in his 20s who is a household contact; he developed similar symptoms and was confirmed. The cluster comprises two cases. A total of 491 contacts have been identified and will be monitored through June 16. This year Taiwan has 11 measles cases: 3 domestic, 8 imported from Vietnam, Malaysia, United States, India, Indonesia, Kyrgyzstan, Japan and Thailand. Globally, Japan reports 511 cases; Bangladesh over 70,000 cases and 585 deaths since March; transmission continues in Indonesia, Vietnam and Thailand. Measles is highly contagious; suspected cases should wear masks and contact health authorities. Vaccination: those born after 1966 or traveling to outbreak areas should receive MMR 2–4 weeks before travel.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹疫情拉警報！境外移入病例引爆本土感染　疾管署急匡列491人
triage.triage_reason: 複数の対象国（台湾/中国、ベトナム、インドネシア、タイ、インド）で麻疹の活発な流行が確認されており、IHR基準3つ以上該当。特に公衆衛生への深刻な影響（バングラデシュで7万例以上・585死亡）、国際的拡大リスク、異常性が明確。
triage.notes: 台湾の記事ですが、台湾は中国（GeoNames ID 1814991）に含まれるため China として verified_locations に記載。バングラデシュの深刻な流行（70,000以上の症例、585死亡）が言及されているが、バングラデシュは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。複数国での流行リンク、491人の接触者監視、高い感染性により WPRO 基準5つすべてに該当。フルRRA推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Leptospirosis di Bantul Capai 123 Orang, Enam Meninggal Dunia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Leptospirosis cases in Bantul reach 123 people, six dead.
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis in Bantul Regency, Yogyakarta, Indonesia, totaled 123 cases from January to May 30, 2026, with six deaths—largely linked to delayed treatment and comorbidities. The disease, caused by Leptospira and shed in infected animal urine, enters humans via wounds or mucous membranes after contact with contaminated water or soil. RSUD Saras Adyatma Bantul reported 49 laboratory-confirmed cases under care by end-May, along with six suspected and one probable. Among confirmed cases, four deaths occurred (two from Bambanglipuro, one from Imogiri, one from Sanden). Most patients are farmers; others include students, traders, and a member of the TNI. Across Bantul’s 17 kapanewon, highest counts were Bantul district 16, Kasihan 15, Pandak 14, Sewon 10; others 2–9. Early symptoms include high fever, chills, muscle pain, red eyes, and fatigue; severe disease can cause kidney failure, anemia, and septic shock. Preventive measures: PPE, wound protection, avoiding standing water, rodent control, and secure storage of food and waste.

triage.headline_ja: バンツール地域のレプトスピラ症患者が123人に達する、6人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・ヨグヤカルタ州バンツール地域でレプトスピラ症の集団発生が報告され、2026年5月末までに123例、6死亡が記録されている。重症度（死亡例）、異常性、および対象国での発生という点で複数のスクリーニング基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが Sierra Leone (Northern Province) を発生地域として含めているが、記事サマリーには該当国への言及がなく、実際の発生地はインドネシア・ヨグヤカルタ州のバンツール地域である。Sierra Leone は verified_locations から除外した。レプトスピラ症は環境・動物・人間に影響するズーノーシスであり、接触性水系感染症として対象国での管理可能性評価は不明だが、すでに複数死亡例と複数地区への拡がりが報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ngăn chặn dịch Ebola xâm nhập vào Việt Nam qua đường hàng không
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Preventing the Ebola outbreak from entering Vietnam via air travel.
article.articleSummary: On June 2, 2026, Vietnam's Civil Aviation Authority issued directives to prevent Ebola from entering Vietnam by air. The order mandates strict adherence to prevention protocols, early detection of suspected cases, isolation, and monitoring, with airport authorities stepping up screening of passengers from Ebola-affected regions and ready to isolate and trace contacts. It requires coordination with the Ministry of Health and other agencies to inspect, detect, and respond to imported infections and to disseminate procedures to all airport units. The measures come as Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda raise international concern; WHO reports 906 suspected cases and 223 deaths in the DRC, while the DRC's Ministry of Information confirms 282 confirmed cases, including 42 deaths; Uganda reports 9 infections and 1 death. Vietnam has not recorded any Ebola cases, but the Ministry of Health urges heightened entry surveillance, especially for travelers from affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムへのエボラウイルス流行の航空路由での侵入防止
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの国際的拡大リスク（DRC・ウガンダでの継続的流行）に対して、ベトナムが積極的な国境検疫措置を実施する関連情報である。IHR基準では異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限が該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準では長期曝露・流行しやすさ・管理可能性が該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はベトナムの防止措置であり、DRCとウガンダでの流行を背景としている。Uganda（226074）は対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。DRCはWHOが906疑似症例、223死亡を報告し、ウガンダは9感染、1死亡と記載されており、継続的な流行が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: Hónapokig terjedhetett észrevétlenül a halálos vírus: a szakértők attól félnek, megismétlődik a korábbi rémálom
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The deadly virus could have spread unnoticed for months: experts fear that the previous nightmare will repeat itself.
article.articleSummary: Deadly Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo likely far more severe than official figures indicate, per the International Rescue Committee (IRC). Health ministry data show over 1,000 suspected cases and more than 200 estimated deaths, while official totals stand at 282 confirmed infections and 42 deaths. The IRC warns the virus could have circulated undetected for up to three months before the May official confirmation. Only about 20% of potential cases are being traced, hindering isolation of new transmission chains. Uganda reports nine travel-associated cases and one death; risk of spread to Burundi and South Sudan is acknowledged. Diagnostic stockouts slow confirmation of cases. At least six health workers have died, including two doctors recently, and people are increasingly avoiding health facilities, pushing care into communities. The outbreak involves Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no licensed vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: 致命的なウイルスが数ヶ月間気付かれないまま拡大した可能性：専門家は過去の悪夢の再現を懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス疾患の大規模流行で、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、複数国への国際的拡大、高い死亡率と医療施設回避による管理困難性が確認される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）のエボラ流行。ウガンダは旅行関連の二次症例（9例）を報告しているが、発生地域は記載されていない。ブルンジとスーダンは「拡大リスク」として言及されているが、確認された流行地域ではない。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみ。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ワクチンなし）、実際の患者数が公式数より大幅に過小報告されている可能性、3ヶ月間未検出の流行、医療施設の利用回避による追跡困難という、極めて高いリスク要因が複数存在。

article.articleHeadline: Đồng Tháp kiểm soát tốt dịch sốt xuất huyết Dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dong Thap Province effectively controls the Dengue fever outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Dong Thap Province reports effective control of a dengue fever outbreak in 2026. By May 17, the province recorded over 3,400 dengue cases, with 88 severe cases and 1 death, and roughly 1,700 outbreak clusters. The Department of Health attributes progress to continuous disease surveillance, timely implementation of larval source reduction campaigns and chemical insecticide spraying to contain clusters, and strengthened health education and patient care capacity at medical facilities. Local authorities, youth unions, women's associations, farmers’ associations, health collaborators, and broad community participation have boosted mobilization. On June 2, the province held an ASEAN Dengue Day rally, both in-person and online, across 102 commune/ward venues. ASEAN Dengue Day, selected by 10 ASEAN member states and the World Health Organization, is observed on June 15 annually to combat dengue. The article underscores ongoing measures to sustain control.

triage.headline_ja: ドンタップ省がデング熱の流行を効果的に抑制
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでのデング熱流行は局地的には管理されている状況だが、3,400例以上の確定例と88例の重症例、1例の死亡が報告されており、継続的な監視が必要。情報は限定的だが、地域レベルの対応状況を示しており、経過観察に値する。
triage.notes: ドンタップ省は6月2日にASEANデング熱デーのイベントを開催しており、政府機関および地域社会の関心が高い。ただし、記事は流行の『効果的な抑制』を強調しており、国際的な広がりや渡航・貿易制限のリスクは示唆されていない。デング熱は季節性疾患であり、流行の報告自体は非典型的ではない。フルRRA前の継続的な監視推奨。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Moderna dostanie 50 mln dol. na szczepionkę przeciw eboli Bundibugyo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Moderna will receive $50 million for the Bundibugyo ebolavirus vaccine.
article.articleSummary: CEPI will fund Moderna with $50 million to advance Bundibugyo ebolavirus vaccine development, supporting preclinical work, a Phase 1 trial, and scaled manufacturing to prepare for Phase 2/3 if early results are favorable. The candidate uses Moderna’s mRNA platform, previously employed for COVID-19 vaccines. CEPI also channels funds to two other groups: $3.2 million to the International AIDS Vaccine Initiative for a vaccine using the same technology as Merck’s Ervebo, and $8.6 million to the University of Oxford and Serum Institute of India for an adenoviral-based vaccine. No vaccines or therapies are licensed for Bundibugyo ebolavirus yet; two vaccines exist for the Zaire ebolavirus. The ongoing outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is complicated by conflict and high population movement. WHO reports 1,041 cases (135 confirmed, 906 suspected) and 241 deaths (18 confirmed, 223 suspected) as of June 2026.

triage.headline_ja: Modernaが50百万ドルのブンディブギョエボラウイルスワクチン開発資金を獲得
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19として分類されているが、サマリーはBundibugyo ebolavirus（エボラウイルス）の集団発生と新規ワクチン開発支援について述べている。DRCでの進行中の集団発生（1,041症例、241死亡）、高い重症度、国際的関心があり、IHR基準および社会的関心を満たす。
triage.notes: 疾患カテゴリが『COVID-19』として誤分類されている。記事サマリーはBundibugyo ebolavirus（Zaire ebolavirus ではない稀なエボラ種）の集団発生と新規ワクチン開発プログラムについて述べている。DRCでの集団発生は紛争と高い人口移動により複雑化しており、WHO公式報告がある。Bluedot API の地域フィールドに UK が含まれているが、サマリー上でイベント発生地はDRCのみ。India および UK は対象国リストに含まれるが、記事サマリーではワクチン開発資金配分先（IAVI、Oxford、Serum Institute of India）として言及されているのであり、実際の集団発生地ではない。よって verified_locations は DRC のみ。

locations.name: Independent State of Papua New Guinea
United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Anh đầu tư hàng chục triệu USD vào Đông Nam Á để phòng chống đại dịch mới
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Britain Invests Tens of Millions of USD in Southeast Asia to Prevent a New Pandemic
article.articleSummary: Britain has announced a £25 million (about $33.6 million) investment to bolster pandemic preparedness in Southeast Asia, as the UK reduces its foreign aid budget. The Health Security Partnership Programme with ASEAN emphasizes early detection, containment, and rapid response. Twenty initial grants worth about £7.5 million fund remote-area disease surveillance, training of diagnostic scientists, and tabletop outbreak drills; Sheffield University and Hilleman Laboratories will establish vaccine-manufacturing training. The operation rests with the Regional Public Health Laboratory Network (RPHL), launched in 2019 and spanning 11 ASEAN states plus Pakistan, Nepal and Papua New Guinea, which receives £1.5 million to train experts, strengthen biosafety standards, and broaden regional cooperation. The push addresses rising zoonotic risk from deforestation, urbanization, and wildlife trade, with ~66,000 annual human infections from animal SARS-like viruses. A SARS-CoV-2–like bat virus near Bangkok and Nipah virus (up to 75% mortality) underscore the need for system-wide preparedness rather than disease-by-disease responses.

triage.headline_ja: イギリスが新型パンデミック対策としてアジア太平洋地域に数千万ドルを投資
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルスは高い致死率を持つシグナルダイジェストであるが、本記事は資金投資・能力構築プログラムの発表であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイク報告ではない。情報不足により詳細なリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は感染症検知システムの国際的なキャパシティビルディング投資に関する発表であり、実際のアウトブレイク警告ではない。バンコク近郊でSARS-CoV-2類似のコウモリウイルスとニパウイルスの存在が言及されているが、これは潜在的リスク評価の文脈であり、進行中のアウトブレイク報告ではない。パキスタンとネパルが地域ネットワークに含まれているが、記事サマリー上での主題はタイおよび東南アジア地域でのシステム構築であり、パキスタンとネパルは verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: 國內腸病毒疫情升溫 越南疫情暴增2.5倍 疾管署：暑假出國罹病風險增
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Domestic enterovirus outbreak intensifies; Vietnam outbreak surges 2.5-fold; Taiwan CDC: Risk of illness when traveling abroad during summer vacation increases.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports rising domestic enterovirus activity, with 5,573 outpatient visits last week, not yet at epidemic threshold but climbing. Predominant strains are Coxsackievirus A6, followed by Coxsackie A4 and enterovirus D68. The CDC notes four severe enterovirus cases in Taiwan this year—two EV-D68, one Coxsackie A4, and one Coxsackie A16—with one Coxsackie A4 patient dying. Although severe cases are fewer than last year, they exceed 2022–2024 levels. International surveillance centers on Vietnam, where more than 34,000 cases and 8 deaths occurred in the first four months, a 2.5-fold increase year over year; over 90% of patients are aged 1–5. Ho Chi Minh City remains hotspots; EV71 genotype C1 accounts for more than half of cases. Vietnam’s outbreak follows a three-year cycle; broader regional activity includes China (>200,000), Thailand (>12,000), and rising cases in Japan, South Korea, Singapore, and Hong Kong. Taiwan also cautions travelers about illness risk abroad this summer.

triage.headline_ja: 国内腸病毒疫情が悪化 ベトナム疫情2.5倍増加 台湾疾管署：夏休みの海外出国時の罹病リスク増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で異常性・予想外性・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクが複数該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度（死亡例あり）、長期曝露（地域流行），流行しやすさ（小児多数感染）が該当。東南アジア・東アジア地域での多国広域流行の兆候あり。
triage.notes: サマリーに基づき、ベトナム（34,000例以上、死亡8例、2.5倍増加）、タイ（12,000例以上）、中国（200,000例以上）での実質的な流行が確認されている。台湾も国内疫情上昇中だが対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。EV71 genotype C1がベトナムで優位。小児（1～5歳）が90%以上を占め、流行しやすい年代。夏休み期間での国際移動による拡大リスク高い。

article.articleHeadline: 해외여행 시 주의...포항시, 에볼라 유입 차단 '방역망 강화' - 내외일보
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Be careful when traveling abroad... Pohang City strengthens quarantine network to prevent Ebola importation.
article.articleSummary: Pohang City tightens quarantine network to prevent Ebola virus disease importation as outbreaks spread in Africa, led by the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. The KDCA raised the risk alert to 'watch' and designated DR Congo, Uganda, South Sudan, Ethiopia, and Rwanda as focused quarantine regions, tightening border screening. A May 28 infection assessment discussed measures to prevent domestic introduction. Ebola virus disease spreads via contact with blood or body fluids of infected people or animals; symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pain, vomiting, and diarrhea, with high fatality. Travelers should avoid outbreak countries, wildlife contact, and maintain hand hygiene while minimizing contact with suspected cases. If symptoms appear within 21 days of return, consult KDCA call center or local health center before care. Nam-gu Public Health Center Director Kim Jung-im urged travelers to check outbreak information before travel and cooperate with entry screening. Updates are on KDCA portals.

triage.headline_ja: 海外旅行時に注意...浦項市、エボラ流入遮断『防疫網強化』
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の複数国での流行拡大、国際的な拡大リスク、韓国での防疫強化措置の実施により、IHR基準2つ以上（国際的拡大リスク、異常性）、WPRO基準複数該当のため。
triage.notes: 記事はアフリカにおけるエボラウイルス病の流行、特にDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン、エチオピア、ルワンダでの発生を報道している。韓国（ソウル）はこれら地域からの輸入症例防止のため防疫措置を強化している。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Advisory India: Travel Guidance And Public Health Alerts
article.articleSummary: India's Health Ministry on 2 June issued an Ebola advisory amid a global outbreak, stating there are no confirmed Ebola cases in India to date, while noting a Gujarat case investigated earlier tested negative. Travellers from Ebola-affected countries (DRC, Uganda, South Sudan) should monitor health for 21 days and self-isolate if fever, headache, muscle pain, vomiting, diarrhoea, or unexplained bleeding occur; report to local authorities using helpline 1075. Avoid non-essential travel to DRC, Uganda, South Sudan and keep medical records for contact tracing. WHO recently declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern; about 80 early deaths, rising to over 200 fatalities with 1,077 suspected infections since the start. Congo reopened the eastern province airport as transmission indicators show cautious signs; authorities emphasize surveillance for importation risks.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ勧告インド：渡航ガイダンスと公衆衛生アラート
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的公衆衛生緊急事態（PHEIC）宣言に伴う広域流行であり、IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。インドを含む対象国への輸入リスク管理の政府対応を示す重要なシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはインドの保健省によるエボラ勧告の発出を主題としており、DRCとウガンダ、南スーダンでの流行に対するインドの輸入リスク対応を記述。Bluedot APIの発生地域にはウガンダと南スーダンも含まれているが、これらは記事の主題ではなく、対象国リスト外のため verified_locations から除外した。WHO PHEIC宣言、1,077疑い例、200死亡以上という重症度情報あり。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Menkes Sebut Pasien Hantavirus di RS Sulianti Saroso Sudah Dipulangkan, Pastikan Tak Ada Penularan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Minister says the hantavirus patient at Sulianti Saroso Hospital has been discharged; ensure there is no transmission.
article.articleSummary: UK national with hantavirus discharged from RSPI Sulianti Saroso in Jakarta as of 2 June 2026; the patient had previously stayed on cruise MV Hondius, which experienced a hantavirus outbreak in the Atlantic in April 2026. Health Minister Budi Gunadi Sadikin said Indonesia was informed by the UK government, traced the patient’s activities in Indonesia, and found no secondary transmission after contact tracing. Hantavirus has been detected in Indonesia since the early 2000s, with seroprevalence surveys showing antibodies in Bali around 16%, and 13% in Jakarta and Surabaya, indicating prior exposure but not a new virus. The fatality rate is described as very low. The case is classified as imported; no evidence of further spread within Indonesia has been reported.

triage.headline_ja: 保健大臣がスリアンティ・サロソ病院のハンタウイルス患者はすでに退院したと述べ、感染がないことを確認
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで確認された輸入感染例だが、二次感染なし、患者退院、公衆衛生への深刻な影響は現在のところ限定的。ただしハンタウイルス感染の報道・国際関心があり、今後の展開を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが米国Iowa州と英国を発生地域として含めているが、記事サマリーによれば主要なイベントはインドネシア（ジャカルタ）での患者受け入れと治療に関するもの。患者は英国人で、クルーズ船での曝露は大西洋で発生したが、インドネシアでの二次感染は報告されていない。感染症危機管理では輸入感染例であること、インドネシアでの血清有病率調査で過去の抗体が存在することが重要。現時点では深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威ではないが、情報不足の可能性があり継続監視が適切。

article.articleHeadline: La Línea amenaza con suspender el Congo-Chile si Sanidad no garantiza riesgo cero por el ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: La Línea threatens to suspend Congo-Chile if the Health Ministry does not guarantee zero risk from Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 June 2026, the town hall of La Línea de la Concepción could block the international friendly between the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Chile, set for 9 June at Ciudad de La Línea stadium, unless health authorities provide guarantees of zero risk from the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Mayor Juan Franco said he would issue a decree denying authorization if reports from Sanidad Exterior, the Junta de Andalucía, and the La Línea Hospital do not meet safety thresholds. Authorities are seeking technical assessments on arrival of the Congolese delegation and potential risks to residents and visitors. The Congolese team recently suspended training in Kinshasa and moved to Belgium under a strict health protocol amid ongoing outbreak concerns; Belgium maintains preventive controls as Spain monitors travel and epidemiological evolution.

triage.headline_ja: ラ・リネア、保健省がエボラのリスク ゼロを保証しない場合、コンゴ-チリ戦の中止を脅迫
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生国（DRC）が関連していますが、記事の主体は国際親善試合の開催可否に関する政治的・行政的決定であり、感染症の実際の発生拡大ではありません。エボラ爆発はDRCに限定され、スペイン到着のリスク評価段階です。情報不足のため経過観察が必要です。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ爆発を背景としていますが、主な関心事はスペイン・アンダルシア州での国際試合開催可否です。DRC内での実際の感染事例数、死亡者数、拡大状況に関する具体的情報が記事に記載されていないため、IHRおよびWPRO基準の完全な評価は困難です。続報でDRCでの疫学情報が明らかになった場合、シグナルステータスの更新が必要です。

article.articleHeadline: Prévention d'Ebola : les médias appelés à accompagner la sensibilisation des populations
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Prevention: The Media Urged to Support Public Awareness Campaigns.
article.articleSummary: As of June 2, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports the 17th Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak, declared in May 2026 in Ituri province, caused by the Bundibugyo strain. No vaccine or approved specific therapy exists; several confirmed and suspected cases with a worrisome case-fatality rate. Cases have also appeared in neighboring Uganda, raising cross-border spread concerns amid regional population movements. Chad is strengthening preventive measures, reinforcing epidemiological surveillance at entry points (airports and land borders) with early detection and case management protocols. Public awareness campaigns explain transmission through direct contact with body fluids and risky funeral practices; mobile units and medical teams have been deployed to all entry points, and a 13-13 hotline is active for reporting suspects. WHO representative Dr Anya Blanche lauded collaboration and supplied communication tools; authorities urge calm and reliance on official sources.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ予防：メディアは公衆衛生啓発キャンペーンをサポートするよう促される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の新規発生（Bundibugyo株）、複数国での患者確認、高い致死率、越境拡大リスク、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC（Ituri州）での2026年5月のエボラ発生を主要テーマとしている。隣接国ウガンダでの患者確認と、チャドでの予防強化も述べられているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。WPRO基準5項目すべてに該当し、新規流行（Bundibugyo株）、越境拡大、高い致死率、WHO関与など多角的リスク要因が存在。フルRRA実施が急務。

article.articleHeadline: India Issues Fresh Ebola Advisory; Travellers From Affected Countries Asked To Isolate If Symptoms Develop
article.articleSummary: India issues a fresh Ebola advisory amid ongoing regional outbreaks; as of 2026-06-02, there are no confirmed Ebola cases in India. Travellers who have arrived from or transited through Ebola-affected countries within the last 21 days should remain vigilant and isolate if they develop symptoms. Symptoms to watch: fever, headache, muscle pain, vomiting, diarrhoea, or unexplained bleeding; seek medical care and inform local authorities immediately. The national helpline 1075 is available for guidance. A recent suspected case in Gujarat-traveller returning from the Democratic Republic of Congo-tested negative; state officials urged calm. Countries under watch include the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan. Globally, hundreds of suspected and confirmed cases have been reported; WHO classifies the outbreak as a significant international public health concern, with emphasis on contact tracing, testing and surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: インドが新たなエボラ警告を発表、影響を受けた国からの旅行者に症状が出た場合は隔離するよう要請
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準4つ以上該当、社会的・政治的関心が高い。複数国での進行中の流行に対する各国の対応を示すシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事はインドの公式警告と地域流行への対応を述べている。グジャラート州の疑い症例は陰性であったが、DRC、ウガンダ、スーダンでの進行中の流行が背景。WHO分類による重大な国際公衆衛生上の懸念として認識されている。ウガンダとスーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Deadly violence erupts in Kenya as Trump admin orders Ebola quarantine for Americans
article.articleSummary: Two people were killed in central Kenya’s Nanyuki area near Laikipia Air Base as protests erupted over a U.S.-backed Ebola quarantine facility. Kenyan authorities approved a Trump-admin request to establish a quarantine site for Americans potentially exposed to Ebola amid a growing Central Africa outbreak, fueling fears Kenya would become a holding zone for imported cases. President William Ruto defended the plan as part of national emergency preparedness, noting existing centers nationwide and that the facility could serve Kenyans if needed. The Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda report a deadly Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak, with 48 deaths and WHO declaring an international public health emergency. Courts briefly halted the project; a Kenyan judge suspended it earlier. U.S. C-130 flights were spotted in Nanyuki, and border screening is intensified, with about 3,000 people screened daily. No Ebola cases detected in Kenya.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで暴力事件が勃発、トランプ政権がアメリカ人向けのエボラ隔離命令を発出
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。DRCおよびウガンダで確認されたBundibugyo Eボラアウトブレイク（死者48名、WHO国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言済み）に加え、ケニアが隔離施設の設置地となることで地域的波及リスクが顕在化。社会政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ケニア領内での実際のエボラ感染者は未検出だが、DRC・ウガンダの48死亡例を伴うBundibugyo Eボラアウトブレイクが進行中。ケニアは隔離施設設置場所として国際的関心が集中しており、社会政治的緊張が高い。本評価では対象国リスト外のケニアでの隔離施設設置自体は verified_locations に含めず、実際のアウトブレイク発生国（DRC、Uganda）のみを計上。

article.articleHeadline: Pemkot: Ada 105 kasus cacing hati pada hewan kurban di Mataram
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mataram City Government: 105 cases of liver fluke in sacrificial animals.
article.articleSummary: 105 Fascioliasis (liver fluke) cases were detected in cattle during Eid al-Adha 1447 Hijriah/2026 in Mataram City, West Nusa Tenggara (NTB), Indonesia, with one hepatic cyst case. The data, collected across six districts at 225 slaughter points, involve 2,865 animals: 1,150 cattle and 1,715 goats. Cases likely linked to feeding practices and pen cleanliness, including dew-wet morning grass. In response, inspectors remove contaminated liver portions: liver segments with parasites are discarded or destroyed, and whole livers are discarded if hepatic cysts are present. Healthy meat and other organs remain within ASUH (Safe, Healthy, Whole, Halal) guidelines for distribution. Surveillance covers Eid al-Adha and the following three days, with emphasis on hygiene and feed management to prevent transmission.

triage.headline_ja: マタラム市政府：犠牲祭の動物105頭に肝吸虫症を検出
triage.triage_reason: 動物での食媒介感染症検出で公衆衛生上の関心がありますが、人間への感染報告がなく、管理措置が実施されているため、継続観察対象としました。
triage.notes: 本イベントは動物での肝吸虫症検出であり、人間への感染例は報告されていません。インドネシア当局は流通段階での感染臓器の除去により管理措置を実施しており、すぐさまフルRRA対象とはなりませんが、食媒介感染経路の監視の観点から経過観察を推奨します。

article.articleHeadline: कोरोना वैक्सीन के बाद Ebola वायरस की दवाई बनाएगी भारतीय कंपनी, अब तक 200 से ज्यादा मौतें और 900 बीमार
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An Indian company will develop a drug for the Ebola virus after the COVID-19 vaccine, with more than 200 deaths and 900 sick so far.
article.articleSummary: Eastern Africa’s Bundibugyo-strain Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda has reached 321 cases with 48 deaths and about 1,100 suspected, across three provinces, prompting WHO to declare a public health emergency. CEPI has allocated about $60 million to vaccine development involving Moderna, Oxford University, and IAVI. Moderna receives up to $50 million for early clinical testing and manufacturing; Oxford University and Serum Institute of India are funded with $8.6 million for a ChAdOx1 Bundibugyo vaccine based on the COVID-19 platform; IAVI is allotted $3.2 million initially for a single-dose vaccine using a proven approach similar to Merck’s Ervebo. Animal data are encouraging, though field trials in eastern Congo will be logistically challenging. Gavi pledges $50 million and the World Bank Pandemic Fund provides $220.6 million to strengthen access and health systems in affected regions, including India’s SII involvement.

triage.headline_ja: コロナワクチンに続きエボラウイルス治療薬を開発する同国の企業、現在までに200人以上の死者と900人の患者
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常なエボラ多国発生、国際的拡大リスク、国際支援展開）。WHO公式に公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言済み。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC及びウガンダでのエボラ（Bundibugyo株）発生が主題。インドはワクチン開発に参加する役割として言及。ウガンダ（対象国外）での発生報告があるが、verified_locationsには記事関連性の高いDRCとインドのみを含める。WHO公式に公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）宣言済みのため、国際的対応が既に進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Ebola : Tshisekedi et le patron de l'OMS passent en revue la riposte contre la souche Bundibugyo | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Ebola: Tshisekedi and the head of the WHO review the response to the Bundibugyo strain | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: June 1, 2026, WHO DG Tedros and DR Congo President Tshisekedi reviewed the Ebola virus disease outbreak caused by Bundibugyo strain in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. Two advances were announced: the recovery of five initial patients—health workers, including a woman—treated at Bunia Centre Médical Évangélique (CME) with optimized symptomatic care; and the construction of a 60-bed Ebola Treatment Center in Bunia, Ituri. These recoveries signal progress and help counter myths about treatment centers. Tedros highlighted DR Congo’s experience from 17 Ebola outbreaks since 1976 and criticized travel restrictions that hinder rapid epidemiological information sharing. The national response emphasizes strengthened surveillance, rigorous contact tracing, delivery of protective equipment and medical supplies to affected areas, and community engagement to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：ツィセケディ大統領とWHO事務局長がブンディブギョ株への対応を検討
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス疾患の発生はIHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生への影響と国際的な懸念が該当し（2つ以上），WPROスクリーニングでも異常性・重症度・流行性が認められる。DRC政府とWHOが協調対応しており，社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株によるエボラ疾患流行が発生地域（イトゥリ，北キブ，南キブ州）で確認。DRC政府とWHO（テドロス事務局長）が対応を協議し，ブニアのCMEで初期患者5名の回復を報告。60床規模の治療センター建設予定。航空旅行制限への懸念も表明されており，国際的な注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 國內爆「麻疹群聚」！491名接觸者遭匡列 疾管署急示警：有這些症狀要提高警覺
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles cluster outbreak in the country! 491 contacts traced; Taiwan CDC urgently warns: be vigilant for these symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan CDC reports a new overseas-imported measles cluster, bringing this year’s domestic cases to 11 (3 domestic, 8 imported), with origins in Vietnam, Malaysia, the United States, India, Indonesia, Kyrgyzstan, Japan, and Thailand. A foreign woman in her 30s who visited Taiwan in mid-May developed fever, cough, runny nose, and rash within three days of arrival; measles was lab-confirmed. A northern Taiwan contact, a man in his 20s who shared accommodation, also developed fever, cough, and rash and was confirmed. The cluster now has 2 confirmed cases; 491 contacts have been traced and are under health monitoring through June 16. Measles is highly contagious via airborne transmission; contacts should monitor and seek care if fever, cough, runny nose, conjunctivitis, or rash, wearing a mask and avoiding nonessential clinic visits. Non-compliance with monitoring can incur up to NT$300,000. MMR vaccination remains the most effective prevention; free public MMR is available; those born since 1966 traveling to measles-endemic areas should consider a pre-travel booster 2–4 weeks before departure. Return travelers with symptoms should disclose travel history.

triage.headline_ja: 国内で「麻疹集団発生」！接触者491名が隔離対象 疾管署が緊急警告：これらの症状に注意
triage.triage_reason: 台湾での麻疹集団発生により、複数国での輸入症例が確認されている。麻疹は高い感染性を持つため、国際的な拡大リスクが存在し、IHR基準の「異常/予想外」および「国際的拡大リスク」に該当する。
triage.notes: 台湾での麻疹集団発生は本来対象国外だが、輸入源が対象国（ベトナム、インドネシア、タイ、インド）である点、および高い空気感染性による地域内拡大リスクから、これらの国がverijfied_locationsに含まれる。491名の接触者追跡と監視が実施中。マレーシア、米国、キルギスタン、日本は記事に言及されているが対象国に含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 4台人伊波拉疫區返台 羅一鈞：1人發燒採檢陰性
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Four Taiwanese return to Taiwan from Ebola-affected areas; Luo Yijun: one fever patient tested negative.
article.articleSummary: Ebola prevention in Taiwan: As of 2 June 2026, Taiwan's CDC reports ongoing vigilance over Ebola virus disease linked to outbreaks in Africa. Since 27 May, inbound travellers from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda must undergo self-health management for 21 days. Four Taiwanese nationals have been issued advisory notices—two from Uganda and two from the DRC—currently completing home self-monitoring. One entrant developed a mild fever the day after arrival; he was sent to hospital, tested for Ebola by PCR, and the result was negative; he has been discharged. The DRC outbreak is substantial: 321 confirmed cases, 48 deaths, 6 recovered, with about 220 suspected cases awaiting confirmation as of 31 May. Uganda has 9 confirmed cases and 1 death. From 2 June, Taiwan further suspends entry of residents from both countries for 90 days. Malaria and other infections complicate clinical assessment, underscoring PCR confirmation for Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: 4名の台湾人がエボラ流行地域から台湾に帰国 羅一鈞：1人は発熱しているが検査陰性
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は高い重症度と国際的拡大リスクを持つが、本件は台湾への入国者スクリーニング事例であり、現地での新規感染・流行拡大ではなく、既知の地域流行（DRC・ウガンダ）への対応。IHR基準は2つ以上該当の可能性がありWHO通知相当だが、対象国に台湾は含まれず、DRC・ウガンダも対象外であるため、情報不足を補いつつ経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: Bluedotの発生地域に台湾が含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRC・ウガンダでのエボラ流行であり、台湾は流行地ではなく入国者スクリーニングの対応地である。対象国リストにDRC（203312）、ウガンダは含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準は既知の流行事象で複数該当するが、対象国外のため情報ピックアップ対象外となり、WATCH判定。

article.articleHeadline: 全球麻疹疫情嚴峻 國內現今年第三起境外病例釀本土群聚
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Global measles outbreak is severe; this year's third imported case in the country has triggered a domestic cluster.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports a domestic measles cluster triggered by an imported case, the third such cluster this year. The index case is a foreign woman in her 30s who traveled from Thailand in mid-May; she was lab-confirmed with measles. A northern Taiwan man in his 20s who cohabited with her was identified as a contact; in late May he developed cough, fever and rash and was confirmed. The cluster comprises two cases with 491 contacts identified and monitored through June 16. Taiwan has 11 measles cases this year: 3 domestic infections and 8 imported. Globally, Japan has 511 cases; Bangladesh reports about 9,049 confirmed cases and 585 deaths, with Dhaka most affected. Prevention: MMR vaccination is most effective; adults born after 1966 traveling to endemic regions should consider vaccination 2–4 weeks before travel; contacts should follow health-monitoring notices and seek care promptly if symptoms appear.

triage.headline_ja: グローバル麻疹アウトブレイクが深刻化、国内で今年3番目の輸入病例が国内クラスターを引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響：バングラデシュで9,049症例585死亡；異常性：台湾で3件目の輸入関連クラスター；国際的拡大リスク：複数国での同時発生；渡航制限リスク：グローバルアウトブレイク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、バングラデシュ（9,049症例585死亡）とタイ（輸入源）が対象国リストに該当する実際の発生地。日本は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。台湾も対象国でないため除外（ただし国内クラスターの報告地であり重要）。グローバルな麻疹流行の重要なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Menkes Risiko Penularan Virus Ebola di Indonesia Cukup Rendah
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Minister: Risk of Ebola Virus Transmission in Indonesia Is Quite Low.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 June 2026, Indonesia faces a low risk of Ebola transmission, according to Health Minister Budi Gunadi Sadikin, because Indonesia is not a major international transit hub like Dubai or Singapore. Ebola spreads through direct contact with the body fluids of an infected person or contaminated objects, not via airborne routes. WHO guidance notes high risk in affected areas but very low risk elsewhere, including Indonesia. Nevertheless, authorities have increased vigilance for foreign travelers and Indonesian nationals with travel history from the Democratic Republic of the Congo or other countries with significant Ebola spikes. This follows WHO's 17 May 2026 declaration of Public Health Emergency of International Concern due to the Congo outbreak. Transmission requires contact with blood, saliva, or other body fluids; travelers should follow international health protocols.

triage.headline_ja: 保健大臣：インドネシアにおけるエボラウイルス伝染のリスクはかなり低い
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行は公衆衛生上の重大事象（WHO PHEIC宣言済み）だが、インドネシアでの実際の症例報告はなく、リスク評価段階の情報に留まっている。引き続き動向監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年6月2日のインドネシア当局の声明に基づいており、DRCでのエボラ流行（WHO PHEIC宣言：2026年5月17日）への対応状況を述べている。インドネシア国内での症例報告はなく、現在のところリスク評価段階。ただしWHOが国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念を宣言済みであり、また記事が航空網ハブ（ドバイ、シンガポール）経由での国際的な拡大リスクに言及していることから、WATCH段階での継続監視が妥当と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Rritet numri i rasteve dhe vdekjeve nga Ebola në RD të Kongos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola cases and deaths rises in the DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo exceed 300 with 48 deaths as of June 2, 2026, amid a Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak. The transmission covers 23 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with Ituri reporting over 260 confirmed cases. Community resistance in Bunia and the eastern town of Nizi, along with misinformation, is increasingly hindering response efforts. Four patients have recovered and were discharged from the Gospel Medical Center in Bunia. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus concluded his visit after meeting President Felix Tshisekedi to discuss the outbreak response. Authorities and partners have opened a new 60-bed treatment center in Bunia and are conducting vaccine testing. Bunia airport has reopened for humanitarian flights following installation of monitoring equipment. The outbreak was declared on May 15.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラウイルス感染者と死亡者の数が増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラは致命的な感染症であり、すでに300例以上の患者と48名の死亡者が確認されており、23の保健ゾーンに広がっている。国際的な関心と支援が高まっており、WHOのトップレベルの関与があり、フルのリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 進行中のBundibugyo ebolavirus（エボラウイルス属）のアウトブレイク。Ituri州で260例以上の確認患者。コミュニティの抵抗とデマが対応を妨げている。新規治療センター（60床）がブニアで開設され、ワクチンテストが実施中。WHO事務局長が大統領と会談し、対応体制の強化に関与している。2026年5月15日にアウトブレイクが宣言された。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Serum Institute to manufacture Ebola vaccine developed by Oxford University
article.articleSummary: Serum Institute of India (SII) will manufacture clinical-trial doses of an experimental Ebola vaccine developed by the University of Oxford. The Coalition for Epidemic Preparedness Innovations CEPI provides up to $8.6 million to fast-track efforts against the Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in Africa, funding preclinical testing and early-stage development of the vaccine candidate. The announcement signals international collaboration to boost Ebola vaccine readiness, with SII supplying trial-dose manufacturing capacity. No specific case or death counts, laboratory confirmation details, or infection sources are provided in the report. The initiative aims to strengthen outbreak response timing and vaccine development for Bundibugyo ebolavirus in Africa, leveraging the Oxford candidate and CEPI funding.

triage.headline_ja: セラム・インスティテュート・オブ・インディアがオックスフォード大学開発のエボラワクチンを製造
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）のアフリカでの発生が背景にあり、国際的な対応が進行中だが、記事は主にワクチン開発・製造能力構築に焦点を当てており、具体的な患者数や死亡事例の報告がないため、現在の感染症動向そのものについては情報不足。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン開発と製造提携の発表が主題であり、Bundibugyo ebolavirus のアフリカでの実際の発生状況に関する具体的な疫学情報（患者数、死亡数、確認検査結果など）は含まれていない。India（セラム・インスティテュート所在地）が verified_locations として該当。アフリカでの実際の発生地は特定されていないため追加対象国なし。国際的な協力体制の構築と予防接種開発の加速は社会的・政治的関心が高いが、現在の感染症イベントの深刻度や拡大状況については不明な情報が多いため WATCH 判定。

article.articleHeadline: From Check-In to Check-Out -- Thailand's Hotels Keep Visitors Ebola-Safe
article.articleSummary: Thailand's Department of Disease Control (DDC) has rolled out Ebola prevention and surveillance nationwide to reassure travelers. Thai hotels and accommodations are briefed and trained on health surveillance protocols from check-in onward; facilities install hand sanitizer stations, masks on request, and staff trained to respond to health concerns. A dedicated rapid-response specialist team is in place to coordinate medical care when needed, preventing confusion or delays. Intensive disinfection routines cover rooms and high-touch areas to maintain hygiene standards. 24/7 DDC support is available via Hotline 1422 or the DDC website (ddc.moph.go.th) for guidance. The initiative positions Thailand as a safe and prepared destination for travelers, with Ebola-focused measures integrated into hotel operations nationwide.

triage.headline_ja: チェックインからチェックアウトまで――タイのホテルが訪問者をエボラから守る
triage.triage_reason: 記事は予防措置と準備態勢に関する情報提供であり、実際のエボラ症例発生やアウトブレイクを報告していない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はタイの疾病管理局によるエボラ予防策と監視体制の整備に関する広報である。実際の症例報告やアウトブレイクを示す情報は含まれていない。予防措置の実施は公衆衛生当局の適切な対応を示すものであり、シグナルトリアージの対象外である。

article.articleHeadline: India dispatches second tranche of medical aid to Africa CDC to strengthen Ebola response
article.articleSummary: India dispatched the second 43-tonne tranche of medical aid to the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention to strengthen Ebola response capacities across Africa, focusing on the Bundibugyo outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo. This follows the May 24 first tranche of urgent medical supplies and protective kits. The shipment includes protective gear, diagnostic and monitoring equipment, medicines, and nutritional supplements. Africa CDC welcomed the assistance on May 31, and External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar highlighted that the consignment would bolster Ebola response across Africa. The World Health Organization declared the Ebola situation a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. Ebola is transmitted through direct contact with infected bodily fluids, with symptoms ranging from fever and vomiting to diarrhea and severe bleeding. India has pledged ongoing support for Africa's public health response during emergencies.

triage.headline_ja: インドがアフリカCDCに医療支援物資の第2陣を派遣、エボラ対応を強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病のWHO PHEIC宣言（5月17日）に基づく国際的な緊急対応の報道。IHR基準3項目該当（重大な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はコンゴ民主共和国でのBundibugyo型エボラアウトブレイクであり、インドが国際支援を実施している事例。WHOによるPHEIC宣言済み。DRCが対象国に含まれないため、インドのみverified_locationsに含める（インドが医療支援国として主要な役割を果たしている）。ただしDRCの発生状況を記事が述べているため、実際の流行地域の検証が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Çin, Ebola ile Mücadeleye Destek İçin Demokratik Kongo Cumhuriyeti'ne Uzman Ekip Gönderiyor
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China Sends an Expert Team to the Democratic Republic of the Congo to Support the Fight Against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: China dispatches a high-level health-expert team to the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) to support Ebola outbreak response. The deployment follows the WHO's May 17 designation of the Congo Ebola outbreak as a public health emergency of international concern. The new team will join the 24th Chinese health team already in DRC, work with local health and outbreak-control agencies, and strengthen collaboration to help contain the outbreak. They will provide prevention and treatment training to local health facilities, the Chinese health team, the Chinese Embassy, Chinese companies, and Congolese residents. The National Health Commission officials emphasized China's commitment to international cooperation and knowledge exchange. The ongoing emergency-response plan in Congo, including drills, medical-supply logistics, and living-condition improvements, supports frontline clinicians serving both the local population and Chinese nationals.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、エボラ対策支援のためコンゴ民主共和国に専門家チームを派遣
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WHO公式認定のPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）、国際的な支援・協力体制の構築段階。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラ流行はWHOにより2026年5月17日にPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）として公式認定されている。中国からの専門家チーム派遣は国際的な支援体制の強化を示唆する重要なシグナル。記事サマリーの主題はDRCでのエボラ対応であり、中国の支援活動はこのイベントの文脈内。

article.articleHeadline: India Issues Fresh Ebola Advisory, Asks Travellers From Affected Countries To Monitor Symptoms For 21 Days
article.articleSummary: India issues a fresh Ebola advisory amid outbreaks in Africa; no confirmed cases in India. Travellers who have arrived from, or transited through, Ebola-affected countries in the last 21 days should monitor health, isolate if symptoms such as fever, headache, muscle pain, vomiting, diarrhoea, or unexplained bleeding appear, and report to local authorities. Helpline 1075 is available. Affected countries include the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan. A suspected Ebola case in Gujarat, traced to the Congo, was tested negative, with Health Minister Praful Pansheriya affirming no panic. International events affected: the India-Africa Forum Summit was postponed, and a pre-World Cup training camp in the DRC was canceled. Ebola is believed to originate in bats and spread via bodily fluids or contaminated surfaces; WHO notes a historical fatality rate around 50%, emphasizing early detection and isolation to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: インド、エボラ出血熱に関する新たな注意喚起を発令 - 影響を受けた国からの旅行者に21日間の症状監視を要請
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の多地域での発生（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン）による国際的な拡大リスク、および異常・予想外のイベント（複数国での同時発生）が認められ、IHR基準を満たす。インドで疑い症例が報告されており、国際的な関心も高い。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIはGujarat（India内の州）、Uganda、Sudanも発生地域として列挙しているが、記事サマリーでは主な発生地域はDRC、Uganda、South Sudanと記載されている。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCとIndiaのみであり、この2国で検証された。インドはアドバイザリー発令国であり、DRCが主たる発生地である。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Scare: Health Ministry Issues Advisory, Says No Cases Reported In India Yet
article.articleSummary: As of 2 June 2026, India reports no Ebola cases. The Ministry of Health and Family Welfare issued a public health advisory urging vigilance for travelers who have recently passed through Ebola-affected regions. A 24x7 Health Helpline (1075) assists with information and guidance. If you travelled from or transited through an Ebola-affected country in the last 21 days and develop fever, headache, muscle pain, vomiting, diarrhoea, or unexplained bleeding, isolate and inform local health authorities. Ebola virus disease is a severe, often fatal illness with an average fatality around 50% (historical range 25–90% per WHO). Transmission occurs via direct contact with blood, secretions, organs, or other bodily fluids of infected people or animals. The 21-day window reflects the maximum incubation period; the broad advisory targets travellers through any Ebola-affected country amid ongoing outbreaks in parts of Africa.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ恐怖：保健省が勧告を発令、インドでは未だ症例報告なし
triage.triage_reason: インドでは現在のところエボラ症例が報告されていないが、アフリカの進行中の流行を背景にした予防的警告であり、国際的な拡大リスクと管理可能性の問題が存在する。情報が限定的であるため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はインド国内での症例は報告されていないことを明示しており、これはアフリカの進行中のエボラ流行に対するインドの予防的対応である。IHR基準は2つ以上該当（重大性と国際的拡大リスク）するが、インドへの実際の流行は確認されていない。WPRO基準で管理可能性と流行の可能性が該当し、政府の関心が高い（公衆衛生勧告発令）ため、フルRRA前の継続監視が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Ruto defends US-backed Ebola facility as court battle and backlash grow in Kenya
article.articleSummary: Kenya’s plan to host a US-backed Ebola quarantine facility at Laikipia Air Base in central Kenya has become a flashpoint amid a regional outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. The facility would quarantine American citizens potentially exposed to the Bundibugyo-strain Ebola; the Bundibugyo strain currently has no licensed vaccine. Kenya reports no Ebola cases and conducts about 3,000 daily airport and border screenings, with no infections detected domestically. The outbreak has killed dozens; WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Nairobi argues the site is part of national preparedness and existing capacity across 23 counties for isolation, surveillance, and treatment. Critics say the move risks public health and lack of consultation. Kenya’s High Court temporarily suspended the project last week as the case proceeds. Ruto defends the plan as routine preparedness, while opponents push transparency. The future remains uncertain.

triage.headline_ja: ルト大統領、ケニアで米国支援のエボラ施設を擁護 法廷での争いと反発が拡大
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言したエボラアウトブレイク（DRC・ウガンダ）に関連し、ケニアが米国支援の隔離施設を設置する計画。国際的な拡大リスク、重症度、管理可能性の観点からシグナルとして識別。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの米国支援施設設置の政治的争点であるが、実際のエボラアウトブレイク発生地はDRCとウガンダ。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。WHOがPHEICを宣言済みの状況下での地域的準備活動であり、国際的な懸念の高さが特徴。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : la société civile et les confessions religieuses
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: Civil Society and Religious Denominations
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Ituri, Democratic Republic of Congo: Civil society coordination and religious denominations in Ituri call for mobilization to support medical teams fighting the outbreak in affected areas. On May 31 in Bunia, four patients were cured at the Centre Medical Évangélique (CME); with another cured case in Bunia and Rwampara health zones, recoveries continue to rise. The groups warn the sample is small and highlight inadequate logistical support across Ituri, limiting response and risking further spread. Religious leaders say cures build community trust and counter rumors on social media. Pastor Ignace Bingi emphasizes the need for broader support for healthcare facilities. Human rights activists urge Ebola survivors to become awareness ambassadors to combat fear and promote rapid care. Authorities, partners, and the public are urged to bolster support for frontline workers to consolidate gains and accelerate the response across Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州のエボラ出血熱：市民社会と宗教団体が動員を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認事例（DRC・イツリ州）であり、IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク（ルワンダ隣接）が認められる。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数基準該当。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC・イツリ州でのエボラ出血熱確認事例を報道。ルワンダが隣接地域として発生地域に含まれているが、サマリーではルワンダでの発生は明記されていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみに限定。ただし地理的隣接性から国際的拡大リスクは高い。複数の回復事例が報告されている一方、ロジスティック支援の不足が懸念されており、対応能力の問題が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: 國內爆發麻疹群聚！泰國移入個案同住友人確診　491名接觸者列入監測
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Domestic measles cluster outbreak! Housemate of Thailand-imported case diagnosed; 491 contacts placed under monitoring.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports a domestic measles cluster linked to a Thailand-imported case. On June 2, 2026, a man in his 20s in the north, co-residing with the imported patient, was diagnosed after symptoms during health monitoring, bringing the cluster to two local cases with 491 contacts under monitoring through June 16. The index case is a foreign woman in her 30s who arrived mid-May, developed fever, cough and rash, and was confirmed; her housemate is the second case. Taiwan’s total measles cases this year reach 11 (3 domestic, 8 imported), with import sources including Vietnam, Malaysia, the United States, India, Indonesia, Kyrgyzstan, Japan and Thailand. Internationally, Japan reports 511 cases in 2026 (concentrated in Tokyo, Kanagawa, Saitama); Bangladesh faces a severe outbreak (roughly 70,936 suspected, 9,049 confirmed, 585 deaths, Dhaka most affected). Vaccination remains essential; MMR stock is adequate; adults born in 1966 or later should consider pre-travel MMR (2–4 weeks before travel); emphasize hygiene and masking; returnees with symptoms should report to border screening.

triage.headline_ja: 国内麻疹集団発生！タイからの移入患者と同居の友人が確診　491名の接触者が監視下に
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における麻疹の国内集団発生（既に2例の国内感染確認、491名の接触者監視中）は異常かつ予想外であり、複数の国（日本、バングラデシュ等）での同時多発的な麻疹発生と関連している。IHR基準2つ以上該当（異常性・国際的拡大リスク）かつWPRO基準複数該当、社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事はTaiwan（対象国外）での国内集団発生が主題であり、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めず。ただし記事内で複数の対象国（Vietnam, Indonesia, Thailand, India）を麻疹輸入源として言及しており、これらの国での流行背景が重要。同時にBangladesh（対象国）での大規模発生（推定70,936人の疑い患者、9,049人確認、585人死亡）が記載されているがバングラデシュは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。Japan（対象国外）での511例も言及されている。WPRO地域における麻疹の多国同時多発は重要なシグナルである。

article.articleHeadline: ಎಬೋಲಾ ಭೀತಿ: ಪೀಡಿತ ದೇಶಗಳಿಂದ ಭಾರತಕ್ಕೆ ಬಂದವರು ತಕ್ಷಣ ಐಸೋಲೇಟ್ ಆಗಿ: ಕೇಂದ್ರದಿಂದ ಮಾರ್ಗಸೂಚಿ ಜಾರಿ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola scare: Those arriving in India from affected countries should be isolated immediately; guidelines issued by the Centre.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 June 2026, India’s Health Ministry issued new Ebola guidelines: individuals arriving from Ebola-affected countries—Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan—or traveling via them in the past 21 days must self-isolate. If symptoms such as fever, headache, muscle pain, vomiting, diarrhea, or bleeding appear, they must be promptly isolated and reported to local health authorities. There are no confirmed Ebola cases in India; a Gujarat traveler with Ebola-like symptoms tested negative. A toll-free 1075 helpline is available for guidance. Internationally, the WHO has declared the African Ebola outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, with over 200 deaths and more than 1,077 suspected cases. In Congo’s eastern province, transmission appears to be easing and its key airport has reopened, though global contact tracing remains challenging.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ恐怖症：アフリカの感染地域から インドに到着した人々は即座に隔離される必要があります。中央政府がガイドラインを発行
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。WHO が Public Health Emergency of International Concern を宣言し、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限、200名以上の死亡がある重大事象。インドが予防措置を導入する異常事象として該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンからの渡航者対策を述べているが、対象国リストではDRCとインドのみ該当。ウガンダと南スーダンは対象国外。WHO PHEIC 宣言、200名超の死亡、1,077名超の疑い事例が確認されており、国際的に重大な公衆衛生上の脅威。インドでの確定例なしだが、予防措置の発動は国の異常事象として評価。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo laporkan 5 pasien ebola sembuh dan 263 kasus terkonfirmasi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kongo reports 5 Ebola patients recovered and 263 confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: Five patients infected with Bundibugyo Ebola have recovered in Bunia, the capital of Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo. Four are healthcare workers and one is a laboratory worker; all recovered after two negative Ebola tests and have been discharged or sent home. Bunia hosts a newly inaugurated Ebola treatment center attended by WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, who highlighted progress in vaccines and treatments amid ongoing transmission risk. As of May 29, 2026, the DR Congo reported 263 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 42 deaths among confirmed cases. More than 1,100 test results remained pending as of May 30, 2026, per CDC Africa, while health authorities said no samples were awaiting laboratory testing. The outbreak response includes enhanced testing, case management, contact tracing, and case verification in affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴが5人のエボラ患者の回復と263の確定症例を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスク）。また、WPRO基準も複数該当し、DRC内での確定症例263人、死亡42人という深刻な状況。国際的な関心が高く、WHO事務局長の現地訪問など政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebolavirus（エボラウイルス属）による既知の流行であり、263確定症例、42死亡が報告されている。WHO事務局長がBunia治療センターを訪問し、ワクチン・治療の進捗をハイライトしている。1,100以上の検査結果が保留中（CDC Africa報告）。強化された検査、症例管理、接触追跡が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Hai phút vàng nhận diện nguy cơ lây nhiễm virus Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two Golden Minutes to Identify the Risk of Ebola Virus Infection
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) remains a spillover risk for Vietnam despite no confirmed cases. Experts emphasize exploiting epidemiological history at presentation to distinguish potential cases during early triage, especially since early symptoms—fever, malaise, diarrhea, and headache—are nonspecific and overlap with dengue, influenza, malaria, and gastroenteritis. The incubation period is 2–21 days; during the pre-symptomatic phase, transmission risk is negligible, but once symptoms appear, the virus can spread via blood and body fluids. At Bach Mai Hospital in Hanoi, authorities train staff, review intake workflows, and enforce isolation for suspected cases. The "2-5-30" protocol guides response: two minutes to assess symptoms and epidemiology; five minutes to establish temporary isolation; thirty minutes to activate the full response, including infection control, reporting, and procedures. Healthcare workers use full PPE; waste handling, disinfection, patient transport, and specimen management are strictly followed. The public is urged to report travel and contact history and not conceal exposure.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス感染リスク識別のための2分間の黄金時間
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムにおけるエボラウイルス疾患（EVD）の溢出リスクについての専門家による警告と感染対策強化の報告。確認症例がないため即座の公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は不明だが、準備態勢強化と社会的関心がある状況として経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは「ベトナムで確認症例はないが溢出リスクがある」と述べており、ハノイのバック・マイ病院における準備態勢強化の報告である。複数の疾患名が列挙されているのは鑑別診断の文脈であり、実際のイベントはエボラウイルス疾患の準備状況。確認症例がないため深刻度は不明だが、スクリーニング基準（異常性、流行の可能性）に該当し、政府・医療機関での対応が進行中であるため、継続的な情報収集が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Pasien Dugaan Hantavirus di RSPI Sulianti Saroso Diperbolehkan Pulang
