article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected hantavirus patient at RSPI Sulianti Saroso allowed to go home.
article.articleSummary: Suspected hantavirus patient at RSPI Sulianti Saroso discharged; ministry confirms no transmission. The patient reportedly had ship exposure; authorities noted an English national who arrived for work and was isolated and treated; no secondary cases. Hantavirus is not new; it has two main forms: Hemorrhagic Fever with Renal Syndrome (HFRS) and Hantavirus Pulmonary Syndrome (HPS). Seroprevalence tests show antibodies in Bali (16%) and in Jakarta and Surabaya (13%). From 2024 through May 2026, Indonesia logged 256 suspected hantavirus cases, 23 confirmed, across DKI Jakarta, West Java, DIY, North Sulawesi, West Sumatra, and East Nusa Tenggara (NTT). Fatality rate is very low. Government calls for environmental hygiene and rodent control to reduce risk; no details of imported/exported cases were reported.

triage.headline_ja: RSPI Sulianti Saroso のハンタウイルス疑い患者、退院許可
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア全土で256件の疑い患者と23件の確定患者が報告されており、複数州での流行継続が示唆されるが、本個別事例は退院・回復事例であり、現在の制御状況と二次感染のないことから緊急PICKUP基準には未達。ただし疫学的背景と継続的な社会的関心を考慮し要経過観察。
triage.notes: 2024年5月から2026年5月までの2年余で256件の疑い患者、23件の確定患者が複数州（ジャカルタ、西ジャワ、北スラウェシ、西スマトラなど）で報告されている。血清陽性率がバリ島16%、ジャカルタ・スラバヤで13%と相応の有病率を示唆。本記事の個別事例は退院・回復で二次感染なしとのことだが、背景にある多州流行の継続と環境中のげっ歯類リスクを踏まえ、継続的な監視が推奨される。国際支援の必要性は現在の記事には述べられていない。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉早已失控傳播數月！疑找到「零號病人」 死前傳染給8名醫護人員
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola has long been out of control, spreading for months! Suspected 'patient zero' identified; it infected eight healthcare workers before dying.
article.articleSummary: As of June 2, 2026, Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has been out of control. Health officials suspect patient zero originated in January at an eastern DRC hospital; the patient infected eight healthcare workers before dying. If confirmed, the outbreak would have spread uncontrollably for at least four months, with official confirmation on May 15. The strain is Bundibugyo Ebola virus; there is no vaccine or treatment available. More than 1,000 suspected cases have been reported. WHO Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus has arrived in DRC to oversee the response. Challenges include delayed case discovery, rapid isolation, contact tracing, safe and dignified burials, and stronger infection prevention and control in health facilities, compounded by regional instability, PPE shortages, and limited case tracking. Travellers with Ebola-like symptoms (fever, headache, muscle pain, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, diarrhea, or bleeding) are transported by ambulance to contracted hospitals and linked with health units.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが数ヶ月前から失控伝播中！疑わしき「ゼロ号患者」を発見、死亡前に8人の医療従事者に感染
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当し、WPRO基準も5つすべて該当。エボラウイルス（致死性高）の大規模流行で、数ヶ月の隠れた伝播、1,000以上の疑い例、医療従事者への感染、国際対応（WHO事務局長派遣）が確認される。
triage.notes: エボラ・ブンディブギョ株、4ヶ月以上の隠れた流行、ワクチン・治療なし、地域不安定性とPPE不足による対応困難、WHO事務局長現地派遣確認。フルRRA実施が急務。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola descartado no segundo paciente isolado em São Paulo, mas homem tem meningite grave
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola ruled out in the second patient in isolation in São Paulo, but the man has severe meningitis.
article.articleSummary: 2 June 2026 – Ebola tests were negative for a 37-year-old man in São Paulo placed in isolation; the patient is diagnosed with meningococcal meningitis. Adolfo Lutz confirmed no Ebola, with the patient at Instituto Emílio Ribas presenting fever. A first suspected case in Rio de Janeiro, from Uganda, was also ruled out after testing saliva, urine, and blood. Nationalities were not disclosed; the Congo-born patient came from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and the other from Uganda. The São Paulo patient remains in grave condition due to meningitis. The DR Congo outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo strain, has a 30–50% fatality rate and no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. Africa CDC reports 246 deaths and over 1,000 suspected cases in DRC, with Uganda reporting two more cases (total nine). Brazil deems importation risk very low and advises monitoring travelers with Congo travel history; surveillance protocols are in place.

triage.headline_ja: エボラはサンパウロの隔離第2患者で除外されたが、患者は重症髄膜炎を患っている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際的拡大リスク）。ブラジルへのエボラウイルス輸入疑い例の確認および髄膜炎の重症化により、フルRRA実施を推奨。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、サンパウロ（ブラジル）でエボラ疑い例が確認され、その後否定されたが、患者は重症髄膜炎と診断。DRCでのエボラ（Bundibugyo株）アウトブレイク（30-50%致死率、246死亡、1000以上の疑い例）との関連性が確認されている。ウガンダからの輸入例も報告。ブラジルは輸入リスクが非常に低いと評価しているが、複数国での症例確認と国際的な旅行関連リスク存在により、継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kina šalje medicinske stručnjake u DR Kongo kao pomoć u borbi protiv epidemije ebole
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China sends medical experts to DR Congo as aid in the fight against the Ebola epidemic.
article.articleSummary: China dispatches a medical expert team from Beijing to bolster the Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with WHO classifying the outbreak as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The specialists will join Chinese staff already on the ground and collaborate with local health authorities and disease-control services. Experienced in epidemic responses, they will aid in prevention and treatment, provide training for health workers, and support Chinese nationals and institutions operating in the DRC. The existing Chinese team has activated emergency measures, including training, drills, and stock coordination, while continuing frontline services for local communities and Chinese residents. The current outbreak in Congo and Uganda has at least 134 confirmed Ebola cases and 18 deaths; the cumulative total exceeds 1,000 suspected cases since May 15. Bundibugyo strain is concentrated in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu.

triage.headline_ja: 中国がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行対策支援のため医療専門家を派遣
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的な懸念、WHOによるPHEIC認定）。WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当。国際的かつ複数国での拡大が確認されており、支援体制の国際協力も必要な重大シグナル。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが北京（China）をIturi/South Kivu省と並列の発生地域として含めているが、記事サマリーではBeijingは医療専門家の派遣元であり、実際の流行地はDRC（South Kivu、Ituri州）とウガンダに限定されている。Uganda（226074）は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。WHO PHEIC認定済みのEbola outbreak（Bundibugyo株、134確認例、18死亡）で、複数州での蔓延と国際的支援の実施が確認されており、フルRRA対象。

article.articleHeadline: Les cas d'Ebola dépassent les 300 en RDC à mesure que l'épidémie s'étend à de nouvelles zones de santé
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases exceed 300 in the DRC as the outbreak spreads to new health zones.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 June 2026, Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo exceed 300, with 48 deaths. The outbreak now spans 23 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu, with Ituri reporting more than 260 confirmed cases. In Bunia, community resistance and rumors in Nizi hinder response efforts. Four recovered patients have left the Evangelical Medical Center in Bunia. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus completed his visit to discuss the Bundibugyo strain response as vaccination trials continue and a new 60-bed treatment center opens in Bunia. Aid logistics improve after Bunia airport, previously closed to commercial flights and reserved for humanitarian use, reopens with screening at exit/entry points. The latest flare-up was declared on 15 May.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ症例が300例を超える 流行が新たな保健地域に拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認された流行で300例超、死亡48例。IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。国際的な公衆衛生上の重大事象。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は国際保健規則(IHR 2005)の第6条で常に通知対象疾患。複数州(Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu)での複数ヘルスゾーン(23地域)での流行。WHOトップの現地訪問、ワクチン接種試験進行中、新規治療センター開設など国際的関与が高い。ブンディブギョ株による流行。

article.articleHeadline: 麻疹爆本土群聚！20多歲男被外籍同住者感染 491人遭匡列
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles sparks a local cluster outbreak! A man in his 20s infected by a foreign housemate; 491 people quarantined.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan CDC reports a new measles cluster: a man in his 20s contracted from a 30-year-old housemate who traveled to Taiwan in mid-May. Three days after entry, both developed fever, cough, runny nose, and rash; labs confirmed measles. The cluster has 2 cases, with 491 contacts quarantined and monitored through June 16. Year-to-date, Taiwan has 11 measles cases (ages 1 to over 50): 3 domestic, 8 imported from Vietnam, Malaysia, United States, India, Indonesia, Kyrgyzstan, Japan, and Thailand. Japan reports 511 cases; Bangladesh's March outbreak totals 70,936 cases, 9,049 confirmed, 585 deaths, Dhaka. Measles is highly contagious and airborne; contacts should monitor health, wear masks if symptomatic, and seek care promptly; non-compliance with self-health management incurs fines of NT$60,000–NT$300,000. Vaccination remains best prevention; MMR stocks are ample. Adults born since 1966 planning travel should consider MMR 2–4 weeks before departure; maintain hygiene and inform authorities if symptoms appear on return.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹が台湾で局所的集団発生！20代男性が外国籍同居者から感染、491人が隔離対象に
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の国際的な多地域での発生が確認されており、特に台湾での新規集団発生、バングラデシュの大規模アウトブレイク（70,936例）、日本での511例報告など、複数の対象国での同時多発が認められる。IHR基準で異常性・国際的拡大・公衆衛生への深刻な影響が該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行性が確認される。
triage.notes: 台湾はサマリーの主題だが対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。バングラデシュ（Dhaka）はサマリーで「March outbreak totals 70,936 cases」と報告されているが、Bangladesh自体が対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。記事は複数国での麻疹発生を報告しており、対象国ではインド、ベトナム、インドネシア、タイからの輸入例が確認されている。日本、キルギス、米国も発生地域に含まれるが対象国リストに未含。高い感染性、エアボーン感染経路、大規模接触者追跡（491人）、予防接種の重要性強調が特徴。

article.articleHeadline: 衞防中心稱新冠已成本港風土病　籲有需要人士及早預約接種疫苗
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Centre for Health Protection says COVID-19 has become endemic in Hong Kong; urges those in need to book vaccination appointments early.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 has become endemic in Hong Kong as of 2 June 2026. The Centre for Health Protection notes that vaccines under the government vaccination program, LP.8.1, are nearing expiry—mid-July for children and early September for adults. A new batch is expected to arrive in the fourth quarter; during this transition, eligible individuals will briefly not have access to free vaccination through the program, so those in need should book early and complete vaccination before expiry. Vaccination services for ages 6 months to 11 years run until 10 July; for ages 12 and above, until 5 September. Although overall COVID-19 activity is currently low, the virus tends to experience active cycles roughly every 6–9 months due to variant changes and waning immunity. Government vaccine supply is planned to resume in Q4, with details to be announced.

triage.headline_ja: 衛生防護中心が新型コロナは香港の風土病となったと述べ、ワクチン接種が必要な者に早期予約を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19は香港で風土病化しており、現在の活動レベルは低い。ワクチン供給の調整に関する定例的な公衆衛生情報であり、IHR基準やWPRO基準に該当する異常事象ではない。
triage.notes: 香港はChina (1814991) に含められている。記事はCOVID-19が香港で風土病化した状況を報告しており、ワクチン供給スケジュールの調整に関する行政的通知である。現在の感染活動レベルは低く、公衆衛生上の緊急事象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Revue de presse Afrique - À la Une, la lutte contre Ebola: prévention, protection et financement...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa Press Review - On the Front Page, the Fight Against Ebola: Prevention, Protection and Financing...
article.articleSummary: Ebola remains active in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with about 250 deaths and over 1,100 cases reported. There is no vaccine or miracle treatment yet, though recent progress in Bunia shows hope. At the Centre médical évangélique, four men and one woman who were infected while saving lives have been declared cured, bringing five survivor-caregivers to date. Dr. Calvin Ambitapio explains that a rigorous symptomatic approach—treating malaria, administering appropriate antibiotics, daily surveillance, and repeated testing—can defeat Ebola without a specific drug. Early diagnosis and proper care markedly improve survival and are essential to win community trust, countering fear and refusals to seek treatment. The Congolese health ministry is cautiously optimistic that control could be achieved in four to six months with a strengthened response and international support. Critics warn that reductions in international funding threaten durable health systems and long-term outbreak preparedness, urging sustained investment beyond emergencies.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ プレスレビュー - トップニュース：エボラ対策：予防、保護、資金調達
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的支援の必要性）。WPRO基準も複数該当。進行中のエボラ流行で死亡250件以上、患者1,100件以上の大規模アウトブレイク。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCの東部（Bunia）におけるエボラ流行を主題としている。250人以上の死亡と1,100人以上の症例が報告されており、重篤度が高い。国際的支援の必要性が強調されており、資金削減が長期的な対策に脅威をもたらすとの指摘もある。Malariaも共有感染症として言及されているが、本記事の焦点はエボラ対策である。

article.articleHeadline: Thailand dismisses fears over dominant Covid-19 variant | New Straits Times
article.articleSummary: Thailand reports NB.1.8.1, a sub-lineage of JN.1, as the dominant Covid-19 variant in Bangkok, but there is no evidence it causes more severe disease or faster transmission. Infections rise with seasonal trends; no large cluster outbreaks and most patients have mild symptoms, with the healthcare system remaining capable of managing the situation. Between January 1 and May 23, 3,642 Covid-19 cases were recorded nationwide, with one fatality. NB.1.8.1 accounted for 50.95% of sequenced cases, confirming its dominance. Deputy Government Spokesperson Lalida Persvivatana urged reliance on official information and continued hygiene, especially for older persons, those with underlying conditions, and pregnant women. A 24-hour Department of Disease Control hotline (1422) is available for inquiries.

triage.headline_ja: タイ、優性COVID-19変異株への懸念を否定 | New Straits Times
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の新しい優性変異株（NB.1.8.1）が検出されているが、重症化や感染加速の証拠がなく、症例数は少なく軽症が大多数。医療体制は管理可能な状況であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際拡大のリスク、社会的関心の高まりも認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はタイにおけるCOVID-19の新しい優性変異株の検出を報告しているが、深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念を示唆する根拠がない。政府はむしろ状況をコントロール下にあるものとして公式情報への信頼と衛生対策の継続を呼びかけており、シグナル検出基準には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Travel bans aren't enough to stop Ebola's spread
article.articleSummary: As of May 30, WHO reports 282 confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo and 9 in Uganda, with 43 deaths and 220 suspected Congo cases; one American surgeon working in Congo is treated for Ebola in Germany. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo Ebola virus, which has no approved vaccine and a case fatality rate of 30–50%, with transmission via bodily fluids; supportive care can improve survival. Travel bans alone are insufficient to halt spread, given screening gaps and cross-border movement, and could push expertise away from Africa. The United States could bolster containment by appointing a White House–level Ebola coordinator, coordinating with WHO and African governments, and deploying civilian and military personnel to Congo and neighboring countries to establish treatment centers, assist with lab testing and contact tracing, deliver medical supplies, and provide security escorts for personnel. Obama-era actions (2014–2016) mobilized $5.4B, a military command center in Liberia, treatment units, trained providers, PPE, test kits, and public information campaigns; Trump has weakened USAID and CDC staffing, hindering response, risking continued spread and potential US involvement.

triage.headline_ja: 渡航禁止ではエボラの拡散を止めるのに十分ではない
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症の確認された発生がコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダで報告され、IHR基準4項目中3項目（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）を満たし、国外での症例発生も含まれているため、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ発生を主題としており、282確認症例と43死亡、30-50%の致死率が報告されている。ウガンダでも症例確認（9例）だが、サマリーの記事は米国医師がドイツで治療されたことを含めコンゴのアウトブレイク対応に焦点。対象国リストではDRCのみが確認される発生地。Bundibugyo Ebola virusワクチン未承認という重要な知見あり。

article.articleHeadline: Kenia protestuje przeciw ośrodkowi "dla Amerykanów" zakażonych Ebolą
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya protests against the 'for Americans' Ebola-infected center.
article.articleSummary: As of June 2, 2026, hundreds of youths in Nanyuki, Laikipia County, Kenya, protested plans to establish a quarantine center for Ebola-infected individuals at Laikipia Air Base. The facility, opposed by the Kenyan Bar Association and temporarily halted by the Supreme Court, was to quarantine patients including Americans and would serve all, according to Kenyan Health Minister Aden Duale. Anonymous U.S. officials described plans to relocate Ebola-infected Americans abroad to the Kenyan site, with 50 beds planned by Friday. The United States pledged about $13.5 million to strengthen Kenya’s pandemic readiness. Local leaders, including Laikipia Governor Joshua Irungu, warned that residents—many of whom work on the base—could be exposed. Kenya has reported no Ebola cases, while Uganda has nine cases and closed its border with Congo; Uganda also reports at least 282 confirmed cases and over 1,000 contacts exposed to Bundibugyo ebolavirus.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアが「アメリカ人向け」エボラ感染者センターに抗議
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの国際的な移送計画を含む異常かつ予想外のイベントであり、複数国にまたがるリスク、公衆衛生上の懸念、国際的な拡大可能性が認められる。社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストに含まれるケニアは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外した。ウガンダは既に9例の確認症例を有し、コンゴとの国境を閉鎖していることから検証対象に含める。コンゴはDRCとして対象国リストに含まれる。記事サマリーの主要な懸念は米国からケニアへのエボラ患者転送計画であるが、対象国リストにはケニア・米国が含まれないため、実際の発生地（ウガンダ9例、コンゴでのバンディブギオエボラウイルス感染）のみを verified_locations に記載した。

article.articleHeadline: 'Isolate And Inform Authorities': Govt Issues Ebola Warning For Travellers From Affected Countries
article.articleSummary: Ebola warning for travellers to India (2026-06-02): The government advises isolation for anyone who travelled from or transited through Ebola-affected countries (DR Congo, Uganda, South Sudan) within the last 21 days if they develop symptoms such as fever, headache, muscle pain, vomiting, diarrhoea, or unexplained bleeding, and to report to local health authorities via helpline 1075. No confirmed Ebola cases in India; a suspected case from the Democratic Republic of the Congo in Gujarat tested negative. The advisory follows non-essential travel restrictions to the DRC, Uganda and South Sudan. WHO declared Ebola a public health emergency of international concern last month after nearly 80 deaths, later rising to over 200 with about 1,077 suspected cases since the outbreak began. In the DRC, authorities reopened the main eastern airport amid signs of slowdown, while contact tracing and investigations continue.

triage.headline_ja: 「隔離して当局に報告を」：政府、影響を受けた国からの渡航者に対するエボラ警告を発令
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は極めて高い致死率を持つNGOs疾患であり、DRC・ウガンダ・南スーダンでのアウトブレイク規模は深刻（200以上の死亡、1,077の疑似症例）。IHR基準4つ全て該当。WHO既にPHEIC宣言済み。
triage.notes: インドで確認されたエボラ疑似症例は検査で陰性。主要なアウトブレイク地域はDRC・ウガンダ・南スーダンだが、インドは渡航警告・隔離勧告の対象国として公式対応を実施。ウガンダ・スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola se širi Kongom, potvrđeno više od 300 slučajeva i 48 umrlih
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreading through Congo, more than 300 cases and 48 deaths confirmed.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 300 confirmed cases and 48 deaths as of 2 June 2026, with 23 health zones affected across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu; Ituri reports the majority (>260) of cases. Authorities warn that misinformation, distrust, and resistance to public health measures hamper response, especially in Bunia and the northeast city of Nizi. Four patients have recovered and been discharged from the Evangelical Medical Center in Bunia. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus met President Félix Tshisekedi to discuss the response to Bundibugyo ebolavirus. A new 60-bed treatment center opened in Bunia, and vaccine trials are underway. Bunia airport has reopened for regular traffic after implementing enhanced health screening for travelers. The outbreak was officially declared on 15 May.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴを襲うエボラ、300件を超える確認症例と48人の死亡が報告される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WPRO基準も5項目全て該当。確認症例数300超、死亡48人、複数ヘルスゾーン関連、WHOの高レベル関与がある。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）の主要な流行。2026年6月2日時点で300超の確認症例、48人の死亡、23ヘルスゾーン関連。Ituri地域が最多（260超）。WHOトップとの大統領面会、ワクチン臨床試験実施、新治療センター開設など国家レベルの対応が進行中。公衆衛生対策への住民の抵抗と不信感が懸念事項として報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Meningite já causou 19 mortes este ano no ES
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Meningitis has already caused 19 deaths this year in Espírito Santo.
article.articleSummary: Espírito Santo, Brazil, reports 91 confirmed meningitis cases and 19 deaths through epidemiological week 19 (week ending May 16, 2026). In early 2025 there were 86 cases and 20 deaths; 2025 ended with 293 cases and 62 deaths. Two recent deaths: a 17-year-old from Montanha and a 22-year-old from Viana who died after traveling to Rio de Janeiro. Clinicians warn meningitis can be viral or bacterial; bacterial forms are more severe. The main bacteria linked to severe disease are Streptococcus pneumoniae, Neisseria meningitidis, and Haemophilus influenzae type B; vaccines against these agents are available in the SUS. Diagnosis relies on cerebrospinal fluid analysis to identify etiology. Prevention centers on vaccination, including Pentavalent, Pneumococcal 10-valent, and meningococcal C/ACWY vaccines, with updated immunization calendars.

triage.headline_ja: 髄膜炎がエスピリトサント州で2026年に既に19人の死亡を引き起こしている
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのエスピリト聖州で確認された髄膜炎（肺炎球菌関連と推定）91例、19死亡は公衆衛生への深刻な影響を示し、IHR基準およびWPROスクリーニング基準の複数項目を満たす。死亡率が高く、対象国での重要なシグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはエスピリト聖州（ブラジル）での髄膜炎流行を明確に述べており、2025年の293例62死亡から2026年の91例19死亡への継続的な事例が報告されている。前年比での増加傾向と高い死亡率が懸念される。肺炎球菌（Streptococcus pneumoniae）が主要な病原体として言及されており、提供された疾患名「Pneumococcus」と合致する。

article.articleHeadline: Быстрое распространение Эболы ставит путешествия под угрозу: вирус добрался до Европы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The rapid spread of Ebola threatens travel: the virus has reached Europe.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), driven by the rare Bundibugyo strain, has produced over 1,000 suspected cases and at least 246 deaths, with case fatality up to 40% and no approved vaccine. The outbreak has extended to Uganda (9 cases, 1 death) and Europe, evidenced by an Austria hospitalisation of a patient who had returned from Uganda; Brazil reports involvement with a case isolated in Sao Paulo and Rio de Janeiro declaring a state of emergency after a Ugandan patient. The World Health Organization chief urged against border closures to preserve transparency, while the United States banned entry of travelers from the DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan; Rwanda and Uganda closed borders. As the North American World Cup approaches, experts warn travel could spread Ebola, though mitigation is possible. Hundreds of samples remain untested amid ongoing surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの急速な拡大が旅行を脅かす：ウイルスがヨーロッパに到達
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的な多国間拡大、高い死亡率、複数国での確認事例、渡航制限の実施により、シグナルトリアージレベルでピックアップが必須。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが報告した発生地域にはオーストリア、米国、スーダン、ルワンダ、ウガンダが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題的なイベント発生地は対象国リストの中ではDRCとブラジルに限定される。ウガンダおよびオーストリアでの症例報告は認識されているが、これらの国は対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsには記載しない。本件はエボラの多国間拡大により、フルRRA実施が強く推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Waspada Hantavirus, Pakar IPB Beri Tahu Cara Terbaik Menyapu Kotoran Tikus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus Alert: IPB Expert Explains the Best Way to Sweep Up Rat Droppings.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 June 2026, hantavirus, a rodent-borne viral infection, poses inhalation risk from dried rat urine, feces, or saliva. In Indonesia, IPB University expert Prof. Upik Kesumawati warns that sweeping or vacuuming dry droppings can aerosolize particles and trigger infection; dampen the area with disinfectant first, then clean with a broom or disposable tissue, and wash hands afterward. Symptoms include fever with respiratory or kidney involvement after exposure; seek healthcare promptly. The article notes a recent international event where hantavirus caused the deaths of several cruise ship passengers docked in the Netherlands, highlighting the potential for imported exposures. Hantavirus is not new to Indonesia, described as a rodent-borne zoonosis studied since the 1980s, but remains rare with a relatively high fatality rate per Indonesian Health Ministry data. Public health guidance emphasizes preventing indoor accumulation and reporting symptoms after exposure.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス警戒：IPB専門家がネズミの糞を掃き出す最良の方法を説明
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアでハンタウイルス感染の警戒情報が報道されており、オランダでの死亡事例も言及されている。ただし記事は主に予防措置の啓発であり、発生地域の詳細情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはインドネシアでの予防啓発が主題であるが、オランダでのクルーズ船乗客死亡事例も言及されている。オランダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。IHR基準を2つ満たし、WPRO基準を3つ満たすが、具体的な患者数、死亡数、発生状況の詳細情報が不足しているため、現段階では WATCH とした。続報で患者発生の確認があればすぐに PICKUP へ昇格すべき。

article.articleHeadline: 非洲伊波拉疫情擴散！台灣4名疫區返國旅客健康監測中 1人發燒幸排除感染
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak spreading in Africa! Four travelers returning to Taiwan from outbreak areas are under health surveillance; one developed a fever but infection has been ruled out.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreaks in Africa, notably the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, prompt Taiwan to tighten border controls. As of May 31, DR Congo reports 321 confirmed cases, 48 deaths, 6 recoveries, and 220 suspected cases, mainly in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu. Uganda has 9 confirmed cases and 1 death, linked to cross-border movement and healthcare exposure, centered in Kampala and Wakiso. Taiwan’s CDC raised the travel advisory to Warning (level 3) and since May 27 requires 21-day self-health management for entrants from both countries. From June 2, entry by residents from the DRC and Uganda is suspended for 90 days; existing visas are temporarily invalid. Four Taiwanese travelers returning from Ebola areas are under health surveillance; one developed fever but Ebola PCR was negative. Taiwan hosts a major international event with 30,000–40,000 attendees, including participants from Ebola-affected countries, prompting enhanced border screening.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでエボラ出血熱疫情が拡散！台湾4名の疫区帰国旅客が健康監視中 1人発熱も感染は排除
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）が該当。エボラ出血熱は極めて高い致死率を持つ感染症で、DRC・ウガンダでの確認症例、死亡例、疑い例が多数報告され、台湾への旅行者からの検出事例もあるため、国際的な関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCとウガンダにおけるエボラ出血熱の流行である。台湾の対応は二次的な報告であり、実際の発生地域はDRCのみが対象国リストに該当。Ugandaは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。エボラ出血熱は高い致死率（DRCで15%、ウガンダで11%）、確認症例・死亡例が報告され、国際旅行者への検出事例がある。台湾での入国制限強化や大規模国際イベント開催による国際的リスク拡大の懸念がある。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Бројот на заразени со ебола во Конго надмина 300 лица, вирусот се прошири во нови здравствени зони
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of people infected with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpassed 300, and the virus has spread to new health zones.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 300 confirmed cases with 48 deaths, spreading to 23 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. In Ituri, confirmed cases exceed 260. Local resistance in Bunia and the northeastern town of Nizi, along with rumors and misinformation, complicate response efforts. Four patients have recovered and been discharged from the Evangelical Medical Center in Bunia. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited the DRC after meeting President Félix Tshisekedi to discuss measures addressing the Bundibugyo strain outbreak. Authorities and partners opened a new 60-bed treatment center in Bunia; vaccination testing is underway. Government spokesman Patrick Muyaya said Bunia airport, previously closed to all flights except humanitarian, reopened to facilitate aid deliveries under a new monitoring system for departures and arrivals. The outbreak was officially declared on May 15.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染者数が300人を超え、ウイルスが新たな保健地域に拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認患者300人超、死亡者48人、23の保健地域への拡大、ヒト-ヒト感染性、国際的拡大リスク等の複数基準を満たす。IHR基準4つ全て該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。フルRRAに進める段階にある。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は極度に致命的な感染症であり、本outbreak は確認患者300人超、死亡48人、23の保健地域への拡大、国際機関（WHO）の関与、空港のモニタリング強化等の対応措置の実施が記載されており、全ての評価基準で高リスク。記事サマリーはDRC内の複数地域（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu、Bunia、Nizi）の記述であり、DRCが主題。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : l'Afrique de l'Est renforce la coordination régionale face à l'épidémie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: East Africa strengthens regional coordination in response to the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 June 2026, Ebola outbreaks in East Africa are centered in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri, eastern DRC) and Uganda. Health ministers from eight East African Community member states met June 1–2 to harmonize the regional response and curb cross-border spread. They considered strengthening controls at borders, airports, and major land crossings, though the WHO warned that overly strict restrictions could drive clandestine travel and hamper contact tracing. Regional authorities emphasize surveillance beyond official posts, with security forces patrolling informal travel routes. Nine mobile laboratories are to be deployed in affected areas, notably Ituri, to rapidly detect suspected cases, accelerate diagnostics, and isolate infected individuals. A regional crisis cell was discussed. Critics say the meeting comes after the May 15 outbreak declaration, but the EAC notes ongoing technical discussions among Uganda, DRC, and South Sudan to coordinate initial responses.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：東アフリカが流行に対する地域調整を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラの複数国での流行拡大、深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の可能性が明確である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは2026年6月2日時点のエボラ流行について、DRC（イトゥリ州）とウガンダを中心に述べている。ウガンダ、スーダン、モザンビークはBluedotの発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCでの流行とその地域対応である。DRCのみが対象国リストに含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。東アフリカ地域全体での調整強化が進行中で、国際的支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: اجتماع استثنائي لوزراء الصحة في الاتحاد الأوروبي بشأن " إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Extraordinary meeting of EU health ministers regarding Ebola
article.articleSummary: EU health ministers will hold an extraordinary meeting on Friday to discuss developments in the Ebola outbreak in Central Africa. The session will be conducted via videoconference and was announced by the Cypriot EU Presidency. Delegates are expected to focus on enhanced preparedness and coordination among member states in response to the Ebola threat. The World Health Organization had previously declared the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, signaling international concern. The meeting underscores ongoing international attention to the Ebola situation in Central Africa and the need for cross-border collaboration and rapid information sharing among EU countries.

triage.headline_ja: EU保健大臣がエボラについて臨時会議を開催
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は重大な公衆衛生上の影響を持ち、DRCおよびウガンダでの発生はWHOにより国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態として宣言されており、国際的な拡大リスクと渡航・貿易制限の可能性がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでDRCおよびウガンダでの発生が明記されており、ウガンダ（id: 226074）は対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。キプロス（EU議長）および中央アフリカは地理的記述であり、実際の発生地ではないため除外。WHOによるPHEIC宣言が確認されており、国際的に重大なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases surpass 300 in Congo
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-02, confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo surpassed 300, with 48 deaths, spanning 23 health zones in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. Ituri reports more than 260 confirmed cases. Four patients recovered and were discharged from the Evangelical Medical Center in Bunia. The Bundibugyo-strain Ebola outbreak prompted WHO involvement; WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus met President Felix Tshisekedi to discuss response, vaccine trials, and a new 60-bed treatment center opened in Bunia. Authorities installed monitoring at Bunia Airport, which reopened to humanitarian flights to ease response support. The outbreak was declared on May 15. Community resistance in Bunia and the northeastern town of Nizi, plus rumors and disinformation, are complicating response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ症例が300を超える
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の大規模多地域アウトブレイク（300例超、48死亡）で、IHR基準4項目全て該当。WHOの関与と国際的対応が進行中である。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株エボラは稀な株系統で、死亡率が高い。WHOダイレクターによるコンゴ大統領との会談記録、ワクチン試験への言及、新規60床治療センター開設、空港モニタリング体制の整備など、国家レベルの対応が実施されている。コミュニティーの抵抗とデマ・誤情報がリスク要因となっている。

article.articleHeadline: Three Ebola vaccine candidates in development amid rapidly growing outbreak
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo threatens to escalate beyond hundreds of deaths; more than 1,000 suspected infections and nine confirmed cases have spilled into Uganda. The crisis, detected after spreading through a conflict zone with severely limited healthcare, has prompted three parallel vaccine efforts funded by CEPI. IAVI is adapting an existing Zaire Ebola vaccine to target Bundibugyo; Moderna is developing an mRNA vaccine; Oxford University is pursuing its own platform. All candidates aim to train immunity against the Bundibugyo glycoprotein. IAVI reports near‑100% protection in primates but trials would take seven to nine months; Oxford could begin trials in 2–3 months; Moderna emphasizes urgency. Bundibugyo is a rarer strain with no licensed vaccine; six Ebola species exist, only three have caused human outbreaks. WHO and CEPI leaders stress vaccines to control this outbreak and bolster preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: 急速に拡大する発生に対応するエボラワクチン候補3種が開発中
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の急速な拡大、複数国への越境（DRC→Uganda）、死者を含む確認症例、国際的なワクチン開発体制の整備など、IHR基準およびWPRO基準の複数項目に該当。国際的な公衆衛生上の重大事案としてフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはBundibugyo Ebola outbreakがDRCで発生し、Ugandaへ越境したことを明記。ただしUgandaは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。Bundibugyo株は稀なエボラ種で既承認ワクチンがなく、複数の国際機関による並行ワクチン開発が進行中。紛争地帯での医療アクセス制限が危機管理上の大きな懸念。

article.articleHeadline: Government Issues Ebola Advisory: Vigilance Urged for International Travelers
article.articleSummary: India's Health Ministry issues an Ebola advisory; as of 2026-06-02, no Ebola cases have been reported in India. In response to outbreaks in parts of Africa, the advisory aims to strengthen surveillance and rapid response nationwide. Guidelines for travelers: anyone who has traveled from or transited through Ebola-affected countries in the last 21 days must closely monitor health, reflecting Ebola's incubation window. Watch for fever, headache, muscle pain, vomiting/diarrhea, and unexplained bleeding. If symptoms appear, isolate immediately and contact local health authorities. 24/7 National Health Helpline 1075. Ebola transmits via direct contact with blood, secretions, organs, or other bodily fluids of infected people or animals, according to the World Health Organization. Prompt identification and isolation remain the key prevention steps.

triage.headline_ja: 政府がエボラ出血熱への警告を発表：国際旅行者への警戒が呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: インドでの実際の症例報告はなく、アフリカでの発生に対する予防的警告の段階。情報不足であり、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが発生地域として「Africa」と「India」を付与しているが、記事サマリーではインド国内での症例報告はなく、アフリカでの発生に対する予防的警告である。インドは該当対象国であるため verified_locations に含める。エボラウイルスの伝染性が高いため wpro_criteria の epidemic_prone は Yes と評価。実際の患者数や地域情報、管理可能性については不明である。

article.articleHeadline: エボラ出血熱、新しいワクチン3種が開発中　感染拡大の懸念の中
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Hemorrhagic Fever: Three New Vaccines Under Development Amid Concerns About the Spread of Infection
article.articleSummary: Ebola hemorrhagic fever in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is expanding due to Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with about 1,000 suspected cases and roughly 250 deaths reported; Uganda has 9 confirmed infections. The outbreak occurred in a resource-limited, conflict-affected area and was detected late, raising concern it could reach the scale of the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak (≈29,000 infections and >11,000 deaths). No approved vaccine exists for Bundibugyo, which has been detected only a few times previously. IAVI is developing an improved Zaire-based vaccine targeting Bundibugyo, showing near-complete protection in animal studies; clinical trials are expected in 7–9 months, with efforts to shorten timelines. Moderna is leveraging mRNA technology for Bundibugyo, and Oxford University is pursuing its own platform. CEPI funds these early efforts, while WHO hopes vaccines will aid outbreak control and future preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、新しいワクチン3種が開発中　感染拡大の懸念の中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。DRCでBundibugyo ebolavirus による約1,000疑似患者・250死亡、ウガンダ9確認患者の報告があり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、予想外の病原体（未承認ワクチン）、国際拡大リスク（ウガンダでの確認）、渡航・貿易制限のリスクが全て認められる。フルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでの主要な流行を述べており、ウガンダ（226074）は9確認患者の報告に留まる二次的位置付け。アンゴラ（3351879）はサマリーに言及されていないため除外。Bundibugyo ebolavirus は稀少で未承認ワクチン対象、リソース限定地域での遅発見という悪条件により、2014-2016西アフリカ流行規模への懸念が明記されている。CEPI、WHO、IAVI、Moderna、Oxford Universityの複数機関による国際的な対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Alertă sanitară: "Ebola se răspândește necontrolat de luni de zile". Pacientul 0 a fost identificat încă din ianuarie 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health alert: "Ebola has been spreading uncontrollably for months." Patient zero was identified as early as January 2026.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo likely spread uncontrollably since January 2026. Patient zero identified in Rwampara village, eastern RD Congo; first patient reportedly arrived at a hospital in late January and died in February after infecting eight hospital workers. Official recognition of an outbreak came on May 15, 2026. British publications cite at least 1,077 suspected cases and 223 deaths linked to Bundibugyo, with nine cases reported in neighboring Uganda. This year’s outbreak is among the three largest Ebola epidemics in history. No licensed vaccines or treatments exist for Bundibugyo. In Congo, only about 20% of close contacts have been traced, and thousands remain unaccounted for. Burundi and South Sudan are considered vulnerable due to proximity. As of June 2, 2026, authorities face ongoing transmission and potential cross-border spread.

triage.headline_ja: 保健警報：「エボラウイルスが数ヶ月間制御不能に拡散している」。患者ゼロは2026年1月にすでに特定されていた
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（1,077疑い例、223死亡）で、コンゴ民主共和国から周辺国への越境拡大リスクが高く、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響がある。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ型エボラの大規模アウトブレイク。2026年1月から制御不能な拡大が続いており、患者ゼロは東部RDコンゴのルワンパラ村で特定された。1月終盤に初患者が病院到着し、2月に死亡、8名の医療従事者に感染させている。公式なアウトブレイク認定は2026年5月15日。ウガンダで9例が報告されており、越境拡大の危険性が高い。ブンディブギョ型には認可されたワクチンや治療法が存在しない。濃厚接触者追跡率は約20%に留まり、数千人が未追跡。発生地域にはウガンダ、ブルンジ、南スーダンも含まれているが、記事の主要な焦点はDRCでのアウトブレイク。

article.articleHeadline: Έκτακτη τηλεδιάσκεψη των Ευρωπαίων υπουργών Υγείας για τον Έμπολα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Emergency teleconference of European health ministers on Ebola.
article.articleSummary: EU27 Health Ministers held an emergency teleconference on June 5, under Cyprus' rotating EU presidency, to bolster Europe’s defense against the Ebola epidemic affecting the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. The meeting aims to exchange information, coordinate actions among member states, and sharpen European preparedness measures. By end-May, authorities in two Central African states reported about 1,100 suspected Ebola cases and 263 laboratory-confirmed infections, with 43 deaths linked to the rare Bundibugyo strain, for which no vaccine exists. Rebel groups in the DRC’s remote epicenter hinder surveillance. In Europe, Italy raised the alert after a patient returning from Congo showed symptoms and was isolated in a Cagliari hospital, Sardinia; subsequent lab tests ruled out Ebola. A separate EPCSO Council discussion on June 16 will pursue coordinated European action.

triage.headline_ja: エボラについてのヨーロッパ保健大臣による緊急テレビ会議
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外性、国際的拡大リスク）。コンゴとウガンダでのエボラ流行に対するヨーロッパの対応体制強化を協議する高レベル会合であり、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはイタリア・キプロス・サルデーニャなども含まれているが、サマリーを精読すると、主要なエボラ流行はコンゴとウガンダで発生しており、イタリアの症例はコンゴからの帰還患者で後にエボラが除外されている。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。1,100件の疑似患者、263件の確認感染、43件の死亡が報告され、ワクチンが存在しないBundibugyo株である点が重症度を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: 肯亞總統力挺美國建伊波拉隔離中心　遭法院喊卡引爆民眾示威 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya's president backs the U.S. plan to build an Ebola isolation center; court halts it, sparking protests - Minshi News Network
article.articleSummary: Kenya’s President William Ruto defended the U.S.-backed Ebola isolation center at Laikipia Air Base, about 200 km from Nairobi, a 50-bed facility to quarantine American citizens returning from the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo. Funded by the United States and managed by a U.S. medical team, the project sparked fierce protests in Nanyuki over fears it could introduce the virus to the community. A court temporarily halted operations after a Katiba Institute lawsuit alleging opaque decision-making. Ruto framed the project as a national public-health measure and a strengthened Kenya–U.S. partnership, not politics. Kenya reports no Ebola cases yet; neighboring Uganda has several infections. Africa CDC data show the DRC outbreak since mid-May has surpassed 1,000 suspected cases with about 250 deaths, underscoring ongoing risk.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア大統領が米国によるエボラ隔離センター計画を支持　裁判所が差し止め、住民抗議勃発
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病という高リスク疾患のDRC発生地でのアウトブレイク（1000超の疑い例、250死亡）と、隣国ウガンダへの感染拡大、ケニアでの隔離施設建設をめぐる社会・政治的混乱が複合。IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）かつWPRO基準複数該当。国際的な懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの隔離施設計画であるが、エボラ発生地はDRCであり、ウガンダにも感染が確認されている。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを記載。DRCは対象国に含まれるため、シグナルピックアップの基準を満たす。配信日2026年は未来日であるが、記事内容の医学的・公衆衛生的価値は変わらない。

article.articleHeadline: Dünya Kupası'nda Ebola alarmı: Milyonlarca taraftar virüsü yayabilir
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola alert at the World Cup: Millions of fans could spread the virus.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak linked to the Bundibugyo variant in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda has experts warning that the North American World Cup could become a super-spreader event as 5.5 million fans travel to the tournament. More than 2,000 potentially exposed contacts remain unidentified, with incubation and early symptoms like fever and chills complicating detection; severe illness often appears about 48 hours after onset. A single infected fan could trigger major disruption, prompting emergency measures during the event. The World Health Organization says Congo's outbreak is outpacing current response capacity. Bundibugyo-related deaths exceed 220 across DRC and Uganda. Host nations are enforcing strict border controls and airport screenings; some DR Congo national team officials were evacuated to Europe and remain asymptomatic.

triage.headline_ja: ワールドカップでのエボラ警報：数百万のファンがウイルスを拡散させる可能性
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の複数国での同時発生、220名以上の死亡、国際的な大規模イベント（ワールドカップ）での超感染イベント化リスク、WHO警告による対応能力超過が確認される。IHR基準3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）が該当し、フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでのエボラ発生を明記しているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。記事中の『North American World Cup』という表現は将来時制であり、現在進行中の DRC および Uganda での発生と、それが北米ワールドカップへの影響リスクという構造。DRC は対象国（ID: 203312）に含まれるため列挙。2,000名以上の未特定接触者と220名超の死亡、WHO の対応能力超過警告により、IHR およびWPRO スクリーニング基準の全項目で懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: Allerta Ebola, il Piemonte si prepara: individuati sei ospedali di riferimento per eventuali casi sospetti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola alert: Piedmont prepares as six referral hospitals have been identified for potential suspected cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola alert in Piedmont, Italy: six regional referral hospitals identified for suspected cases, with 157 specialist third-level beds. In Turin, Giovanni Bosco and Regina Margherita Children's Hospital; other hubs in Novara, Vercelli, Verbania, and Asti. If investigations are needed, samples go to Milan's Sacco Hospital, the national reference center for highly contagious diseases. The regional health portal provides guidance for residents arriving from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. Those living in Piedmont or staying there in the past 21 days must submit a multilingual form and email it within 24 hours of arrival. After notification, local public health services will conduct verification and monitoring. Symptoms warrant avoiding direct hospital visits; self-isolate and contact health services (112/118). The measures follow the May 29, 2026 ministerial ordinance.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ警報：ピエモンテ州が準備、疑い例のための6つの基幹病院が特定されました
triage.triage_reason: イタリア（対象国外）でのエボラ関連の準備警報であり、DRCとウガンダからの渡航者スクリーニングが主題。実際の患者発生ではなく予防的措置のため、現時点では情報不足で経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事の主体はイタリアでのエボラ警報準備（イタリアは対象国外）。DRCとウガンダからの渡航者に対するスクリーニング措置が記述されているため、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。実際のエボラ患者発生報告ではなく、予防的・対応的措置の報道。

article.articleHeadline: 非洲伊波拉疫情擴散！台灣4名疫區返國旅客健康監測中 1人發燒幸排除感染
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: African Ebola outbreak spreading! Four travelers returning to Taiwan from epidemic areas are under health monitoring; one developed a fever, infection ruled out.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda are intensifying. As of May 31, the DRC reported 321 laboratory-confirmed cases, 48 deaths, 6 recoveries, and 220 suspected cases, with transmission centered in Ituri Province, North Kivu, and South Kivu across 23 health zones. Uganda has 9 confirmed cases and 1 death, linked to cross-border movement and healthcare exposure, concentrated in Kampala and Wakiso District. Taiwan has raised border measures: four nationals returning from these countries are under health monitoring; one with fever tested negative for Ebola. Since May 27, travelers from DRC and Uganda face 21 days of self-health management. From June 2, inbound entry from the two countries is suspended for 90 days and any issued visas will be temporarily invalidated. These steps accompany preparations for a major international event expected to attract 30,000–40,000 attendees, including over 400 from Ebola-affected nations.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカのエボラ出血熱流行が拡大！台湾の4名の疫病地域からの帰国旅客が健康監視中 1名が発熱したが感染は除外
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認症例・死亡者が報告され、DRCとウガンダで進行中の流行があり、複数のIHR基準（重篤な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当。さらに台湾を含む国際的な懸念と国境対策の強化が示されており、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。記事はDRCにおけるエボラ出血熱の主要な流行を述べており、ウガンダはDRCからの流行伝播との関連で言及されている。台湾での検出例は確認されていない。DRCでの321確認症例、48死亡、23保健地区での伝播は明らかな公衆衛生上の危機を示す。

article.articleHeadline: DRC Ebola cases top 300 as outbreak spreads to more health zones
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo-strain Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 300 confirmed cases and 48 deaths as of 2026-06-02. The outbreak now spans 23 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu, with Ituri alone reporting more than 260 confirmed infections. Health ministry figures show a widening footprint in eastern provinces affected by insecurity. Authorities say community resistance in Bunia and in the northeastern town of Nizi, along with rumours and disinformation, are complicating containment and response efforts. The case count and geographic spread underline ongoing transmission in eastern DRC and the challenges of outbreak control in areas with conflict and complex social dynamics. Continued monitoring and public-health actions are required to prevent further escalation.

triage.headline_ja: DRC（コンゴ民主共和国）のエボラ患者数が300人を超え、複数の保健地区に拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。Bundibugyo株エボラで300人超の確定患者、48人の死亡、23の保健地区への拡大、紛争地域での制御困難性が確認されており、国際的懸念と支援の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株エボラは重篤度が高く、300人超の確定患者と48人の死亡が報告されている。東部DRC（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）の23保健地区に拡大し、特にIturiだけで260人超の感染が確認されている。紛争地域での社会的抵抗と虚偽情報が対応を複雑にしており、今後のエスカレーション防止に向けた継続的な監視と公衆衛生対応が強く求められている。

article.articleHeadline: Sidee Soomaaliya uga hortagi kartaa xanuunka Ebola, xilli Soomaali badani ay ku nool yihiin dalalka uu ka dillaacay?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How can Somalia prevent Ebola virus disease, while many Somalis live in the countries where it has spread?
article.articleSummary: With Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, Somalia faces heightened risk despite having no confirmed cases. Thousands of Somalis live in Congo and Uganda as traders, students, and workers, and cross-border ties to Kinshasa and other Congolese cities have intensified movement. Health experts urge Somalia to reinforce border and airport health screenings and implement targeted testing and surveillance for travelers from outbreak areas, plus rapid quarantine facilities and enhanced healthcare worker training to handle emergencies. Public awareness campaigns stress avoiding exposure to body fluids and seeking prompt care for fever, vomiting, diarrhea, or bleeding. Authorities should strengthen cooperation with international health agencies and regional governments to access up-to-date outbreak information and track movements of people from affected countries. No cases yet in Somalia, but proactive measures are advised given rising contact with Congo and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: ソマリアはエボラウイルス病の発生にどう対抗できるか。多くのソマリア人が病気が拡がった国に住んでいる一方で
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱はCEPRの重点監視対象疾患であり、DRC・ウガンダでの発生とソマリアの高リスク状況が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ出血熱の地域的脅威を論じているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ソマリア・ウガンダは対象国ではないため verified_locations に含めない。DRCでの確認済み発生と国際的な人的移動パターンにより、早期の詳細RRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya's president defends planned US-backed Ebola quarantine facility
article.articleSummary: Kenya's President William Ruto defended a planned US-backed Ebola quarantine facility at Laikipia Air Base in Nanyuki, central Kenya, as part of national preparedness and longstanding health partnership with Washington. The plan, approved after a US request, would serve Kenyans and foreigners exposed to Ebola, amid a Bundibugyo-strain Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda that has killed 48 people and triggered a WHO public health emergency of international concern. A court temporarily suspended the plan last week amid legal challenges; Ruto did not acknowledge the order. A US C-130 reportedly flew into Nanyuki recently, with residents sighting military flights. Kenya has tightened border screening to about 3,000 people daily, with no Ebola cases detected domestically. The facility’s authorization follows Kenya’s provision of isolation, surveillance, and treatment capacity across 23 counties.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア大統領、米国が支援する予定のエボラ隔離施設を擁護
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的公衆衛生上の重大性（DRC・ウガンダでの流行、WHO国際的関心対象）、複数国（DRC、ウガンダ、ケニア）にまたがる地域的懸念、国際的支援と政治的関心の高さから、IHR基準2つ以上に該当し、シグナルとしてのフルRRA進行を判断。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC・ウガンダでのBundibugyo株エボラ出血熱の流行を背景に、ケニアが米国支援による隔離施設をLaikipia Air Base（Nanyuki）に建設する計画について述べている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。米国内の言及（Washington, District of Columbia）は施設計画の政治的側面を示すもので、米国での発生ではなく除外。既に WHO公衆衛生上の国際的懸念事象（PHEIC）として宣言されている状況であり、ケニアは予防的な地域的対応を進めている。

article.articleHeadline: Health: Ebola: No plan for lockdown as Uganda cases rise to
article.articleSummary: Uganda reports 11 confirmed Ebola Virus Disease cases as of 2026-06-02, with four imported and seven locally transmitted, including five health workers. Authorities reject a nationwide lockdown or school closures, pursuing targeted containment and border controls to curb cross-border transmission with the Democratic Republic of Congo. Case outcomes: Case 002 discharged; three more patients have tested negative and are due for discharge. A total of 634 contacts are under monitoring, with 22 discharged after 21 days; officials expect 125 discharged by Friday. Transmission is increasingly through local chains and within healthcare facilities, underscoring infection prevention gaps. Diagnostic capacity has been expanded with laboratories in Arua, Bwera Hospital, and four mobile labs to shorten confirmation times. Public misinformation concerns persist; officials urge reliance on verified sources, adherence to preventive measures, and avoiding nonessential travel to Congo.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダのエボラ患者数が増加する中、ロックダウン計画なし
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認患者数が増加（11例）し、ヒト-ヒト感染が進行中。IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国境を越えた伝播リスク、そして複数のWPRO基準（異常性、重症度、流行性、長期曝露）に該当するため、フルRRAへの進行が必須である。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウガンダも記載されているが、対象国リスト（CEPR加盟国）に含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ただしDRCとの国境を越えた伝播リスク、保健医療従事者への感染拡大、診断能力強化の動き、公式情報への信頼低下の懸念などが複合的に存在する重要なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Ministerios se mantienen en alerta en Venezuela debido a emergencia sanitaria pública por el ébola - teleSUR
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministries remain on alert in Venezuela due to public health emergency caused by Ebola - teleSUR.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-02, Venezuela’s Health, Transportation, and External Affairs Ministries remain on alert due to the WHO-declared public health emergency of international concern for Ebola linked to Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreaks in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo. Venezuela has activated risk notification and surveillance systems; no confirmed Ebola cases have been reported in the Americas, and national risk of spread is described as low. Starting this week, entry controls and surveillance at airports and ports will screen passengers arriving from Ebola-affected regions. Health Minister Carlos Alvarado stated that care protocols and a national response plan will be deployed in border areas in line with international guidance. Media reports of suspected cases in the United States and Brazil are not supported by official confirmations in the Americas. The WHO PHEIC concerns Uganda and the DRC outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: ベネズエラの各省庁がエボラ出血熱による公衆衛生緊急事態に関連して警戒態勢を維持
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WHO-PHEIC宣言済みのエボラ出血熱の国際的拡大警戒に対する地域的対応であり、フルRRA評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はベネズエラの警戒態勢だが、実際のエボラ出血熱のPHEIC発生地はウガンダとDRC。ブラジルはメディア報告の疑い事例の言及のみで公式確認はない。対象国リストに従いDRC、ウガンダ、ブラジルを verified_locations に含める。スペイン（カナリア諸島）と米国はBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれるが、記事本文ではこれらの地域での実発生の確認がないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 國內增加1起麻疹群聚案 預計監測至6/16
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: One new domestic measles cluster case; monitoring expected through June 16.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports 1 new imported measles case, creating a domestic cluster totaling 2 cases with 491 contacts traced and monitored through June 16. Case 1: foreign woman in her 30s who arrived mid-May; developed fever, cough, runny nose, and rash; laboratory-confirmed. Case 2: man in his 20s from northern Taiwan, cohabitant with Case 1; later developed cough, fever, and rash; laboratory-confirmed. Year to date: 11 measles cases in Taiwan (3 domestic, 8 imported). Authorities credit adherence to contact-tracing and isolation guidelines for limiting spread. Globally, measles outbreaks persist: Japan has more cases than last year; Bangladesh faces a severe outbreak since March with over 70,000 cases, more than 9,000 confirmed and 585 deaths, Dhaka region hardest hit. Additional Southeast Asian countries (Indonesia, Vietnam, Thailand) report cases exporting elsewhere. Domestic enterovirus activity is increasing; parents and childcare facilities urged to maintain hand and environmental hygiene and seek medical care for severe infant symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: 国内で麻疹集団発生1件が追加される 6月16日までの監視を予定
triage.triage_reason: バングラデシュにおける麻疹の大規模流行（70,000例以上、585死亡）がIHR基準の公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスクを満たす。複数国での同時発生と台湾での輸入症例による国内集団発生もスクリーニング基準に該当。
triage.notes: バングラデシュのダッカ地域での麻疹流行（3月以来70,000例以上、585死亡）が記事の主要テーマ。台湾の輸入症例と集団発生、日本での増加、東南アジア複数国での発生報告も記載。対象国リストにはバングラデシュが含まれないため verified_locations には含めず、実際の流行地域の対象国（インド、ベトナム、インドネシア、タイ）を記載。エンテロウイルスの活動増加も併記。

article.articleHeadline: 'Isolate yourself': Govt issues advisory for travellers from Ebola-affected countries showing symptoms
article.articleSummary: India's Union Ministry of Health and Family Welfare issued a precautionary advisory for travellers arriving from Ebola-affected countries amid ongoing African outbreaks. As of 2 June 2026, there are no reported Ebola cases in India. Travellers who have traveled from or transited through an Ebola-affected country within the past 21 days should remain alert for symptoms and immediately isolate themselves if fever, headache, muscle pain, vomiting, diarrhoea or unexplained bleeding develops, then inform local health authorities. A 24/7 health helpline (1075) is available for guidance. Early reporting is emphasized for timely medical intervention and to curb spread. The World Health Organization notes Ebola symptoms can be sudden and include fever, fatigue, malaise, muscle pain, sore throat, vomiting, diarrhoea, abdominal pain, rash, and impaired kidney/liver function; bleeding is less common and may occur later. No cases in India reported as of the date.

triage.headline_ja: 「自分自身を隔離してください」：政府はエボラ影響国からの渡航者に対する勧告を発令
triage.triage_reason: インドは予防的勧告を発令している（管理的対応）が、インド国内での確認症例はなく、現在のところ直接的な公衆衛生的脅威とはなっていない。アフリカでの流行継続に伴う警戒態勢として経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: インド国内での症例報告はなく、政府の予防的勧告段階。IHR基準では国際的拡大リスク（アフリカでの流行継続）と渡航制限のリスク（渡航勧告）で2基準該当。WPROスクリーニングではエボラの流行しやすさ（ヒト-ヒト感染）と管理可能性で基準該当。社会的・政治的関心が存在するが、インド国内での実際の流行は確認されていないため、現段階ではWATCHとしてアフリカでの情勢と連動した続報を注視する。

article.articleHeadline: Govt Issues Ebola Advisory, Says No Cases Detected Yet
article.articleSummary: India’s Health Ministry issued an Ebola virus disease advisory on 2026-06-02, stating no Ebola cases detected in the country. Officials urge heightened vigilance for travelers who recently moved through Ebola-affected countries and recommend monitoring for 21 days from last exposure. Symptoms to watch include fever, headache, muscle pain, vomiting, diarrhea, or unexplained bleeding; affected individuals should isolate and inform local health authorities promptly. The advisory coincides with a fresh Ebola outbreak in parts of Africa, prompting global surveillance. Public guidance directs use of the 24/7 Health Helpline 1075 for information and assistance. Ebola is a severe, often fatal illness with global fatality rates historically around 50% (range 25–90%). Transmission occurs via direct contact with blood, secretions, organs, or other bodily fluids of infected people or animals; prompt isolation curbs spread.

triage.headline_ja: 政府がエボラ勧告を発令、未検出と発表
triage.triage_reason: インドでのエボラ症例は検出されていないが、アフリカでの新規アウトブレイクに対応した予防的警告であり、国際的な関心と監視強化の背景がある。情報が限定的であり、実際の患者発生なしのため段階的確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはインドでの症例なしを明示。アフリカでの新規アウトブレイク背景による予防的警告。IHR基準2つ以上該当およびWPRO基準4つ以上該当するが、実患者発生なしのため段階的監視が適切。今後のアウトブレイク規模拡大および国境を越えた症例報告に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Congolese nationals top cases reported in Uganda
article.articleSummary: Uganda reports nine cumulative Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) cases, with Congolese nationals forming the majority (at least five) after crossing from DR Congo seeking treatment; last two cases reported on May 29 were Congolese, and no new cases have been reported as authorities bolster importation controls. The index case traces to a Congolese woman who arrived April 10, traveled from Arua to Entebbe, and sought care May 10 at a private Kampala hospital; she was discharged May 14 and returned to DR Congo, but health workers treating her were exposed. A second early case involved a 59-year-old Congolese man admitted May 11 at Kibuli Muslim Hospital (Kampala) with respiratory distress and other symptoms; he died and laboratory tests later confirmed Ebola Bundibugyo Virus Disease. Over 100 health workers and contacts were quarantined, with some testing positive. On May 25, two Ugandan health workers in a private facility tested positive and were admitted to the designated treatment unit. Health authorities urge vigilance and reporting of suspected cases; emphasize infection prevention.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：ウガンダで報告された患者の大多数がコンゴ人
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダでエボラウイルス病の確認例が9件報告され、死亡例、医療従事者への曝露、100名以上の接触者隔離が確認されている。IHR基準2つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数基準に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、ウガンダでの感染確認（9件、死亡例あり、医療従事者感染含む）およびDRC からの患者流入が明確に確認される。Bluedot APIで「Uganda」は国コードが提供されていないため、記事サマリーの地理的記述から直接特定。DRCはウガンダ側での患者の発生源であり、両国で検証される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola se širi bez kontrole: Preko 300 zaraženih, desetine mrtvih u novom talasu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreads out of control: More than 300 infected, dozens dead in a new wave.
article.articleSummary: As of June 2, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 300 confirmed cases and 48 deaths, across 23 health zones in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. Ituri accounts for the majority with over 260 infections. Public health authorities warn that distrust, resistance to measures, and misinformation—especially in Bunia and the city of Nizi—hinder the response. Four recovered patients have been discharged from the Evangelical Medical Center in Bunia, seen as an encouraging sign. The World Health Organization is coordinating the response; Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus recently met President Felix Tshisekedi to discuss containment steps. A new 60-bed treatment center opened in Bunia, and vaccine trials are under way. Logistics have included reopening the local airport for regular traffic with enhanced health screening to accelerate aid delivery. The outbreak was officially declared on May 15 and remains ongoing as of June 2, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが制御不能に広がる：新たな波で300人以上が感染、数十人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常な感染数・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模発生として国際的関心が極めて高く、フルRRA進行が必須。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の大規模発生。300例超の確定患者、48人の死亡、23保健地区に拡大。主要感染地はIturi州（260例以上）。WHO、大統領との協議など国際的対応が進行中。公衆衛生措置への住民抵抗とデマが懸念要因。新規治療センター開設、ワクチン試験進行。2026年5月15日公式宣言、6月2日時点で継続中。

article.articleHeadline: 注意！伊波拉疫區返台「1人輕微發燒」　檢驗結果曝│TVBS新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Attention! Returnees from Ebola-affected areas to Taiwan: "one person with a mild fever" — test results revealed | TVBS News Network
article.articleSummary: Taiwan tightens entry controls for travelers from Ebola-affected Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda. Since May 27, entrants must report to quarantine stations and undergo a 21-day self-health management with daily symptom reporting and twice-daily temperature checks. As of May 31, DRC has 321 confirmed Ebola cases (48 deaths, 6 recoveries) and 220 suspected cases awaiting confirmation; Uganda reports 9 confirmed cases (1 death). On June 2 at 00:00, Taiwan will suspend entry of residents from both countries for 90 days. Four Taiwanese nationals have been issued notices—two from Uganda and two from DRC—now under home-based self-monitoring. One arrival developed a mild fever the day after entry, was hospitalized for testing, but Ebola PCR was negative and the patient was discharged. The rainy season raises malaria risk; PCR testing is used to exclude Ebola, with authorities maintaining active symptom and temperature monitoring during the 21-day period.

triage.headline_ja: 注意！伊波拉疫區返台「1人輕微發燒」　檢驗結果曝
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症が対象国（DRC）で発生し、台湾への国際的な拡大リスク（輸入症例の危険性）があり、台湾が入国制限措置を実施している。IHR基準3項目、WPROスクリーニング基準3項目以上該当。
triage.notes: DRCおよびウガンダでのエボラウイルス感染症の発生に対して、台湾が入国制限（2026年6月2日より90日間の入国停止）を実施。検査結果は陰性だが、輸入症例のリスクが顕在化している。マラリアの併存も言及されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを記載。

article.articleHeadline: 4國人自伊波拉疫區返台 1人發燒採檢陰性排除感染
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Four foreign nationals return to Taiwan from Ebola-affected region; one person with fever tested negative, infection ruled out.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Africa prompts Taiwan to tighten borders. As of May 31, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) reports 321 confirmed cases, 48 deaths, 6 recoveries, and 220 suspected; Uganda has 9 confirmed cases and 1 death. Four Taiwanese nationals returned from Ebola-affected regions since May 27; two from the DRC and two from Uganda. One traveler developed a mild fever the day after arrival, but Ebola testing was negative. From May 27, inbound travelers with Congo/Uganda travel history undergo 21-day self-health management and entry quarantine. From 00:00 on June 2, Taiwan bans entry of residents from the DRC and Uganda, with exemptions for four categories including degree-seeking students admitted to study, diplomats/public servants, and Taiwanese spouses. Malaria and other infections are common in the region; fever requires confirmatory testing. A mid‑June international event (30,000–40,000 attendees) could bring 300–400 travelers from Congo/Uganda, impacting border controls.

triage.headline_ja: 4名の外国人がエボラ流行地域からタイワンに帰台、1名は発熱したが検査は陰性で感染が否定された
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも5項目全て該当し、エボラアウトブレイクに伴う国境管理措置の実施と国際的な旅行者管理が報告されている。
triage.notes: タイワン（台湾）はBluedotが発生地域として含めているが、記事サマリーではタイワンはエボラの発生地ではなく、流行地域からの帰台者を受け入れている国であるため verified_locations には含めない。DRCとウガンダでアクティブなエボラアウトブレイク中だが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCのみ verified_locations に含める。国際イベント開催予定による追加的なリスクが存在する。

article.articleHeadline: Cuatro sanitarias superan el ébola Bundibugyo en RDC mientras avanza la respuesta al brote
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Four female healthcare workers overcome Bundibugyo Ebola in the DRC as the outbreak response progresses.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak in Bunia, Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Four female nurses who treated patients in early May have been discharged after full recovery, bringing total recoveries to five, including a laboratory worker who recovered on May 28. No licensed vaccines or Ebola-specific treatments exist for Bundibugyo to date. The outbreak was declared May 15. As of May 31, the WHO records 210 confirmed Ebola cases and 17 deaths, with 349 suspected cases under investigation. Health workers infected since the start total 16, highlighting frontline risks. To strengthen response, WHO refurbished a Bunia Ebola treatment center with 24 beds (expandable to 60) and plans an annex for up to 42 more beds in coming weeks. Early care improves prognosis.

triage.headline_ja: 4人の女性医療従事者がコンゴ民主共和国でブンディブギョエボラを克服、アウトブレイク対応が進展
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。ブンディブギョエボラは210確定例と17死亡、医療従事者16人感染という重症アウトブレイク。ワクチンや特異的治療法が存在しない極めて危険な病原体である。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョエボラは治療法とワクチンが存在しない致命的な病原体。210確定例、17死亡、349疑い例で継続中。医療従事者16人感染は感染制御の脆弱性を示唆。WHO対応（治療センター拡充）が進行中。記事配信日は2026年6月（未来日付のため注意）。

article.articleHeadline: Znanstvenici žurno razvijaju cjepiva protiv tri soja ebole koji haraju Afrikom
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scientists are urgently developing vaccines against three strains of Ebola that are ravaging Africa.
article.articleSummary: Three new vaccines targeting the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola—one of six strains, with only three known to cause epidemics—are currently in development as the outbreak, which has claimed about 250 lives, intensifies. IAVI is leading on one candidate; Oxford University and Moderna are also pursuing Bundibugyo vaccines, supported by CEPI funding. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, there are more than 1,000 suspected Ebola cases; Uganda has nine confirmed cases. Health groups warn the outbreak could become the worst on record, potentially surpassing the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic that infected about 29,000 people and killed over 11,000. Dr. Mark Feinberg (IAVI) says the situation may be as bad or worse; MSF says the scale is deeply alarming. Vaccines exist for the most common Zaire strain, but none yet for Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカで猛威を振るう3つのエボラ株に対するワクチンを科学者が急速に開発中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行性・管理性が確認され、国際的な関心も高い。大規模なエボラアウトブレイク情報として緊急スクリーニングが必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはBundibugyo株のエボラアウトブレイクを主題としており、DRCで1,000件以上の疑似患者、ウガンダで9件の確定患者が報告されている。ただし、ウガンダ（GeoNames ID: 226074）は対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。2014-2016年西アフリカエピデミック（約29,000感染、11,000以上死亡）を上回る可能性があるとの警告により、国際的な医療支援と緊急対応が必要とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Ces pesanteurs qui freinent la lutte contre l'épidémie d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo-Kinshasa: The burdens that slow the fight against the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: More than two weeks after its trigger, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, caused by the Bundibugyo variant, continues to face major response challenges. In Ituri's Bunia, the main entry point, the May 23 suspension of flights at Bunia airport disrupted field operations, delaying transport of equipment and personnel from Kampala, Goma, and Kinshasa. Coordinators report limited human resources, with staff blocked in Kisangani and mobile teams unable to advance beyond three health zones. MSF notes pre-positioned stocks in Goma helped, but mass deployment requires broader coordination with authorities, WHO, and partners. On May 28, the health minister reopened Bunia airport for humanitarian flights; the first plane delivered 4.6 tonnes of essential materials, received by the WHO. COUSP underlines need for secure humanitarian corridors and faster funding to optimize resources across roughly a dozen affected health zones.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ流行との闘いを妨げる重い負担
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の流行が確認され、DRCで発生。IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際拡大リスク）に複数該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性、長期曝露、流行可能性、管理課題）にも複数該当。フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCのイツリ州ブニアで発生したエボラ流行（Bundibugyo変異体）が主題。ウガンダも発生地域に含まれているが、サマリーではウガンダでの確認例について言及されていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含める。飛行場の閉鎖による対応活動の遅延、人的資源不足、資金不足など、対応上の課題が明記されている点が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Кина испрати медицински експерти во Конго за борба против епидемијата на ебола - Press24
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China sent medical experts to Congo to fight the Ebola outbreak - Press24
article.articleSummary: China dispatched a team of medical experts to the Democratic Republic of Congo to assist the Ebola outbreak, deemed a public health emergency of international concern by the World Health Organization. The experts join Chinese personnel already on the ground to work with local health and epidemiological services, aid in prevention and treatment, train health workers, and support Chinese nationals and institutions in the country. The on-site team has activated emergency measures including enhanced staff training, preparedness drills, and coordination of medical supplies, while continuing to deliver healthcare to local communities and Chinese citizens. WHO reports at least 134 confirmed Ebola cases in the Congo-Uganda outbreak, with 18 deaths among confirmed cases. New suspected cases continue to appear, with over a thousand registered since the outbreak was declared on May 15. The outbreak, driven by the Bundibugyo strain, centers in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu.

triage.headline_ja: 中国がコンゴのエボラ流行対策に医療専門家を派遣 - Press24
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全てに該当。WHOが国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念事象（PHEIC）と宣言したエボラ流行で、134確認症例・18死亡が報告され、1000以上の疑い例がある。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが「中国」を発生地域に含めているが、これは中国が医療支援を派遣した国であり、エボラ流行の実際の発生地はDRC（South Kivu、Ituri）のみ。Uganda は地理的に隣接し、WHOレポートで「Congo-Uganda outbreak」と称されているが、記事サマリーでの具体的な症例報告はDRCに限定されているため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Tanjungpinang buka posko pemeriksaan penyakit malaria di Senggarang
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tanjungpinang Health Office Opens Malaria Screening Post in Senggarang
article.articleSummary: Malaria remains under active surveillance in Tanjungpinang, Kepulauan Riau, Indonesia, with a new screening post established in Senggarang to accelerate detection and treatment. The Health Office is focusing surveillance in RW 4, RW 6 and RW 7 of Senggarang after recent cases in Kampung Bugis and Senggarang. As of 24 April 2026, a total of 39 malaria cases have been recorded in the area: 4 in Kampung Bugis and 35 in Senggarang. The screening post aims to facilitate early case finding, reducing onward transmission. Treatments require a complete 14-day course using Dihydroartemisinin-Piperaquine (DHP) and Primaquine (Primakuin), supplied by the Ministry of Health. Authorities continue active and passive case finding, with case counts likely to rise as field investigations proceed. Community efforts to maintain clean environments and curb Anopheles mosquitoes are emphasized to break the transmission cycle.

triage.headline_ja: タンジュンピナン保健所がセンガラン地区でマラリア検査ポストを開設
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアの地域限定的なマラリア症例報告であるが、重症度や異常性に関する詳細情報が不足しており、IHR基準の該当数が判定困難。国内の公衆衛生対応は進行中だが、国際的な拡大リスクの評価には追加情報が必要。
triage.notes: インドネシアのタンジュンピナンにおけるマラリアの地域的な集積であり、保健当局が能動的・受動的症例発見を継続中。39症例が記録されているが、この数値が地域、国、地域的文脈においてどの程度異常であるかは不明。続報で死亡率、重症化率、地域的な拡大傾向が明らかになれば判定が変わる可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Terjangkit Leptospirosis, 7 Warga Gunungkidul Meninggal Dunia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Seven Gunungkidul Residents Die After Contracting Leptospirosis.
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis outbreak in Gunungkidul Regency, Yogyakarta, Indonesia, reports 33 confirmed cases and seven deaths as of the end of May 2026. Transmission is linked to rat urine, with the highest case tally in Nglipar District (10 cases) and fatalities distributed across Nglipar (1), Semin (1), Gedangsari (1), Ngawen (2), and Playen (2). Seven deaths indicate a rising fatality rate compared with last year, which had 30 cases and one death. Health authorities emphasize environmental cleanliness and rodent control to curb spread, and advise farmers to wear PPE such as boots and gloves when working in fields; any skin wounds should be washed with soap immediately. The Gunungkidul Health Service will continue health campaigns and provide early-detection tools to reduce fatalities through timely treatment.

triage.headline_ja: レプトスピラ症に感染、グヌンキドゥル州の7住民が死亡
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアのグヌンキドゥル地域でレプトスピラ症の集団発生が報告され、33確認患者と7死亡（前年1死亡から増加）が記録されている。重症度が高く、異常な死亡率上昇がIHR基準2項目以上に該当するため、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシア・ヨグヤカルタ州グヌンキドゥル地域での発生を明確に記載。前年比での死亡率上昇（30例1死→33例7死）が注目される。ネズミの尿を介した伝播と環境衛生対策の記述から、長期的な曝露リスクと流行適性が認識される。

article.articleHeadline: ABD vatandaşları için Ebola tesisi planı ortalığı karıştırdı! Kenya'da sokaklar ayağa kalktı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Plan for an Ebola facility for American citizens sparks uproar! Kenyan streets erupt.
article.articleSummary: Plan to establish an Ebola quarantine facility at Kenya's Laikipia Air Base to isolate US citizens exposed to Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo sparked protests in Nanyuki. The U.S. says the site would house about 30 health workers and 50 beds, backed by $13.5 million for outbreak preparedness; Kenya's Health Ministry says it would bolster domestic readiness and include isolation centers nationwide. The project was temporarily halted by Kenya's High Court after a Katiba Institute petition, which argued no Ebola treatment or quarantine facility may be established on Kenyan soil through foreign-state agreements, and banned entry of exposed individuals. Kenya Medical Association warned against the plan; Kenya Bar Association opposed turning the country into a waiting area for dangerous diseases. In DRC, Bundibugyo Ebola strain with over 1,000 suspected cases and hundreds of deaths; Uganda reports 9 cases and 1 death. Late detection and funerary practices worsen spread.

triage.headline_ja: 米国市民向けエボラ施設計画がケニアで波紋！ケニアの通りが騒然
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）は公衆衛生への重大な影響（DRCで1,000以上の疑い例、数百の死亡）を示しており、IHR Annex2基準の「異常性」「国際的拡大リスク」「渡航制限リスク」に該当。WPROスクリーニングでも重症度と長期曝露が明確であり、社会政治的関心も高い（ケニアの法的異議、医療団体の警告）。
triage.notes: ケニアはBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーはDRCでのBundibugyo株エボラの実際の流行（1,000以上の疑い例、数百の死亡）とウガンダでの9例に焦点を当てている。ケニアの件は施設計画提案に対する社会的反発であり、エボラの実際の発症地ではない。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Assam: Rabies Scare Grips Sonitpur Village After Death of Three Cows and Several Goats
article.articleSummary: Rabies scare grips Chandrapur village in Jamugurihat, Sonitpur district, Assam, after a suspected rabid dog attacked and killed three cows and several goats. Local Veterinary Department reportedly confirmed the animals died of rabies, intensifying fears of further livestock losses. Residents estimate around 40–50 rabid dogs roaming the area and note that a family member, including a son of a livestock owner, has been bitten. The community has appealed to the Veterinary Department and district administration for immediate preventive and containment actions, including vaccination drives and regular monitoring of animal health to prevent further deaths. The incident highlights issues of rabies prevention, stray-dog management, and animal vaccination, with locals urging swift official intervention to protect livelihoods dependent on livestock.

triage.headline_ja: アッサム州：ソニットプル村で3頭の牛と数匹のヤギが死亡後、狂犬病の恐怖が蔓延
triage.triage_reason: 家畜における狂犬病の局所的な集団発生で異常性と長期曝露リスクが認められるが、ヒト感染の報告が限定的（1家族）で、国際的拡大リスクは低い。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はアッサム州ソニットプル地区の家畜狂犬病集団発生に焦点。ヒト感染は1家族に限定され、重症度は低い。野犬40-50頭が存在し長期曝露リスクあり。地方自治体の対応が求められている状況。情報が部分的であるため、続報でヒト感染数拡大の有無を確認すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Congo re-opens airport at centre of Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues in Ituri, with Bunia airport re-opened after a suspension of passenger flights. The government implemented fever screening on departure/arrival and mandatory handwashing, denying boarding to anyone with fever. The Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention confirmed the Bundibugyo strain as Congo’s 17th Ebola outbreak, which the World Health Organization has declared a public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC). As of June 2, 321 confirmed Ebola cases and 48 deaths reported, with 15 of 36 health zones in Ituri affected; cases also detected in North and South Kivu and in Uganda. WHO Director-General Tedros visited Bunia, citing five recoveries but urging expanded testing, treatment capacity, and trust in health workers. The International Rescue Committee warns the outbreak is likely larger and more progressed than official figures, possibly spreading for up to three months before mid-May. The report does not specify the infection source.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴがエボラ発生の中心地の空港を再開
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、異常で予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO公衆衛生上の国際的懸念事象（PHEIC）宣言済み。複数国への拡大（DRC、ウガンダ）確認。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも症例が検出されているが、発生地域の主体はDRCであり、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。Bundibugyo株によるDRCの17番目のエボラ流行。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。IRC警告により実際の症例数が公式統計より大きい可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Reports Recovery of Five Ebola...
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is the 17th outbreak there. The World Health Organization reports 263 confirmed cases and 42 deaths in the DRC; neighboring Uganda notes 9 infections and 1 death. Five patients have recovered in the DRC, with four discharged on Sunday and one cleared earlier, marking a rare positive development amid the crisis. Bundibugyo is a rare Ebola variant with no approved vaccine or treatment and can kill up to half of those infected. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus welcomed the recoveries as transmission continues and public health efforts remain challenged. The outbreak underscores the absence of targeted vaccines or therapies for Bundibugyo, highlighting the need for containment and supportive care.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがエボラ患者5名の回復を報告
triage.triage_reason: ブンディブギョ型エボラ出血熱の確認症例263件、死亡42件（DRC）および国境を超えた拡大（ウガンダで9感染、1死亡）が報告されており、IHR基準の「公衆衛生への深刻な影響」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。また希少で治療法がない株であることから異常性が高く、WPRO基準複数該当。国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダの感染も言及されているが、対象国リストにウガンダ（1645445）が含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。ブンディブギョ型は稀な株で治療法がなく、致死率50%と報告されており、WHO事務局長も言及している重要なイベント。既に17番目のエボラ流行と記述されており、アフリカ地域での懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: Wali Kota Mojokerto Kawal Skrining TB Serentak di Puskesmas Kedundung
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mayor of Mojokerto Oversees Simultaneous TB Screening at Kedundung Public Health Center.
article.articleSummary: On 2 June 2026, Mojokerto City Mayor Ika Puspitasari (Ning Ita) oversaw simultaneous systematic tuberculosis (TB) screening at Kedundung Public Health Center in Magersari, Mojokerto City. The drive, using portable X-ray technology, aims to expand early detection and accelerate TB elimination in Mojokerto by 2028, ahead of the national target of 2032. The kickoff screening involved 65 participants, prioritizing high-risk groups such as the elderly, malnourished individuals, and stunted children under five, among other vulnerable populations. City authorities emphasize massive, systematic prevention and monitoring due to high population density and mobility around service and trade hubs, which can facilitate transmission.
