One participant, Siti Rochayah, joined despite feeling healthy, underscoring community support for early detection and timely treatment.

triage.headline_ja: モジョクルト市長、クドゥンドゥン保健センターでのTB同時スクリーニングを監視
triage.triage_reason: 結核の同時スクリーニング実施は公式主導の予防活動であり、異常な流行イベントではない。記事は行政的な防止キャンペーンの実績報告であり、緊急的な感染症リスクシグナルの証拠は不十分。
triage.notes: 記事はモジョクルト市における組織的なTBスクリーニング計画であり、新規患者の大量発生や流行の報告ではない。ただし、高人口密度・高い流動性による結核感染リスク懸念が記述されており、今後の発生動向に注意が必要。スクリーニング参加者数（65名）は限定的で、重症例や死亡の報告なし。情報が公式アナウンスレベルであるため詳細なリスク指標は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Tshisekedi et Macron réaffirment leur volonté pour une réponse coordonnée contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tshisekedi and Macron reaffirm their commitment to a coordinated response against Ebola
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak confirmed May 15, 2026 in Ituri Province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with cases also in North Kivu and South Kivu. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, noting a rare viral strain for which there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. In a June 2026 discussion, French President Emmanuel Macron and Democratic Republic of the Congo President Félix Tshisekedi reaffirmed a coordinated international response and bilateral cooperation, including economic engagement supported by the private sector. They also stressed France’s backing for peace initiatives in the Great Lakes region (Washington and Doha processes addressing Kinshasa–Kigali and Kinshasa–AFC/M23) and urged reopening of Goma airport to permit humanitarian flights. An October 2025 Paris conference with Togo aimed to resume two weekly humanitarian flights with small aircraft, though progress remains slow amid mutual accusations between Kinshasa and AFC/M23.

triage.headline_ja: シセケディとマクロン、エボラに対する協調対応への決意を再確認
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認された大規模アウトブレイク（PHEIC宣言済み、新型株、ワクチン/治療法なし）であり、IHR基準4項目全て該当し、国際的な高い懸念がある。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのエボラアウトブレイク（5月15日確認、Ituri/North Kivu/South Kivu州）を主題としており、WHO PHEIC宣言済み、新型株でワクチン・治療法なし。オーストラリア、フランス、トーゴは地域検証では除外（DRCとの外交協議の文脈のみ）。フル RRA推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola's long shadow over the World Cup
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus–driven outbreak in Ituri Province, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, is spreading across urban and rural areas and has crossed into Uganda as authorities tighten cross-border controls ahead of the FIFA World Cup. About 3,500 contacts are being monitored across Uganda and DRC, with contact tracing expanding to seven of eight Ituri health zones. Uganda issued temporary border restrictions on May 27, allowing only authorized Ebola response teams, humanitarian operations, cargo and security personnel, while border districts' schools boost health surveillance. Nearly US$500 million in pledged support underscores the urgency. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus, a rare strain for which there is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment; control relies on surveillance, isolation, contact tracing and community engagement. Testing initially focused on the Zaire strain, delaying detection. Though smaller than West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic (28,000 infections, 11,000 deaths), officials warn of cross-border risks amid displacement and conflict. World Cup timing magnifies global vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスのワールドカップへの影響
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、予想外の国境越境、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。ブンディブギョエボラウイルスの稀な株による多国間アウトブレイクで、ワールドカップという国際的イベントと時期が重なり、高い社会政治的関心がある。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo地区はDRC東部Ituri州に位置し、ウガンダへの国境越境が確認されている。記事サマリーの主題はDRCでのアウトブレイク発生であるため、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。稀なBundibugyo Ebolavirus株で、ワクチンが利用できない重大なリスク。約3,500人の接触者監視中。約5億米ドルの支援が誓約されている。

article.articleHeadline: Palace says dengue vaccine under FDA review
article.articleSummary: TAK-003 (Qdenga), a live-attenuated tetravalent dengue vaccine from Takeda, remains under FDA review in the Philippines as the government awaits the applicant's responses to questions raised during evaluation. The Department of Health notes data showing lower efficacy in children 4–5 years old compared with older groups, and concerns that severe dengue type 3 could occur in those with no prior dengue infection. Dengue type 3 is among strains circulating in the Philippines. TAK-003 has been approved in multiple countries across Europe, Asia and Latin America. The WHO emphasizes vector control as the primary prevention strategy. The Dengue issue evokes memories of the 2018 Dengvaxia controversy, though no direct link to fatalities has been established. National cases declined 57% this year to 48,151 from 110,924 last year, underscoring persistent endemic transmission in the Philippines, among Southeast Asia's highest dengue burdens.

triage.headline_ja: 宮殿、デング熱ワクチンがFDA審査中であると発表
triage.triage_reason: デング熱は風土病的に流行しており、ワクチン承認審査中という政策関連の動きがあるが、新規の流行拡大やアウトブレイク報告ではなく、むしろ症例は前年比57%減少している。引き続き情報を注視する必要があるが、現時点では緊急性が低い。
triage.notes: フィリピンは東南アジアで最高レベルのデング熱負担国であり、TAK-003ワクチンの承認審査は政策レベルで注視されている。しかし記事の主眼はワクチン承認プロセスであり、新規のアウトブレイクではない。むしろ症例数は前年比で大幅に減少しており、IHR基準を満たさない。2018年のDengvaxia論争への記載は歴史的参照であり、現在の事象とは別である。

article.articleHeadline: Еболата се шири во Конго, потврдени се повеќе од 300 случаи и 48 смртни исходи
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading in Congo, more than 300 cases and 48 deaths confirmed.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 300 confirmed cases and 48 deaths as of June 2, 2026, spanning 23 health zones in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. Ituri is the hardest hit with more than 260 cases. Response efforts are hampered by misinformation and distrust, with resistance to health measures and rumors centered in Bunia, the Ituri capital, and the northeastern town of Nizi. Four patients have recovered and were discharged from the Evangelical Medical Center in Bunia. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Congo to discuss the response to the Bundibugyo Ebola strain; authorities and partners opened a 60-bed treatment center in Bunia, and vaccine evaluations are underway. Bunia airport has reopened to regular traffic after enhanced health screening to facilitate aid delivery. The outbreak was officially declared on May 15.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴで拡大、300件以上の確認事例と48人の死亡が報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。エボラアウトブレイク（300例以上、48死亡）は最優先シグナル。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）の大規模アウトブレイク。23の保健地域に拡大、Ituri州が最も被害（260例以上）。WHO総長訪問、治療センター開設、ワクチン評価実施中。ヘルスケア施設への不信と流言飛語が対応を阻害。2026年5月15日公式宣言。

article.articleHeadline: Քենիայում երկու մարդ է զոհվել Էբոլայի դեմ պայքարի ամերիկյան կարանտինային կենտրոնի դեմ բողոքի ցույցերի ժամանակ․ Reuters
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two people have died in Kenya during protests against the U.S. Ebola quarantine center.
article.articleSummary: Two people died in Kenya's central region at a Laikipia military base during protests against a U.S.-run Ebola quarantine center intended for Americans potentially infected in the Democratic Republic of Congo. Circumstances of the fatalities are unknown, and Kenya's national police have not commented. Earlier reports from Citizen TV described hundreds in Nanyuki town demonstrating against the project, with protesters setting fires, blocking roads, and throwing rocks at police; authorities used tear gas and detained at least five. The Kenyans portal notes that Nairobi High Court had earlier paused the project pending a challenge by civil rights and medical groups who cited lack of public consultations and potential risks to the health system. Kenyan authorities frame the project as part of international efforts to prepare for infectious disease outbreaks and consistent with national health system capabilities.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラ出血熱対策の米国カランティーンセンターに対する抗議デモ中に2人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症という高リスク疾患の確認に加え、国際的に拡大するリスク、国家レベルの社会政治的懸念、および複数のIHR/WPRO基準に該当するため、フルRRA実施の対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーによると、イベントはケニア（Laikipia軍事基地）で発生しているが、米国運営のエボラ隔離施設はコンゴ民主共和国での感染リスクに対応するために設置されている。Bluedot APIは Kenya（対象国リストに含まれない）を検出しているが、サマリー上で実際の感染症発生は DRC に関連している。ケニアでの死亡は抗議デモ中の事象であり、エボラウイルス感染症の確定患者報告ではないが、国際的な感染症対応インフラをめぐる重大なイベントとして認識される。verified_locations には DRC のみを記載。社会的・政治的関心が非常に高い。

article.articleHeadline: Karanténa pro Američany s ebolou budí v Keni vášně: Demonstrace má dvě oběti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Quarantine for Americans with Ebola stirs passions in Kenya: The demonstration has two casualties.
article.articleSummary: On Monday in Nanyuki, central Kenya, two protesters were killed during demonstrations against a U.S. plan to establish a quarantine facility for Ebola patients at a nearby military base. The circumstances of the deaths are unclear. The project would isolate and treat Americans potentially exposed to Ebola and has drawn local criticism over health risks and why Kenya should host a U.S.-run center. Kenyan President William Ruto defended the plan as part of national preparedness and ongoing public-health cooperation with the United States, noting similar facilities exist in 23 counties and that the center could serve Kenyan citizens if needed. A Kenyan court last week temporarily halted the project following a lawsuit alleging it could endanger public health. Separately, the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda are contending with an Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak; Kenya reports no cases yet, but border and airport checks screen about 3,000 travelers daily.

triage.headline_ja: 米国人によるエボラ隔離がケニアで波紋：デモで2人が犠牲
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの国際的な拡大リスク、複数国での同時流行（DRC、ウガンダ）、米国関連施設に対する公衆衛生懸念が存在し、IHR基準2つ以上該当。また異常性、重症度、管理可能性のWPRO基準も該当し、社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではケニアでのデモと隔離施設建設計画が主題だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCはエボラ Bundibugyo アウトブレイク流行中として記事で言及されており、対象国であるため含める。ウガンダも流行が言及されているが対象国リストに含まれない。エボラの国際的リスク、複数国での流行、米国関連の国際的関心が高く、全IHR基準に該当。

article.articleHeadline: مقتل شخصين خلال احتجاجات ضد مركز أمريكى للحجر الصحى من الإيبولا فى كينيا - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two killed during protests against an American Ebola quarantine center in Kenya - Youm7
article.articleSummary: Two people were killed in Nanyuki, Kenya, during protests against a US-backed plan to build a private Ebola quarantine facility near Laikipia Air Base. Protest organizers and security sources told Reuters that gunfire erupted as police dispersed hundreds of demonstrators. Kenya’s High Court had temporarily suspended the project amid a legal challenge, with a new hearing slated for Tuesday. Despite the court order, US officials said military aircraft have continued delivering equipment and personnel to the site. President William Ruto defended the project as part of a national preparedness program and a health partnership with the United States, stating it would serve Kenyan and foreign nationals alike. The proposed 50-bed center would receive Americans exposed to Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo or Uganda who show no symptoms, with any developing cases moved elsewhere for treatment. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo strain in eastern DRC, spreading to Uganda, with over 900 suspected cases and more than 220 deaths; actual numbers may be higher.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアの米国支援エボラ隔離センター反対デモで2人死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス疾患という高リスク病原体の国際的対応と、実際の死亡を伴う社会的紛争が発生。IHR基準3項目該当（重症性、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）およびWPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は、DRCおよびウガンダで発生しているエボラ(Bundibugyo strain)の国際対応に関連する、ケニアでの社会的紛争。ケニアはサマリー上で隔離センター建設反対デモの会場だが、実際の疾患発生地はDRCとウガンダ。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。ケニアとウガンダは対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch in der Demokratischen Republik Kongo: 321 bestätigte Fälle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: 321 confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 321 laboratory-confirmed cases with 48 deaths across three eastern provinces, according to authorities. The World Health Organization estimates nearly 1,000 suspected cases. The Bundibugyo virus, a relative of Ebola, drives transmission through close contact and bodily fluids, and while the global risk is considered low, the outbreak is unfolding amid heavy fighting, displacement, and restricted access that hinder containment. Aid shortages and funding cuts compound challenges, with no approved vaccine or approved specific therapy available. WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged containment efforts in Bunia, noting ongoing risk to health workers and communities. The situation is complemented by international responses, including US plans to establish a quarantine and treatment center in Kenya for potentially infected Americans, a project met with protests and a Kenyan court injunction.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ出血熱の流行：321例の確定患者
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全てに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。確定患者321例、死亡48例の重大な流行で、地域的な拡大リスク（ケニアでの隔離センター設立計画）と国際的な関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにおいて、エボラの発生地はDRC（特にBunia、東部3州）と明記されている。米国とケニアについては、DRCの患者対応のための隔離・治療センター設立計画が記述されているが、これらの国での実際の患者発生ではなく、対応策に過ぎないため verified_locations には含めない。BundibugyoウイルスはEbolaの関連種で、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性、医療従事者への感染リスク、紛争地域での感染対策の困難性が報告されており、管理可能性が低い。

article.articleHeadline: 肯雅爆示威反伊波拉隔离设施 酿2死 - 国际 - 带你看世界
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya erupts in protests against Ebola isolation facility, leaving 2 dead - International - See the World
article.articleSummary: Kenya saw anti-US protests in Laikipia County’s Nanyuki over plans to establish a 50-bed Ebola isolation facility at a local air force base to receive Americans exposed to Ebola. The demonstrations left two people dead, with protesters blocking roads and burning debris. Locals criticized the government for not consulting residents, arguing Laikipia is not an Ebola hotspot and should not bear the risk. The project had been paused by a court order, with a Tuesday hearing scheduled. Kenyan President William Ruto publicly defended the plan, saying the facility resembles others in the country and urged Kenyans not to doubt the government's preventive capacity. Separately, the Democratic Republic of Congo reported rising Ebola cases with nearly 50 deaths, as China dispatched its first expert group to support Congo’s outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアがエボラ隔離施設に対する抗議で2人が死亡 - 国際 - 世界を見る
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱という高い危険性を持つ感染症について、ケニアでの社会不安（2人死亡の抗議活動）とコンゴでの症例増加が報道されており、IHR基準（異常性、公衆衛生影響、国際的関心）に複数該当。
triage.notes: ケニアはWPRO対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。コンゴでのエボラ症例増加（約50人の死亡）と中国専門家派遣が記事サマリーで主題として記述されているため、DRCのみを検証済みロケーションとした。ケニアでのストレスイベントはエボラ隔離施設反対デモであり、実際のエボラ発生とは異なるが、社会的政治的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Deadly protest in Kenya against Ebola quarantine centre
article.articleSummary: Two people in Nanyuki, Kenya, died after police opened fire on protesters opposing a planned US Ebola quarantine facility at Laikipia Air Base. The organiser said both died; a security source did not specify the cause. The 50-bed unit would house Americans exposed to Ebola in the DRC or Uganda and would be staffed by the US Public Health Service. A Kenyan court suspended the plan amid a lawsuit; another hearing was due. Despite the order, US staff have continued arriving. President William Ruto described the facility as part of a national preparedness plan and Washington partnership, saying it would serve Kenyans and foreign nationals. The Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak is centered in eastern Congo with spillover into Uganda; over 900 suspected cases and more than 220 deaths since May 15. A US citizen treated in DRC was moved to Germany; seven others were sent to the Czech Republic.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアのエボラ隔離センターに対する抗議デモで2人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的な拡大リスク（DRC・ウガンダでの流行、米国市民のドイツ・チェコへの移送）と、深刻な公衆衛生影響（220人以上の死亡、900人以上の疑い例）が確認され、IHR基準2つ以上に該当。また社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: Nanyuki（ケニア）とLaikipia（ケニア）はサマリーに記載されているが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。実際のエボラ流行はDRC（スピルオーバーあり）とウガンダで発生している。米国市民のドイツ・チェコへの移送は治療目的であり、新規の感染事例ではなく、国際対応の一環。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: Director-Geral da OMS Termina Visita à RDC Com Apelo ao Reforço da Resposta à Doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: WHO Director-General Ends Visit to the DRC With Appeal to Strengthen the Ebola Response
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Ghebreyesus wrapped up his visit to the Democratic Republic of Congo amid an Ebola outbreak, the third largest on record. Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu have been affected; the outbreak has lingered undetected for weeks, with health workers struggling to detect, isolate cases, trace contacts, and ensure safe burials. As figures, 906 suspected cases with 223 deaths under investigation; 282 confirmed cases and 42 deaths reported, 264 in Ituri, 15 in North Kivu, 3 in South Kivu. Armed-group violence, including ADF attacks in Beni that killed 15 civilians and a soldier, complicates response. Uganda has confirmed Ebola cases too. IRC warns the true scale may be far larger; only about 20% of contacts traced. Bundibugyo strain lacks an approved vaccine; CEPI plans $60 million to accelerate vaccine development; China will send a medical team. Tedros urged stronger testing, treatment capacity, and community leadership.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ: WHO事務局長がコンゴ民主共和国訪問を終了、対応強化を呼び掛け
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な大規模発生、国際的拡大（ウガンダ確認）、国際的関心と支援の必要性）。WPRO基準も複数該当。フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはChina（1814991）が含まれているが、サマリーを精読するとChina は医療チーム派遣の計画言及のみであり、実際のエボラ発生地ではない。したがって verified_locations から除外。ウガンダはDRC対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。エボラウイルス病は最高リスク病原体であり、第3位の大規模発生（906疑い症例、282確認症例、42死亡）、ウガンダへの越境例確認、武装勢力による紛争が対応を阻害、ワクチン未承認株（Bundibugyo）が流行しており、国際的支援（CEPI 6000万ドル、中国医療チーム派遣）が必要。WHO事務局長訪問・声明により高い国際的政治的関心。

article.articleHeadline: 日本麻疹炸鍋！確診人數暴增4倍 東京成重災區
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles outbreak in Japan! Confirmed cases surge fourfold; Tokyo becomes a hard-hit area.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreaks continue in Japan, with cases reaching 511 by May 24, a fourfold rise from the previous year and the second-highest in a decade. Tokyo accounts for about half, with 253 cases; the week May 18–24 added 11 new cases, eight in Tokyo, signaling the capital region as the outbreak's core hotspot. Measles is highly contagious and spreads via air; after ~10 days of incubation, patients develop fever, cough, and rash, potentially leading to pneumonia and other complications. Japan's Health Ministry is reviewing control measures and urging verification of personal MMR vaccination records. Citizens with fever or rash should minimize outings and seek prompt medical care to prevent spread. Southeast Asian countries such as Vietnam, Indonesia, and Thailand continue to report cases and export infections; travelers returning with fever, cough, runny nose, red eyes or rash should wear a mask and seek medical care, and report travel history to clinicians.

triage.headline_ja: 日本麻疹炸鍋！確診人數暴增4倍 東京成重災區（日本の麻疹が大流行！確診者数が4倍激増、東京が重災地となる）
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の急速な流行拡大（前年比4倍、過去10年で2番目の水準）、高い伝染性、複数国への国際的な拡大の報告、および社会的・政治的関心の高さからIHR基準3つ以上に該当し、WPRO基準も複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは日本の麻疹アウトブレイクを主題としているが、Bluedot APIの発生地域にはJapanが含まれている。しかし対象国リストにはJapanが含まれないため、verified_locationsには日本は含めない。記事内で「ベトナム、インドネシア、タイなどの東南アジア諸国が症例報告を続け、感染を輸出している」と明記されており、これらの対象国における麻疹の継続的な流行が実際に発生していることが確認される。WPRO基準のすべてが該当し、国家間の公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Coming Weeks Critical for Ebola Response in DR Congo - MSF
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in DRC (Bundibugyo virus) intensifies as MSF strengthens treatment and containment; No approved vaccines or specific treatments. As of 28 May, 125 confirmed cases, 906 suspected cases, and 223 deaths have been reported across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu, though the true scale is uncertain due to limited testing and access. Ituri is the epicentre, accounting for more than 90% of suspected cases, with increases in Mongbwalu and Rwampara. MSF is constructing a 65-bed Ebola treatment centre in Ituri and supporting care and isolation at Mongbwalu General Referral and Fataki General Referral hospitals. Bunia isolation at Salama hospital with support. In North Kivu, an 80-bed ETC in Goma with isolation units in Walikale, Mweso, Rutshuru, and Kyeshero hospital. In South Kivu, two ETCs are planned for Bukavu and Lwiro. Testing remains bottlenecked; hundreds of samples await processing; supplies delivered. Weeks are critical to scaling care and testing.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ対応の数週間が重要 - MSF
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱の確認患者125名、疑い患者906名、死亡223名の大規模流行であり、複数国への拡大懸念がある。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダ・ルワンダも含まれるが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCのエボラ流行。ウガンダ・ルワンダについて具体的な患者報告や流行拡大は記載されていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。Bundibugyo virus subtype、北キブ州・南キブ州・イトゥリ州で多数の治療センター設置が進行中。検査能力の不足が大きな課題として指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: DSÖ'den Ebola açıklaması! - Bursa Hakimiyet
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola statement from WHO! - Bursa Hakimiyet
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease continues in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Bunia. As of 2026-06-02, the outbreak has 282 laboratory-confirmed cases and 42 deaths, with 19 new positives reported; five people have recovered after four Bunia nurses and a laboratory worker were discharged. The World Health Organization notes there is currently no approved vaccine or specific therapy for Bundibugyo Ebola, but good medical care can enable recovery. The crisis—the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC and the third-largest in the country’s history—has prompted intensified response and surveillance; Africa CDC chief Jean Kaseya says regional spread risk is rising, with more than 1,100 suspected cases under investigation. Internationally, suspected Ebola cases in Brazil (São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro) and Italy (Cagliari) led to testing; Brazil found meningitis and malaria, while Italy reported negative Ebola tests, and investigations continue in Brazil linked to travel from DRC or Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: WHOからのエボラに関する声明！ - Bursa Hakimiyet
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo型）のDRC発生と複数国への疑い事例報告は、国際通知相当のシグナルである。
triage.notes: DRCで確認されたBundibugyo Ebola virus disease（282確定患者、42死亡、1,100以上の疑い患者）は17番目のエボラアウトブレークであり、国内歴史上3番目の規模。BrazilとItalyで疑い事例が報告されたが、Brazilは確定患者なし（髄膜炎・マラリア）、Italyは陰性。ただしBrazilのDRC/Uganda渡航関連の調査は継続中。Africa CDC長官による地域拡大リスク上昇の警告あり。WPROリストにはUgandaが含まれるが、記事サマリーではBrazilでの症例確認がなく、DRCとBrazilの疑い事例調査が主要な国際関心である。Italyはリスト対象国外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo re-opens airport at centre of Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: DR Congo re-opens Bunia airport in Ituri province to resume air transport with safety measures after suspending passenger flights; passengers will undergo temperature screening both ways, must wash hands, and anyone with fever is barred. The Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak was declared by Africa CDC on May 15 and designated a WHO public health emergency of international concern. As of June 2, 2026, there are 321 confirmed Ebola cases and 48 confirmed deaths, with the outbreak spanning 15 of Ituri’s 36 health zones and crossing into North and South Kivu and into Uganda. The move follows a visit by WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, who cited five recoveries but stressed the need to boost testing, treatment capacity, and trust in health workers. The International Rescue Committee warned the true scale may be larger, potentially spreading for months before detection; the outbreak is the 17th Ebola event in DRC and among the largest on record.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱流行の中心地の空港を再開
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、予想外の流行、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク）。WHO緊急事態宣言済み、複数国への拡大、高い死亡率、国際的な懸念が存在。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak declared WHO public health emergency of international concern on May 15, 2026. As of June 2, 2026: 321 confirmed cases, 48 confirmed deaths across 15 health zones in Ituri province, with spread to North Kivu, South Kivu, and Uganda. WHO Director-General visited the region. International Rescue Committee warns actual scale may be larger. This is the 17th Ebola event in DRC and among the largest recorded. Uganda mentioned as affected location but DRC is primary reporting focus; regional verification noted.

article.articleHeadline: Zambia undertakes the second round of the polio vaccination campaign to protect every child against polio - Zambia
article.articleSummary: Polio vaccination campaign in Zambia enters a second round (2–5 June 2026) to protect children under five in six provinces—Lusaka, Southern, Eastern, Central, Western, and Muchinga. The drive aims to reach more than 3.8 million youngsters with oral polio vaccine, reinforcing multi-dose immunity to interrupt transmission. This follows an April 2026 round that reached about 3.8 million and exceeded the national target of 3.7 million. The campaign responds to poliovirus detected in Lusaka environmental samples earlier this year and aligns with regional efforts in Mozambique, Malawi, Zimbabwe, and Namibia to curb cross-border spread. Vaccination teams will conduct door-to-door visits and outreach in markets, schools, churches, and health facilities; every child under five will be offered vaccine, even if previously vaccinated. Supported by MoH, WHO, UNICEF, Rotary, and GPEI, the initiative stresses sustained immunity and routine immunization; report sudden paralysis to facilities.

triage.headline_ja: ザンビアがポリオワクチン接種キャンペーンの第2ラウンドを実施し、すべての子どもをポリオから保護する
triage.triage_reason: ポリオウイルスがザンビアの環境サンプルから検出され、複数国での地域的な流行リスクが存在するため、IHR基準（異常性・国際拡大リスク・公衆衛生影響）を複数満たす。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは環境サンプルからのポリオウイルス検出をザンビアで報告しており、モザンビーク、マラウイ、ジンバブエ、ナミビアでの地域的な対応との連携が述べられている。これらの隣接国は対象国リストに含まれないが、ザンビアでの事象は確認済みである。公式な保健機関（MoH、WHO、UNICEF、Rotary、GPEI）が関与しており、国家的・国際的対応レベルが高い。

article.articleHeadline: No Ebola cases in India, Health Ministry issues advisory amid Africa outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of 2 June 2026, India reports no Ebola virus disease cases. The Health Ministry issued a public health advisory amid a fresh Ebola outbreak in Africa, urging travellers who have recently arrived from or transited through Ebola-affected countries to monitor for 21 days, isolate if symptoms develop (fever, headache, muscle pain, vomiting, diarrhoea, or unexplained bleeding), and promptly inform local health authorities. The public is advised to use the 24×7 Health Helpline 1075 for guidance. Early reporting is emphasized as crucial to save lives and prevent transmission. Ebola is a severe illness with a global average fatality rate around 50% (historical range 25–90%). Transmission occurs via direct contact with blood, secretions, organs, or other bodily fluids of infected people or animals, and the 21-day monitoring reflects the maximum incubation period used for surveillance and contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: インド国内でのエボラ出血熱症例はなし、アフリカでの流行に伴い保健省が勧告を発表
triage.triage_reason: アフリカでのエボラ出血熱流行は重大だが、本記事の主題はインドにおける予防的勧告であり、当該国での実際の症例発生ではない。情報がインドの公衆衛生対応に限定されているため。
triage.notes: アフリカでのエボラ流行は重大だが、本記事はインド国内での症例報告ではなく、インド保健省による予防的勧告と監視体制の確立に関するものである。Bluedot APIで Africa が発生地域に含まれているが、対象国リストに該当しないため除外。インドは渡航者スクリーニングと公衆衛生警告の対象国として verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Javalis ampliam risco sanitário no entorno das granjas, alerta Embrapa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Wild boars increase sanitary risk around farms, Embrapa warns.
article.articleSummary: Wild boars in Brazil pose a broader sanitary risk beyond crop damage, warns Embrapa Swine and Poultry. Invasive boars alter environmental health dynamics by introducing new pathogens and amplifying existing ones, expanding epidemiological interfaces among wildlife, domestic animals, and humans. Brazil’s program, run with the Ministry of Agriculture since 2012, notes the challenge is greater than the United States, which has about 6 million wild boars and US$3.4 billion in annual losses. In Brazil, the problem spans biomes, with boars sharing water and food with other species—maned wolves, jaguarundis, and domestic dogs—creating pathogen pathways before farms. Minas Gerais camera images illustrate this shared environment. Hematophagous bats are cited as reservoirs carrying multiple pathogens, often without clinical signs. The speaker emphasizes asymptomatic circulation and the difficulty of convincing people who access these animals to acknowledge the risk; hunters may handle boars without gloves.

triage.headline_ja: イノシシが農場周辺の衛生的リスクを拡大、エンブラパが警告
triage.triage_reason: 野生イノシシによる人獣共通感染症リスクの潜在的な懸念があるが、具体的な疾患名、患者数、確認された病原体、発症事例などの情報が不足している。環境・野生動物リスクの警告段階であり、人への実際の感染事例は記述されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は野生イノシシ由来の病原体との環境的インターフェースとコンタクト機会を警告しているが、現在の人への感染事例や具体的な疾患アウトブレイクは記述されていない。Unknown Illnessとの関連性は不明。ブラジルの農業省と共同で2012年から運営されているプログラムの一環であり、政府レベルの関心は存在する。続報で具体的な病原体同定と感染事例の報告が出現した場合はPICKUP判定に変更すべき。

article.articleHeadline: 2026 Ebola outbreak: Maps track spread and global impact data of virus
article.articleSummary: 2026 Ebola outbreak centered in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) exceeds 1,000 suspected infections with 223 suspected deaths in the DRC as of May 29. Uganda reports seven confirmed cases, three of which were imported from the DRC, including one death. The Bundibugyo strain’s first suspected case appeared in late April in the DRC; WHO investigations began in early May, and there is currently no approved vaccine or targeted treatment for this strain. An emergency was declared by WHO on May 17. Transmission is via close contact with blood, secretions, or other bodily fluids of infected animals, with spillover from fruit bats, monkeys, and porcupines; symptoms typically begin 2–21 days after infection. The virus’s reproduction number is relatively low but fatality is high. Plans for a 50-bed Ebola quarantine facility for Americans in Kenya were suspended by court order; symptomatic patients would be treated elsewhere. CDC restricted entry for travelers from the DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年エボラ出血熱の発生：ウイルスの拡大と世界的影響データを示す地図とチャート
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は1,000件を超える疑い患者と223人の死亡を記録し、複数国に国際拡大（DRC→ウガンダ、スーダン）しており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と渡航制限の実施が確認される。WHO緊急事態宣言済み。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC、ウガンダ、スーダン、ケニアが言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダとスーダンは対象国外。ケニアはアメリカ人隔離施設計画に関するもので、アクティブな発生地域ではない。Bundibugyo株は珍しく、ワクチン・治療法不在の状況が懸念される。WHO緊急事態宣言済み（2026年5月17日）、CDC渡航制限実施済み。

article.articleHeadline: Visite du directeur général de l'OMS en RDC : l'épidémie d'Ebola est-elle hors de contrôle ?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Visit of the WHO Director-General to the DRC: Is the Ebola outbreak out of control?
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu). WHO Director-General Tedros visited the DRC to assess the field response and mobilize international support, not to signal an uncontrollable outbreak. Official figures: 906 suspected Ebola cases and 223 suspected deaths under investigation; the government reports 282 laboratory-confirmed cases with 42 deaths. Most cases are in Ituri (264 infections), with 15 in North Kivu and 3 in South Kivu. The WHO-conjoint statement notes ongoing challenges: rapid case finding, contact tracing, and safe burials amid armed conflict and insecurity. The International Rescue Committee cautions the true magnitude could be higher, with only a small fraction of contacts being followed. Despite concerns, authorities, WHO, and partners remain mobilized to contain transmission and strengthen surveillance; the visit aimed to boost capabilities and community trust, not declare defeat.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長のDRC訪問：エボラ出血熱の流行は制御不能か？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の確認症例282件・死亡42件を伴う進行中の流行であり、国際的対応の必要性からWHO事務局長の現地訪問を招く公衆衛生上の重大事象。
triage.notes: DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱の進行中の流行。確認症例282件・死亡42件（公式発表）、疑い症例906件・疑い死亡223件。Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu州で検出。武力紛争と不安定性が対応を複雑にしている。WHO事務局長の現地訪問は国際的対応の強化を示唆。フルRRA実施を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Sanepid wycofuje popularne szklanki z sieci KiK oraz sałatkę z tuńczykiem od firmy DEGA z powodu groźnej bakterii
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Sanitary Inspectorate recalls popular drinking glasses from the KiK network and a tuna salad from the DEGA company due to a dangerous bacterium.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 June 2026, the Główny Inspektor Sanitarny (GIS) warns of two major recalls in Poland: a DEGA tuna salad containing Listeria monocytogenes removed from shops, and KiK-branded drinking glasses manufactured in China recalled because the rims release lead and cadmium into contact with lips. The article emphasizes that pathogens such as Salmonella and Listeria can cause illness rapidly, sometimes requiring hospitalization within hours, and that chemicals, heavy metals, or allergens may pose risks even when not visibly detectable. It outlines hazard categories including chemical residues, mechanical hazards (sharp glass, plastic fragments, metal shavings), and allergen mislabeling. Consumer guidance: if a product is officially recalled, retailers must accept returns and issue refunds without a receipt, using the batch number to verify the recall. Check batches and comply with recall procedures.

triage.headline_ja: サニテーション検査局がKiKネットワークの人気ガラスコップとDEGA社のマグロサラダを危険な細菌を理由に回収
triage.triage_reason: リステリア感染症を含む食品汚染イベントとしてWPRO基準1項目（重症度）に該当。ただし記事の主焦点はポーランドでの製品リコール事例であり、イベント発生国がポーランド（対象外）のため、対象国での検証可能な感染症クラスターの報告なし。情報不足のため経過観察へ。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はポーランドでの製品リコールおよび食品安全警告であり、ポーランドは対象国リストに含まれない。発生地域にChinaが記載されているのはKiK製ガラスの製造国として登場しているが、実際の感染症イベント発生地ではない。対象国での確認可能な感染症クラスター情報がないため、verified_locationsは空配列。

article.articleHeadline: Při protestu proti americké karanténě na ebolu zemřeli v Keni dva lidé
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: During a protest against the American Ebola quarantine, two people died in Kenya.
article.articleSummary: Two people died in Kenya during a protest against an American Ebola quarantine. Kenyan President William Ruto described the government as responsible, noting that isolation, monitoring, and treatment facilities already exist in 23 counties and that a new center could serve Kenyan citizens if needed. He said the plan had been approved at the request of the U.S. President Donald Trump. The plan faces legal obstacles, with a Kenyan court temporarily suspending its deployment after a lawsuit alleged the facilities could threaten public health. Separately, Congo (DRC) and Uganda are contending with an outbreak of the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, for which the World Health Organization has declared a public health emergency of international concern. Kenyan authorities report no Ebola cases in Kenya so far, but border controls have been raised, with around 3,000 travellers checked daily at airports and land borders. As of 2026-06-02.

triage.headline_ja: 米国のエボラ隔離に対する抗議デモ中、ケニアで2人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当。Bundibugyo株のエボラ流行がDRC・ウガンダで発生し、WHOが国際的懸念の公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言している。ケニアでの死亡事例、国際的な対応（米国の隔離施設計画）、旅行制限措置が存在し、複数国への拡大リスクがある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではケニアでの死亡とDRC・ウガンダでのBundibugyo株エボラ流行が記述されているが、実際の感染症イベントはDRCとウガンダで発生。ケニアでの死亡は隔離施設計画に対する抗議デモ中の死亡であり、エボラ感染による死亡ではないため、verified_locationsに含めない。WHOによるPHEIC宣言により国際的な公衆衛生上の重大な懸念が存在する。

article.articleHeadline: Farmacêutica Avalia Uso de Antiviral da Covid-19 Para Combater Surto de Ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pharmacist Evaluates Use of the COVID-19 Antiviral to Fight Ebola Outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Merck is evaluating molnupiravir (Lagevrio) for Ebola amid a Bundibugyo-variant outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. About 1,100 suspected cases and 42 deaths have been reported, and no vaccines or approved treatments exist for this Ebola variant. Molnupiravir is a broad-spectrum RNA-virus inhibitor developed with Ridgeback Biotherapeutics and authorized for emergency use to treat mild-to-moderate COVID-19 in high-risk adults. It is not approved for Ebola, though animal studies have suggested activity that could help prevent infection in high-exposure individuals. Not recommended for pregnant women. Merck also produces Ervebo, a vaccine for the Zaire ebolavirus variant, and Barr said the platform could be adapted to Bundibugyo. Uganda has nine confirmed cases and one death, underscoring the outbreak’s seriousness.

triage.headline_ja: ファルマシューティカル企業がCOVID-19の抗ウイルス薬をエボラ流行対策に評価
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。Bundibugyo型エボラの新規流行で死亡例あり、既存の承認治療法なし。WPRO基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: Ugandaの記事への言及は見られるが、サマリーでUgandaは二次的な情報（9例、1死亡）として述べられており、主流行地はDRCのBundibugyo型エボラ。対象国リストにUgandaが含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。既存の承認治療法・ワクチンがないBundibugyo型という点で異常性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes: Ada 203 kasus HIV di Tangerang, delapan diantaranya balita
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Office: There are 203 HIV cases in Tangerang, eight of which are under five.
article.articleSummary: As of January–April 2026, Tangerang Regency Health Office (Banten Province, Indonesia) reported 203 HIV cases, including eight among children under five. Most cases were identified at Curug, Kelapa Dua, Kosambi, and Cikupa health centers, with other centers reporting cases too. Of the total, 167 were in the productive age group (21–55 years), 28 among adolescents, and eight in toddlers. Transmission sources cited include syringe injections, sexual intercourse, and deviant sexual practices. In toddlers, infections were attributed to HIV-positive parents. Authorities emphasize prevention through condom use and sexual activity with a legally recognized partner, and urge people living with HIV to take antiretroviral therapy consistently to avoid progression to AIDS. Data were presented by Dinas Kesehatan Kabupaten Tangerang on 2026-06-02.

triage.headline_ja: 保健局：タンゲラン地区に203件のHIV感染者、うち8人は5歳未満
triage.triage_reason: HIV感染の報告は既知の流行疾患であり、個別地域の定期的なサーベイランスデータに該当。公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常な状況、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク等は認められない。
triage.notes: HIV感染の地域別サーベイランスレポートであり、新規な感染症危機を示唆するものではない。タンゲラン地区（バンテン州）における定期的なHIV検査・報告活動の一環。発生地域はインドネシア（Jawa Barat州、Banten州、Tangerang地域）。
