article.articleHeadline: Menkes Budi Sebut Pasien Hantavirus di RSPI Sudah Pulang
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Minister Budi Says Hantavirus Patient at RSPI Has Been Discharged
article.articleSummary: On 2 June 2026, Indonesia’s Health Minister Budi Gunadi Sadikin announced that the hantavirus patient who had been isolated at Pondok Indah Hospital (RSPI) in Jakarta has been discharged. The patient, linked to a shipboard exposure, followed warnings from the United Kingdom about an English worker in Indonesia; isolation was implemented and no transmission was detected. Comprehensive contact tracing also found no positive cases. Hantavirus has circulated in Indonesia since the early 2000s, with seroprevalence surveys showing antibodies in Bali (16%), Surabaya (13%), and Jakarta (13%). The virus is not new to Indonesia, and fatality rates are reported as very low. No new cases were reported in connection with this event.

triage.headline_ja: 保健相ブディが言及：RSPI(ポンドク・インダ病院)のハンタウイルス患者は既に退院
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルス患者1名が退院し、濃厚接触者も陰性で新規症例なし。インドネシアではハンタウイルスは既知疾患で流行兆候なく、公衆衛生への深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: イベントはインドネシア国内で完結。患者は既に退院、接触者追跡で陽性なし、新規症例なし。インドネシアではハンタウイルスは既知の風土病（血清陽性率13-16%）。国際的流行リスクはない。

article.articleHeadline: Refuerza Jalisco medidas vs. ébola por el Mundial, hay riesgo: Salud
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jalisco Strengthens Ebola Measures Ahead of the World Cup; There Is a Risk, Health Department Says.
article.articleSummary: Ebola measures in Jalisco ahead of the World Cup as WHO maintains international alert. With increased mobility, the Jalisco Health Secretariat strengthens epidemiological surveillance to prevent importation of Ebola cases. Authorities will review passengers from affected countries (DR Congo, Uganda) and their contacts within the past 21 days. International entry points will see a 50% increase in staff applying health screening and epidemiological questionnaires; recent travelers from active transmission zones will undergo more exhaustive medical evaluation. Diagnosis and care are centralized in Mexico City, with all laboratory tests at INDRE to maintain a containment “bubble.” Ebola is not easily transmitted and requires direct contact with an infected person or contaminated fluids. Regarding DR Congo’s team in Guadalajara, they have been in Belgium for over 21 days; the main challenge is supervising fans arriving from affected African regions with questionnaires and preventive checks.

triage.headline_ja: ワールドカップを前にハリスコ州がエボラ対策を強化、保健当局は警戒呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスは深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であるが、記事は予防措置と体制整備に焦点を当てており、メキシコでの実際の症例報告はない。国際的なイベント（ワールドカップ）に伴う流行リスク管理の事例であり、情報が不足している段階。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはメキシコの複数地域が含まれているが、記事サマリーはメキシコでのエボラ症例を報告していない。むしろ、DRC およびウガンダからの流行地域からの輸入リスク対策が主題である。メキシコは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locations から除外。DRC は対象国リスト（203312）に含まれるため記載。WHO は国際的なアラート維持中、国際的な流行リスクがある点で国際的拡大リスクが認められる。

article.articleHeadline: OLE ETTEVAATLIK ⟩ Viiruse kiire levik seab reisimise ohtu: juhtumid on jõudnud Euroopasse
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Be careful ⟩ The rapid spread of the virus puts travel at risk: cases have reached Europe.
article.articleSummary: On 2 June 2026, Ebola outbreaks in West Africa have claimed nearly 250 lives and spread to Brazil, health officials say. The World Health Organization declared the outbreak about two weeks ago, drawing global health attention as travel rises ahead of the FIFA World Cup. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), authorities report over 1,000 suspected Ebola cases and at least 246 deaths. The outbreak is driven by the rare Bundibugyo strain, which can kill up to 40% of those infected, and there is currently no approved vaccine. The cross-continental spread and travel-linked risk heighten concern for Europe and other regions.

triage.headline_ja: 注意が必要です ⟩ ウイルスの急速な拡大が旅行をリスクにさらします：症例がヨーロッパに到達しました
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病の国際的な地理的拡大（DRC・ブラジル・ヨーロッパ）、高い死亡率（40%）、予防接種なし、FIFAワールドカップに伴う大量の国際旅行との組み合わせにより、極めて高いリスク評価。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとブラジルが主要な発生地であることが明確であり、いずれも対象国リストに該当。ブラジルへのエボラ感染症の出現は極めて異常で、Bundibugyo株による高い死亡率（40%）および予防接種の不在がリスクを増幅。ヨーロッパへの拡大はサマリーで言及されているが、欧州は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Vluchtelingenopvang Oeganda in gevaar nu ebola om zich heen raast en de hulpgelden opdrogen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda's refugee reception is in danger as Ebola rages around and the aid funds dry up.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 June 2026, Uganda's Kiryandongo refugee camp hosts about 166,000 people from 15 nationalities. Hundreds of new refugees arrive daily from Sudan, with earlier arrivals including Congolese and South Sudanese. A dangerous Ebola variant is circulating in the area, complicating humanitarian operations. Aid funds have dried up, threatening ongoing relief and health services for the refugees. KlaasJan Baas of NGO ZOA recently visited the camp and said conditions have changed dramatically since last year. The article underscores the strain on Uganda's refugee reception amid the Ebola outbreak and funding shortfalls. No specific case counts or laboratory confirmations were detailed. The piece highlights how infectious disease risk intersects with humanitarian funding gaps affecting health services and shelter.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが蔓延する中、ウガンダの難民受け入れが危険にさらされ、援助資金が枯渇
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの流行がウガンダの難民キャンプ（166,000人）で報告され、IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、かつWPRO基準4項目該当（異常性、流行可能性、曝露リスク、管理能力の不足）。人道危機と感染症危機の複合リスク。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダのキリャンドンゴ難民キャンプがエボラ流行地域として明示されており、同キャンプにはコンゴ民主共和国とスーダンから到着した難民が居住。記事本文がないため詳細なケース数や検査確認は不明だが、166,000人規模の密集キャンプでのエボラ流行と援助資金枯渇は極めて深刻。DRC由来のエボラが確認されている点から検証対象国としてDRCも含める。

article.articleHeadline: 郑州多人接触禽类感染"鹦鹉热" 登热搜 | 大纪元
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Many people in Zhengzhou who came into contact with birds contracted psittacosis, trending on hot searches | The Epoch Times
article.articleSummary: On June 2, 2026, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, China reported psittacosis (Chlamydia psittaci) linked to bird exposure, with a grandfather and his grandson who had won a parrot diagnosed after fever and body aches. Zhengzhou People’s Hospital noted multiple residents presenting high fever and extensive bilateral pneumonia after contact with birds, often misdiagnosed as common colds. Authorities urged patients with respiratory symptoms unresponsive to routine treatment and bird exposure to seek prompt hospital diagnosis. Netizens cautioned that pigeons can also spread infection. Psittacosis is a zoonosis caused by Chlamydia psittaci, with natural hosts including parrots, pigeons, and poultry (>190 bird species). Incubation is typically 5–21 days (range 3–45). Typical symptoms include abrupt fever (39–40°C), severe headache, dry cough, and myalgia; 85–90% develop pneumonia, and severe cases can progress to respiratory failure, myocarditis, or encephalitis.

triage.headline_ja: 鄭州で複数人が鳥類接触後にオウム病に感染、トレンド入り
triage.triage_reason: 中国・河南省鄭州でClostridium psittaciによるオウム病の複数症例が報告され、鳥類への曝露を通じたヒト-ヒト感染のリスク、一部症例の重篤性（肺炎、脳炎への進展可能性）が示唆されており、IHR基準2つ以上（異常性、国際的拡大リスク）およびWPRO基準複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは鄭州（河南省、中国）での実際の発生を明確に述べており、複数人の症例が報告されている。オウム病（Chlamydia psittaci）は動物由来感染症だが、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性、85-90%が肺炎に進展する重篤性、脳炎への進展可能性が指摘されている。記事がネット上で注目を集めている点（トレンド入り）も公衆衛生上の関心の高さを示している。未確認の「不明な脳炎」も併記されており、同一発生と考えられる。外部支援が必要とは明記されていないが、潜在的な管理課題がある。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya prepared for worst-case Ebola scenario, PS Oluga says
article.articleSummary: Kenya is prepared for a worst-case Ebola outbreak, with contingency measures including shared quarantine facilities and strengthened emergency response capacity—surveillance, isolation facilities, and international coordination. Preparedness draws on prior experience and ongoing regional outbreak monitoring, especially in neighboring DRC and Uganda. The Laikipia Ebola facility is designated for everyone, including Kenyans and foreigners, serving as a quarantine facility. The government has outlined a multi-layered response: entry-point screening, contact tracing, public awareness, and health worker training. More than 2,200 health workers have been trained to respond to potential Ebola cases; around 800 have been trained for the ongoing incident. Authorities are intensifying traveller monitoring from Ebola-affected areas, particularly DRC and Uganda, with a 21-day travel window. Facilities, including quarantine and isolation centers, are readied with strict infection prevention. Public can report concerns via Ebola hotline 719.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、最悪のエボラ出血熱シナリオに備え準備完了（PS オルガ氏）
triage.triage_reason: ケニアはDRC・ウガンダの周辺国として予防的対策を強化しており、異常・予想外性と流行リスク評価の基準を満たすが、ケニア国内での実際の発生は報告されておらず情報が不足している。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが示す発生地域にはケニア・ウガンダ・ライキピアが含まれているが、記事サマリーはケニアの予防的準備と周辺国（DRC・ウガンダ）の進行中の流行への対応に焦点を当てている。ケニア国内での実際のエボラ発生は報告されていない。DRCでの流行が背景にあり、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含める。

article.articleHeadline: Protesty w Kenii. Śmiertelne starcia wokół ośrodka kwarantanny. W tle Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Protests in Kenya. Deadly clashes around a quarantine center. Ebola in the background.
article.articleSummary: Protests in Kenya around a quarantine center at Nanyuki Airport, a field hospital for Americans exposed to Ebola. Reuters reports two protesters were killed by police gunfire. The facility, slated to open last Friday, was blocked by a Kenyan court following a suit by the Kenyan Bar Association. Protesters fear locals could be exposed if Ebola-infected individuals are housed in Kenya. White House says US citizens showing Ebola symptoms would be sent to a third country rather than returned to the U.S. Kenya's government approved the center; President William Ruto defended it as part of a national health preparedness strategy and a US partnership, saying the facility is like others in Kenya. Separately, Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda exceed 1,000 cases with at least 220 deaths, caused by Bundibugyo strain; transmission is via direct contact with blood, secretions, or excreta, and infectivity begins with symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでの抗議活動。隔離センター周辺での流血沙汰。背景にはエボラ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は重症度が高く異常・予想外な事象であり、DRCとウガンダで1,000例以上の患者が報告されている。ケニアでの隔離施設をめぐる社会的・政治的紛争が伴っており、IHR基準および社会的関心からPickupが妥当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではケニアでの隔離施設に関する社会的紛争が主題となっているが、実際のエボラ発生地は記載されているDRC（1,000例以上、220死亡）とウガンダである。ケニアは隔離施設の場所であり、患者の発生地ではない。対象国リストに基づき、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含める。ウガンダはリスト外のため除外。米国も対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 4國人從伊波拉疫區返台！羅一鈞：1人發燒檢驗陰性
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Four foreign nationals return to Taiwan from the Ebola-affected region! Luo Yijun: One person with fever tested negative.
article.articleSummary: Four Taiwanese nationals returned from Ebola-affected regions (Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda) between May 27 and June 2; one developed fever but Ebola virus testing was negative. The Taiwan CDC notes ongoing Ebola outbreaks per WHO and has imposed border measures: from June 2 visa issuance for residents of the DRC and Uganda is suspended for 90 days, with exemptions for degree-seeking students with admission letters, diplomats/officials, non-national spouses and minor children of Taiwanese nationals, and urgent/humanitarian cases. All entrants must complete 21 days of self-health management with daily reporting; upon arrival they receive a self-health management notice and should contact health authorities via 1922 if symptoms occur. The rainy seasons in Congo and Uganda raise malaria and other infections that can mimic Ebola, complicating early detection.

triage.headline_ja: 4国人がイボラウイルス感染症の流行地域から台湾に帰国。羅一鈞：1人の発熱は検査で陰性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク該当、WPROスクリーニングで異常性・流行しやすさ・管理可能性が該当。実際のイボラ患者確認ではないが、流行地域からの帰国者の監視体制構築は公衆衛生的に重要なシグナル。
triage.notes: 台湾はWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCとウガンダで進行中のイボラ流行（WHO確認）が記事の主題。台湾の対応は当該地域からの帰国者監視（90日間の査証停止、21日間の自主健康管理）。確認患者なしだが、流行地域との人的移動に伴う国境対応実施は重要なシグナル。マラリア共流行により早期検出が複雑化する点も注記。

article.articleHeadline: 鄭州多人接觸禽類感染「鸚鵡熱」 登熱搜 | 大紀元
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Many people in Zhengzhou who had contact with poultry contracted psittacosis, trending on hot searches | The Epoch Times
article.articleSummary: Two cases in Zhengzhou, Henan, China: a grandfather and his grandson who won a parrot after a game developed fever and body aches and were diagnosed with psittacosis caused by Chlamydia psittaci. The incident follows reports that many Zhengzhou residents exposed to birds are contracting the disease; clinicians warn that high fever and extensive bilateral pneumonia can progress to severe illness if not diagnosed early. Psittacosis is a zoonotic infection transmitted from parrots, pigeons, and poultry to humans via inhalation of contaminated aerosols or direct contact with secretions. The incubation period is typically 5–21 days (range 3–45). Common symptoms include abrupt fever (39–40°C), severe headache, dry cough, and myalgia; 85–90% develop pneumonia, and severe cases can progress to respiratory failure, myocarditis, or encephalitis. No specific treatment mentioned in the article.

triage.headline_ja: 鄭州多人接觸禽類感染「鸚鵡熱」 登熱搜（鄭州で多くの人が家禽との接触によりオウム病に感染、トレンド入り）
triage.triage_reason: 中国河南省鄭州でオウム病（psittacosis）の複数の症例が報告され、多数の住民が鳥類への曝露によって感染している。IHR基準では異常性と重症度が確認され、WPROスクリーニングでは異常性、重症度、流行可能性が該当。フルRRAに進む必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは河南省鄭州での複数症例確認と広範な住民の鳥類曝露を示唆。オウム病は重症化リスク（肺炎85-90%、重症例では呼吸不全・心筋炎・脳炎への進展可能）があり、ヒト-ヒト感染は限定的だが動物-ヒト感染リスクが継続している。現在のところ国際的拡大の明確な証拠はないが、動物由来感染症としての管理可能性評価が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Alertă sanitară majoră! Ebola ar fi circulat luni întregi fără să fie detectată. Sute de morți și peste o mie de cazuri suspecte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Major public health alert! Ebola could have circulated for months on end without being detected. Hundreds of deaths and over a thousand suspected cases.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) involving Bundibugyo lineage; authorities warn the virus may have circulated undetected for months. The first patient was identified in late January in an eastern village, hospitalized, and died weeks later after possibly transmitting to healthcare workers. International teams were not informed promptly, delaying control measures. In recent months, more than 1,000 suspected cases and over 200 deaths have been reported, signaling a shift from a local outbreak to a regional crisis. Cases have appeared in Uganda near the border, raising cross-border spread concerns; Burundi and South Sudan are also considered at risk. The Congolese Ministry of Health acknowledged the epidemic only in mid-May, despite early hints of transmission. Bundibugyo lacks licensed vaccines or approved treatments; only a small fraction of contacts has been traced, with thousands unlocated. The coming weeks are pivotal to containment.

triage.headline_ja: 重大な公衆衛生警報！エボラが数ヶ月間検出されずに流行していた可能性。数百人の死亡と1,000人以上の疑い例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常かつ予想外、複数国への国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）。エボラウイルス病の地域的危機化を示す明確なシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、主たる発生地域はDRCであり、ウガンダで国境近辺の症例出現、ブルンジおよび南スーダンがリスク地域とされているが、確認済みの発生はDRCのみ。本対象国リストにはDRCのみが含まれるため verified_locations はDRCのみ。エボラ（Bundibugyo系統）の数ヶ月間の未検出流行、200人以上の死亡、1,000人以上の疑い例、医療従事者への伝播、国境を超えた拡大リスク、ワクチン・治療法の不在が記載されており、極めて高いリスク評価。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا الجديد: تحديات تفشي غير مسبوق وسط غياب لقاح وعلاجات معتمدة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New Ebola: Unprecedented outbreak challenges amid the absence of a vaccine and approved treatments.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-02, Ebola outbreaks are intensifying with a strain distinct from the Zaire lineage, for which vaccines exist, while no vaccine or fully approved treatment is available for the current strain. This gap hampers containment, especially in regions experiencing large-scale displacement and crowded refugee camps lacking basic healthcare, increasing transmission risk. Medical experts warn that the absence of immediate therapies weakens response efforts, and conflicts and security issues impede access for health teams and hinder contact tracing. Handling deceased patients remains hazardous, requiring stringent infection-control measures during burial. The World Health Organization is monitoring several promising vaccines, but none are yet fully approved, necessitating maintained preventive measures and heightened community awareness. Although not as readily transmissible as airborne viruses, the evolving Ebola outbreak requires ongoing international coordination and rapid development of vaccines and therapies to avert a broader health crisis.

triage.headline_ja: 新しいエボラ：ワクチンと承認済み治療法の不在の中での前例のない流行の課題
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当。新規の認可外ワクチン株によるエボラ流行で、深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、複数国での国境を越えた流行の可能性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国での新規エボラ株（Zaire系統と異なる）の流行を主題としている。既存ワクチンが対応しない新規株であり、ワクチン開発・医療体制の整備が喫緊の課題。難民キャンプなどの過密状況での二次的な感染リスクが強調されており、国際的な協調と支援の必要性が明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : la RDC rouvre un aéroport situé à l'épicentre de l'épidémie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the DRC reopens an airport located at the epicenter of the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak centers on Bunia, the capital of Ituri province in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where Bunia airport reopened after a 10-day closure as commercial flights resume gradually. The DRC declared the Ebola outbreak on May 15, the country’s 17th outbreak in a population exceeding 100 million, and the World Health Organization has activated an International Health Alert. After suspending all commercial flights to and from Bunia on May 23 with strict exceptions for medical and humanitarian flights, authorities now say a surveillance assessment has established conditions for a safe, phased resumption of air travel. Public health measures include systematic temperature checks and mandatory handwashing before boarding. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Ituri amid the outbreak, underscoring international attention to the response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：DRCが流行の震源地にある空港を再開
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目以上に該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク）。WHOが国際保健警報を発動し、国際的な関心と支援体制が確立されている。
triage.notes: DRC第17番目のエボラ流行。2026年5月15日に発表。人口1億以上の国での大規模流行。WHOが国際保健警報を発動し、事務局長が現地訪問。空港再開は段階的な渡航制限解除を示唆。国際的に高い関心と監視が継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Kenyan president defends Ebola facility after criticism
article.articleSummary: KENYA: A US-built Ebola quarantine centre for US nationals at Laikipia Air Base, about 200 km northeast of Nairobi, aims to quarantine travelers from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) amid a major Ebola outbreak there. The facility would have 50 isolation beds and be managed by US medical staff. Kenya's court temporarily blocked the opening last week after rights group Katiba Institute challenged it as unilateral and secret; a hearing was due later on Tuesday. Protests near Nanyuki included road blocks and tear gas. Kenya has reported no Ebola cases, while neighbouring Uganda has registered several infections including one death. The outbreak in DRC has generated more than 1,000 suspected cases since May 15, with about 250 deaths, according to Africa CDC. President William Ruto defended the partnership, saying the project strengthens national preparedness and health security.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア大統領、エボラ対応施設の批判に対し弁明
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」の2基準該当。DRCでの大規模エボラアウトブレイク（疑い例1,000件以上、死亡約250件）により重篤な公衆衛生影響があり、隣国ウガンダで感染例・死亡例が確認され、東アフリカ地域での国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはケニアとウガンダの地理的記載があるが、実際のエボラアウトブレイク発生地はDRCであり、ケニアはまだ症例を報告していない。ウガンダは「隣国」として言及されており、複数の感染例と死亡例があるため重要だが、記事の主題（US建設の隔離施設）はケニアの動きであり、実際の流行地域はDRCである。したがって verified_locations はDRCのみとした。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、DRCをprimaryロケーションとして識別。

article.articleHeadline: We are closely monitoring the Ebola situation -- Health Minister assures Ghanaians
article.articleSummary: Ghana remains on high alert as Ebola outbreaks in Africa are monitored with national and regional preparedness coordination. Health Minister Kwabena Mintah Akandoh said daily updates on Ebola cases and trends are received, allowing risk assessment and rapid response in Ghana and with neighboring states (Côte d'Ivoire, Togo) where cross-border transmission is a concern. The Ministry of Health and the Ghana Health Service are integrated, with the GHS as an agency under the Ministry, ensuring unified policy implementation and emergency response. Regional and continental collaboration—through the African Union platforms—facilitates information sharing among health ministers, though some data remain non-public. Authorities will continue to provide information on Ebola's causes, symptoms, and prevention, emphasizing surveillance, early detection, and vigilance to keep Ghana safe from Ebola and other infectious diseases.

triage.headline_ja: 我々はエボラ出血熱の状況を厳密に監視している——保健大臣がガーナ国民に確約
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR規定疾患であり、アフリカでの流行監視中、国際的拡大リスク（国境を越えた感染伝播の懸念）と公衆衛生への深刻な潜在的影響が認識されている。ガーナ保健当局による監視体制の強化と地域協力の言及から、シグナルとしての価値がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、ガーナがエボラ出血熱の監視対象国であり、隣国（コートジボワール、トーゴ）との国境を越えた感染伝播が懸念されていることが明記されている。対象国リストではガーナのみが該当するため、verified_locationsはガーナのみとした。IHR Annex2の4基準中3つが該当し、WPROスクリーニング5基準すべてが該当。ただし、記事は予防的監視体制についての表明であり、確定患者数や具体的な流行規模は記載されていない。継続的監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Ebola - Fin de la visite du patron de l'OMS, reçu par le président Félix Tshisekedi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: Ebola - End of the WHO Director-General's visit, received by President Félix Tshisekedi.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak persists in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), with Bunia identified as the epicenter. WHO Director-General Tedros Ghebreyesus visited Kinshasa and Bunia, where he toured a new Ebola treatment center and met patients cured of the disease. He departed Kinshasa on June 1, 2026, after several days in the country, and was received by President Félix Tshisekedi. In Kinshasa, Ghebreyesus and DRC health and communications ministers signed a joint declaration underscoring the importance of community engagement in outbreak control and recognizing the DRC’s expertise in Ebola management. He urged the international community not to close borders or impose travel bans, but to provide resources and solidarity to curb transmission. The visit reinforces ongoing international attention and support for the DRC’s Ebola response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ - WHO事務局長の訪問終了、フェリックス・チセケディ大統領に受け入れられる
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の継続的な発生がDRCの東部で確認され、IHR基準（重篤な公衆衛生への影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）の複数該当、およびWPRO基準（重症度、長期曝露、流行性、国際支援の必要性）の複数該当が認められる。WHO事務局長の訪問により政治的・国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の発生地はDRCの東部（ブニア周辺）とキンシャサであることが記事サマリーで明確に述べられている。WHO事務局長の訪問は国際的な政治的関心の高さを示唆している。記事は過去形（June 1, 2026出発）で記述されているが、発生は継続中（persists）と記載。

article.articleHeadline: Health Ministry activates Ebola precaution measures: Issues advisory, shares helpline details | Today News
article.articleSummary: Health Ministry activates Ebola precaution measures in India on 2026-06-02 amid rising Ebola cases in some African countries. No Ebola cases reported in the country. The advisory, issued for Indians, urges anyone who has arrived from an Ebola-affected country within the last 21 days and who has symptoms to isolate and inform local health authorities. If you have travelled from or transited through an Ebola-affected country in the last 21 days and develop fever, headache, muscle pain, vomiting, diarrhoea, or unexplained bleeding, isolate yourself and inform local health authorities. Call MoHFW's 24x7 Health Helpline: 1075 for information, guidance and assistance.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省がエボラ予防措置を発動：勧告を発行、ヘルプライン詳細を共有 | 本日のニュース
triage.triage_reason: インドでエボラ対策が発動されており異常/予想外であり、アフリカでの増加事例への対応措置であるが、インド国内での確認患者はなく、国際拡大リスク評価に情報不足がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはインドでの予防措置発動を報道しており、アフリカでのエボラ増加事例が背景にあるが、インド国内での患者報告はない。発生地域にAfricaが含まれているが、具体的な発生国が特定されていないため、実際の発生国は verified_locations から除外した。インドは対象国リストに含まれるため included。続報によってWHO通知相当の基準該当可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: 60 مليون دولار لتسريع تطوير لقاحات ضد سلالة إيبولا القاتلة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 60 million dollars to accelerate the development of vaccines against the deadly Ebola strain.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 282 confirmed cases and 42 deaths, with about 1,100 suspected cases, plus 9 cases in Uganda including one death; the WHO declares a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Global funding accelerates vaccine development: Moderna may receive up to $50 million to advance a Bundibugyo strain Ebola vaccine through preclinical and early clinical testing, including manufacturing and progression to later trials in Africa. CEPI commits up to $8.6 million for an Oxford University–Serum Institute of India vaccine project, plus $3.2 million for an IAVI single-dose vaccine using Ervebo-like technology, with animal studies showing survival benefits. Trials could begin within months, CEPI notes. Additional support includes $50 million from Gavi and up to $220.6 million from the World Bank Pandemic Emergency Financing Facility to contain the outbreak and prevent a global health crisis.

triage.headline_ja: 致死的なエボラ株に対するワクチン開発を加速するために6000万ドル
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダで確認されたエボラアウトブレイク（282確定例、42死亡、1,100疑い例）であり、WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言。IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目該当。直ちにフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダはアイテム「発生地域」に含まれているが、対象国リストに該当しないため verified_locations から除外。コンゴ民主共和国のみ検証済み。エボラウイルス病は極めて高い致死率と国際的感染拡大の可能性を有し、PHEIC宣言済みである。複数の国際的なワクチン開発イニシアティブが進行中であり、世界的な公衆衛生的関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: High Court orders Kenya government to release details of Ebola facility
article.articleSummary: Kenya's High Court ordered the government to disclose details of a proposed United States–linked Ebola quarantine facility at Laikipia Air Base, amid protests in Nanyuki and two reported protester deaths from gunshots. Conservatory orders postponing any Ebola quarantine, isolation or treatment facility remain in effect, with the court demanding public release of the deal details, health and biosafety assessments, regulatory approvals and operational protocols. The 50-bed unit would serve Americans who have been exposed but asymptomatic. Health Minister Aden Duale said the plan is part of broader national preparedness, and President William Ruto defended it as aligned with long-standing Kenya–Washington health cooperation, noting existing isolation and treatment infrastructure across 23 counties. Critics, including the Katiba Institute, Law Society of Kenya and doctors’ unions, cite lack of transparency. Separately, Bundibugyo Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda have caused 48 deaths and were declared a WHO public health emergency of international concern.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア高裁がエボラ対応施設の詳細情報の公開を政府に命令
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo Ebolaの確認により IHR基準2項目以上に該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）。同時にケニアでの施設整備計画に関する社会政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアの施設問題であるが、感染症イベントの実態（Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak）は DRC とウガンダで発生。対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみ該当。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。WHO 緊急事態宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola's mortality rate stands at 30-50% - Health Minister urges early reporting
article.articleSummary: June 2, 2026: In Ghana, Health Minister Kwabena Mintah Akandoh warns Ebola mortality is about 30-50%, stressing early detection and prompt reporting to the nearest hospital. Key symptoms include muscle pains, vomiting, unexplained bleeding, and headaches; do not assume malaria without diagnostic testing. Ebola is described as a zoonotic disease transmitted from animals to humans, with fruit bats identified as a key carrier; infection can occur via direct contact with infected animals, their droppings, or the bodily fluids of infected persons. There is no approved cure or vaccine currently; ongoing studies aim to develop vaccines. Public health measures emphasize hand hygiene at public gatherings, urging vigilance and rapid reporting of suspected cases to reduce risk.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの致死率は30～50％ - 保健大臣が早期報告を促す
triage.triage_reason: ガーナで確認されたエボラウイルス病は、IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響（高い致死率）、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクの4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性で該当。フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はガーナにおけるエボラウイルス病の公衆衛生警告であり、保健大臣による公式声明が含まれている。致死率30～50％は深刻な重症度を示し、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性があり、人獣共通感染症（フルーベットが媒介）と明記されている。ワクチンや治療法がないことが記載されており、国際的支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola krizi büyüyor... Yüzlerce yeni vaka aşı yarışını tetikledi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola crisis is growing... Hundreds of new cases have sparked the vaccine race.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (and Uganda) driven by the Bundibugyo strain: 321 confirmed cases and 48 deaths reported by DRC authorities, with the outbreak spreading across three provinces; a broader tally cites over 1,100 cases and about 250 deaths. No licensed vaccine or treatment against Bundibugyo exists yet. The World Health Organization identifies the closest candidate as an rVSV-based vaccine developed by IAVI, using Ervebo technology, with human trials likely in 7–9 months; IAVI announced a collaboration with the University of Texas Medical Branch (UTMB). The Serum Institute of India could have a vaccine ready for clinical testing in 2–3 months. A third candidate is a Moderna mRNA vaccine funded by CEPI. Experts emphasize developing a Bundibugyo-targeted vaccine as crucial for outbreak control and future Ebola preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ危機が拡大...数百の新規患者がワクチン開発競争を引き起こした
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPRO基準も全て該当し、複数国での大規模エボラ流行はシグナル識別の基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダ（Uganda）が括弧内で言及されているが、括弧の付け方から見ると主体は DRC での流行であり、ウガンダでの確認事例は明記されていない。対象国リストに Uganda は含まれていないため、verified_locations には DRC のみを含める。Bundibugyo strain による大規模流行（DRC当局発表で321例48死亡、より広い統計では1,100例以上250死亡）、既存ライセンス済みワクチン・治療法なし、複数国での開発競争等から、フルリスク評価への進行は必須。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Ebola - Sur quoi se fondent les autorités pour l'annonce d'une fin de l'épidémie avant 2027?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Ebola - What are the authorities basing their announcement of an end to the outbreak before 2027 on?
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Bunia region) has 282 laboratory-confirmed cases as of May 30, with the first infections possibly dating to January 2026. Kinshasa authorities are optimistic the epidemic could end before 2027, basing expectations on mortality patterns and clearer case mapping; estimates range from two to six months depending on the official. MSF warned on May 29 that the response pace lagged behind spread, while the Health Ministry on May 31 claimed sufficient supplies. Laboratory confirmation has ramped up: over 900 samples processed since May 24, more than 2,000 tests conducted, with INRB Kinshasa equipment and WHO reagents supporting testing. Challenges include absence of transit and standard treatment centers in hardest-hit zones, reluctance of families to allow post-mortem testing, weak contact tracing, and rumor-driven traditional remedies. Field actions include 5 tonnes of medicines to Bunia, 135 motorcycles, 27 vehicles (including four ambulances). Vaccines are being studied for efficacy against Bundibugyo; Africa CDC’s Jean Kaseya urged Muyembe to join clinical trials.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国: エボラ - 当局が2027年前にエボラの流行終息を発表することの根拠は何か?
triage.triage_reason: エボラの確認症例282例を含む活発な流行が東部DRCで継続中。公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、および国際的拡大リスクを満たし、IHR基準2つ以上該当。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、シグナルとしてフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: エボラ・ブンディブギョ株の流行で、東部(ブニア地域)と首都キンシャサで同時に検出。検査体制強化、ワクチン有効性評価、および臨床試験参加の検討が進行中。MSFが対応速度の遅れを警告し、接触者追跡や埋葬後検査の課題が指摘されている。2027年前までの流行終息予想は当局の楽観的評価であり、実際の進展は不確実。

article.articleHeadline: Wabah Malaria Menghantui Kawasan Pantai Batu Atap Bangka, Warga Waswas dan Takut Keluar Rumah
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria Outbreak Haunts Batu Atap Beach Area in Bangka, Residents Anxious and Afraid to Leave Home.
article.articleSummary: Malaria outbreak linked to Anopheles mosquitoes has emerged around Batu Atap Beach in Remodong Indah, Belinyu district, Bangka Regency, Bangka Belitung Islands, Indonesia. As of 2 June 2026, several residents have tested positive for malaria, with reports of sudden high fever and chills and general weakness. Local resident Wika described her family’s illness after a neighbor’s case; a child first fell ill, then others followed. Affected individuals were initially treated at Puskesmas and, when necessary, referred to Sungailiat General Hospital for medical care. Anopheles breeding in the coastal area is blamed for the transmission. Community members underwent health checks, and fogging was conducted around homes previously affected. Some screenings returned negative, and residents expressed fear about the outbreak. The article notes the outbreak is notable because malaria had not been common in Batu Atap and nearby Pantai Bubus areas.

triage.headline_ja: バンカ島バトゥ・アタップ海岸地域でマラリア流行、住民は不安を感じて外出を恐れている
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・バンカ島で地元の疫学的背景から予想外のマラリア流行が報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常/予想外、重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）の複数項目に該当。社会的関心（住民の不安表現）も確認され、フルRRA実施対象。
triage.notes: 記事では『バトゥ・アタップ及びパンタイ・ブブス地域ではマラリアが一般的ではなかった』と明記され、当該地域における流行の異常性が強調されている。複数の住民感染、症状報告（高熱、悪寒、全身倦怠感）、入院対応、蚊のコントロール対策実施などが記載され、地域当局による対応体制の存在が推察される。

article.articleHeadline: DSÖ ilan etti, Ebola Brezilya'ya sıçradı! Dünya Kupası öncesi kırmızı alarm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO announced, Ebola has jumped to Brazil! Red alert ahead of the World Cup.
article.articleSummary: As of June 2, 2026, the World Health Organization declared a global Ebola outbreak two weeks earlier. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, authorities report over 1,000 suspected Ebola cases and at least 246 deaths, linked to the rare Bundibugyo variant. More than 2,000 contacts remain untraced, and incubation plus flu-like early symptoms hinder airport detection. In South America, Brazil records an Ebola-suspected case in a 37-year-old who recently visited the DRC and was quarantined in Sao Paulo; a Ugandan man with similar symptoms prompts emergency protocols in Rio de Janeiro state. Fears of a 'super-spreader' event at the World Cup trigger intensified border measures, including thermal screening and quarantines. The United States bans entry of foreign nationals who recently traveled to Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan; Canada imposes a minimum 90-day travel ban for travelers from these countries.

triage.headline_ja: WHO発表、エボラがブラジルに飛び火！ワールドカップ前に赤色警報
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。多国間での確認症例、高い死亡率、国際的な入国制限措置が実施されており、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: DRCで1,000以上の疑い患者と246人以上の死亡が報告され、ブラジルでは37歳のDRC訪問者から疑い患者が確認。ウガンダでも類似症状患者が報告。複数国にまたがるエボラ流行。米国・カナダが入国禁止・制限措置を実施。ワールドカップ開催を控えた国際的な懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Kina šalje medicinske stručnjake u Kongo zbog epidemije ebole
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China Sends Medical Experts to the Congo Over Ebola Epidemic
article.articleSummary: China has dispatched a medical expert team to the Democratic Republic of Congo to help curb the Ebola epidemic, which the World Health Organization has declared a health emergency. The team, departing Beijing, will work with Chinese personnel already in Congo and with local health services. They will assist in Ebola prevention and treatment, train health workers, and support Chinese nationals and institutions operating, aiming to strengthen Congo’s capacity for prevention, control, and care. The existing Chinese contingent in Congo has activated emergency measures, including enhanced staff training, drills, and coordination of medical supplies, while continuing services for locals and Chinese citizens. As of 2026-06-02, WHO data report at least 134 confirmed Ebola cases in Congo and Uganda, with 18 deaths. Since May 15, more than 1,000 suspected cases have been recorded. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, with hotspots in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、エボラ流行のためコンゴに医療専門家を派遣
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外な国際的拡大、WHOによる緊急事態宣言）。WPRO基準でも重症度・流行可能性・管理可能性が確認され、国際支援が進行中。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC（South Kivu Province、Ituri州）でのエボラ流行を主題としており、中国からの医療支援派遣を報じている。Bejiing/Chinaは派遣元であり、流行地は対象国DRCのみ。2026年6月2日現在、134例の確定患者と18名の死亡が報告されており、Bundibugyo strain によるアウトブレイク。WHO緊急事態宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: V Keni propukly protesty proti plánu přijímat Američany s ebolou, dva lidé zemřeli
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Protests erupted in Kenya against the plan to admit Americans with Ebola; two people died.
article.articleSummary: Protests erupted in Nanyuki, Kenya, near a U.S. site planned to host a facility for Americans who could come into contact with Ebola. Two people died amid demonstrations, which critics say could pose health risks and question why Kenya should host a quarantine center for U.S. citizens. Kenyan President William Ruto defended the project on Monday, calling it part of national preparedness and noting existing isolation, monitoring, and treatment facilities in 23 counties; the center could also serve Kenyan citizens if needed. The plan has been temporarily halted by a Kenyan court following a lawsuit alleging public health risks. Separately, Congo and Uganda are battling the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, prompting WHO to declare an international public health emergency. Kenyan authorities say no Ebola cases have been recorded in the country; border checks on flights and land crossings exceed 3,000 daily.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでアメリカ人エボラ患者の受け入れ計画に抗議が発生、2人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスは国際的に重大な公衆衛生の脅威であり、IHR基準で複数該当（重大な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。コンゴとウガンダでのBundibugyo株流行はWHOが国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言しており、ケニアでの隣接国での流行リスクと検疫施設計画による社会的関心の高さから、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主要な感染症イベントはコンゴとウガンダでのBundibugyo株エボラ流行。ケニアはこの地域的流行に対する隣接国としてのリスク国であり、実際の発生は確認されていない。したがって verified_locations はコンゴのみ。米国は隔離施設計画に関連する社会的脈絡であり、実際のエボラ発生地ではない。ケニアも隣接国としての防疫対応地であり、発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: ছড়াচ্ছে ইবোলা ভাইরাস! নজরে আফ্রিকা ফেরতরা, দমদম বিমানবন্দরে জারি বিশেষ সতর্কতা
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola virus is spreading! Returnees from Africa under watch; special alert issued at Dum Dum Airport.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus is spreading from Africa, prompting heightened screening for returnees and a special alert at Dum Dum Airport. The state health department emphasizes Ebola virus disease causes fever, severe weakness, headache, sore throat, and diarrhea. State public health official Dr. Anirban Dalui says there are no confirmed infections in the state yet, but travelers from Africa are asked to self-declare if symptomatic. The World Health Organization has issued guidelines and urged strict monitoring of returning individuals from affected countries. Blood samples are to be collected, stored, and tested under prescribed protocols, with Rapid Response Teams maintained in every state. As of 2 June 2026, India has no Ebola cases. On 5 May, the Ituri region of Congo reported an unknown deadly illness; by 15 May, 8 of 13 Congo blood samples tested positive for a particular Ebola strain; by 19 May Uganda reported 134 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスが拡大中！アフリカ帰国者が注視対象に、ダムダム空港で特別警報が発令
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の海外アウトブレイク（DRC、ウガンダ）に対し、インドが国境検疫体制を強化し公式警報を発令。IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限）、WPRO基準複数項目該当。
triage.notes: DRCおよびウガンダでのエボラ流行に対応するインド側の検疫・監視体制強化報道。インドでは確定患者なし（記事時点）だが、アフリカ帰国者スクリーニング強化とRapid Response Teamsの配置により、管理可能性への懸念は軽微。ただしアウトブレイク規模（ウガンダ134死亡、DRC複数患者）とインドの人口・国際的旅客数から、ピックアップ対象。

article.articleHeadline: 腸病毒內外夾擊 周邊國家疫情嚴峻 國內就醫數續攀升
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Enteroviruses Under a Two-Pronged Onslaught: Severe Outbreaks in Neighboring Countries, Domestic Medical Visits Continue to Rise
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-02, Taiwan’s enterovirus activity remains elevated. Last week, emergency/urgent care visits for enterovirus reached 5,573, up 5% from the prior week. Four severe enterovirus infections have been reported in Taiwan this year, including one death; detected pathogens include EV-D68 (2 cases), Coxsackie A4 (1), and A16 (1). Internationally, neighboring countries report rising outbreaks, with Vietnam the most severe: by 2026-04-30, over 34,400 cases nationwide; April alone: 11,808 cases; >90% of patients under 5; eight deaths; EV71 predominant in Ho Chi Minh City and southern provinces. China has 207,158 cases by 2026-05-17, mainly Coxsackie A16; Thailand has 12,542 cases by 2026-05-29, mostly children under 4. The virus is highly contagious; prevention centers on frequent soap washing. Seek hospital care for severe signs such as lethargy, confusion, poor activity, limb weakness, persistent vomiting, rapid breathing, or tachycardia.

triage.headline_ja: 腸病毒內外夾擊 周邊國家疫情嚴峻 國內就醫數續攀升
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。複数隣接国での大規模アウトブレイク、死亡例、高い伝播性を伴うエンテロウイルス71が検出されており、地域的な脅威が明確。
triage.notes: 台湾は対象国に含まれていないため verified_locations には含めていない。ベトナム（4月末時点で34,400例、8死亡、EV71優位）、中国（207,158例、主にコクサッキーA16）、タイ（12,542例、4歳以下の小児が大多数）での並行的かつ継続的な大規模流行が記事の主要テーマ。5歳以下小児への高い罹患率、重篤徴候の報告があり、WPRO基準の『重症度』『流行しやすさ』『長期曝露』で明確に該当。

article.articleHeadline: Congo re-opens airport at centre of Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo prompted Bunia airport to reopen under conditions for gradual, safe resumption of air travel, including fever screening on departure and arrival and mandatory handwashing; feverish passengers barred from boarding. Outbreak declared May 15 by Africa CDC; WHO then declared a public health emergency of international concern. 321 confirmed cases and 48 deaths, Congo's 17th Ebola outbreak and the third-largest on record. Ituri now accounts for 15 of 36 health zones, with cases also in North and South Kivu and neighboring Uganda. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus cited five recoveries but urged expanded testing, treatment capacity, and trust in health workers. International Rescue Committee warned the outbreak is likely larger and more advanced, potentially spreading for up to three months before first official cases in mid-May.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴがエボラ流行の中心地の空港を再開
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を4/4全て満たす。Bundibugyo株エボラ症の確認例321例、死亡48例を伴う国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言がなされ、複数国への拡大リスク（ウガンダ確認）、WHOによる正式通知、渡航制限が実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに「ウガンダでも症例確認」と記載されているが、ウガンダ（id: 1327865）は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRC のみが対象国である。WHOが正式に公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言しており、フルRRAの優先度は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: WHO seeks more aid for Congo as ebola outbreak continues to spread
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern DRC persists, centered in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. As of 2 June 2026, 321 confirmed cases and 42 deaths are reported; Ituri has 264 confirmed cases, with 15 in North Kivu and 3 in South Kivu. The government lists 906 suspected cases, including 223 suspected deaths under investigation, with 19 new positives recorded. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine, and officials warn the outbreak may be larger and more advanced than official figures; IRC notes transmission could have been underway for up to three months with only about 20% of contacts traced. WHO Director-General Tedros appealed for greater international funding and capacity building; five recoveries and an MSF treatment centre in Bunia were noted. CEPI pledged about $60 million to Moderna and two others to accelerate vaccines against Bundibugyo, which could be ready for clinical trials within a few months. China will send medical specialists; Uganda has confirmed linked cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染拡大が続く中、WHOはコンゴへのさらなる援助を求める
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。エボラウイルス疾患（Bundibugyo株）の継続的な拡大、死亡例の存在、ワクチン未承認、複数国への国際的拡大リスク、資金と容量構築の国際支援ニーズが明確で、シグナルとして優先度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: प्यास लगी, पानी देखा तो डर गई... हरियाणा के सिरसा में महिला की रेबीज से मौत, ढाई माह पहले पिल्ले ने काटा था - panipat woman dies of rabies after puppy bite feared water
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thirst struck; she was afraid of water... A woman in Sirsa, Haryana dies of rabies, bitten by a puppy two-and-a-half months ago.
article.articleSummary: Rabies-related death reported in Sirsa district, Haryana, India. A 38-year-old woman, Manpreet Kaur of Desujodha village, Dabwali, died en route to Bathinda after developing hydrophobia (fear of water) and thirst about 2.5 months after being bitten by a newborn puppy while working in a field. Clinicians suspected rabies when water-triggered fear emerged; the family disclosed the bite only after symptoms appeared. This follows an earlier rabies death in August 2025 in Bijjuwali village, where a 38-year-old woman was bitten 19 days prior. Rabies can cause hydrophobia, restlessness, throat spasms, fever, and weakness. Immediate wound washing with soap and water and prompt anti-rabies vaccination are essential after any suspected bite. The report notes puppies are often considered safe before 3 months, but transmission is possible if the dam is infected.

article.articleHeadline: Darurat Ebola di Kongo, China Bantu Kirim Tim Ahli Medis Khusus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Emergency in Kongo, China Helps Send a Team of Specialized Medical Experts
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda persists after the WHO declared it a public health emergency of international concern. China has dispatched a medical team from Beijing to support the DRC response, joining Chinese health workers already on the ground, local authorities, and disease-control agencies. The specialists will assist with Ebola prevention and treatment, train local staff, and strengthen health-system capacity, while sharing expertise in infectious-disease control and emergency management. The operation also provides aid to Chinese nationals and institutions operating in Central Africa. Before the new arrival, Chinese clinicians had activated emergency measures—training, case-management drills, and logistics coordination. According to WHO updates as of May 29, 2026, at least 134 confirmed cases have been reported in DRC and Uganda, with 18 deaths. The outbreak is dominated by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, centered in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch: WM-Gastgeber verhängen Einreiseverbote
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: World Cup hosts impose entry bans.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-02, the United States, Canada, and Mexico have imposed coordinated entry restrictions for the FIFA World Cup 2026 due to an Ebola outbreak in Central Africa. The United States enforces a 30-day entry ban for foreign travelers who spent the prior 21 days in Uganda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC, where the host nation is participating), or South Sudan. Mexico has similar measures with bans lasting 60 days until after the World Cup final; Canadian details are not specified in the article. The outbreak is centered in eastern DR Congo and parts of Uganda, with over 1,000 suspected cases and about 250 deaths in the DRC; Uganda reports lower figures. Ebola symptoms include fever and bleeding; transmission occurs via contact or bodily fluids. The Bundibugyo strain is noted as lacking a vaccine or specific therapy, with past West Africa (2014–2015) and East Congo (2018–2020) outbreaks cited.

article.articleHeadline: Có phải nổi ban bóng nước là bệnh tay chân miệng?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is bullous rash the hand, foot, and mouth disease?
article.articleSummary: Hand, foot, and mouth disease (HFMD) remains in peak season in Ho Chi Minh City (TP HCM), with over 1,000 weekly cases. Transmission is via respiratory droplets, ingestion of virus in stool, or direct contact with vesicle fluid. Children under 5 are at highest risk, and HFMD can cause meningitis and, rarely, death. A 3-year-old with vesicles on hands and feet may indicate HFMD, especially with mouth ulcers, poor appetite, and drooling, though vesicles also occur in allergy, eczema, chickenpox, or shingles. Chickenpox (varicella) spreads easily by respiratory routes or contact with vesicle fluid, with about 90% of susceptible individuals infected after close exposure, notably in nurseries or within families. Parents should seek medical evaluation, avoid unverified home remedies, and maintain hygiene; monitor fever, lethargy, or irritability for hospital care. Varicella vaccine is approved; first dose from 9 months, two-dose schedule; efficacy >97%. HFMD vaccine is approved by the Ministry of Health; VNVC is pursuing deployment.

triage.headline_ja: 水疱性発疹は手足口病か？
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムのホーチミン市で手足口病（HFMD）が流行期を迎えており、週1,000件以上の症例が報告されている。異常性と流行傾向は認められるが、情報源が単一の医療教育記事であり、新規の重大な発生状況の確認が不十分。
triage.notes: 記事はベトナムホーチミン市のHFMDとVaricelaについて、症状鑑別と予防接種情報を提供する医療教育記事。流行期を迎えており、5歳未満の高リスク集団への影響が指摘されている。ワクチン展開状況は「進行中」との記載。国家レベルでの緊急対応の必要性や国際的拡大については現時点では明記されていない。継続観察により、症例数増加傾向や地域外への拡大の確認が必要。

article.articleSummary: Two people were killed yesterday in central Kenya during a protest against the United States' plan to establish an Ebola quarantine center at a nearby military base. The circumstances of the deaths were not immediately clear. Kenyan President William Ruto defended the plan as part of national preparedness and a long-standing health partnership with Washington. Kenya had approved the request last week to set up the center at an air force base in Kenya for Americans possibly exposed to Ebola. Residents near Nanyuki fear community exposure and question why Kenya would host a quarantine facility for Americans; protests could lead to legal action to block the plan. Separately, the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda face Ebola Bundibugyo outbreaks with 48 deaths. Ruto said Kenya has isolation, surveillance and treatment facilities in 23 counties and tightened border controls, screening about 3,000 people daily, with no Ebola cases detected in Kenya.

About 30,000–40,000 people are expected at a mid-June international private gathering in Taiwan, with over 400 participants from DRC/Uganda planning to travel, prompting tightened border controls to curb importation risk. Experts emphasize Ebola is largely local-endemic and not a global pandemic, and domestic risk remains low due to limited international travel.

article.articleHeadline: Nipah in India: Why Kerala and West Bengal face the same virus but different outbreak risks
article.articleSummary: Two healthcare workers in Barasat, West Bengal, tested positive for Nipah virus in January 2026; the infection traced to a 55-year-old woman who consumed raw date palm sap from a local vendor. She died of ARDS and multi-organ failure. Genomic sequencing showed a 99% match with Bangladesh genotype 2022, confirming hospital-acquired transmission. The event reinforces findings that Nipah, carried by Pteropus bats, produces divergent outbreak patterns in India. Kerala experiences more spillovers but typically small, contained clusters due to strong surveillance and a One Health approach; West Bengal experiences fewer spillovers, but outbreaks have historically been healthcare-associated. West Bengal had AES/ARI surveillance with 10 VRDLs; 196 contacts tested negative. Kerala has invested in triage, PPE, rapid isolation, and a 17-lab network since 2024. First West Bengal outbreak 2001 Siliguri with 66 cases and CFR 68.2; nearly 75% of infections occurred among healthcare workers and visitors. Nadia district 2007 palm-product link.

article.articleHeadline: 3 Ebola vaccines being developed amid outbreak in Africa
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-02, the Bundibugyo-strain Ebola outbreak is centered in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with nearly 250 deaths and over 1,000 suspected cases; nine confirmed infections have been recorded in neighbouring Uganda. The flare-up emerged after crossing a conflict zone with limited healthcare resources, prompting fears of becoming the largest outbreak since West Africa’s 2014–16 epidemic (about 29,000 cases, 11,000 deaths). article.articleHeadline: Two Killed in Nanyuki Protests Over U.S. Ebola Facility
article.articleSummary: Two people were killed during protests in Nanyuki, Kenya, on Monday, June 1, over plans to establish a U.S.-funded Ebola quarantine facility at Laikipia Air Base. The deaths were confirmed on Tuesday, June 2, with circumstances unclear and no official NPS statement yet. Hundreds protested health risks and demanded transparency about housing the facility in Kenya rather than the U.S., calling for its closure by June 9. article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus continues to spread in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), with 321 confirmed cases and 116 suspected cases reported by the World Health Organization as of 02 June 2026. The outbreak has caused 41 deaths and 6 recoveries in the DRC. Uganda has nine cases linked to the outbreak and one related death. The illness was declared an outbreak on 15 May; the WHO subsequently designated a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak recorded in the DRC. Cross-border transmission is being monitored, with attention to possible imported/exported cases across the Uganda-DRC border. The Bundibugyo variant is the pathogen identified in this epidemic; no details on infection source or clinical symptoms are provided in the report.

article.articleSummary: Indonesian Health Minister Budi Gunadi Sadikin stressed tightening entry screening, especially for travelers from Congo, to prevent Ebola spread. article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: MSF intensifies its response in the face of the rapid expansion of the outbreak - ACP
article.articleSummary: MSF intensifies its Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of Congo as Bundibugyo virus drives outbreaks in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu. In Ituri, the epicenter, MSF is building and operating Ebola Treatment Centers (CTEs), including a 65-bed unit at Mongbwalu and a Bunia center with up to 36 beds, and is supporting isolation and care for suspected cases in Mongbwalu, Fataki, and Bunia. The true scale remains hard to gauge due to extremely limited testing and restricted access, with hundreds of samples awaiting analysis. In North Kivu, MSF runs an 80-bed CTE in Goma and is strengthening isolation capacity in Goma, Walikale, Mweso, Rutshuru, Butembo and surrounding areas. In South Kivu, teams are establishing CTEs in Bukavu and Lwiro and training health workers in infection prevention and control. Transportation restrictions hinder rapid deployment and limit capacity improvements.

article.articleHeadline: Ministry of Heath rolls out second round of polio vaccination campaign
article.articleSummary: Second round of Zimbabwe's novel Oral Polio Vaccine Type 2 (nOPV2) campaign runs from 2026-06-02 to 2026-06-05, targeting all children under five (0–59 months). The synchronized regional effort responds to the outbreak of circulating vaccine-derived poliovirus type 2 detected in Malawi, with involvement from Malawi, Zambia, Mozambique and Botswana. Vaccination teams will move door-to-door and operate at shopping centres to reach every eligible child; every targeted child should receive two drops of nOPV2, even if previously vaccinated. Poliomyelitis is highly infectious, primarily affecting children under five; transmission is mainly fecal-oral via contaminated water or food, and the virus can invade the nervous system, causing paralysis. Zimbabwe seeks to maintain polio-free status and align with regional/global eradication efforts, urging community cooperation with vaccination campaigns.

article.articleHeadline: The Chagas disease time bomb in Latin America's cities
article.articleSummary: Chagas disease (Trypanosoma cruzi) threatens about six million people across Latin America, now a “ticking time bomb” as urban transmission rises beyond rural habitats. The parasite, carried by triatomine bugs, spreads via rural vectoring, contaminated food (notably acai juice in Brazil), blood transfusions, and congenital mother-to-child transmission. About 30% of infections progress to serious cardiac complications (stroke, arrhythmia, heart failure) decades after initial infection, with heart muscle deterioration driving late symptoms such as breathlessness. Diagnosis is often incidental (blood donation, pregnancy, organ transplants); only roughly 10–20% of infected individuals are diagnosed, leaving 80–90% undetected. Congenital transmission accounts for a growing share of new cases (5–10% of pregnancies from infected mothers). Bolivia reports 80–115 new cases per 100,000 annually; Brazil experiences substantial oral transmission, over half of acute cases. Treatments (benznidazole, nifurtimox) are highly effective if started early but require long courses with notable side effects and adherence challenges, underscoring gaps in screening and maternal testing programs across the region.

As of 2 June 2026, India has zero active Ebola cases, but authorities have strengthened surveillance amid continued spread in parts of Africa. Travelers who have visited or transited through Ebola-affected regions in the last 21 days should self-isolate if they develop fever, headache, muscle pain, vomiting, diarrhea, or unexplained bleeding, and notify local health authorities. Early symptoms can include fever, fatigue, malaise, muscle aches, sore throat; later stages may involve vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, rashes, liver-kidney issues, and bleeding. Quick reporting can save lives and curb transmission. A 24/7 health helpline is available: 1075. Health workers are instructed to monitor symptoms and remain ready.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Court ruling shocks Washington: Kenyan judges prevent Ebola treatment in a U.S. field hospital.
article.articleSummary: On June 2, 2026, a Kenyan court suspended the Trump administration's plan to establish a provisional Ebola field hospital at a U.S. base in Kenya's Laikipia to isolate and treat Americans exposed to or infected with Ebola. The facility, for up to 50 patients, was linked to the Congo-centered outbreak; authorities say suspected cases exceed 1,000 with about 250 deaths. Critics, including Dr. Craig Spencer, argue the policy reflects fear more than medical need. A physician evacuated from Congo was treated in Prague. The court also barred entry of Ebola-affected individuals and halted the field hospital until review.
